[h2=mini-games][b]Multiplayer Mini-games[/b][/h2][list][*]Six new mini-games have been added to the mini-game menu.[list][*]These mini-games are based on past events that Milletians have played over the years.[/*][*]The mini-games menu can be accessed by pressing the ▲ button on the right side of the bottom menu icon and selecting the mini-game button.[/*][/list][/*][*]The new mini-games are:[table noborder=1][tr][td][list][*][b]Round-the-World Race[/b][list][*][i]Roll for initiative. You and your pet must make it around the board before your opponent and their pet - be prepared to duel it out and pray the dice rolls are in your favor.[/i][/*][/list][/*][*][b]Gesture Showdown[/b][list][*][i]Compete against your friends in a no-stakes game of copying gestures.[/i][/*][/list][/*][*][b]Code Cracker (Multiplayer)[/b][list][*][i]Wanted to prove you were smarter than your friends in Code Cracker? Now’s your chance![/i][/*][/list][/*][*][b]Wild Stampede[/b][list][*][i]As the old saying goes, you don't have to outrun the animals, you just have to outrun your friend!.[/i][/*][/list][/*][*][b]Snowball Fight[/b][list][*][i]Powerups? Dragons? Fireballs? I thought this was a friendly game of Snowball Fighting!?[/i][/*][/list][/*][*][b]Paper Flip (Ttakji)[/b][list][*][i]Best known from the hit Erinn Crystal Ball Show Squid Mini-game, flip the paper and win![/i][/*][/list][/list][/td][td width=15%][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/mthjmesv/mini-game-icons-v2.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table][*]A Mini-game High Score tracker has been added to keep track of personal accomplishments.[list][*]Total Win/Loss are not recorded.[/*][/list][/*][*]24 New Journal Achievements have been added for the multiplayer mini-games:[list][*]All new Journal Achievements are worth 1 point each.[/*][/list][/list]

[h2=pet-changes][b]Pet Changes[/b][/h2]
[h3=web-shop][b]Web Shop Reorganization:[/b][/h3]
[i]As part of our ongoing effort to improve the Web Shop and provide fairer monetization, this month we’re relocating pets, updating prices, and more![/i]
[list][*]The following pets and pet packages will be [b]removed[/b] from the Web Shop:[list][*]Adelie Penguin[/*][*]Alaskan Husky[/*][*]Black Cotton Ostrich[/*][*]Black Mud Crab[/*][*]Black Seal[/*][*]Black Wolf[/*][*]Black and White Ferret Package[/*][*]Blue Elephant[/*][*]Border Collie[/*][*]Brown Fox[/*][*]Clover Gnu[/*][*]Clover Pig[/*][*]Coral Cobra[/*][*]Dalmatian[/*][*]Dapple Thunder Spaniel[/*][*]Desert Cobra[/*][*]Eagle Owl[/*][*]Emperor Penguin[/*][*]Falcon[/*][*]Goldfinch[/*][*]Gray Wolf[/*][*]Green Gecko[/*][*]Guardian Spider[/*][*]Haflinger[/*][*]Hamster[/*][*]Himalayan[/*][*]Japanese Bobtail[/*][*]Jungle Scout Imp[/*][*]Kangaroo Rat[/*][*]Kingfisher[/*][*]Labrador Retriever[/*][*]Laghodessa[/*][*]Lava Walker Imp[/*][*]Lime Sprite[/*][*]Magic Carpet[/*][*]Malamute[/*][*]Mini Bear[/*][*]Oak Magic Broom[/*][*]Orange Pixie[/*][*]Persian[/*][*]Pitta[/*][*]Polar Bear[/*][*]Red Panda[/*][*]Red Rock Crab[/*][*]Short Horned Lizard[/*][*]Siamese[/*][*]Silver Fox[/*][*]Snowy Owl[/*][*]White Elephant[/*][*]White Flame Spider[/*][*]White Jindo[/*][*]White Seal[/*][*]White Sheep [/*][*]Cow[/*][*]White Thunder Spaniel[/*][*]White Tiger Cub[/*][*]Wooden Mimic[/*][*]Yellow Jindo[/*][*]Yellow Tiger Cub[/*][/list][/*][*]The following pets will have their [b]prices adjusted[/b] and will be [b]re-added[/b] to the Web Shop permanently:[list][*][b]Scooter Imp[/b][list][*]Old Price: 14,900 NX[/*][*]New Price: [b]12,700 NX[/b][/*][/list][/*][*][b]Flying Food Truck[/b]
[list][*]Old Price: 14,900 NX[/*][*]New Price: [b]12,700 NX[/b][/*][/list][/*][*][b]Fire Dragon[/b]
[list][*]Old Price: 16,100 NX[/*][*]New Price: [b]8,700 NX[/b][/*][/list][/*][*][b]Thunder Dragon[/b]
[list][*]Old Price: 16,900 NX[/*][*]New Price: [b]8,700 NX[/b][/*][/list][/*][*][b]Ice Dragon[/b]
[list][*]Old Price: 16,900 NX[/*][*]New Price: [b]9,100 NX[/b][/*][/list][/*][*][b]Thunder Dragon (2-Seater)[/b]
[list][*]Old Price: 16,900 NX[/*][*]New Price: [b]9,100 NX[/b][/*][/list][/*][*][b]Thoroughbred[/b]
[list][*]Old Price: 10,900 NX[/*][*]New Price: [b]5,800 NX[/b][/*][/list][/*][*][b]Lemongrass Flora[/b]
[list][*]Old Price: 12,000 NX[/*][*]New Price: [b]9,600 NX[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]All Pets purchased through the Web Shop will now be added as a Pet Whistle to your Cash Shop Inventory instead of a Pet Character Card.
[list][*]Unused Pet Character Cards can still be used as normal from the Character Selection Screen.[/*][/list][/*][*]There are no changes made to Partners.[/*][/list]
[h3=shamala][b]Shamala's Pet Shop:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Shamala will be opening her own shop for Milletians to purchase old pets that have been sold in the past.[/*][*]All pets sold will be in the form of a Pet Whistle and purchasable with Pon.[list][*]Pon is available for purchase through the [url=https://www.nexon.com/mabinogi/shop/webshop/detail/cash/138486]Web Shop[/url].[/*][/list][/*][*]The following pets and their prices are as follows:[/*][/list][table][tr][th]Pet[/th][th]Price (Pon)[/th][/tr][tr][td]Adelie Penguin[/td][td]30[/td][/tr][tr][td]Albino King Snake[/td][td]30[/td][/tr][tr][td]Beyaya[/td][td]30[/td][/tr][tr][td]Bluebird[/td][td]30[/td][/tr][tr][td]Cow[/td][td]30[/td][/tr][tr][td]Desert Cobra[/td][td]30[/td][/tr][tr][td]Golden Retriever[/td][td]30[/td][/tr][tr][td]Goldfinch[/td][td]30[/td][/tr][tr][td]Gray Wolf[/td][td]30[/td][/tr][tr][td]Green Gecko[/td][td]30[/td][/tr][tr][td]Himalayan[/td][td]30[/td][/tr][tr][td]Kangaroo Rat[/td][td]30[/td][/tr][tr][td]Pitta[/td][td]30[/td][/tr][tr][td]Reindeer[/td][td]30[/td][/tr][tr][td]White Hedgehog[/td][td]30[/td][/tr][tr][td]White Jindo[/td][td]30[/td][/tr][tr][td]Bengal[/td][td]40[/td][/tr][tr][td]Blue Elephant[/td][td]40[/td][/tr][tr][td]Bombay[/td][td]40[/td][/tr][tr][td]Bull[/td][td]40[/td][/tr][tr][td]Crow[/td][td]40[/td][/tr][tr][td]Falcon[/td][td]40[/td][/tr][tr][td]Ghost Crab[/td][td]40[/td][/tr][tr][td]Laghodessa[/td][td]40[/td][/tr][tr][td]Lime Sprite[/td][td]40[/td][/tr][tr][td]Silver Fox[/td][td]40[/td][/tr][tr][td]Tiger Cub[/td][td]40[/td][/tr][tr][td]White Seal[/td][td]40[/td][/tr][tr][td]Albino Tiger[/td][td]50[/td][/tr][tr][td]Brown Ostrich[/td][td]50[/td][/tr][tr][td]Cheetah[/td][td]50[/td][/tr][tr][td]Griffin[/td][td]50[/td][/tr][tr][td]Lesser Panda[/td][td]50[/td][/tr][tr][td]Magic Carpet[/td][td]50[/td][/tr][tr][td]Mini Skeleton[/td][td]50[/td][/tr][tr][td]Monkey[/td][td]50[/td][/tr][tr][td]Rainbow Sprite[/td][td]50[/td][/tr][tr][td]Shire[/td][td]50[/td][/tr][/table]
[h2=fantasy-life][b]Fantasy Life Changes[/b][/h2]
[list][*]Unvisited Mana Tunnels and Moon Gates will be semi-transparent until visited for the first time.[img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/hrajw0az/mana-tunnel-map-merged.png[/img]
[*]Right-clicking an item will now list options to search and list the item on the Auction House.[/*][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/zqoas4m3/right-click-menu.png[/img]
[*]When searching the Auction House: Pet Adoption Medals, Blacksmith Manuals, and Sewing Patterns will contain the full name.[/*][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/g0pf5luw/auction-house-improvement.png[/img]
[*]Preset Character Models have been refreshed for new accounts and premium character cards during character creation.[/*][*]The pop-up box will no longer appear when attempting to enter a dungeon room where a battle is active.[/*][*]When changing channels, you can now double-click the channel name in the list to move.[/*][*]Two new functions have been added to items when the Inventory Magnifying Glass window is open:
[list][*]You can preview weapons, clothing/armor, and chairs.
You can search items directly that are listable on the Auction House.[/*][/list][/*][*]The Auction House has added security measures to assist with your daily trading and shopping:
[list][*]The warning message has been enhanced to give more notice when attempting to purchase or sell an item 90+% higher or lower than the average price.[/*][*]Warning messages have been added when attempting to purchase non-repairable items that have 20% or less durability/use.[/*][/list][/*][*]Options for Hair Styles, Eye Shapes, Faces, and Mouths have been revised in the Dressing Room so the most recent additions will appear at the top.[/*][*]Sick of having to go outdoors to warp? We are too… so we’ve addressed that! You can now warp indoors when using the following warp functions:
[list][*]The Arcana Room via your Character UI Menu.[/*][*]Festia via your Character UI Menu.[/*][*]Doki Doki Island via the Soulmate UI Menu.[/*][*]The Star Citadel via skill use.[/*][*]Guild Hall via the Guild Hall UI Menu.[/*][*]Event NPCs through the Event UI Menu.[/*][/list][/*][*][url=https://discord.com/channels/278742874097582081/1317970922715742268]Feedback heard![/url] We’ve updated the Astral Reave Dan Tests to be slightly less difficult. You will now receive 35 points instead of 30 when attacking an enemy with Astral Reave.[/*][*]Additional search fields have had their case sensitivity removed:[list][*]Guild UI Menu[/*][*]Point Inventory[/*][*]Party Board[/*][*]Production Crafting Lists[/*][*]Bard Bulletin[/*][/list][/*][*]When picking up equipment from the ground, the logic has been modified so it will no longer be equipped to the character’s style tab automatically.
[list][*]The equipment can still be automatically slotted into the character’s equipment tab as normal if the equipment tab slot is empty.[/*][/list][/*][*]The following appearance scrolls have been renamed to indicate that they are applied onto two-handed axes, not scythes, despite visually being scythes:
[list][*]Moonshadow Emissary's Scythe Appearance Scroll -> Moonshadow Emissary's Scythe Appearance Scroll (2H Axe)[/*][*]Duskveil Emissary's Scythe Appearance Scroll -> Duskveil Emissary's Scythe Appearance Scroll (2H Axe)[/*][*]Frost Great Scythe Appearance Scroll -> Frost Great Scythe Appearance Scroll (2H Axe)[/*][/list][/*][*]Following the Magic Attack Changes in July, adjustments to ease the difficulty have been made to most RP missions where the Magic Talent is a focus.[/*][*][Element] Alchemy skills have been properly unified in name, matching the format of the current Earth Alchemy Mastery skill: 
[list][*]Fire Alchemy -> Fire Alchemy Mastery[/*][*]Wind Alchemy -> Wind Alchemy Mastery[/*][*]Water Alchemy -> Water Alchemy Mastery[/*][/list][/*][/list][h2=bug-fixes][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]
[i]We’ve been continuing to address G27 via several fixes throughout the month. Thanks for all the reports - we very much appreciate these, and we hope that you’re enjoying the story![/i]
[list][*]Zap-happy Dark Diviners with Thunderblight and specific timing could accidentally destroy the enemies during one of the G27 cutscenes, creating a time paradox where nothing further would happen! ...Until you left and tried again, that is. The enemies have been adjusted to no longer be defeated during the cutscene. [/*][*]Fixed an issue causing the game to close when previewing one of the following chairs: 
[list][*]Kanna Tanning Chair[/*][*]Eirlys Tanning Chair[/*][*]Elsie Tanning Chair[/*][*]Dai Tanning Chair[/*][*]Kaour Tanning Chair[/*][*]Logan Tanning Chair[/*][*]Shuan Tanning Chair[/*][*]Christmas Dessert Table[/*][*]Elegant Afternoon Tea Table[/*][/list][/*][*]Through your reports, we found and fixed a few more Sewing Patterns where the pattern had gone mysteriously blank.
[/*][/list]
[b]Bugs fixed during the August 28th Maintenance[/b]
[list][*]Addressed the channel lag by adding new channels and redistributing channel population capacities. See the [url=https://www.nexon.com/mabinogi/news/30036/completed-scheduled-maintenance-and-hotfix-patch-august-28th#channel-increase]August 28th Maintenance Patch Notes[/url] for the full details! [/*][*]More text fixes added for Generation 27. We're still working on our polish for this Generation based on our own playthroughs and your reports, and we're still eternally grateful! More is yet to come as this giant-sized generation is brought to heel![/*][*]As accidentally (we swear!) showcased by GM Quuku and GM Hongenjo during the Brí Leith stream, the hard cap on Protection was not set, allowing damage reduction to increase up to 100% instead of capping at 90%. This hard cap will be put in properly with this update, though this requires very high values that can be difficult or impossible for players to reach.[/*][*]In rare circumstances crafting recipes using the Destructive Crest that are expected to be 99.9% completion in one tap would incorrectly finish at less than this. Robes that were crafted in this incorrect way have been corrected automatically. [/*][*]The following armor pieces have been renamed to match their materials:[list][*]Saint Guardian's Leather Armor [M/F] -> Saint Guardian's Breastplate [M/F][/*][*]Saint Guardian's Leather Helmet [M/F] -> Saint Guardian's Battle Helmet [M/F][/*][/list][/*][*]In order to properly reflect the multiple weapons that come with it, the following weapons have been renamed:
[list][*][Dual Guns]
[list][*]Nightbringer Vanquisher -> Nightbringer Vanquishers
[Control Bars][/*][/list][/*][*]Nightbringer Trickster -> Nightbringer Tricksters
[list][*]Perseus Conflict Control Bar -> Perseus Conflict Control Bars
[Knuckles][/*][/list][/*][*]Nightbringer Vagabond -> Nightbringer Vagabonds
[list][*]Perseus Tormented Knuckle -> Perseus Tormented Knuckles[/*][/list][/*][*]Additionally in a future patch, based on feedback from the Soul Liberator weapons, we will be looking to rename the Nightbringer weapons to include the Weapon Type (ie. Nightbringer Warlord Greatsword).[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Bugs fixed during the August 21st Maintenance[/b]
[list][*]Fixed some Generation 27 typos as reported by our Milletians.[/*][/list][h2=known-bugs][b]Known Bugs[/b][/h2][list][*][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1592/bug_catching.png[/img][/*][*]An e-2 error is occasionally causing in-game Player Reports to fail to send. In the meanwhile, if you need to submit a report we ask that you use our [url=https://support-mabinogi.nexon.com/hc/en-us]Player Support website[/url].[/*][*]There are currently issues causing the Blacklist to not work as expected for some players.[/*][*]Under periodic conditions, Milletians will be temporarily unable to duel other Milletians.[/*][/list]

[b]Maintenance has concluded as of 10:30 AM PDT and the servers are available once more. We thank you for your patience.[/b]
[hr][/hr]
Mabinogi will have a scheduled maintenance on [b]August 28th[/b]. During this time, the game will be unavailable. Maintenance will begin at [b]5:00 AM PDT[/b] and is expected to last up to [b]6 hours[/b]. In addition to the below, [i]please see the [url=#patch-notes]Patch Notes[/url] section for more information[/i].
[list][*]Windows Update[/*][*]Weekly server upkeep.[/*][*]Did you find all the GMs in the [url=https://www.nexon.com/mabinogi/news/29688/summer-gm-event-2025][b]GM Hide & Seek Event[/b][/url]? The following server buffs may be active starting tomorrow:[list][*]Erg Success Rate Boost[/*][*]+2 Dungeon Guide Coins[/*][*]2x Erinn Spirit Drop Rate[/*][/list][/*][*]It's back to school in Erinn. Pick up your new uniforms in the [url=https://www.nexon.com/mabinogi/news/29875/metropolitan-high-school-box][b]Metropolitan High School Box[/b][/url]![/*][*]Last chance to acquire the looks from the [url=https://www.nexon.com/mabinogi/news/28770/celestial-eminence-box][b]Celestial Eminence Box[/b]![/url][/*][/list]
Note that the estimated length of time for each maintenance is subject to change without notification.
[h2][b]-Time-[/b][/h2]
[b]Thursday, August 28th[/b]
[list][*]Pacific (PDT, UTC -7): 5:00 AM - 11:00 AM[/*][*]Eastern (EDT, UTC -4): 8:00 AM - 2:00 PM[/*][*]Paris (CEST, UTC +2): 2:00 PM - 8:00 PM[/*][*]Sydney (AEST, UTC +10): 10:00 PM - 4:00 AM (August 29th)[/*][/list]
[b]Note:[/b] The [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/shop/namechange]Name Change submission site[/url] will be unavailable after 5:00 AM PDT time, and will be available after the maintenance.
[hr][/hr]
[h3=patch-notes][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/acuhclbs/patch-notes-1400x300.jpg[/img][/h3]
Hello Milletians!

We'll be having a mid-cycle patch with a few upcoming changes.

[b]Table of Contents:[/b]
[list][*][url=#OTR]Return of the Over the Rainbow Event[/url][/*][*][url=#channel-increase]Channel Increase and Reduction[/url][/*][*][url=#bug-fix]Bug Fixes[/url][/*][/list]
[h3=OTR][b]Return of the Over the Rainbow Event[/b][/h3]
In our [url=https://www.nexon.com/mabinogi/news/29819/notice-regarding-the-over-the-rainbow-event-august-19-2025]previous announcement[/url], we shared about the various issues that were discovered and needed to be addressed to ensure the gameplay was fair for all Milletians. The biggest issue was the efficiency in which Milletians could acquire rewards through Leprechauns, particularly Dapper. To prevent high-valued rewards from being flooded into the game's economy and ensure that the rewards still have value after the event, the following adjustments have been made:
[list][*]A weekly [b]Leprechaun Encounter Limit [/b]will be added to Uladh Hard Mode Advanced, Tech Duinn, and Crom Bás Dungeons.[list][*]Crom Bás: 10 Encounters[/*][*]Tech Duinn: 15 Encounters[/*][*]Uladh Hard Mode Advanced: 15 Encounters[/*][*]This limit functions separately from the dungeon reward limit.[/*][/list][/*][*]The weekly encounter limit will reset on [b]Thursdays at 7:00 AM PDT[/b].[/*][*]With the addition of this limit, the encounter rate for higher-grade Leprechauns has been slightly increased for both Tech Duinn and Crom Bás.[/*][*]Leprechauns will no longer spawn in the Tech Duinn - Seven Nightmares mission. Initially, a Leprechaun would spawn when Cethlenn would reach 20% health, but would cause the Leprechaun to despawn if Cethlenn was defeated.[list][*]Due to the nature of this bug and to ensure a timely return of the event, this particular Tech Duinn mission has been excluded.[/*][/list][/*][table noborder=1][tr][td][*]The [url=https://www.nexon.com/mabinogi/news/27082]Over the Rainbow Event[/url] will resume [b]this Thursday after maintenance[/b] and will be [b]extended for 2 weeks[/b] after its original end date, with the [b]new end date[/b] being October 30th (Before Maintenance).[/*][/td][td width=40%][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/doto52nn/otr-ticket.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table][/list]
We greatly apologize for the inconvenience that the temporary suspension and adjustment of the event has caused. As compensation, the following rewards will be provided via a Hotday Event for all accounts from [b]August 28th to September 11th[/b]:
[list][*][b]Service Error Compensation Box[/b] (Expires in 30 Days)[list][*]5x Unlimited Dungeon Pass Boxes (Expires in 7 Days)[list][*]Each Box contains 3x Unlimited Dungeon Passes (Expires in 7 Days)[/*][/list][/*][*]3x Holy Water of Murias (No Expiration)[list][*]Applying this item to equipment can grant a powerful random effect.[/*][*]Once applied, the equipment will be untradeable and cannot be stored in the Dressing Room unless removed.[/*][*]Please refer to our [url=https://www.nexon.com/mabinogi/news/28948/generation-27-the-garden-of-solace-update#bri-leith-rewards]Generation 27: The Garden of Solace Update Notes[/url] for more details and information.[/*][/list][/*][*]1x Mabinogi Combination VIP Service (14 Days) (No Expiration)[/*][/list][/*][*]All items received are untradeable and can only be claimed once per account.[/*][/list]
[h3=channel-increase][b]Channel Increase and Reduction[/b][/h3]
With the Summer Festival in full swing, we have noticed a significant increase in Milletians both joining for the first time and returning to Erinn! [url=https://www.nexon.com/mabinogi/news/28948/generation-27-the-garden-of-solace-update#known-bugs]As mentioned previously[/url], we are aware that these growing pains are not without issues, particularly lag amongst all channels. 

In this upcoming maintenance, our first update aimed at addressing the recent performance will be taking place:
[list][*]3 new channels will be added to the server, for a total of 13 channels.[list][*]Channel 11[/*][*]Channel 12[/*][*]Channel 13[/*][/list][/*][*]Adjusting the channel population to be uniform for all channels.[/*][/list]
While these adjustments are just an initial step, we will continue to share about the changes made to the game. In the weeks following we will be monitoring these changes and these new channels for stability and overall improvements. Following changes to be made include improvements to the server hardware, the inclusion of more channels as needed, and more as our changes uncover other issues or point us towards areas of greater focus. 

Thank you for your patience as we continue to make further adjustments as necessary to bring you the best Mabinogi.

[h3=bug-fix][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]
[list][*]More text fixes added for Generation 27. We're still working on our polish for this Generation based on our own playthroughs and your reports, and we're still eternally grateful! More is yet to come as this giant-sized generation is brought to heel![/*][*]As accidentally [i](we swear!)[/i] showcased by GM Quuku and GM Hongenjo during the Brí Leith stream, the hard cap on Protection was not set, allowing damage reduction to increase up to 100% instead of capping at 90%. This hard cap will be put in properly with this update, though this requires very high values that can be difficult or impossible for players to reach.[/*][*]In rare circumstances crafting recipes using the Destructive Crest that are expected to be 99.9% completion in one tap would incorrectly finish at less than this. This issue has been corrected, and any players who encountered this issue are encouraged to contact [url=https://support-mabinogi.nexon.com/hc/en-us]Player Support[/url] to have their robe corrected.[/*][*]The following armor pieces have been renamed to match their materials:[list][*]Saint Guardian's Leather Armor [M/F] -> Saint Guardian's Breastplate [M/F][/*][*]Saint Guardian's Leather Helmet [M/F] -> Saint Guardian's Battle Helmet [M/F][/*][/list][/*][*]In order to properly reflect the multiple weapons that come with it, the following weapons have been renamed:[list][*][Dual Guns][list][*]Nightbringer Vanquisher -> Nightbringer Vanquishers[/*][/list][/*][*][Control Bars][list][*]Nightbringer Trickster -> Nightbringer Tricksters[/*][*]Perseus Conflict Control Bar -> Perseus Conflict Control Bars[/*][/list][/*][*][Knuckles][list][*]Nightbringer Vagabond -> Nightbringer Vagabonds[/*][/list][/*][*]Perseus Tormented Knuckle -> Perseus Tormented Knuckles[/*][/list][/*][*]Additionally in a future patch, based on feedback from the Soul Liberator weapons, we will be looking to rename the Nightbringer weapons to include the Weapon Type.[/*][/list]

[i]- The Mabinogi Team[/i]

[h2=generation-27][b]Generation 27: The Garden of Solace[/b][/h2]
Word travels across the land as Divine Beasts begin to appear once again. This time, however, rumors spread of a mysterious warrior who claims they can solve any problem that the famous Milletian can…
[table noborder=1][tr][td][list][*]Generation 27: The Garden of Solace has been added.[list][*]Players who have completed Generation 26 will automatically receive the quest [b]The Sign of the Comet[/b].[/*][*]Players who have not completed Generation 26, but have reached at least Cumulative Level 5,000, will receive a window notification that the storyline is available for them to start if they so choose. [list][*]You may start the storyline by clicking the “Start G27 The Garden of Solace” button in the Storyline Menu.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Korean voiceover has been added to all characters in the story. [list][*]You can adjust the volume of the voices through the Options menu by going to the following: [list][*]Options → System →Sound → Voice Volume[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][/td][td width=30%][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/yhxcpaox/g27-story-message-ui.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table][list][*]Completing Generation 27 Part 1 will reward the player with the following:[list][*]Sister's Flower Crown[/*][/list][/*][*]Completing Generation 27 Part 2 will grant the player with the following:: [list][*]Brí Leith Dungeon unlocked[/*][*]who Recalls the Unfading Garden title[/*][*]Solace Prefix Enchant[/*][/list][list][*]Acquire the Garden of Solace Collection Book to further enhance your MabiNovels by talking to Declan at the East Wind Camp in Port Ceann.[/*][*]Invite a G27 NPC to the Campfire Spirit.[/*][*]Revisit Generation 27 cutscenes by watching them anytime through the Crystal Ball in the Dunbarton Library.[/*][/list][/*][*]9 BGMs related to the G27: The Garden of Solace campaign have been added to the Jukeboxes for your Homestead and Moonlight Island.[list][*]These songs can be unlocked through the C1-C7 Replay Reward Boxes.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h2=bri-leith-dungeon][b]Brí Leith Dungeon[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Entry Details[/b] [img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/554fnkwr/bri-leith-dungeon-pass.png[/img][/h3]
[list][*]Entry will be available through the Gate of Murias located at the Longa Desert Oasis in Connous.[/*][*]Dungeon Entry Conditions:[list][*]Generation 27 completed.[/*][*]Cumulative Level 20,000 or higher.[/*][*]Arcana Total Level 200 or higher.[/*][/list][/*][*]A minimum of 1 to a maximum of 8 party members can enter the dungeon.[/*][*]Each party member must have a [b]Bri Leith Dungeon Pass[/b] to enter.[/*][*]You may purchase passes from the NPC outside the dungeon Entrance Portal.
[list][*]The price of purchasing a pass will increase depending on the number of passes you purchase during the week.[list][*]These prices are applied [b]account-wide[/b].[/*][*]Purchased Dungeon Passes are good for 7 days.[/*][/list][/*][*]Dungeon Pass prices will reset every [b]Thursday at 7:00 AM Server Time[/b].[/*][/list][/*][/list][table center=1][tr][th]Number of Passes Purchased[/th][th]Price (in Gold)[/th][/tr][tr][td]1[/td][td]100,000[/td][/tr][tr][td]2[/td][td]200,000[/td][/tr][tr][td]3[/td][td]400,000[/td][/tr][tr][td]4[/td][td]700,000[/td][/tr][tr][td]5[/td][td]1,000,000[/td][/tr][tr][td]6[/td][td]2,000,000[/td][/tr][tr][td]7[/td][td]3,000,000[/td][/tr][tr][td]8[/td][td]5,000,000[/td][/tr][tr][td]9[/td][td]7,000,000[/td][/tr][tr][td]10[/td][td]10,000,000[/td][/tr][tr][td]11+[/td][td]50,000,000[/td][/tr][/table]
[h3][b]Retry & Checkpoints[/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]Retry[/b][list][*]During battle, the party has the option to restart the current battle from the beginning by pressing the [RETRY] button at the top right of the screen.[/*][*]All players in the party must press the button to restart.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Checkpoint[/b][list][*]Allows the party to continue where they left off in the dungeon.[/*][*]After defeating a boss, a checkpoint save menu will appear, allowing you to save your status in the dungeon and re-enter at a later time.[list][*]The checkpoint save will last until you’ve completed the next boss/cleared the dungeon, or canceled it outside at the gate.[/*][/list][/*][*]A new Dungeon Pass is required when exiting and re-entering the dungeon where you left off.[/*][*]When entering the dungeon through a checkpoint, ALL party members must be at the same checkpoint.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h3][b]Revival Restrictions[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Party members can be revived [b]once[/b] per battle stage.[list][*]Harmonic Saint’s Steadfast Soul ability can bypass this limit, allowing for a second revival for themselves.[/*][*]The limit is reset upon retrying or winning the battle.[/*][*]If all party members are incapacitated, the battle will automatically restart, regardless of the number of revivals the party has remaining.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h3][b]Time Limit[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Each stage of the dungeon has a set time limit.[/*][*]Should the fight exceed the time limit, the current battle will end and automatically be retried.[/*][/list]
[h3][b]Reward Distribution[/b][/h3]
[list][*]After defeating each stage of the dungeon, the party will be rewarded with [b]one[/b] treasure chest.[list][*]See [url=#bri-leith-rewards][b]Brí Leith Dungeon Reward Details[/b][/url] section for more details on the rewards themselves.[/*][/list][/*][*]At first, the treasure chest can only be opened by the party leader.[list][*]If the party leader does not open it after 30 seconds, anyone in the party can open the treasure chest.[/*][/list][/*][*]Upon opening the treasure chest, a special reward distribution UI will appear listing all the rewards that can be distributed to all party members currently in the dungeon.[list][*]If a party member happens to re-enter the dungeon after the chest has been opened, they will be ineligible for reward distribution.[/*][/list][/*][*]Each eligible party member will roll the dice (1 to 100) for each item. The party member with the highest roll will win that item.[list][*]If two or more winning party members rolled the same number on an item, a second tie-breaker roll will be initiated to break the tie.[/*][/list][/*][*]If you move to another location or exit the dungeon during the reward distribution, all items except for the ones you’ve already won will be automatically “passed over”.[/*][*]If a solo party opens the treasure chest, a reward choice UI will appear, allowing the player to select which items they’d like to discard/keep rather than the party reward distribution UI.[/*][/list]
[h3][b]Other[/b][/h3]
[list][*]A cooldown period of 30 seconds is applied when consuming a potion in the dungeon.[/*][*]Party members can only re-enter the dungeon when the party is not currently fighting a boss.[/*][/list]
[h2=bri-leith-rewards][b]Brí Leith Rewards[/b][/h2]
[i]Many new rewards have been added, allowing you to further empower your gear, Arcanas, and craft the most powerful weapons ever seen in Erinn - Soul Liberator weapons.[/i]
[list][*]Rewards can be obtained after defeating each boss in the dungeon.[list][*]With each boss defeated, each party member is guaranteed the following rewards:[list][*]Trace of Memory[/*][*]Holy Water of Murias (Not Tradeable)[/*][/list][/*][*]Further rewards are distributed through the reward distribution UI.[/*][*]Neither EXP nor Gold are awarded in the dungeon.[/*][/list][/*][table noborder=1][tr][td][*]Defeating each of the 3 dungeon bosses will reward you with a Journal Achievement[list][*]Bri Leith - Defeat Vertrag of the Deep Roots (10 points)[/*][*]Bri Leith - Defeat Bronntanas (20 points)[/*][*]Bri Leith - Defeat [Final Boss] (30 points)[/*][/list][/*][/td][td][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/cpvmeowq/bri-leith-journal-achievements.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table][*]Multiple titles are available to earn throughout the dungeon:[list][*]who Broke the Comet’s Orbit[list][*]Movement Speed +3%[/*][/list][/*][*]who Trampled the Trampler[list][*]Movement Speed +3%[/*][/list][/*][*]the Ender of Euphoria[list][*]Movement Speed +3%[/*][/list][/*][*]the Agony and the Ecstasy[list][*]Max Damage +33[/*][*]Magic Attack +55[/*][*]Defense +30[/*][*]Magic Defense +30[/*][*]Protection +15[/*][*]Magic Protection +15[/*][*]Movement Speed +2%[/*][/list][/*][*]whose Memories Shall Never Fade[list][*]Max Damage +33[/*][*]Magic Attack +55[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h3=holy-water][b]Holy Water of Murias[/b][/h3]
[table noborder=1][tr][td][list][*]The following items have been added:[list][*]Bri Leith Cascading Water[/*][*]Elixir of Reality[/*][*]Holy Water of Murias[/*][*]Holy Water of Murias Cleansing Scroll[/*][/list][/*][/list][/td][td][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/ccphbqqn/holy-water-murias.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table][list][*]Similar to Holy Flame, applying Holy Water of Murias will grant new [h2=destructive-robe][b]Destructive Robe Changes[/b][/h2][list][*]Four new robes have been added as a “stepping stone” for crafting a Destructive Robe:[list][*]Void Robe (M)[/*][*]Void Robe (F)[list][*]The Void Robes have Piercing Level 1.[/*][/list][/*][*]Abyssal Robe (M)[/*][*]Abyssal Robe (F)
[list][*]The Abyssal Robes have Piercing Level 2.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Six new Sewing Patterns for Tailoring have been added and can be found in the Dead-End Hallway Chests of Rundal Advanced Hardmode, Rundal Advanced, and Peaca Intermediate dungeons:[list][*]Sewing Pattern - Void Robe (M)[/*][*]Sewing Pattern - Void Robe (F)[/*][*]Sewing Pattern - Abyssal Robe (M)[/*][*]Sewing Pattern - Abyssal Robe (F)[/*][*]Sewing Pattern - Destructive Robe (M) (Upgrade Only)[/*][*]Sewing Pattern - Void Robe (F) (Upgrade Only)[/*][/list][/*][*]A new item, Destructive Crest, has been added:[list][*]This new item will be required for the Abyssal and Destructive Robes (Upgrade Path).[/*][*]The Destructive Crest can be crafted through Handicrafting.[/*][/list][/*][*]The number of dyeing channels for the Destructive Robe (M) and (F) have been improved from 4 to 6.[/*][/list][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/np1incrp/mabinogi_2025_08_05_125615.png[/img]

[h2=fantasy-life][b]Fantasy Life Changes[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Bag Tag Improvements[/b][/h3]
[table noborder=1 equalcells=1][tr][td][list][*]We’ve added MORE tags to better help you filter your inventory space![list][*]Star Reflections[/*][*]Shyllien[/*][*]Hillwen[/*][*]Homestead[/*][*]Glyphs[/*][*]Checks[/*][*]Music Scrolls[/*][*]Alban Knights[/*][*]Expiring Items[/*][/list][/*][*]When minimizing a bag, the icons you’ve selected will now remain listed.[/*][*]The Fynni Gems tag now includes Fynni Whistles.[/*][/list][/td][td][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/5fyip0sa/updated-bag-tag-list.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table]
[h3][b]Improved NPC Searching[/b][/h3]
[list][*]A new UI window has been added to search for any available NPC throughout Erinn.[list][*]This menu is accessible by clicking the “NPC Search” button on the mini-map.[/*][*]Click the NPC on the list to automatically move to the relevant Mana Tunnel/Moon Gate or go on foot.[/*][/list][/*][/list][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/kuvgnrr1/npc-search-window.png[/img]
[h3][b]Other Misc. Changes:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The delay when using the Thunder Skill has been reduced significantly further.[/*][list][*][url=https://cms.nexon.net/media/ggobtora/thunder-before-and-after-august-patch-v3.mp4]Before/After Comparison[/url][/*][/list][*]With the release of Generation 27, Veteran Mercenary Fedelm has added two new items to her Master Plan Event Main Shop. These rare relics are only available upon completing Generation 27 during this Master Plan Event, so don’t delay![list][*]Homestead Murias Apple Tree[/*][*]Homestead Murias Ground Floor Small Arch[/*][/list][/*][*]Enhanced Mana Bullet has been added for Dual Guns.[list][*]This new powerful bullet can be crafted through Magic Crafting.[/*][*]Attack +50[/*][*]Maximum Stack Size: 5000[/*][/list][/*][*]The tooltip has been updated to show the RBG values of item pouches.[/*][*]In order to encompass the new Murias Relics, texts that previously indicated Falias Relics as the category name, such as the Auction House category, have been renamed to Divine Relics.[/*][*]In order to better indicate that they are magically replenishing, the infinite-use Arrow items have been renamed to include a pluralization. With the inclusion of the infinite use Soul Liberator Eternal Bolts, one Bolt has also been renamed:[list][*]Demolition Breaker Arrow → Demolition Breaker Arrows[/*][*]Arrow of Ruination → Arrows of Ruination[/*][*]Perseus Voiceless Arrow→ Perseus Voiceless Arrows[/*][*]Handmade Bolts → Handmade Bolt[/*][/list][/*][*]The item descriptions for the various Mana Bullets have had their format unified.[/*][*]The following items have been renamed:[list][*]Melodic Metal Board → Melodic Metal Plate[/*][*]Falias Rain Drop → Falias Raindrops[/*][/list][/*][/list]

[i]Over the next few months, we’ll be overhauling the Web Shop to better suit Milletian needs and desires per all your wonderful feedback in our survey earlier this year. Starting this month, the following changes have been made:[/i]
[table noborder=1][tr][td][list][*]The following items have been [b]added[/b] to the Web Shop:[list][*]Rainbow Name/Chat Color Change Box[/*][*]2x Skill Training Potion Selection Box[list][*]Open to select a [Talent] Skill 2x EXP Potion (1 Day)[/*][/list][/*][*]Age Potion Selection Box[list][*]Open to select an Age Potion (Ages 9 to 19)[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]The following items have been [b]removed[/b] from the Web Shop:[list][*]Crusader Skill 2x EXP Potion (1 Day)[/*][*]Chain Slash 2x EXP Potion (1 Day)[/*][*]Ninja Skill 2x EXP Potion (1 Day)[/*][*]Puppeteer Skill 2x EXP Potion (1 Day)[/*][*]Music Skill 2x EXP Potion (1 Day)[/*][*]Fighter Skill 2x EXP Potion (1 Day)[/*][*]Dual Gun Skill 2x EXP Potion (1 Day)[/*][*]Alchemy Skill 2x EXP Potion (1 Day)[/*][*]Magic Skill 2x EXP Potion (1 Day)[/*][*]Combat Skill 2x EXP Potion (1 Day)[/*][*]Life Skill 2x EXP Potion (1 Day)[/*][*]Age Potion - Age 10[/*][*]Age Potion - Age 11[/*][*]Age Potion - Age 12[/*][*]Age Potion - Age 13[/*][*]Age Potion - Age 14[/*][*]Age Potion - Age 15[/*][*]Age Potion - Age 16[/*][*]Age Potion - Age 17[/*][*]Age Potion - Age 18[/*][/list][/*][/list][/td][td width=35%][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/5xonndnz/aug-shop-items.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table]
[h2=bug-fixes][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]
[i]This is a fix-heavy patch, with some unmentioned smaller text fixes, as we continue to polish Mabinogi to a shine. There is a lot of text in this update (like last month!), and while we hope as ever that there aren't any issues, we aim to fix any that do get reported by you with expedience! ♥[/i]
[list][*]Adjusted the song answers for Musical Math Dungeon to match the proper song titles.[/*][*]Under certain specifications, an issue was causing Gold-Leaf Pine Cones to stack in values less than 1000 when registering them in the Handicraft menu.[/*][*]When creating an Elite Shadow Mission party via the Shadow Mission Board with an invalid name, the Shadow Mission pass would be lost to the shadow realm. A ward has been put in place to prevent your passes from being lost.[/*][*]On relevant weapons, the item attribute for "Piercing Can Be Added" was missing a proper line break and was running cozy with the line before it. It should now respect the boundaries of others.[/*][*]Fixed several display issues with the following outfits:[list][*](Special) Moonlit Howls Outfit (M) & Moonlit Howls Gloves (M)[/*][*](Special) Astraea Stella Wear (F) & Astraea Stella Heels (F)[/*][*](Special) Royal Brawler Outfit (M)[/*][*](Special) Royal Brawler Outfit (F) & Royal Brawler Heels (F)[/*][*]Neon Blossom Shinobi Gloves (F) (for giants)[/*][*](Special) Winter Fairy Long Outfit (F) (with Demigod)[/*][*]Cowenna's Outfit (M) & Cowenna's Gloves (M)[/*][*]Moonlight Hunter's Hat (M) (for giants)[/*][*]Ravenscall Halo[/*][*]Eochaid's Outfit (F) & Eochaid's Shoes (F)[/*][*](Special) Blue Dragon's Chosen Robe (F) & Blue Dragon's Chosen Wristguards (F)[/*][*]Simple Autumn Wear (M) & Chic Autumn Wear (M)[/*][*]Helionic Chariot Halo & Selenian Chariot Halo[/*][*](Special) Sunbather's Paradise Wear (F) & (Special) Sunbather's Bliss Wear (F)[/*][*](Special) Sunbather's Paradise Wear (M)[/*][*]Soldier's Combat Raincoat[/*][*]Queen of Hearts Staff[/*][*]Special Neon Blossom Shinobi Wear (F) (during the motion)[/*][*]Celtic Control Bar (for giants)[/*][*](Special) Eternal Resistance Outfit (M) & Eternal Resistance Shoes (M)[/*][*]Folamh's Set (all pieces)[/*][*]Midnight Investigator (F) (all pieces, when Resting)[/*][*](Special) Crocus High School Warm-Weather Uniform (M) (for giants)[/*][/list][/*][*]Improved the texture on Homestead Timepiece Mechanism A.[/*][*]Fixed a rigging error when equipped with Lightning Two-handed Sword Appearance Scroll and Eternal Resistance Replica Sniper Rifle Two-Handed Blunt Weapon Appearance Scroll.[/*][*]Corrected some overlapping textures on the Cwn Annwn pets.[/*][*]Fixed an issue causing the Naraka Inferno wings to be unable to be picked up from the ground unless Alt was held.[/*][*]The Dark Erg spilling forth from Crom Bas was causing Brielle's body to warp during the Crom Bas storyline missions. Nothing our brave sundrop couldn't handle--she has dispelled the effect and once again looks just like the picture on her archaeologist's license.[/*][*]Behold! The magical "Pig Cooking Pot" and "Antique Cooking Pot"! See how they cook food, despite not having any flame beneath them whatsoever! Yours for the low pri- no! The flame has come back?![/*][*]The following Homestead Props were difficult to select, and have been adjusted to make them easier to move:
[list][*]Homestead Halloween Flagstone (Partial)[/*][*]Homestead Halloween Flagstone (Whole)[/*][*]Homestead Halloween Pumpkin Flagstone (Whole)[/*][/list][/*][*]Adjusted the menu present when right-clicking items to better fit some rarer text options. [i]Lookin' at you, Classic Spirit Weapons.[/i][/*][*]A vile and insidious curse befell elves holding the Royal Mage Cane- their footsteps would fall silent, as if their existence was denied! Thankfully, in the whisper of the night, they have returned, as if nothing had happened.[/*][*]The visual effect for the Eclipse 2nd title was appearing incorrectly under certain animations and has been corrected.[/*][*]The visual effect for the Ruler of the Stage of Trials 2nd title will no longer render incorrectly when equipped by giants.[/*][*]During G2's Paladin Training Courses cutscene, the ground texture was previously not visible. A rendering error, or a possible preview of a later storyline- you decide![/*][*]Some Sewing Patterns for Bonita Plumed Ankle Boots were showing as blank. They have been restored to the correct functionality.[/*][*]The weapon upgrades that were named "Break [weapon name] Seal", or similar names, have been unified to "[weapon name] Unsealing". 
[list][*]Before example: Break Infinite Bow Seal[/*][*]After example: Infinite Bow Unsealing[/*][/list][/*][*]An unused setting was present in the hotkey menu and has been removed.[/*][/list]
[b]Bugs fixed during the July 24th Maintenance[/b]
[list][*]In addition to the below list, we've also included fixes for several smaller typos (such as a missing space after your character name in the Arcana questlines) and text display errors from the July patch. There was a high word count in this update (same for next month! exciting times for Mabinogi~), so we are thankful for the quick reports to allow us to make quicker fixes.[/*][*]The Talent icons for the Arcanas were slightly misaligned. Laoire was informed and he has since brought them back in line.[/*][*]The notification text when using a Memory of a Story book has been adjusted to show in full.[/*][*]The ranking list shown when viewing the Previous Guild Point Rank Info has had the test guilds removed, and will now display the proper rankings.
[list][*][i]Congrats to Goodmorning for having the most Guild Points earned prior to the Guild Renewal![/i][/*][/list][/*][*]The Duration text for Divine Retribution was incorrect and has been adjusted. This is a text only error; no gameplay has been adjusted.
[list][*]At Rank 1:
[list][*]Before: Equal to the Shield skill with the longest duration + 6 sec.[/*][*]After: Equal to the Shield skill with the longest duration[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The additional duration time was a holdover from a previous version of the skill that had a much longer cooldown, and no behavior that could reduce the cooldown.[/*][*]The Little Morning Star Homestead Figures (from the Flying High Event) were incorrectly able to be placed in the Relic equipment slots. As these are not proper Relics, we have fixed these items to no longer be equippable. We have unequipped these Figures from characters that had them equipped, and placed them back into your inventory.[/*][/list]
[h2=known-bugs]Known Bugs[/h2]
[list][*][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1592/bug_catching.png[/img][/*][*]There are currently issues causing the Blacklist to not work as expected for some players.[/*][*]Under periodic conditions, Milletians will be temporarily unable to duel other Milletians.[/*][/list]
[i]The Mabinogi Team has been working hard to investigate fixes for the lag issues that have been occurring of late. With the many new Milletians entering Erinn, we love to see Mabinogi growing and flourishing, though we recognize this hasn’t been without issues. In the future, we will send a letter about our plans to address and improve the network latency. We apologize again for the impacted gameplay, and thank you for your patience as we determine the causes.[/i]

notes.title: Guild Renewal Update
notes.notes:
[img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/aonb2vws/250526-wgc-2054-mb-guildrenewal-1400x300.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Active Events/Sales/Promotions[/b][/h2]
[table][tr][td][url=https://www.nexon.com/mabinogi/news/27012/summer-festival-event][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/yc5jvkgv/250527_summerfestivalevent_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg[/img][/url][/td][td][url=https://www.nexon.com/mabinogi/news/27101/south-sea-sailor-box][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/grwk4o3n/250530_southseasailorbox_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][tr][td][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/23897/pan-s-check-in-attendance-season-7][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1694/250303-wgc-1841-mb-panscheckinevent-940x290.jpg[/img][/url][/td][td][url=https://www.nexon.com/mabinogi/news/27349/shopkeeper-s-sale-shopping-bags-and-summer-package][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/kdwjfugb/250523-wgc-2063-mb-outfitpakagesale-940x290.png[/img][/url][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/25363/erinn-adventure-pass-season-2][/url][/td][/tr][tr][td][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/25363/erinn-adventure-pass-season-2][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/rurdjmvc/250403-erinnpassevent_940x290.jpg[/img][/url][/td][td][url=https://www.nexon.com/mabinogi/news/26986/ravenscall-box][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/tamjcquk/250519_mb_ravenscallbox_wgc-2006_940x290-1.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][tr][td][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/84562/glenn-bearna-dungeon-support][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/ylxh1ugg/260529_mb_glennbearnaevent_wgc-2057.jpg[/img][/url][/td][td] [/td][/tr][/table]
[i](Click the banners to go to that event/sales/promotion webpage)[/i]
[h2][b]Guild Renewal[/b][/h2]
[i]Guilds have been a cornerstone of Erinn since Mabinogi first released! While the strengths and bonds between Guild Members is unique for each guild, the system to help foster those bonds had been severely neglected. We hope that this massive renewal of the Guild System will continue fostering new bonds between Guildmates that cannot be found anywhere else.[/i]
[list][*]A new Guild Home UI has been created and added to the game to house most guild-related things.[list][*]A new Guild Menu button has been added to the bottom of the screen to open the Guild Home.[/*][*]The Guild Home and Guild List buttons at the bottom of the friends messenger window have been removed.[/*][*][b]All Guild Stones will be removed with the update. [/b][/*][/list][/*][*]The following features have been added to the Guild Home UI:[list][*][b]Guild Search[/b]
[list][*]You will be able to search by Guild Name and/or Guild Master.[/*][*]Tag Filtering is now possible to find the guild that suits your playstyle best.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Guild Recommendation[/b]
[list][*]When not in a guild, opening the Guild Menu will open the “Recommended Guilds” tab.[/*][*]Guilds that have a healthy activity record will have priority in the displayed list.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Guild Member Play Rankings[/b]
[list][*]Guild Members will be able to compete against other members of their guild to be displayed on a Leaderboard for certain activities.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Guild Portrait[/b]
[list][*]Guild Portraits allow Guild Members to be displayed on the Guild Home screen.[/*][*]Spend Guild Points or Gold to unlock new locations, the number of members that can be displayed, and more.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Guild Guide[/b]
[list][*]Will guide you to the official web [b][url=https://www.nexon.com/mabinogi/guide/advancedguide/general/25467/guilds]Guild Guide[/url][/b].[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]A new NPC, [b]Siobhan[/b], has been added to take over the duties of Eavan and Sinead.[list][*]Talk to Siobhan outside the Guild Hall to start the first quest.[/*][*]Siobhan is normally located inside the Guild Hall.[/*][*]Three (3) new Guide Quests titled [b][Guild] A Guild-ed Opportunity[/b] have been added to introduce the changes to the Guild System.[list][*]Talk to Siobhan outside the Guild Hall to start the 1st quest.[/*][/list][/*][*]After completing A Guild-ed Opportunity (1), Siobhan will open the Guild Shop for Guild Members, and be in charge of handling changes made to the Guild Banner, Guild Robe, and when available, Guild Title.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Guild Leveling[/b] and [b]perks [/b]have been added.[list][*]Guilds can now level up, earning perks with each level.[/*][*]The types of Perks a guild has unlocked or yet to unlock can be viewed through the “Perks” tab in the Guild Menu.[/*][*]Leveling will require a set amount of Guild Points (GP) and Guild Gold (GG), contributed by members of the guild.[/*][*]Members can still donate GP if the guild is at the cap to earn Guild Coins, but the GP will not be credited to the guild.[list][*][b]All Guild Points prior to the update will be reset. [/b][/*][*]The maximum amount of GP a Guild Member can now hold is 2,000.[/*][*]The maximum amount of GP a guild can now have is equal to the amount required for leveling up.[list][*]Members can still donate GP if the guild is at the cap to earn Guild Coins, but the GP will not be credited to the guild.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Donations of GP will reward the donor with Guild Coins.[/*][*]Guild Coins are a new currency, allowing Guild Members to purchase items from the new Guild Shop through the Guild Assistant Siobhan.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Guild Missions[/b] have been added.[list][*]Two different types of Guild Missions have been added:[list][*][b]Guild Field Missions[/b] - band with your Guildmates to defeat a Field Boss and earn GP.[/*][*][b]Guild Life Mission [/b]- deliver materials per the NPC's request to earn GP based on your score.[/*][/list][/*][*]Each Guild Member can earn GP from both Field and Life Missions up to 3 times per week.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]A Guild Shop[/b] has been added.[list][*]The new Guild Shop is available for all Guild Members starting at Guild Level 1 through Siobhan in the Guild Hall.[/*][*]The Guild Shop only accepts Guild Coin (GC) and all items are subject to a weekly purchase limit per character.[/*][*]A guild can level up the shop by reaching Guild Level to access the “Guild Shop Level 2” tab containing more powerful items.[/*][/list][/*][/list][table noborder=1][tr][td][list][*]Guilds can now create [b]Guild Banners[/b].[list][*]The ability to create Guild Banners is unlocked when a guild reaches Level 6.[/*][*]Creation of a Guild Banner will cost the guild 25,000 Guild Points and 10,000,000 Gold.[/*][*]Guild Banners can be crafted through Siobhan in the Guild Hall.[/*][*]A Guild Banner will apply the same emblem, embroidery, and border used in the Guild Robe.[/*][*]Guild Banners can only be wielded by the Guild Master.[/*][*]Guild Banners can be planted when a guild Reaches Level 9.[list][*]Planting a banner will create an interactable banner, and will remain for 10 minutes or until the Guild Master leaves the map.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][/td][td width=30%][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/ex4hsiej/guild-banners.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table][list][*]Additional Guild Changes:[list][*][b]All web functionality of guilds has been removed.[/b][list][*]The "Guilds" tab will be removed from the Mabinogi Website.[/*][/list][/*][*]Member requirement for creating a guild has been reduced from 5 players to 2.[/*][*]The Guild Hall is now available immediately upon creation of a guild.[/*][*]Guild Leaders can now assign up to 3 Guild Officers.[/*][*]Functionality of duties between Guild Leader, Guild Officers, and Members/Senior Members has been updated.[/*][*]Guild Leaders can now withdraw up to 100 million gold per day from the Guild Treasury.[/*][*]The requirements of disbanding a guild have been updated to require only the Guild Leader to remain in the guild.[/*][*]The cooldown time for leaving and joining another guild has been reduced from 1 week to 24 hours after joining the previous guild.[/*][*]An “Immediate Join” option has been added, allowing players to instantly join a guild without waiting for approval, if the guild allows it.[/*][*]Guild Quests sold by Eavan have been removed.[/*][*]The method for obtaining Guild Points have changed:
[list][*]Before: 1 GP per 10 minutes; 5 GP per level up.[/*][*]After: 1 GP per minute; available through Guild Missions.[/*][/list][/*][*]The Guild Points requirement for the Guardian Guild Tournaments has been reduced from 15,000 GP to 1,000 GP.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
Read more in-depth about guilds and all the new changes in the dedicated [b][url=https://www.nexon.com/mabinogi/guide/advancedguide/general/25467/guilds]Guild Guide[/url][/b]!
[url=https://www.nexon.com/mabinogi/guide/advancedguide/general/25467/guilds][i][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/5uifjiey/guildguide-1400x300.jpg[/img][/i][/url]
[h2][b]Tutorial Improvements[/b][/h2]
[h3]Arcana Achievement Missions[/h3]
[list][*][b]Arcana Achievement Missions [/b]have been added for Milletians that have yet to acquire an Arcana on any character of their account.[/*][list][*]Accounts that have an Arcana unlocked on any of their characters are not eligible for this questline.[/*][*]Only one character can progress through the questline.[/*][/list][*]Upon completing the Third Memoir of Blannid’s Brave Boost questline, you’ll receive a Guide Quest to talk to Eavan in Dunbarton to register for the questline.[/*][*]You can confirm the progress of the questline by going to [b]Guides [/b]→ [b]Arcana Achievement Mission [/b]in your bottom menu bar.[/*][list][*]Alternatively, you can select “View Arcana Achievement Mission” by opening your Quest Log.[/*][/list][/list][b][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/n2cnfvgd/arcana-achievement-missions.png[/img][/b][list][*]The Arcana Achievement Mission UI will provide you with information on what your next Cumulative Point Rewards are, what the next step in your current quest is, and additional details for better understanding.[/*][list][*]Only one quest is given each real life day (17 quests in total)[/*][*]The next quest after completing one will be delivered at [b]7:00 AM Server Time[/b] the next day.[/*][*]When completing objectives, you will receive Arcana Achievement Mission Points as a reward.[/*][*]Upon accumulating enough Arcana Achievement Mission Points, you’ll receive the current Cumulative Point Rewards listed.[/*][/list][/list][h3]Tutorial Improvements ft. Blaanid[/h3]
The introductory tutorial quests have been improved.
[list][*]The quests [Tutorial] Battle in Erinn, [Tutorial] Basics of Battle, and [Tutorial] To The Outside World have been removed.[list][*]Milletians that were actively on the quests can proceed naturally.[/*][*]The removed quest rewards can be obtained from previous quests.[/*][/list][/*][*]When creating a new character, some guidance messages have been added to the upper right corner of the screen.[/*][*]When entering the Soul Stream in certain situations, the following UI will now be hidden:[list][*]Skill slots[/*][*]Chat[/*][*]Notifications[/*][*]Event windows[/*][/list][/*][*]Some of the specifications of the tutorial zone have been changed.[list][*]Some chats and notifications in the UI will be hidden in the tutorial zone.[/*][/list][/*][*]Some of Nao’s dialogue has been adjusted to account for the various tutorial changes.[/*][*][Tutorial] Item Equipping and Usage will no longer provide Lorna's Stadium Horn.[/*][*]After completing the revamped Tutorial, Milletians will receive the books “Traveler’s Guide Life Edition” and “Traveler’s Guide Combat Edition”.[list][*]These books can also be purchased from Aeira in Dunbarton.[/*][/list][/*][*]Some of the contents of the "Traveler's Guide" book when creating a new character has been changed to improve readability.[/*][*]"Practical Course - Talent Experience" has been added to the courses that can be ordered on the Beginner's Combat Course bulletin board.[list][*]By taking this course, you can experience various talent skills.[/*][/list][/*][*]When a beginner rebirths, they can obtain the beginner title of the Talent they selected, and the beginner title will not be removed.[list][*]In addition, some of the title descriptions have been changed due to the specification change.[/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]Blannid’s Memory Book[/h3]
The introductory quests have been improved.
[list][*]The tutorial quest [Tutorial] Rebirth and Talent has been removed.[list][*]As a result, a Milletian's first guided Rebirth will be led by Blaanid.[/*][*]Milletians that were actively on the quests can proceed naturally.[/*][/list][/*][*]The Chain Slash questline has been removed from Blaanid’s Memoir quests.[/*][*]Throughout Blaanid’s quests, various visual glowing indicators have been placed at objectives to help Milletians find their way.[/*][/list][b][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/4uwafqib/blaanid-ooooh-shinyyyyy.png[/img][/b][list][*]When Blaanid’s Memory Book is in progress, a button will appear at the bottom of the quest window.[/*][*]If you have not purchased any items upon Rebirthing, the purchase confirmation pop-up window will not appear.[/*][/list]
[b][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/qkhgsmve/blaanid-brave-boost-quest-mark.png[/img][/b]
[h3]Other Fantasy Life Changes[/h3][list][*]The [b]Auto-Pathing[/b] function has been improved.[list][*]Teleport fees are waived if your cumulative level is below 10,000 or if you have an active Basic VIP Membership.[/*][*]If you are on the same continent and not in a restricted area, you also have the option to Go on Foot without spending any Gold.[/*][*]When viewing Quest Info, you can now teleport to the nearest Moon Gate.[/*][/list][/*][/list][b][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/ovgoivyj/auto-pathing-june-update.gif[/img][/b][list][*]Stack Sizes for certain items have been increased.[list][*]We know that carrying several of the same item can be cumbersome, so we’ve now made the following items stackable and/or had their stack limits increased to [b]100[/b]![list][*]Rebirth Potion[/*][*]Forgetful Potion[/*][*]Tendering Potion[/*][*]Special Tendering Potion (S, SS, and SSS)[/*][*]Likability Potion[/*][*]Chat Color Change Potion[/*][*]Name/Chat Color Change Potion[/*][*]Enchant Protection Potion[/*][*]Enchant Extraction Protection Potion[/*][*]Trade Unlock Potion[/*][*]Height Potion[/*][*]Age Potion - Age 9 ~ 19[/*][*]Partner Age Potion - 9 ~ 19[/*][*]Partner Age Potion - Max Age[/*][*]Pet Age Potion - Age 1 ~ 5[/*][*]Combat 2x EXP Potion[/*][*]Ladeca Combat 4x EXP Potion[/*][*]Pet EXP Potion[/*][*]Life Skill 2x EXP Potion[/*][*]Combat Skill 2x EXP Potion[/*][*]Magic Skill 2x EXP Potion[/*][*]Alchemy Skill 2x EXP Potion[/*][*]Martial Arts Skill 2x EXP Potion[/*][*]Music Skill 2x EXP Potion[/*][*]Puppetry 2x EXP Potion[/*][*]Dual Gun 2x EXP Potion[/*][*]Ninja 2x EXP Potion[/*][*]Speed Walk Potion (30%)[/*][*]Speed Walk Potion (40%)[/*][*]Complete Skill EXP Potion[/*][*]Royal Complete EXP Potion[/*][*]Monster Drop Booster Potion[/*][*]Fishing Booster Potion[/*][*]Dragon Knight’s Potion[/*][*]Magic Power Potion[/*][*]Magic Speed Potion[/*][*]Physical Power Potion[/*][*]All [Skill Name] Training Potions[/*][*]E.g. Fury of Connous Training Potion[/*][*]All [Skill Name] Production Boost Potions[/*][*]All [Skill Name] Quality Increase Potions[/*][*]All Restorative Potions (HP, MP, Stamina, Wound), including:
[list][*]SE[/*][*]RE[/*][*]Liquids[/*][*]Crystals[/*][*]Beginner[/*][*]Buff[/*][*]Comprehensive[/*][*]Full Recovery[/*][/list][/*][*]Base Potion[/*][*]Childlike Green Perfume[/*][*]Childlike Yellow Perfume[/*][*]Childlike Pink Perfume[/*][*]Youthful Black Perfume[/*][*]Mature Red Perfume[/*][*]Holy Water of Lymilark[/*][*]Massive Holy Water of Lymilark[/*][*]Diet Potion U[/*][*]Diet Potion L[/*][*]Diet Potion F[/*][*]Flint[/*][/list][/*][*]We’ve also increased the following item stack limits to [b]200[/b]!
[list][*]Light Magic Power Potion[/*][*]Light Magic Speed Potion[/*][*]Light Physical Power Potion[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]*Note:[/b] The stack improvements will also apply for various items with suffix tags, such as (Event), (Untradable), (Can be Traded Once), (30 min), (1 Day), etc.
[list][*]The following Phoenix pets have been renamed:
[list][*]White Phoenix -> Mistborn Phoenix[/*][*]Blue Phoenix -> Cerulean Phoenix[/*][/list][/*][*]The following items have been renamed:
[list][*]Special Eluned Classic Maid Dress (M) -> Eluned Special Classic Maid Dress (M)[/*][*]Special Eluned Classic Butler Outfit (F) -> Eluned Special Classic Butler Outfit (F)[/*][*]Baseball Bat -> Baseball Bat (M)[/*][*]Pom Poms -> Pom Poms (F)[/*][*]Water Spirit Ankle Straps -> Water Spirit Ankle Straps (F)[/*][*]Water Spirit Sandals -> Water Spirit Sandals (M)[/*][/list][/*][*]The training method for Rain Casting requiring one to "Produce something under a cloud" has been expanded to make the action more clear- "Successfully perform the finishing steps of production under a cloud".[list][*]The required method itself has not changed, only the description.[/*][/list][/*][*]We have truncated the text tags on Commerce Mounts within the Commerce Trading menu, to allow more of the name to be visible.
[list][*][Partner] -> [P][/*][*][Guild] -> [G][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]Commerce Alban Heruin Season 1[/h3]
[table noborder=1][tr][td][list][*][b]Seasonal Commerce Alban Heruin Season 1[/b] will begin at [b]7:00 AM PDT[/b] on [b]July 3rd 2025 [/b]and run until [b]November 6th, 2025 7:00 AM PST[/b].[list][*][Claim Previous Seasonal Ranking Rewards] and [View Previous Seasonal Ranking] buttons will be deactivated during the reset time, and re-activated when you open commerce UI after the previous season's ranking is compiled.[/*][*]Alban Heruin Season 1 will conclude on [b]November 6th, 2025 7:00 AM PST[/b].[/*][*]Viewing the season rankings and claiming previous season’s rewards will be disabled for 30 minutes after the season is changed to ensure that the ranking compilation can be completed before rankings and rewards are distributed.[/*][/list][/*][*]Purchase limits within Trade Merchant’s shops and Sayiv’s shop will be reset.[/*][*]The following items have been added to the Erinn Merchants' Guild Souvenir Box.[list][*]Cone Hat Balloon Pony Whistle[/*][*]Festival Troublemaker Alo Whistle[/*][/list][/*][*]The Alban Heruin Season 1 Challenger Box will be available, containing the following items:[list][*][b]**NEW**[/b] Alban Heruin Season 1 Challenger 2nd Title[list][*]Movement Speed +3%[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Mistborn Phoenix Whistle
[/b][/*][*]20x Precise Reforging Tools (Expire after 30 Days)[/*][/list][/*][/list][/td][td width=40%][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/twwi1xt1/alban-heruin-season-1-challenger-2nd-title.gif[/img][/td][/tr][/table]
[h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]
[i]A few fixes in this auspicious update, with some typical typo fixes alongside them. We like telling you that we're still fixing these typos, and hearing your wonderful reports, we just don't always feel these smaller items are worth highlighting individually as they're typically uninteresting![/i]
[list][*]The icon for the status effect Support Shot was missing and has been added.[/*][*]A few otherwise fine folk in Erinn were sporting an overly bald look, appearing as if they had no hair or skull! Spooky! We asked them to don their hair proper, and they will be showing correctly moving forward.[/*][*]A fix for the recent issue causing audio to behave unexpectedly, such as overlapping BGM, has been added and the issues should be quelled.[/*][*]Small modeling fixes have been made to improve the display of the Shadow Reaper (F) set.[/*][*]The following Weapon Appearance Scrolls were displaying the incorrect name when applied, and will now show their correct name:
[list][*]Ravenscall Hunter's Shotgun Crossbow[/*][*]Ravenscall Shotgun Crossbow[/*][*]Morpho Dreamwood Long Bow[/*][*]Morpho Dreamwood Two-Handed Sword[/*][/list][/*][*]The description for Clairvoyant Wings Orb was updated to properly indicate that it grants Placid Shining Forest Wings instead of Placid Folded Shining Forest Wings.[/*][*]Slight corrections to the following Enchants, to better reflect the actual skill names:
[list][*]Alchemist's[/*][*]Dazed[/*][*]Galactic[/*][*]Tilted[/*][*]Witch[b]
[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h2][b]Known Bugs[/b][/h2]
[list][*][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1592/bug_catching.png[/img][/*][*]There are currently issues causing the Blacklist to not work as expected for some players.[/*][*]Under periodic conditions, Milletians will be temporarily unable to duel other Milletians.[/*][/list]
