notes.notes:
[img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/iphnukl4/v2_250501_mb_r_s7_wgc_1973_1400x300.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Active Events/Sales/Promotions[/b][/h2]
[table noborder=1][tr][td][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/26760/dragon-master-season-3][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/lkxn4wt4/250502_dragonmastereventseason-3_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg[/img][/url][/td][td][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/26892/morpho-dreamwood-box][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/piwdlnrw/250506-wgc-1994-mb-morphodreamwoodbox-940x290-v2.png[/img][/url][/td][/tr]
[tr][td][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/26175/elysees-manor-box][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/tx2l5nr4/250421-wgc-1970-mb-elyseesmanorbox-940x290-1.png[/img][/url][/td][td][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/23897/pan-s-check-in-attendance-season-7][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1694/250303-wgc-1841-mb-panscheckinevent-940x290.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr]
[tr][td][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/25363/erinn-adventure-pass-season-2][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/rurdjmvc/250403-erinnpassevent_940x290.jpg[/img][/url][/td][td] [/td][/tr][/table][list][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/84562/glenn-bearna-dungeon-support][b]Glenn Bearna Dungeon Support[/b][/url]: Thursday, July 13th, 2023, After Maintenance ~ Until Further Notice[/*][/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Renovation: Season 7[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Gunslinger[/b][/h3]
[b][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/dcyewezl/shooting-rush.png[/img] Shooting Rush[/b]
[list][*]Damage has been increased for all Ranks.[list][*]For Dan 3:[list][*]Before: 600%[/*][*]After: 960%[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/piugd1do/flash-launcher.png[/img] Flash Launcher[/b]
[list][*]Damage has been increased for all Ranks.[list][*]For Dan 3:[list][*]Before: 1300%[/*][*]After: 1625%[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The distance pushed back when using the skill has been removed.[/*][*]An area of effect splash damage has been applied to the skill with a radius of 3.5m.[/*][/list]
[b][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/enpl1g0o/bullet-slide.png[/img] Bullet Slide[/b]
[list][*]The delay after using the skill has been reduced.[/*][/list]
[b][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/3kdpw1se/bullet-storm.png[/img] Bullet Storm[/b]
[list][*]Damage per shot has been increased for all Ranks.[list][*]For Rank 1:
[list][*]Before: 50%[/*][*]After: 100%[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Damage per additional target has been increased for all Ranks.
[list][*]For Rank 1:
[list][*]Before: 60%[/*][*]After: 120%[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The Max Damage Limit has been increased for all Ranks.
[list][*]For Rank 1:
[list][*]Before: 400%[/*][*]After: 600%[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The cooldown has been shortened from 15 seconds to 12 seconds at Rank 1.[/*][*]The attack interval per shot has been slightly increased from 0.02 seconds to 0.04 seconds.[/*][*]The effect of Seal: Fragarach will only be applied once when using the skill.[/*][/list]
[b][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/ritj4ckq/way-of-the-gun.png[/img] Way of the Gun[/b]
[list][*]Bonus Damage has been increased for all Ranks when Way of the Gun is active.
[list][*]For Rank 1:[list][*]Before: 15%[/*][*]After: 30%[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The cooldown has been shortened from 180 seconds to 120 seconds at Rank 1.[/*][/list]
[h3][b]Ninja[/b][/h3]
[b][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/02lflqua/shuriken-charge.png[/img] Shuriken Charge[/b]
[list][*]Damage has been increased for all Ranks.
[list][*]For Dan 3:
[list][*]Before: 690%[/*][*]After: 1035%[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The range has been increased from 14m to 15m at Dan 3.[/*][*]The cooldown time has been shortened from 4 seconds to 2 seconds at Dan 3.[/*][/list]
[b][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/ig3hrz1d/kunai-storm.png[/img] Kunai Storm[/b]
[list][*]Damage has been increased for all Ranks.[list][*]For Dan 3:
[list][*]Before: 560%[/*][*]After: 1288%[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The range has been increased from 10m to 15m at Dan 3.[/*][/list]
[b][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/biafowh1/explosive-kunai.png[/img] Explosive Kunai[/b]
[list][*]Damage has been increased for all Ranks.
[list][*]For Rank 1:
[list][*]Before: 300%[/*][*]After: 420%[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The range has been increased from 10m to 20m for Rank 1.[/*][*]The cooldown time has been shortened from 4 seconds to 2 seconds at Rank 1.[/*][*]When the skill is cast, the distance between each kunai will adjust to be farther apart the farther the skill is from your character.[/*][*]The Explosive Trigger Range of the kunai has been increased from 1m to 2m for Rank 1.[/*][*]Changed so that the hit targets are no longer pushed out of position.[/*][*]The cooldown time has been reduced from 11 seconds to 6 seconds at Rank 1.[/*][*]The Enemy Stun Duration has been reduced from 3 seconds to 2 seconds at Rank 1.[/*][*]The delay after using the skill has been reduced.[/*][/list]
[b][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/5dkhuvd4/smokescreen.png[/img] Smokescreen[/b]
[list][*]The range has been increased from 10m to 15m at Rank 1.[/*][*]The delay upon using the skill has been reduced.[/*][/list]
[b][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/zsbfg1fw/sakura-abyss.png[/img] Sakura Abyss[/b]
[list][*]The cooldown time has been reduced from 300 seconds to 60 seconds at Rank 1.[/*][/list]
[hr][/hr][h2][b]Improvements[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Partners[/b][/h3]
Several changes to Partners have been made.
[list][*]Partner Card purchases will now appear in your inventory as an in-game item.[list][*]Using the card from the inventory will create a Partner Card on the character creation menu.[/*][*]Partner Cards are tradeable with other players.[/*][/list][/*][*]The following Partners and their Mounts are now permanent items on the Cash Shop:[list][*]Maid[/*][*]Butler[/*][*]Commerce[/*][*]Partner’s Magical Broom[/*][*]Partner’s Noble Carriage[/*][*]Partner’s Long Boat[/*][*]Partner Mount Package[/*][/list][/*][*]Equipment items equipped by Partners are no longer bound and can be retrieved by the player without the use of a Partner Trade Unlock Potion.
[list][*]All remaining Partner Trade Unlock Potions have been removed as a result.[list][*]Partner Trade Unlock Potions that have been purchased from the Cash Shop since April 1st, 2024 and unused will be refunded the amount purchased in NX.[/*][*]Partner Trade Unlock Potions sold on the Auction House, but the funds are still unclaimed, will be claimed with the gold being delivered via mailbox.[/*][/list][/*][*]A Style Tab has been added for Partners.
[list][*]Tail and Facewear Slots have been added.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Newly created Laighlinne Partners will now have 5x Partner Stat Training Kits in their inventory.
[list][*]Players who previously had a Laighlinne Partner created before the update will receive 5x Partner Stat Training Kits in the mailbox on their highest-leveled character.[/*][/list][/*][*]The Gift function has been improved.
[list][*]The maximum number of daily gifts you can give to your Partner has been increased.
[list][*]Before: 5[/*][*]After: 10[/*][/list][/*][*]A Partner’s favorability now increases further when gifting an item.
[list][*]Before: 2[/*][*]After: 5[/*][/list][/*][*]Partners will now only accept a certain type of gift.
[list][*]Maid: Herbs[/*][*]Butler: Fish[/*][*]Laighlinne: Instruments[/*][*]Commerce/William/Rem/Ram: Gems[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Partners have been given a “Partner Exclusive” tab in their shop containing Partner Age Potions and Homestead Partner Basic Motion Card Boxes.
[list][*]Partner Age Potions do not reset on Saturdays.[/*][/list][/*][*]You can now change most Partners' body type and height.
[list][*]A Partner’s weight, upper body, and lower body can be modified similar to a player’s body through the use of Hot Springs and feeding them food.[/*][*]A Partner’s height can be modified through the use of Partner Age Potions.[/*][*]William and Commerce Partners cannot have their body type or height modified.[/*][/list][/*][*]Multi-person chairs can now be used with Partners.
[list][*]A Partner can only be seated on a multi-person chair placed by the Milletian who summoned them.[/*][*]After sitting on the multi-person chair, you can change the seat that your summoned Partner occupies through right-clicking your Partner and selecting “Sit Together”.[/*][/list][/*][*]Some Partners' dialogue and lines have been updated.[/*][*]A “Disable Basic Interaction” button has been added in the menu options when right-clicking a Partner.
[list][*]Toggling this option will hide all speech bubbles and dialogue, as well as motions by the Partner.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h3][b]Party System[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The Party Creation Menu UI has been updated.
[list][*]Regular Parties and Dungeon Parties have been merged.
[list][*]The ability to restrict parties by Skill Level has been removed as of a result.[/*][/list][/*][*]The maximum length of a party name has been increased to 50 characters.[/*][*]Leaving a party name blank will auto-populate with "[Character Name]’s Party."[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/muzdwpk2/before-after-party-creation-ui.png[/img]
[list][*]The Party Menu UI has been updated.
[list][*]The “Wanted” button has been renamed to “Recruit Locally”.
[list][*]The Recruitment Notice above your character will no longer expire.[/*][*]The [Wanted] party recruitment messages will no longer appear in the party chat.[/*][/list][/*][*]The width of the UI has been expanded for better visibility of text.[/*][*]Added new functionality buttons:
[list][*][u]Recruit on Party Board[/u] - adds/removes your party from the Party Bulletin Board.[/*][*][u]Move to Destination[/u] - teleports you to the pre-determined location.[/*][*][u]Recruit via Bugle[/u] - allows you to send a bugle with the party information.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The Party Bulletin Board UI has been updated.
[list][*]All parties, regardless of objective, will be displayed as a default view.[/*][*]You can now search via party name directly (case-sensitive).[/*][/list][/*][*]The ability to move parties to a preset destination has been added.
[list][*]When creating a Normal Party, the following locations have been added as destinations to teleport to:
[list][*]Glenn Bearna[/*][*]Crom Bás[/*][*]Tech Duinn[/*][*]Mag Mell[/*][*]Avalon Purification[/*][*]Sidhe Finnachaid[/*][*]Alban Knights[/*][*]Taillteann Shadow Mission[/*][*]Tara Shadow Mission[/*][*]Hard Mode Alby Advanced Dungeon[/*][*]Rabbie Phantasm[/*][*]Abyss Peaca Advanced Dungeon[/*][*]Hard Mode Rundal Advanced Dungeon[/*][/list][/*][*]A 30-second cooldown has also been added to prevent teleport spamming.[/*][/list][/*][*]You can now right click → Invite to Join Party.[list][*]If not in a party, this will create the party and send an invite to the player.[/*][*]This option is available through the Player, Friends List, and Guild List.[/*][*]This can be done across channels / maps.[/*][/list][/*][*]Added a Bugle Recruitment Feature.
[list][*]When a destination is determined in a party, the “Recruit via Bugle” option will be available in the Party Menu UI.[/*][*]A ‘Horn Bugle - World’ item is required and consumed when used.
[list][*]The Horn Bugle - World with the shortest expiration timer will be consumed first.[/*][/list][/*][*]Using the feature will display a clickable message with the party information in the message log, allowing other players to join with ease.
[list][*]The bugle message will begin with a # symbol and have an outline around the message.[/*][*]Players joining the party via clicking the bugle message will be prompted to change channels (if necessary) and move to the destination.[/*][/list][/*][*]The bugle link is valid for up to 3 minutes.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/d0bps5lr/bugle-party-message.png[/img]
[h3][b]Emblems[/b][/h3]
[list][*]A new UI has been added for synthesizing Alban Knight and Commander emblems.[list][*]Right-click an Alban Knight or Commander emblem and select "Synthesize" to open the synthesis UI.[/*][*]It is no longer possible to combine emblems through the "drag and drop" method.[/*][/list][/*][*]A "Training Camp" tab has been added to Shaun's shop in the Alban Knights Training Camp with the following items:[list][*]Unadorned Alban Knights Emblem[/*][*]Rune of Body[/*][*]Rune of Mind[/*][*]Rune of Sharpness[/*][*]Rune of Ingenuity[/*][*]Rune of Mana[/*][*][b]*New*[/b] Alban Knights Rune Box[list][*]This box will contain a random chance at an Unadorned Emblem or any of the 5 Runes.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]A "Commander" tab has been added to the Royal Quartermaster's shop in the Tech Duinn Lobby with the following items:[list][*]Unadorned Commander's Emblem[/*][*]Rune of Command: Phantasmal Sight[/*][*]Rune of Command: Fateweaver[/*][*]Rune of Command: Tenacious Taunt[/*][*]Rune of Command: Zone of Renewal[/*][*]Rune of Command: Unified Might[/*][*][b]*New*[/b] Rune of Command Box[list][*]This box will contain a random chance at an Unadorned Emblem or any of the 5 Runes.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h3][b]Auction House[/b][/h3]
[list][*]You can now preview Hair Dyes and Chairs through the Auction House.[/*][*]An “All” category has been added to the top of the Category list.
Categories can now be expanded/collapsed with a single click rather than double click.[/*][*]The following items can now be sold/purchased via the Auction House: 
[list][*]Clothing/Outfits:[list][*]Aladdin Shoes[/*][*]Badoura Costume[/*][*]Cat Armor[/*][*]Cat Armor (Giant)[/*][*]Cheerleader Boots[/*][*]China 7th Anniversary Headdress (F)[/*][*]China 7th Anniversary Headdress (M)[/*][*]China 7th Anniversary Outfit (F)[/*][*]China 7th Anniversary Outfit (M)[/*][*]China 7th Anniversary Ring    [/*][*]China 7th Anniversary Shoes (F)[/*][*]China 7th Anniversary Shoes (M)[/*][*]Clover Pig Costume (F)[/*][*]Clover Pig Costume (M)[/*][*]Dorren's Robe[/*][*]Goggle Shades[/*][*]Great Goggle Shades[/*][*]Heart Eyepatch[/*][*]Lollipop Heart Eyepatch[/*][*]Mabinogi School Shoes[/*][*]Ornamented Crown[/*][*]Pop Star Bracelet[/*][*]Pop Star Dress[/*][*]Pop Star Earrings[/*][*]Pop Star Shoes[/*][*]Style Sunglasses[/*][*]Taoist Bracelet[/*][*]Taoist Costume[/*][*]Taoist Headdress[/*][*]Taoist Shoes[/*][/list][/*][*]Weapons:[list][*]Carpinus Healing Wand[/*][*]Chef's Passion  [/*][*]Metal Ice Wand[/*][*]Metal Lightning Wand[/*][*]Panacea Healing Wand[/*][*]Pop Star Conductor Baton[/*][*]Ruyuefeixue's Butterfly Fan[/*][*]Scythe that Reaps Darkness[/*][/list][/*][*]Chairs:[list][*]Double Sunbed[/*][*]Single Sunbed[/*][/list][/*][*]Misc. Items:[list][*]Ballista Bolt (Merchant Group)[/*][*]Ruined Bonita Twin Tail Ribbons[/*][*]Bonita Twin Tail Ribbons Repair Kit[/*][*]Broken Ruyuefeixue's Butterfly Fan[/*][*]Ruyuefeixue's Butterfly Fan Repair Kit  [/*][*]Rabbie Phantasm Dungeon Mirror World Pass[/*][*]Receiver of Nao's Blessing Title Coupon[/*][*]Totem Reset Coupon[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[hr][/hr][h2][b]Patch Notes[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Fantasy Life Changes[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Keyword Highlights have been added to the Chat Menu Options.[list][*]When an added word/phrase is said in chat, it will be highlighted to draw your attention.[/*][*]You may add up top 10 words/phrases, with a maximum of 20 characters per entry.[/*][*]Management of this system is located in [u]Options [/u]→ [u]Social [/u]→ [u]Chat [/u]→ [u]Manage Highlighted Keywords[/u] [/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/k2ufgwht/image-22.png[/img]
[img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/dhanq0x4/image-23.png[/img]
[list][*]Your chat log history will not reset upon changing channels.[list][*]It will still reset upon logging in/out of the game however.[/*][/list][/*][*] Clicking a player's name on the Message Log will now bring up the Report User window. [/*][*]The in-game Cash Shop has received an update:[list][*]The window will now load directly in your Mabinogi client, rather than as an external window.[/*][*]The specifications and security have been updated.[/*][/list][/*][*]The calculations performed when production crafting have been modified to capture the state when starting the craft. This will prevent situations where the display showed 100%, but it was still possible to fail, even when successfully clearing the crafting mini-game.[/*][*]The setting to hide the visibility of your Support Puppet will now be saved when swapping to different Extra Equipment Slots.[/*][*]Shadow Missions that previously required you to be in a party to progress, such as The Secret of Scathach Caverns, will now allow those not in a party to progress when speaking with the NPCs.[list][*][i]It's dangerous to go alone, but you got this![/i][/*][/list][/*][*]You no longer need to meet the requirements to teleport to the entrance of Sidhe Finnachaid when using the Dungeon Guide.[/*][*]Expanding/Collapsing a Group in your friends list now only requires a single-click instead of double-click.[/*][*]In line with our rename change to Fragarach, we have also renamed the G25 sword from Luminous Cross-hilt Sword to The Answerer.[/*][*]Combo Card Slot Change Coupons have been modified to allow them to be destroyed via the Trash Can.[/*][*]Character Card purchases will now appear in your inventory as an in-game item.[list][*]Using the card from the inventory will create a Character Card on the character creation menu.[/*][*]Character Cards are tradeable with other players.[/*][*]With this change, Hero and Elite Character cards have been removed from the Cash Shop.[/*][/list][/list]
[h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Smaller text fixes this month for some of the Shop related dialogue with NPCs, some C7 NPC text polish, more changes to the Party and Partner related texts, and unification of some of the Lance item descriptions to better convey the gameplay. Thank you for your eyes with each update. We're glad we can continue to make this game clean.[/*][*]Improvements have been made to the newly added Pet Parade action that allow it to perform better under higher latencies.[/*][*]The (old) Doki Doki Island quest Natural Dye Event has been cleared from all accounts. Apologies for the confusion![/*][*]Doll Bag Storage Chests will once again show the contents that are stored within the chest.[/*][*]Shopkeeping Milletians of Dunbarton and elsewhere (though mostly Dunbarton…) - you will once again be able to check the set price of your wares when reviewing your merchandise.
[list][*][i]Belvast Merchants where ya be? [/i]😭[/*][/list][/*][*]The range of Smokescreen was increased to 15m with the Battle Astrologer update. The associated skill text has been updated to reflect this change.[/*][*]With the update to the in-game Cash Shop browser, the zoom level has been corrected and the page will now display as expected when opening.[/*][*]The button redirects for opening specific Cash Shop pages have been updated to better direct you towards the relevant item(s).[/*][*]Fixed an issue where the status effect from a Carpentry Quality Increase Potion was not properly removing itself when failing a crafting attempt.[/*][/list]
[h3][b]Changes during the March 20th Maintenance[/b][/h3]
[list][*]As mentioned in our [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/25214/renovation-season-6-update]April Update[/url], the following mythological sword and accompanying technique have been renamed, and all accompanying text (such as from the storyline) has been replaced:[list][*]Pragarah -> Fragarach[/*][*]Seal: Pragarah -> Seal: Fragarach[/*][/list][/*][/list][table][tr][td]【 Localization Note 】
[i]The Localization Team has wanted to correct "Pragarah" for several years now, re-localizing it to its proper mythological name "Fragarach" (which, in Gaelic, translates to "The Answerer"). After all, just as one would never expect to see "Excalibur" rendered otherwise in a game based on Arthurian legend, Fragarach ought to hold a similar status when one discusses the tales of Ireland. With the recent updates to the Seal: Fragarach skill, we finally had the opportunity to make the change to this odd artifact of legacy localization. The Mabinogi Team hopes that this small yet meaningful change will help foster a deeper connection with the Celtic lore that serves as the inspiration for so many characters, places, and events within the world of Erinn.[/i][/td][/tr][/table]
[h3][b]Bug Fixes during the March 20th Maintenance[/b][/h3]
[list][*]An issue was causing the Def/MDef/Prot/MProt reduced via Brionac and Seal: Fragarach to be lower than expected. This has been fixed, and both should be reducing the values in the same way to the appropriate amounts.[/*][*]The description of this year's Lovely Doki Doki Commemorative Box has been updated to reflect the proper outfit.[/*][*]The Life Exploration Tools now correctly line break in the Item Attribute field.[/*][*]DJ Romantic will be coming back from his "judging competition" on April 17th instead of April 24th. He wrote the wrong date in his calendar, it seems.[/*][*]Reserve Attack settings will now save upon logging out/changing channels.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where an untranslated message was showing when a Trade Unlock Letter of Guarantee when applied on an item.[/*][*]The family name of Zeder was retranslated from Shiarpe to Scharp.[/*][/list]
[h3][b]Known Bugs[/b][/h3][list][*][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1592/bug_catching.png[/img][/*][*]There are currently issues causing the Blacklist to not work as expected for some players.[/*][*]Under periodic conditions, Milletians will be temporarily unable to duel other Milletians.[/*][*]There is an issue with the in-game Guild list not populating with guilds.[/*][/list]

notes.title: 17th Anniversary Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1570/17thanni-news-940x290.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr][h2]Simplenogi[/h2]
[b]Options Menu[/b]
[list][*][b] [/b]The Options Menu has been overhauled and updated to better assist Milletians with their settings.[/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1686/options-menu-before-after.png[/img]
[list][*]Tabs/Categories in the Options have been re-labeled and reorganized.[/*][*]All customizable options have been rearranged to fit the updated tab/category.[/*][*]Many options now have hover text to further explain their functionality.[/*][*]The following customization options have been [b]removed[/b] and are permanently activated:
[list][*]Dithering[/*][*]Sky Rendering[/*][*]Rendering Specular[/*][*]Shadow Blurring[/*][*]Enable Hotkeys[/*][*]Quick Equip[/*][*]Highlight New Items[/*][*]Giant / Nascent Divinity Camera Height Adj.[/*][/list][/*][*]The following customization options have been removed and will be permanently disabled:[list][*]Reserve Attack[list][*]Auto-Attack is [b]not[/b] being removed and has been relocated to the Gameplay tab.[/*][/list][/*][/list][*]The following customization options were [b]removed[/b] due to the option not working as intended:[list][*]Use NPC Theme Music[/*][*]Using 3D Sound[/*][/list][/*][*]New customizable settings have been [b]added[/b] to the Options Menu:[list][*]Horn Bugle - World Prem.[list][*]Located under Gameplay → System → View Announcements.[/*][*]Unchecking this box will prevent all text from [b]World Premium Bugles[/b] from appearing. Regular Bugles will still appear as normal in the Horn Channel.[/*][/list][/*][*]Video Volume[list][*]Located under Sound → Video.[/*][*]You can now adjust the volume of video cutscenes.
[/*][/list][*]Allow Astral Imaging[list][*]Located under Gameplay → Social → Community.[/*][*]Toggle this option for All players, Party members, or Guildmates only.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The following customization options have been [b]added[/b] to the Gameplay → Display → Show/Hide section to help increase visibility of the world of Erinn.[list][*]Talent Title and Icon[/*][*]2nd Title Icon[/*][*]Monster Fynni Gem Icon[/*][*]Guild Name (Self)[/*][*]Guild Name (Others)[/*][*]Doll Bags[/*][*]Pet/Partner Names[/*][*]Monster Names (Non-Boss)[/*][*]Damage Skin (Others)[/*][*]Erg Effects (Self)[/*][*]Erg Effects (Others)[/*][*]Special Upgrade (Self)[/*][*]Special Upgrade (Others)[/*][*]Pet Fynn Sync Effect
[/*][/list][/*][*]For all above customization options, unchecking the box will [b]remove[/b] the display of said effects.[list][*]All options are checked by default.
[/*][/list][/*][*]When entering Dunbarton square, the Simplified Display Options pop-up window will appear.[list][*]Clicking “Apply” will apply the recommended “Simplenogi” settings.[/*][*]You can still fine-tune your preferences through the Options menu.[/*][*]Clicking “Do not show again” will prevent the pop-up from appearing again.
[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]NPC Shop Menu[/b]
[list][*]The UI of NPC Shops has been changed to a “list” format, allowing for better visibility on items, such as cost, inventory size, and more.[list][*]You can alternate between the two styles by clicking on “Switch to Bag” / “View as List” in the top right corner of the Shop Menu.[/*][/list][/*][*]A search function has been added.[list][*]The shop search function is case sensitive.[/*][/list][/*][*]You can now sell up to 14 items at once when selling to an NPC.[/*][*]The repurchase limit from an NPC shop has been increased from 10 to 30.[/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1687/shop-menu-before-after.png[/img]
[b]Title Menu[/b]
[list][*]Title Menu UI has been revamped.[/*][*]Improved search functionality to now include effects from titles.[list][*]i.e. searching “Speed” will bring up “the Busy” title.[/*][*]The title search function is not case sensitive.[/*][/list][/*][*]Expanded the window for easier viewing of all titles.[/*][*]Added a “Favorites” button to have your favorite titles be automatically listed at the top.[list][*]You can still right-click a title to add/remove from the favorites’ list.[/*][/list][/*][*]A “Preview Effects” window has been added, allowing for visibility of 2nd Title Visual Effects.[/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1688/title-menu-before-after.png[/img]
[b]Other Simplenogi Changes:[/b]
[list][*]Talent Title icons and 2nd Title icons will now be vertically centered based on all tags displayed in the name area (Guild, Talent, Name, etc.)[/*][*]Spirit Transformation Liqueur (Invisible) is now available in Berched’s shop in Taillteann.[list][*]When applied, all visual effects from the Spirit Weapon will be invisible.[/*][/list][/*][*]When defeating (most) non-boss monsters, the name will now be hidden and its body will turn transparent before disappearing.[/*][*]The Combat Log will no longer list when you’ve made a critical hit on an enemy.[/*][/list][h2]Auto-pathing[/h2][list][*]Auto-pathing has now been added to the game as an improvement to the auto-navigation system for Milletians and their Pets.[/*][*]When clicking a location on the mini-map, a set route will automatically appear, allowing your character to run or ride all the way to its destination without making a 2nd marker.[/*][*]Auto-pathing is only available in the overworld and is not available in some areas or conditions such as:[list][*]Commercing[/*][*]Dungeons[/*][*]Shadow Missions[/*][*]Stellar Citadel[/*][*]Any Doki Doki Flight[/*][/list][/*][*]Auto-pathing will remember your pathing when on a mount and alternating between ground and sky.[list][*]The auto-pathing must be set before taking flight.[/*][/list][/*][/list][h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[b]Fantasy Life Changes[/b]
[list][*]The Library of Secrets has been added as a Deluxe Background for Astral Imprinting.[/*][*]The name for the visual-only halo for Blaanid's Blessing has been renamed from Blessing Effect to Halo Effect. As this drop-down selection was always visual-only, not the strength of Blaanid's Blessing received, we hope that this better communicates as such.[/*][*]The death-defying technique and Cwn Annwn skill, Defiance and Veil of Mystique, have had their priorities altered. When the conditions are met, Defiance will now activate before Veil of Mystique.[/*][*]All non-gold currency will no longer be able to be stored in your bank.[list][*][b]Note: Any non-gold currency currently stored in your bank account will be automatically moved to the character based on the tab the currency is stored in.[/b][/*][*]These include currency such as:[list][*]Dungeon Vouchers (1st Voucher, 2nd Voucher, etc.)[/*][*]Adventure Seals[/*][*]Gold-Leaf Pine Cones[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list][*]Thank you all for your continued reports! A lot of smaller text fixes here and there with this patch, notably updating the descriptions for Upgrade Stones to better indicate their use, polishing up text for Fate Astrologer, shortening some of the lengthier buff-related ticker messages, and correcting the necessary book for rank 3 Rest's upgrade. Also, a new description for Cilantro's favorite food![/*][*]While we were updating the UIs, several text boxes have been updated to better fit the text inside the field.[/*][*]An issue has been fixed that was causing the Set Effect Bash Enhancement +1 Scrolls and Set Effect Windmill Enhancement +1 Scrolls to not work on the following items:[list][*]Set Effect Bash Enhancement +1 Scroll[list][*]Perseus Brutal War Hammer[/*][*]Nightbringer Enforcer[/*][/list][/*][*]Set Effect Windmill Enhancement +1 Scroll[list][*]Perseus Steeled Sword[/*][*]Perseus Brutal War Hammer[/*][*]Perseus Vigilant Shield[/*][*]Nightbringer Assault[/*][*]Nightbringer Enforcer[/*][*]Nightbringer Vanguard[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Bow-wielding Humans of Erinn, your time has come. The issue causing Arrow Revolver to lock characters in place when the burst fire was cast in extreme rapid succession with other attacks has been fixed. Nock your arrows, fire them well![/*][*]Under rare circumstances, players could find themselves with two Homestead Houses. The issue has been fixed, allowing players to remove the faulty house.[list][*]Despite this sounding affluent, this would lock them out from doing most things relating to the House.[/*][/list][/*][*]Effie found a few boxes of clothes in the back of her shop- these items have returned back for purchase in her Shop.[/*][*]Although he's a star, the Treasure Hunter Ace Talent was unintentionally giving 2x Skill Training to Fate Astrologer skills. This has been corrected.[/*][*]Corrected the listed Collection Categories on the Black Moon Commanders Compact Doll Bag Box. The Bag is unchanged.[/*][/list]
[b]2/13 Maintenance[/b]
[list][*]The issue causing Astral Frames to display incorrectly (missing subjects/stickers/etc) has been fixed. The issue has occurred one last time with this week's maintenance as we corrected the root of the issue; Astral Frames will stop resetting starting next week. Frames that are currently displaying incorrectly cannot be automatically fixed, and we apologize for the inconvenience.[/*][/list]
[b]2/27 Maintenance[/b] 
[list][*]The Black Rose Wig (F) from Tolly's Fashion event was not properly removed- we snatched your wig in this maintenance.[/*][/list]
[b]Known Bugs:[/b]
[list][*][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1592/bug_catching.png[/img][/*][*]For those truly dedicated to Commerce and keeping Erinn stocked up- when reaching over 4.3 billion ducats, the inventory window will incorrectly return the value to 0.[list][*]This is a display only issue- if you obtained another 1 billion ducats after this, the display would show 1b but you would correctly have 5.3b.[/*][/list][/*][*]The props used for Special Idle Motions are currently showing incorrectly at the start of animation cycles. [/*][*]There are currently issues causing the Blacklist to not work as expected for some players.[/*][*]Under periodic conditions, Milletians will be temporarily unable to duel other Milletians.[/*][*]There is an issue with the in-game Guild list not populating with guilds.[/*][/list]

[i]Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, including the Mabinogi x Frieren: Beyond Journey's End crossover![/i]
[hr][/hr][h3][b]The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:[/b][/h3]
[list][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/95253/life-in-erinn-with-frieren][b]Life in Erinn with Frieren Event[/b][/url]: Thursday, February 6th, After Maintenance ~ Thursday, March 6th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/95317/community-event-mabinogi-x-frieren-beyond-journey-s-end-screenshot-contest][b]Mabinogi x Frieren: Beyond Journey's End Screenshot Contest[/b][/url]: Thursday, February 6th, After Maintenance ~ Wednesday, March 5th, 11:59PM PST[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/95251/frieren-beyond-journey-s-end-doll-bag-box][b]Frieren: Beyond Journey's End Doll Bag Box[/b][/url]: Thursday, February 6th, After Maintenance ~ Thursday, March 6th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/95188/frieren-beyond-journey-s-end-adventure-box][b]Frieren: Beyond Journey's End Adventure Box[/b][/url]: Thursday, February 6th, After Maintenance ~ Thursday, March 6th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/95189/frieren-beyond-journey-s-end-demon-king-s-army-box][b]Frieren: Beyond Journey's End Demon King's Army Box[/b][/url]: Thursday, [b]February 20th[/b], After Maintenance ~ Thursday, March 6th, Before Maintenance

[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/95619/tolly-s-valentine-s-glow-up-event][b]Tolly's Valentine's Glow-up Event[/b][/url]: Thursday, January 30th, After Maintenance ~ Thursday, February 20th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/95303/updated-astraea-stella-box][b]Astraea Stella Box[/b][/url]: Thursday, January 23rd, After Maintenance ~ Thursday, February 20th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/94826/master-plan-brilliantly-shining-star][b]Master Plan: Brilliantly Shining Star[/b][/url]: Thursday, December 12th, After Maintenance ~ Thursday, February 13th, 2025, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/95243/milletian-events-fate-astrologer-update-event][b]Fate Astrologer Update Event[/b][/url]: Thursday, January 16th, After Maintenance ~ Thursday, February 13th, 2025, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/94923/milletian-events-battle-astrologer-update-event][b]Battle Astrologer Update Event[/b][/url]: Thursday, December 12th, After Maintenance ~ Thursday, February 13th, 2025, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/94579/otherworldly-guardians-pet-box][b]Otherworldly Guardians Pet Box[/b][/url]: Thursday, December 5th, After Maintenance ~ Thursday, February 13th, 2025, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/84562/glenn-bearna-dungeon-support][b]Glenn Bearna Dungeon Support[/b][/url]: Thursday, July 13th, 2023, After Maintenance ~ Until Further Notice[/*][/list]
[h3][b]Mabinogi x Frieren: Beyond Journey's End:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The highly anticipated crossover has arrived! See our [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/micro-site/frieren][b]microsite[/b] [/url]for more information![list][*]Join Frieren and her party as [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/95253/life-in-erinn-with-frieren#event-details]they search for unique magic[/url] in the world of Erinn.[/*][*]Earn exclusive rewards ranging from Homestead Items, gestures, and even your very own [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/95253/life-in-erinn-with-frieren#achievement-quests]Mimic chair[/url]![/*][*]Dress up like your favorite characters from both the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/95188/frieren-beyond-journey-s-end-adventure-box]Frieren's Adventure Box [/url]and [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/95189/frieren-beyond-journey-s-end-demon-king-s-army-box]Demon King's Army Box[/url].[/*][*]Have a miniature Frieren, Fern, Stark, and others follow you on your adventure with [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/95251/frieren-beyond-journey-s-end-doll-bag-box]Doll Bags[/url].[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h3][b]Additional following changes have been made to the game:[/b][/h3]

[b]Commerce Baltane Season 3[/b]
[list][*]Seasonal Commerce Baltane Season 3 will begin at 7:00 AM PST on March 6th, 2025 and run until June 6th, 2025 7:00 AM PDT.
[list][*]Baltane Season 2 will conclude on March 6th, 6:59 AM PST.[/*][*]Viewing the season rankings and claiming previous season’s rewards will be disabled for 30 minutes after the season is changed to ensure that the ranking compilation can be completed before rankings and rewards are distributed.
[list][*][Claim Previous Seasonal Ranking Rewards] and [View Previous Seasonal Ranking] buttons will be deactivated during the reset time, and re-activated when you open commerce UI after the previous season's ranking is compiled.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Purchase limits within Trade Merchant’s shops and Sayiv’s shop will be reset.[/*][*]The following items will be available in Sayiv’s Limited (Seasonally) shop tab, and have been added to the [b]Erinn Merchants' Guild Souvenir Box[/b].[list][*]Sturdy Angler's Creel Coupon - 1,000,000 Seasonal Ducats[/*][*][b]*NEW*[/b] Erinn Flower Merchant's Knapsack - 10,000,000 Seasonal Ducats[/*][/list][/*][table noborder=1 equalcells=1][tr][td][*]The Baltane Season 3 Challenger Box will be available, containing the following items:[list][*][b]*NEW*[/b] Baltane Season 3 Challenger 2nd Title: [img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q4/1087/baltane-s2-title.png[/img]
(See right for visual effect)
[list][*]Movement Speed +3%[/*][/list][/*][*]20x Precise Reforging Tools[/*][/list][/*][*]The [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/guide/advancedguide/general/75214/seasonal-commerce-system-guide]Seasonal Commerce Guide[/url] will be updated with Baltane Season 3, and Baltane Season 2 information will be archived.[/*][*]The stock for Bartering and Merchant Group Commerce won't reset.[/*][*]Commerce that has been completed while the season is changing will be refunded, however, please note that the purchase count won't be restored.[/*][*]Additional updates to Commerce are as follows:[list][*]Added two [Mercantile] quests available after reaching Commerce Rank Silver 5 as a guide quest for the Barter Trading system.[/*][/list][/*][/td][td][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1396/anaphora-v2.gif[/img][/td][/tr][/table]
[b]Other Changes[/b]
[list][*]Updated the skill description of Fate Foretold to indicate that its damage scales off unique cards drawn, rather than counting any card drawn (example: 5x Wheel of Fortune cards drawn would only count as 1x). This is a text only change.[/*][*]Although technically correct, the best kind of correct, to better differentiate them as well as represent more asterisms we have renamed the seven star version of Ursa Major that appears when Constellation Casting to Big Dipper. [i]We did think about naming it "Ursa Mid" though.[/i][/*][/list]
[h3][b]The following bugs have been fixed:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Some text was appearing incorrectly in the Metal Conversion and Fragmentation UIs. The text enjoyed its brief sojourn, and is now back in its proper place.[/*][*]Alchemic Sharpshooter's Arcana Link Level 6 was previously not displaying Archery Talent Weapon Max Damage +100 in the Arcana menu. This was a text only error, and it has been corrected.[/*][*]The "Open with Inventory" option for the Inventory Search window will once again properly save between channel changes and relogs.[/*][*]Corrected an issue where the Grade 20 Chariot Card on was giving less movement speed than expected.[/*][*]The following Title Coupons have been renamed to correct a mismatch. Note that the 2nd Titles themselves are unchanged, and are only listed here to help convey which title you would receive when using the renamed coupon.[list][*]Beautiful Starlight (Yellow effect)[list][*]Mysterious Starlight 2nd Title Coupon > Beautiful Starlight 2nd Title Coupon[/*][/list][/*][*]Mysterious Starlight (Purple effect)[list][*]Beautiful Starlight 2nd Title Coupon > Mysterious Starlight 2nd Title Coupon[/*][/list][/*][*]Enchanting Starlight (Blue effect)[list][*]Energetic Starlight 2nd Title Coupon > Enchanting Starlight 2nd Title Coupon
[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The following item has been renamed to properly reflect the skill name.[list][*]Bullet Storm Mastery Effect Change Card (Dazzling Shower) > Bullet Storm Effect Change Card (Dazzling Shower)[/*][/list][/*][*]The Christmas Tree in Dunbarton has been finally taken down. [list][*]The resident who was previously responsible for seeing to its removal, whose identity will be kept hidden for her own sake, was previously heard saying "We can just keep it up for another 10 months and it will be correct again. Look, I have books to sell!".[/*][/list][/*][*]Fixed an issue where gold may disappear when unregistering items from the Auction House.[/*][*]Quest Markers will now appear correctly when riding an Antique Mimic Pet. No need to ask random Milletians for directions![/*][*]Corrected an issue where the trade limit was reset when using an exchange coupon when in possession of specific bags.[/*][/list]
[h3][b]The following bugs have been fixed during the January 23rd Maintenance:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Items dropped on the ground will now properly clear from the ground when picked up.[/*][*]Production Boost Potions can no longer be used in Fragmentation.[/*][*][i]Hey, wait, come back![/i] Fixed an issue where the Raft would escape without you during the G17 Raft Escape quest.[/*][/list]
[h3][b]The following are known bugs:[/b][/h3]
[list][*][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1592/bug_catching.png[/img][/*][*]Under periodic conditions, Milletians will be temporarily unable to duel other Milletians.[/*][*]Astral Frames are not saving properly following weekly maintenance, leading to Milletian and other Cards to not appear as expected.[/*][*]There is an issue with the in-game Guild list not populating with guilds.[/*][*]There is an issue where one-time/limited items cannot be purchased from the in-game shop, but can be purchased on the Web Shop.[/*][*]Shop items with expiration times start counting down upon the player logging in or changing channels, rather than having their count down start when the item is purchased.[/*][*]In rare circumstances when rapidly casting Arrow Revolver, players will become unable to move or attack until receiving an attack or relogging.[/*][/list]

This update has several smaller text fixes, including the AS link quests, G20 and G26, some minor UI polish, and more! Let's keep making Mabinogi as great as possible in 2025![/*][*]Dorren found and fixed an magic alchemy jam with the Dry Ovens causing issues when recalling Synthesis favorites and attempting to register materials. [/*][*]A stylish malaise swept across the land, forcing outfit motions to reset to default. The source of this malady has been fixed, to the rejoicing of all fashionable. [/*][*]An issue was causing Milletians to freeze in place when opening the VIP Bank when it was on cooldown. This has been corrected. [/*][*]Fixed an issue where the movement speed granted by the "the Starspoken who is" title was not properly refreshing upon relogging.[/*][*]In Celestial Conjunction, the "Make [type] Aspect" effects have been renamed to "[type] Aspect Alignment".[/*][/list][h3][b]The following bugs were fixed during the December 19th, 2024 Maintenance:[/b][/h3][list][*]Fixed an issue causing reordered skills cast from the All Skills list to use incorrect skills. [/*][*]The "Lucent Neon" items have been readded to the Dressing Room and Auction House. Dressing Room Slots previously filled should remain filled.[/*][*]Fixed a bug where specific players were unable to open the [url=https://stage-mabinogi.nexon.net/news/95020/shopkeeper-s-sale-renewed-welcome-milletian-packages]Renewed Welcome Milletian Attendance Check Package[/url]. Affected players should now be able to open the box without issue. This is a display only error, your mouth has not been lost.[/*][*]The option for the Inventory Magnifying Glass to "Open with Inventory" is not presently saving correctly on a CC or relog.[/*][*]There is a small text error on the Fate Astrologer portion of the Master Plan Event.[/*][*]There is an issue with the in-game Guild list not populating with guilds.[/*][*]There is an issue where one-time/limited items cannot be purchased from the in-game shop, but can be purchased on the Web Shop.[/*][*]Shop items with expiration times start counting down upon the player logging in or changing channels, rather than having their count down start when the item is purchased.[/*][*]In rare circumstances when rapidly casting Arrow Revolver, players will become unable to move or attack until receiving an attack or relogging.[/*][/list]

[h2][b]Event Details[/b][/h2]
[list][*]During the event, characters registered with the Wandering Astrologer will receive three quests related to the Fate Astrology Talent![list][*][b][Event] Fate Astrology Talent Support: Scenario[/b][/*][*][b][Event] Fate Astrology Talent Support: Skill[/b][/*][*][b][Event] Fate Astrology Talent Support: Grandmaster.[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]Talk to the Wandering Astrologer in Tir Chonaill near the Blacksmith's Shop.[/*][*]Register a main character with the Wandering Astrologer, as part of the [b][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/94848]Master Plan: Brilliantly Shining Star Event[/url][/b] questline.[list][*][b]IMPORTANT NOTE: Registering a main character will register for both events; you cannot register different characters between the Master Plan: Brilliantly Shining Star and the Fate Astrologer Update events.[/b][/*][*]Players who have already registered for the Master Plan Event will automatically be enrolled in the Fate Astrologer Update Event.[/*][/list][/*][*]You can only register one character per account.[/*][/list][h2][b]Event Quests[/b][/h2]

[list][*]Clear the Fate Astrologer Scenario quests to learn more about the [b]possibilities[/b].[/*][*]You will receive the following rewards after completing the quest, [b][Event] Fate Astrology Talent Support: Scenario[/b]:[list][*]22,000 EXP[/*][*]22,000 Gold[/*][table equalcells=1][tr][td][*][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1059/waking-among-the-stars-2nd-title.png[/img]Walking Among the Stars 2nd Title Coupon[/b][list][*]Stats:[list][*]Dex +20[/*][*]Luck +20[/*][*]Gathering Success Rate +5%[/*][*]Gathering Speed +5%[/*][*]Bonus Ducats +5%[/*][*]Automatic Fishing Success Rate Increased[/*][*]Movement Speed +1%[/*][/list][/*][*]Note: Title effects expire after 30 days.[/*][/list][/td][td][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1061/walking-stars-title-effect.gif[/img][/td][/tr][/table][/list][/list]

notes.title: Astrologer Part 2: Stellar Reunion Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1024/250108_decemberastrologerpart-2_newsarticleheader_940x290.png[/img]
[hr][/hr][h2][b]Update Details[/b][/h2]
[b]Astrologer Part 1: Written in the Stars[/b]

[url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/94832/astrologer-part-1-written-in-the-stars-update][b]Read the full update details here.[/b][/url] The movements of the stars tell stories about our past, present, and even the future. Astrologers study star patterns and make predictions about what the future may hold. People with this special talent can see a multitude of possibilities hidden in the stars. Meet Neal and Delaney, witness the Stellar Citadel, and reach for the stars as you gain new talents and skills, wielding powerful weapons in the new Astrologer update!

[b]Astrologer Part 2: Stellar Reunion[/b]

Study your constellations and gain new life skills as the Astrologer update continues! Join Delaney and Neal in the rest of their story after the end of their long journey, and learn the ways of Fate Astrology. Master of many life skills, this type of Astrologer can view fates, catch stars, craft materials, and more!
[hr][/hr][h2][b]Fate Astrologer[/b][/h2][table equalcells=1 noborder=1][tr][td][list][*]A new Fate Astrologer Talent and 5 new Fate Astrologer skills have been added to the [Astrology] skill tab.[list][*]Fate Astrologer related items, titles, journal achievements and Grandmaster Quests have been introduced.[/*][/list][/*][*]Additional details for Fate Astrologer can be viewed on the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/micro-site/astrologer/part2]dedicated microsite[/url].[/*][/list][/td][td]          [img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1100/fate-astrology-talent.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table]
[b]Astrology Scenario Quests Part 2[/b]

Those seeking to [b]craft[/b] the stars themselves can begin their journey once they have completed the Astrologer Part 1 Scenario Quests, up to [b][Astrologer] The Workings of the Stellar Citadel[/b]. Begin viewing the possibilities of a Fate Astrologer with Delaney in the Stellar Citadel.[list][*][b]New Milletians[/b] who choose Fate Astrology for their first talent after rebirthing will be granted [i]‘the Aspiring Fate Astrologer’[/i] 1st title.[list][*]Title Effects:[list][*]Magic Attack +15[/*][*]MP +20[/*][*]HP +20[/*][/list][*]The title is available to you until you reach Level 10,000.[/*][/list][/*][/list]Upon visiting Delaney in the Star Citadel, you'll continue the questline with the following quests, rewards, and learned skills:
[list][*][b][Fate Astrology] Wand of Lesser Willpower[/b][list][*]Complete the quest to unlock the [b]Constellation Casting skill[/b], 5,000 Gold, 50,000 EXP, a [b]Constellation Rod[/b] and [b]100x Constellation Bait[/b].[/*][/list][/*][*][b][Fate Astrology] Pentacle of Good Fortune[/b][list][*]Complete the quest to unlock the Stellar Handicraft skill, 5,000 Gold, 50,000 EXP, and the [b]materials to craft Constellation Bait.[/b][/*][/list][/*][*][b][Fate Astrology] Cup of Overflowing Emotion[/b][list][*]Complete the quest to unlock the [b]Astral Imaging[/b] skill and [b]Astral Imprinting[/b] skill, 5,000 Gold, 50,000 EXP, and 20x Astral Sticker Kits.[/*][/list][/*][*][b][Fate Astrology] Sword of Fate’s Resolve[/b][list][*]Complete the quest to unlock the [b]Cartomancy[/b] skill, 5,000 Gold, 50,000 EXP, and [b]10x Conjuration Crystals[/b].[/*][*]Neal and Delaney have been added to the list of NPCs that can be invited through the Spirit Campfire Invitation.[list][*]Neal: 5x Rigel Crystal[/*][*]Delaney: 1x Neal’s Corn Soup[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]Fate Astrologer Skills[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]General Fate Astrologer Skills[/b][/h3]
[list][*]AP Training cannot be used for skills of this talent.[/*][*]When using a skill, a certain amount of mana and stamina will be consumed.[/*][/list][h3][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1104/constellation-casting.png[/img] Constellation Casting[/b][/h3]
[list][*]When the time in Erinn is between 6:00 PM and 6:00 AM, the reflections of the stars are the brightest, and [b]Constellation Casting[/b] will be available for use. [/*][*]This is a skill that allows you to obtain Star Reflection fragments, materials used for [b]Stellar Handicraft[/b].[list][*]Procyon/Polaris/Arcturus/Hadar/Rigel/Canopus/Altair Fragments[/*][*]Procyon/Polaris/Arcturus/Hadar/Rigel/Canopus/Altair Crystals[/*][/list][/*][*]The skill can be used at existing fishing spots.[/*][*]A [b]Constellation Rod[/b] and [b]Constellation Bait Box[/b] is required to begin casting for the stars' reflection![list][*]The Constellation Rod cannot be reforged or upgraded.[/*][/list][/*][*]When fishing manually, you can play a minigame to find constellations. The number of stars you find will be scored, and you can earn Star Reflection fragments depending on the score.[list][*]After a certain amount of time has passed in the mini-game, stars that are not the correct answer will gradually disappear.[/*][*]If you succeed in matching the stars during the mini-game, a buff effect for the next Constellation Cast will activate an increased biting speed +10.[/*][/list][/*][*]Auto fishing is possible for those that wish to just enjoy the tranquility under the stars.[/*][*]Constellation Casting is [b]not[/b] affected by existing Fishing skill related effects.[/*][/list][h3][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1105/stellar-handicraft.png[/img] Stellar Handicraft[/b][/h3]
[list][*]You can create various items used by Astrologers by harnessing the power of Star Reflections paired with the Fatespinner, located in the Stellar Citadel.[/*][*]You can touch the Fatespinner, or use the skill nearby to open the crafting menu.[/*][*][b]38 new recipes[/b] have been added for Stellar Handicraft, including the following items:
[list][*]Altair[/*][*]Altair Crystal[/*][*]Arcturus[/*][*]Arcturus Crystal[/*][*]Astral Sticker Kit[/*][*]Blank Astral Card[/*][*]Canopus[/*][*]Canopus Crystal[/*][*]Conjuration Crystal[/*][*]Constellation Bait[/*][*]Constellation Rod[/*][*]Cups Card[/*][*]Hadar[/*][*]Hadar Crystal[/*][*]Oracle's Pavilion[/*][*]Oracle's Tools[/*][*]Pentacles Card[/*][*]Polaris[/*][*]Polaris Crystal[/*][*]Procyon[/*][*]Procyon Crystal[/*][*]Rare Cups Card[/*][*]Rare Pentacles Card[/*][*]Rare Swords Card[/*][*]Rare Wands Card[/*][*]Rigel[/*][*]Rigel Crystal[/*][*]Starter Cups Card[/*][*]Starter Pentacles Card[/*][*]Starter Swords Card[/*][*]Starter Wands Card[/*][*]Stellar Powder[/*][*]Swords Card[/*][*]Wands Card[/*][/list][/*][*]Entries have been added for Stellar Handicraft in the Crafting Diary.[/*][*]Astrologer Tarot Cards now have Grades from Grade 0 to Grade 30 and can be crafted through Stellar Handicraft.[list][*]The higher the grade, the better the buff effect from the Tarot Card drawn in Fate Foretold. [/*][*]You can create a Card Pack with Stellar Handicraft.[/*][*]Starter Cards are the lowest grade, with Rare being of the highest grade.[/*][*]When opening a card pack, if a card of the same or lower grade appears, you will obtain an amount of Pollux instead, used to craft new Card Packs.[/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1101/astral-imagin.png[/img] Astral Imaging[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Astral Imaging is a skill that can take an image of a Subject, capturing a moment in time.[/*][*]No resources are consumed when using this skill.[/*][*]Capture a subject’s moment by clicking on them. You can capture Milletians (including yourself), NPCs, and monsters.
[list][*]Transformations, Spirit Weapon Awakenings, and Marionettes cannot be captured.[/*][*]Subjects eligible for Astral Imaging will have an HP gauge displayed above their head when hovering the subject. You cannot capture the subject if it does not have an HP gauge displayed.[/*][/list][/*][*]You can save up to 10 images at one time which will be present in the Astral Imprinting skill menu.[/*][/list][h3][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1102/astral-imprinting.png[/img] Astral Imprinting[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Astral Imprinting is a skill that allows you to decorate your own Tarot Cards using the Subjects captured via Astral Imaging, and various elements including stickers and border designs for your cards.[/*][*]When designing a card via Astral Imprinting, you can add decorations up to 100 points, a cost accumulated when adding elements to the card.
[list][*]Each decoration element applies the following cost.
[list][*]Subjects: 8[/*][*]Borders: 2[/*][*]Sticker Shop: 1[/*][*]Extracted Stickers: 2[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Stickers in the Sticker Shop within the Stickers tab can be selected unlimitedly, each costing 1,000 Gold to place into the design.[list][*]The cost of the selected stickers will be shown before completing a card.[/*][/list][/*][*]You can create your own stickers by using an [b]Astral Sticker Kit[/b] to create stickers using the item icons of items in your inventory.[list][*][b]Astral Sticker Kits[/b] can be crafted with [b]Stellar Handicraft[/b].[/*][*]When using the kit, you will be able to select which item you would like to create an [b]Astral Sticker Pack[/b] for.[list][*]The kit will be consumed on use. The target item will not be lost.[/*][*]Using the [b]Astral Sticker Pack[/b] will add the sticker to your Extracted Stickers within the Stickers tab.[/*][*][b]Astral Sticker Packs[/b] can be traded with others, but cannot be sold on the Auction House.[/*][*]You may also use Astral Sticker Kits by clicking Extract Stickers from the Extracted Stickers menu. When done this way, the Extracted Sticker will be available for immediate use without creating a sticker pack.[/*][*]Using an Astral Sticker Kit on a weapon that has had a Weapon Appearance Scroll applied to it will create a sticker of the transformed weapon.[/*][/list][/*][*]Each extracted sticker may only be used once and will disappear from the Stickers tab after being finalized on a card.[/*][/list][/*][*]Decorative borders are unlocked based on the grade of the Tarot Cards you have acquired, and are unlocked permanently.[/*][*]A variety of card backgrounds are available.[/*][*]You can save the completed decorated cards in Blank Astral Cards, crafted via Stellar Handicraft, and these completed cards can be traded with others.[/*][*]The Astral Frame Homestead prop has been added which can display completed card designs. Astral Frames can be installed on Homesteads and Moonlight Islands using the Astral Frame Homestead item, or 75 Pon through the Construction List.[list][*]Looking for additional Constellation themed Homestead items? The following Constellations have also been added:[list][*]Monocerus Constellation (100 Pon)[/*][*]Vulpecula Constellation (75 Pon)[/*][*]Aries Constellation (75 Pon)[/*][*]Cetus Constellation (75 Pon)[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Completed card designs can be applied as the appearance of a Tarot Card.[/*][/list][h3][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1103/cartomancy.png[/img] Cartomancy[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Cartomancy allows one to consult the cards to receive the guidance of fate, allowing you to either accept it for yourself or share your fate with other Milletians to gain access to the drawn card’s chosen destiny.[list][*]The guidance of fate will last up to 36 minutes at rank 1.[list][*]The destiny cannot be overwritten while it is still in effect.[/*][/list][/*][*]Accepting or Sharing will require Conjuration Crystals, an item made using Stellar Handicraft.[/*][*]Each of the 22 tarot cards will have a different effect, shown in the chart below.[/*][/list][/*][*]By [b]Accepting Fate[/b], you will immediately receive the guidance of fate of the drawn card.[list][*]This will consume 1x Conjuration Crystal, and place the ability on a 36 minute cooldown.[/*][*]The fortune of the reader will be revealed.[/*][/list][/*][*]By [b]Sharing Fate[/b], you grant the guidance of fate to yourself and the allies you have shared the drawn card with.[list][*]You will be prompted to select how many Milletians to share with, up to 7 at rank 1.[/*][*]The drawn card will be held face down above your head, allowing Milletians to receive the fate alongside you. This will last up to 5 minutes at rank 1.[/*][*]Once all of the shared fates have been foretold, or the reader ends sharing, the drawn card will be received and all players will receive the guidance.[/*][*]This will consume 1x Conjuration Crystal for yourself plus an additional 1x Conjuration Crystal per share (up to 8 Crystals to share with 7 Milletians), and place the ability on a 36 minute cooldown.[/*][/list][/*][*]One may also choose to simply [b]Read Fortune[/b].[list][*]This will not consume any Conjuration Crystals, but will still place the ability on a 36 minute cooldown. The guidance of fate will not be granted.[/*][*]The fortune of the reader will be revealed. A daily single card reading can give direction to the unknown, or explore possibilities of the future.[/*][/list][/*][*]Oracle’s Tools and Oracle’s Pavilion have been added to allow you to provide readings for others.[list][*]By using one of these items, the reader will sit, allowing others to take the seat across from them to have their fortunes read.[/*][*]A three-card spread tells of the Past, Present, and Future of a subject.[/*][*]The upright and reversed cards will hold the answers, but we give them meaning.
[list][*](Cards drawn in this way will not place the ability on cooldown, and will have no gameplay effect.)[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Cartomancy Tarot Buff List[/b]
[table][tr][th]Card[/th][th]Applied Fate Buff[/th][th]Increased Effect[/th][/tr][tr][td]The Fool[/td][td]Increased Exploration EXP[/td][td]2x[/td][/tr][tr][td]The Magician[/td][td]Increased Magic Attack damage[/td][td]+35[/td][/tr][tr][td]The High Priestess[/td][td]Increased Movement Speed during Commerce[/td][td]+20%[/td][/tr][tr][td]The Empress[/td][td]Increased duration of Harvest Song[/td][td]+300 Seconds[/td][/tr][tr][td]The Emperor[/td][td]Increased Critical damage[/td][td]+2%[/td][/tr][tr][td]The Hierophant[/td][td]Increased chance of receiving a Huge Lucky Bonus[/td][td]+10%[/td][/tr][tr][td]The Lovers[/td][td]Increased Music Buff effect[/td][td]+2[/td][/tr][tr][td]The Chariot[/td][td]Increased duration of Battlefield Overture[/td][td]+300 Seconds[/td][/tr][tr][td]Strength[/td][td]Increased Maximum damage[/td][td]+35[/td][/tr][tr][td]The Hermit[/td][td]Increased Defense/Magic Defense[/td][td]+20[/td][/tr][tr][td]Wheel of Fortune[/td][td]Increased Production success rate[/td][td]+5%[/td][/tr][tr][td]Justice[/td][td]Increased Max HP[/td][td]+1000[/td][/tr][tr][td]The Hanged Man[/td][td]Increased Combat EXP[/td][td]2x[/td][/tr][tr][td]Death[/td][td]Increased number of successful Part-Time Jobs[/td][td]2x[/td][/tr][tr][td]Temperance[/td][td]Increased Movement speed[/td][td]+40%[/td][/tr][tr][td]The Devil[/td][td]Increases Max Critical Chance[/td][td]+1%[/td][/tr][tr][td]The Tower[/td][td]Increased Alchemy damage[/td][td]+15[/td][/tr][tr][td]The Star[/td][td]Increase Max MP[/td][td]+1000[/td][/tr][tr][td]The Moon[/td][td]Increased Max Stamina[/td][td]+1000[/td][/tr][tr][td]The Sun[/td][td]Increased duration of Vivace[/td][td]+300 Seconds[/td][/tr][tr][td]Judgement[/td][td]Increased Gathering speed[/td][td]+20[/td][/tr][tr][td]The World[/td][td]Increased Piercing[/td][td]+1[/td][/tr][/table]
[i]Curious to know what else was added or which bugs have been fixed?

[h3][b]Astrologer Update:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The new Battle Astrologer Talent is here! See the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/94832/astrologer-part-1-update][b]update post[/b][/url] for more information![list][*]An all new story! Join Delaney and Neal as they progress in their pilgrimage.[/*][*]New Weapons, Enchants, Upgrades, and more![/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h3][b]Additional following changes have been made to the game:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The number of spirits you can contract has been increased by 2, allowing you to contract up to [b]8[/b] types of Spirit Weapons.[list][*]Eiry the Ancient Spirit is not included in the maximum contractable quantity.[/*][/list][/*][*]You are now able to search and sort your Point Inventory![list][*]You can select your point inventory to display your items in either alphabetical order or by date when you received the item.[/*][/list][/*][/list][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q4/1769/point-inventory-search.png[/img]
[list][*]The maximum number of additional equipment slots that can be expanded with Extra Equipment Slot Expansion Coupon will be increased from 12 -> 16.[list][*]Hotkeys for the additional Extra Equipment Slots have also been added under the Hotkey Settings menu.[/*][/list][/*][/list][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q4/1751/ees-expansion.png[/img]
[list][*]The Pet/Partner limit has been increased from 300 to 400.[/*][/list]
[list][*]A "Related Quest" description has been added to item tooltips.[list][*]These will display items that are relevant to Generational Storylines, Arcana Questline, etc.[/*][*]Quest Names are shaded depending on whether the quest has been completed, is in progress, or already completed.[/*][/list][/*][/list][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q4/1756/quest-relation.png[/img]

How do you feel about them?[/*][/list][/*][*]You can now collect Flint near Pera Volcano through the use of Rain Casting.[/*][*]The following balance adjustments have been implemented:
[list][*][b]Smokescreen[/b][list][*]The duration of the effect has been increased; for Rank 1, increased from 30 seconds to 60 seconds.[/*][*]When using Smokescreen on an enemy that is already under the effect, the condition timer will refresh.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Fateweaver[/b][list][*]The duration of the effect has been increased; for Level 10, increased from 30 seconds to 60 seconds.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Death Mark[/b][list][*]The duration of the effect has been increased; for Rank 1 to Dan 3, increased from 15 seconds to 40 seconds.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The probability of a rank increase for Precise Reforging Tools, Exquisite Reforging Tools, and Dazzling Reforging Tools has been increased.[list][*]The probability of a rank increase for Precise Reforging Tools will be increased to the same probability as the Exquisite Reforging Tools.[/*][/list][/*][/list][quote][b]【 Developer Comments 】[/b]
[i]This Astrologer update also brings the addition of the Scythe weapon, which is expected to increase demand for Reforging Tools. Accordingly, in order to alleviate some of the burden of using Reforging Tools, the rank upgrade probability of paid Reforging Tools has been increased. In order to narrow the gap between paid and free reforges, Precise Reforging Tools have been adjusted to have the same probability of being used for rank upgrades as the upgraded Exquisite Reforging Tools.[/i][/quote]
[h3][b]The following bugs have been fixed:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Several typo fixes this month across swaths of the game. From further unifying Rudolf to Rudolph on a few items, fixes to assorted quest texts, or more- we will always search high and low to improve the script quality for Mabinogi. Thank you, as always, for your reports![/*][*]The suite of Mysterious [Color] Bags have been renamed slightly in the following format:[list][*]Mysterious Horizontal Green Bag (10x17) -> Mysterious Green Bag (10x17) - Horizontal[/*][/list][*]After an unfortunate mix-up, Edern and Gleywas have demanded that the versatile Kraken Sucker be labeled appropriately. The following items have been renamed:[list][*]The Kraken Sucker for Blacksmithing purposes will be named Fierce Kraken Sucker.[/*][*]The Kraken Sucker for Cooking purposes will be named Fresh Kraken Sucker.[/*][/list][*]The following since-removed event items have had their slots removed from the Chair section of the Dressing Room.[list][*]Beginner's/Journeyman's/Professional's Mannequin (event) [/*][/list][*]The visibility of the Spellwalk glyph has been improved, allowing one to better see another's glyphs and the changed visuals from their Effect Change Cards.[/*][*][b]Milletians that have been trade-blocked due to their first Item Shop purchase will be able to drop Storyline items to enter dungeons unimpeded.[/b][/*][*]Fixed an issue causing Spirit of Tuan pets to miss their rhythm. Whisper of Tuan will properly increase Music skill duration every time.[/*][*]Condensed Strength Fragment: One-handed Blunt Weapon has been added to Gillach's Shop.[/*][*]Unusable items involving the removed Bonita Twin Ribbon (Handicraft) recipe will no longer drop.[list][*]Ruined Bonita Twin Ribbon[/*][*]Bonita Twin Ribbon Repair Kit[/*][/list][*]Slight adjustments to various UIs to better accommodate text. Most notably the chat text for Direct Messages and Altruism's Quest Chat Room will no longer be cut off by the window.[/*][*]The text for Grandmaster Mage Unique Effect now properly indicates that you need a Magic Weapon equipped.[/*][*]The male hairstyle Parted Long Hair has been renamed to Regal Parted Long Hair.[/*][*]A prankster in the Royal Court swapped the ink used for naming Tara Banquet Tables with an invisible brand, causing chaos as nobody knew where to sit! More fine ink has been imported, and tables will once again be able to be named.[/*][*]The skill description of the Ninja skill Smokescreen has been clarified to better describe its effect.[/*][h2][*][i]#fixedtailchasers[/i][/*][/h2]

[h3][b]The following are known bugs:[/b][/h3]
[list][*][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1592/bug_catching.png[/img][/*][*]There is an issue with the in-game Guild list not populating with guilds.[/*][*]There is an issue where one-time/limited items cannot be purchased from the in-game shop, but can be purchased on the Web Shop.[/*][*]Shop items with expiration times start counting down upon the player logging in or changing channels, rather than having their count down start when the item is purchased.[/*][*]In rare circumstances when rapidly casting Arrow Revolver, players will become unable to move or attack until receiving an attack or relogging.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Milletian Events: Battle Astrologer Update Event
notes.notes:
Ready to master the Battle Astrologer Talent? Looking for a powerful weapon to wield with your new skills? Check out the info below.

 
[h2][b]Battle Astrologer Support Event[/b][/h2]
[b]Event Dates:[/b] [b]Thursday, December 12th, After Maintenance - Thursday, February 13th, Before Maintenance[/b]
[list][*]During the entire event period, the following benefits will be active:[list][*]Up to 12x Skill Training Cap for Astrologer Skills[/*][*]10 Skill Lifter for Astrologer Skills (Gain 10% Skill Training when advancing to the next level of a skill)[/*][/list][/*][/list]
These skill effects will stack with the [b][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/94848#event-buffs]Master Plan: Brilliantly Shining Star Event Buffs[/url][/b], so make sure to explore all benefits during this period!
[h2][b]Battle Astrologer Update Event[/b][/h2]
[b]Event Dates:[/b] [b]Thursday, December 12th, After Maintenance - Thursday, February 13th, Before Maintenance[/b]
[h2][b]Event Details[/b][/h2][list][*]During the event, you will receive the guide quest, [b][Event] Battle Astrology Talent Support: Weapon[/b].[/*][*]Talk to the Wandering Astrologer in Tir Chonaill near the Blacksmith's Shop.[/*][*]Register a main character with the Wandering Astrologer, as part of the [b][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/94848]Master Plan: Brilliantly Shining Star Event[/url][/b] questline.[/*][*]You can only register one character per account.[/*][*]You will receive the following rewards after completing [Event] Battle Astrology Talent Support: Weapon:[list][*][b]22,000 EXP[/b][/*][*][b]22,000 Gold[/b][/*][*][b]Perseus Peregrine Scythe[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q4/1697/perseus-scythe.png[/img][/b]
[list][*]Immediately after completing the previous quest and questlines, you will receive the quest [b][Event] Battle Astrology Talent Support: Enhancement[/b].[list][*]You will receive the following rewards after completing [Event] Battle Astrology Talent Support: Enhancement:[list][*][b]22,000 EXP[/b][/*][*][b]22,000 Gold[/b][/*][*][b]Various Objective Rewards[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q4/1699/astrologer-event-ui-button.png[/img]Progress for all quest objectives can be tracked in your [b]Battle Astrology Talent Support[/b] UI! You can access this by clicking on the [b]Scythe icon[/b] under your Event UI.[/*][/list][table][tr][th]Battle Astrology Talent Support: Enhancement[/th][/tr][tr][th]Objective[/th][th]Reward[/th][/tr][tr][td]
Use Battle Astrology Skills 200 Times
[/td][td]
Special Upgrade Hammer (Event)
