This renovation may take some time, so check back later this year on its re-opening![list][*]The ranking reward distribution will be processed for May participants.[/*][*]It will not be possible to enter Fahmes Ruin after Saturday, June 1st, 2024 at 12:00 AM PDT.[list][*]Entrance to Fahmes Ruin will be blocked.[/*][*]You cannot talk to Fahmes Ruin NPCs.[/*][*]The Enigmatic Hourglass will be unable to be used.[/*][/list][/*][*]With the June 6th maintenance, the following changes will be made:[list][*]The Enigmatic Hourglass and related Fahmes Ruin quests will be removed. [/*][*]NPCs won't appear in Fahmes Ruin region. [/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The end of game survey will now open in your default browser. [/*][*]Existing ‘Faint Memory’ and ‘Wistful’ enchant scrolls received from Blaanid’s Brave Boost have been changed to be untradable items. [/*][*]The following items can now be stored in the dressing room: [list][*]Japanese Sandals [/*][*]Supreme Saint Guardian's Sword Wings (Enchantable) (Dyeable) [/*][/list][/*][*]The following items have been renamed and can now be stored in the dressing room: [list][*]Swim Trunks (M) -> Swim Trunks (Fish Print) (M) [/*][*]Swim Trunks (M) -> Swim Trunks (Two-Tone) (M) [/*][*]Swim Trunks (M) -> Swim Trunks (Triangle Pattern) (M) [/*][*]Swim Trunks (M) -> Swim Trunks (Floral Pattern) (M) [/*][*]Swimsuit (F) -> Swimsuit (Polka Dot) (F) [/*][*]Swimsuit (F) -> Swimsuit (Two-Tone) (F) [/*][*]Swimsuit (F) -> Swimsuit (Side-Tie) (F) [/*][*]Swimsuit (F) -> Swimsuit (Floral Print) (F) [/*][*]Yukata (F) -> Yukata (Style A) (F) [/*][*]Yukata (F) -> Yukata (Style B) (F) [/*][*]Yukata (F) -> Yukata (Style C) (F) [/*][*]Yukata (F) -> Yukata (Style D) (F) [/*][*]Yukata (F) -> Yukata (Style E) (F) [/*][*]Yukata (F) -> Yukata (Style F) (F) [/*][*]Yukata (M) -> Yukata (Style A) (M) [/*][*]Yukata (M) -> Yukata (Style B) (M) [/*][*]Yukata (M) -> Yukata (Style C) (M) [/*][*]Yukata (M) -> Yukata (Style D) (M) [/*][*]Yukata (M) -> Yukata (Style E) (M) [/*][*]Yukata (M) -> Yukata (Style F) (M)[/*][/list][/*][*]The following items have been renamed: [list][*](Special) Forest Ranger Muffler Outfit -> (Special) Forest Ranger Hooded Outfit [/*][*]Noble Small Draconian (Adjective) Wing -> Noble Small Draconian (Adjective) Wings[/*][/list][/*][*]The following titles (and related text) have been renamed to be consistent: [list][*]Intense Cosmic Milky Way 2nd Title -> Luminous Cosmic Milky Way 2nd Title [/*][*]Special Luminous Cosmos Milky Way 2nd Title - > Special Luminous Cosmic Milky Way 2nd Title [/*][*]Special Brilliant Cosmos Milky Way 2nd Title - > Special Brilliant Cosmic Milky Way 2nd Title [/*][*]Special Radiant Cosmos Milky Way 2nd Title - > Special Radiant Cosmic Milky[/*][/list][/*][*]All Golden Experience Fruits now display their values in the item name. Buon giorno! [/*][*]The Saga mission "Retreat to Vales" will no longer drop items on monster defeat.[/*][*]Cliona found hidden boxes full of Blacksmith Manual - Hand Chimes, and has subsequently added them to the Tara Auction item pool. [/*][*]To make it more clear which does what, we have improved the descriptions of the Extra Equipment Slot Coupon (# days) and the Extra Equipment Slot Expansion Coupon. [list][*]Additionally, we've also made the pluralizations of the Extra Equipment Slots consistent on the various HUD text.[/*][*]"Slot" refers to an individual extra equipment set. [/*][*]"Slots" refers to the group of sets, and the feature as a whole.[/*][/list][/*][*]Some improvements have been made to the Soul Stream that should allow players to return to Erinn much sooner upon being disconnected unexpectedly.[/*][*]The title menu has received an adjustment! We have expanded the width of the title menu to allow all titles to be read.
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1565/updated-title-ui.png[/img][/*][/list][h3][b]The following bug fixes have been made to the game:[/b][/h3][list][*]Ever continuing Generational Typo polish, this month starring G24 and G25. Also fixed a few missing periods scattered abound.[/*][*]After an hour long diatribe with Eochaid extolling the virtues of scythes, he has determined which casting animations for Harmonic Saints to use while equipped with the following Staves: [list][*]Staff of Ruination [/*][*]Guardian Scythe Staff [/*][*]Sickle Rat Staff[/*][/list][/*][*]During G16's Unspeakable Thoughts, the Secret Meeting was too secret, causing Milletians to spawn on the ground level rather than the top of the tower. [/*][*]We've rewoven the messages displayed when applying Fateweaver to a target. Originally this was just to remove a stray space before 'specially', but we felt it needed some further clarity and a splash of color![/*][*]Fixed the ampersand (&) display issues with items! It was present on a few equipment names, but mostly a lot of potions. May we walk free of the invisible danger pretzel.[/*][*]The message that displays when attempting to study too close to another player has been translated. Just in time- what do you mean the exam was last week?[/*][*]Several Muffler style wings introduced in the Stellar Wing Box were temporarily inaccessible in the Dressing Room. They can now be reaccessed![/*][*]Visual fixes for the following items: [list][*](Special) Bejeweled Monarch Gown (F) [/*][*](Special) Winter Forest Wanderer Outfit (F), Gloves (F), and Boots (F) [/*][*]Winter Forest Campsite [/*][*](Ancient) [Water/Forest] Dragon [Lordling/Maiden] Plus Support Puppets [/*][*]Seraphic Cantabile Holy Censer [/*][*](Special) [Showy/Sweet] Circus Performer's Outfit (M), Gloves (M), and Boots (M) [/*][*]Guardian Boots (M)[/*][*]Digital Destiny Gloves (M)[/*][/list][/*][*]Fixed an issue with the Shooting Star minigame where the indicator would disappear under certain conditions. Get your game on, go play![/*][*]Corrected the Homestead Library Shelf's icon on the Building Information window. [/*][*]The post-game Time Remaining display for the Memory Match mini-game will now display the correct time. [/*][*]Fixed an issue in character creation where the Human’s race description would disappear if scrolled down.[/*][*]It is no longer possible to enter a Mafia match while you are in your Homestead as the game starts.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where in some situations Hans would refuse to draw a portrait.[/*][*]References to 'Four-Legged Animal Mark' have been corrected to 'Sheep Mark'. We believe this to be a conspiracy from Pan to lord over other quadrupeds.[/*][/list][h3][b]The following are known bugs:[/b][/h3][list][*][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1592/bug_catching.png[/img][/*][*]In rare circumstances when rapidly casting Arrow Revolver, players will become unable to move or attack until receiving an attack or relogging.[/*][*]Shop items with expiration times start counting down upon the player logging in or changing channels, rather than having their countdown start when the item is purchased.[/*][*]There is an issue where one-time/limited items cannot be purchased from the in-game shop, but can be on the web shop.[/*][*]There is an issue with the in-game Guild list not populating with guilds.[/*][*]In some cases, it is not possible to transfer leadership to another player within the guild.[/*][/list]

notes.title: May Quality of Life Update
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Dungeon Changes[/b][/h2]
[b]General Tech Duinn Changes[/b]
[list][*]Instructions for some missions have been improved to provide clear indicators such as monster deaths (Example: Golems in Awakened Abyssal Lord) or item use requirements (Example: Lava Lump in Seven Nightmares).[/*][*]The Lava Decal spawned when defeating enemies in the Salamander family will now have a casting indicator to warn of the incoming danger. [/*][*]Fixed an issue causing Lava Decals (such as those from Salamanders) to stun Milletians through Iron Will.[/*][*]A timer gauge has been added to show the time remaining until Salamanders "self-destruct" after a certain period of time.[/*][*]Removed the following skills from most non-Boss enemies: [/*][list][*]Heavy Stander[/*][*]Natural Shield[/*][*]Mana Deflector[/*][/list][*]Bosses will no longer resist the following skills: [/*][list][*]Final Hit[/*][*]Magnum Shot[/*][*]Firebolt[/*][*]Chain Impale[/*][/list][*]The following enemies will have a cooldown added to their Ice Spear spell: [/*][list][*]Cethlenn[/*][*]Tathlum [/*][*]Red Lizard Witch[/*][*]Black Moon Follower[/*][/list][*]The following rewards will now have a longer despawn timer when on the floor:[/*][list][*]Evil Eye Sealstone[/*][*]Function Geata Fragment[/*][*]Remnants of Illusion[/*][/list][/list]
[b]Revived Illusion Changes[/b]
[list][*]A timer to show when the next Salamander will be summoned has been added as a visual gauge above the Red Lizard Witch enemy.[/*][*]The gimmick of Red Lizard Witch reflecting damage from being hit has been removed.
[/*][/list]
[b]Feth Fiada Changes[/b]
[list][*]The draw distance for Feth Fiada has been slightly increased. [/*][*]The frequency of how often the following enemies teleport in combat has been reduced: [/*][list][*]Fire Slime[/*][*]Ice Slime[/*][*]Lightning Slime[/*][/list][*]Lightning Slimes and Black Moon Followers will no longer become temporarily immune to all damage upon knockdown, and will instead gain a temporary boost to their Protection and Magic Protection.[/*][list][*]This change also applies to all Lightning Slimes outside of Feth Fiada.[/*][/list][*]Previously Illusion Zombies and Black Moon Followers would ignore damage below a certain threshold. This has been removed, and their HP values have been increased to compensate.[/*][*]During the Hallway Puzzle, Illusion Zombies will now spawn in the same fixed locations on both Easy and Hard modes.[/*][*]Tathlum's "Spin Dash" skill, which attacks while rolling, has been changed:[/*][list][*]Cast time of the skill before rolling has been increased.[/*][*]An attack range indicator is displayed during the casting time.[/*][*]The monster can be damaged while using the skill.[/*][*]The attack range has been reduced to a narrower range.[/*][*]The attack duration, which was slightly different between difficulties, has been adjusted to be the same in all difficulties.[/*][*]These changes also apply to the Frostwork Soul monsters in Glenn Bearna.[/*][/list][*]A timer gauge has been added to show the remaining time towards when Black Moon Followers will disappear.[/*][*]When the first Tech Duinn Geata is defeated, the particle indicator will be shown to point towards the location of the next orb.[/*][*]Tech Duinn Geatas will now always spawn in a fixed location on both Easy and Hard modes. [/*][*]The following attacks from Tech Duinn Geata will now display cast indicators, and have had their casting time increased to allow better reaction: [/*][list][*]Light of Annihilation[/*][*]Light of Destruction[/*][*]Windmill[/*][/list][/list]
[b]Seven Nightmare Changes[/b]
[list][*]During the Salamander puzzle,[list][*]The "Black Explosion" caused by the Evil Eye Monolith has been removed.[/*][*]Lava Lumps held inside the inventory will now automatically be used against the Evil Eye Monolith every 5 seconds. The Lava Lump can still be manually activated.[/*][/list][/*][*]During the Black Moon Follower Battle puzzle,[list][*]The radius of the Lava Decals has been decreased, and the amount that appears has been increased.[/*][*]A preview casting indicator has been added for decals that are about to appear. [/*][/list][/*][*]During Cethlenn’s boss fight,[list][*]Cethlenn's "Summon Reaper" skill indicator now has a higher resolution.[list][*]The skill indicator has also been changed to better match its range.[/*][/list][/*][*]Cethlenn’s Staff enemies have had the following changes made:[list][*]Staves will pass through targets, applying a bleed effect on hit.  [/*][*]Their attack speed has been increased.[/*][*]They will no longer cause knockback on hit.[/*][*]The enemy name and health bars will be hidden to reduce noise. [/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Awakened Abyssal Lord Changes[/b]
[list][*]During the Golem Puzzle, the moving sacrifice circle has been removed and replaced with a large stationary one in the center.[/*][*]During the Barrier/Bastion Puzzle,[/*][list][*]A timer to show when the next Barrier Spirits will be summoned has been added as a visual gauge above the Bastion enemy.[/*][*]The maximum number of summoned Barrier Spirits has been changed so that it does not exceed a certain number of summoned monsters.[/*][/list][*]During the Boss fight, the location of the name and health bars of the Soaring Leg enemy have been improved to be visible from the floor
[/*][/list]
[b]Crom Bás Changes[/b]
[list][*]Defense and Protection of regular Crom Bás monsters has been reduced.[list][*]When Dark Erg levels are between 71~100, the Protection of regular monsters has been reduced, but their HP has been increased. [/*][/list][/*][*]Removed the following skills from most non-Boss enemies: [list][*]Heavy Stander[/*][*]Natural Shield[/*][*]Mana Deflector[/*][/list][/*][*]The defense-increasing Divine Blessing effect from Frozen Cari and Dark Cari will no longer apply to Frozen Cari and Dark Cari. [/*][*]Stun Immunity has been removed from the following monsters:[list][*]Dark Ronaun[/*][*]Dark Cari[/*][*]Dark Llygadog[/*][*]Dark Gwallgof[/*][*]Dark Wyneb[/*][*]Dark Disciple[/*][/list][/*][*]The following monsters have cooldowns added to the listed skills, causing them to be used less:[list][*]Disciple and Dark Disciple: Shooting Rush[/*][*]Slime Wyneb and Dark Wyneb: Ice Spear and Thunder[/*][*]Un Llygadog and Dark Llygadog: Icebolt and Thunder[/*][*]Ronaun and Dark Ronaun: Puppet's Snare[/*][*]Frozen Cari and Dark Cari: Icebolt, Ice Spear, and Thunder[/*][*]Irusan: Ice Spear and Thunder[/*][/list][/*][*]Excluding specific phase mechanics, the damage caps for Irusan, Completed Glas Ghaibhleann and Giga Glas Ghaibhleann have been removed. [/*][*]The additional damage taken by Completed Glas Ghaibhleann and Giga Glas Ghaibhleann when dazed has been reduced from 230% to 200%.[/*][*]Completed Glas Ghaibhleann and Giga Glas Ghaibhleann's "Erg Black Hole" will now be visible when the ‘Minimize VFX’ option is enabled. [/*][*]The Disciples that spawn during Completed Glas Ghaibhleann and Giga Glas Ghaibhleann's gimmicks had their passive defenses removed, except for when they resist that damage type.[/*][*]The following changes have been made to the fight with Irusan:[list][*]The summoning rules for regular monsters have been changed, and new gimmicks have been added.[/*][*]Irusan now has an increased delay after using Sharpened Claw.[/*][*]The progression rules for Irusan's Sweet Tea Time (where the cauldron is activated) have been changed.[/*][*]Irusan's Deathly Brand has been changed so that it can be canceled using Hand of Restoration.[list][*]This status effect icon is also now visible to all party members.[/*][*]Some dialogue about this effect provided by Brielle has been changed.[/*][/list][/*][*]The interval of Dark Lure (Red exploding circles) has been changed:
[list][*]Dark Erg 0-30: 6~10 seconds[/*][*]Dark Erg 31~70: 5~8 seconds[/*][*]Dark Erg 71~100: 4~6 seconds[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The visibility of Warp Circles in Crom Bas has been improved.[table][tr][td]Green Magic Circle has not been changed.[/td][td][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1563/green-crom-bas-circle.png[/img][/td][/tr][tr][td]Yellow Magic Circle now has an outline without a shade added.[/td][td][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1591/yellow-crom-bas-circle.png[/img][/td][/tr][tr][td]Red Magic Circle now has an outline with a shade added.[/td][td][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1564/red-crom-bas-circle.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table][/*][/list]
[b]Glenn Bearna Changes[/b]
[list][*]Removed the following skills from most non-Boss enemies: [/*][list][*]Heavy Stander[/*][*]Natural Shield[/*][*]Mana Deflector[/*][/list][*]Damage caps have been removed except for certain sections during boss fights.[/*][*]An issue where some monsters behave abnormally when hit by the Flame Burst skill has been fixed.[/*][/list]
[b]Miscellaneous Dungeon Changes[/b]
[list][*]G1 Fiodh - Lowered the HP value of the following creatures:[list][*]Small Golem[/*][*]Flying Sword[/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]Additional Fantasy Life Changes[/b][/h2]
[b]General[/b]
[list][*]Spring is in the air and there are flowers to be picked! To help with that, we’ve added 2 new items: [img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1589/empty-flower-baskets.png[/img][list][*][b]Flower Basket[/b][list][*]This item can hold up to 200 Bundles of Flowers.[/*][*]Can be purchased from Del for 350,000 gold.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Sturdy Flower Basket[/b][list][*]*slaps top of basket* This bad boy can fit even more Bundles of Flowers - up to 500![/*][*]Can be purchased from any Commerce Trading Merchant Imp for 500,000 Ducats.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]We know that carrying several of the same item can be cumbersome, so we’ve now made the following items stackable and/or had their stack limits increased to [b]20[/b], including:[list][*]Bunches of Flowers[/*][*]Dye Ampoules[/*][*]Metal Dye Ampoules[/*][*]All Baltane Mission Elite Passes[/*][*]All Shadow Mission Elite Passes[/*][/list][/*][*]To better assist our merchants, the Auction House functionality has been enhanced.[list][*]The UI will no longer close after registering an item for sale.[/*][*]Erinn will now inform you that the item has been successfully listed in the chat log.[/*][*]Items that can be sold on the Auction House will now be highlighted in your inventory and gear slots.[/*][/list][/*][*]The “Claim Rewards” button in the Growth Guide has been renamed to “Completion Rewards” for better clarity.[/*][*]An outline will be added to the VFX which indicates the impact range of Moon Stones in the G24 [Fallen from the Sky] mission.[/*][/list]
[b]Quest Polishing[/b]
[list][*]Blaanid is now more concise with her dialogue when helping new Milletians on their path of learning about the world of Erinn. [/*][*]In the Pet Training Skill quest [A Blossoming Embrace], the number of required Bear Fynni Gems has been reduced.[/*][list][*]Additional text has been added to the Quest Scroll to clarify how to speak to Fynni Fynn.[/*][/list][*]You can no longer remove the Dark Knight Armor in your inventory prior to completing [Eliminating the Dark Knight Armor] Quest.[/*][*]In the G1 Mission [Paradise], you can now talk to Tarlach to receive another Brown Fomor Pass if you happen to lose it.[/*][*]In the final G1 Missions [Tir Na Nog], [Find the Black Orb], and [Final Dance], additional text has been included into the Quest Scroll on how to return to Tir Na Nog.[/*][/list]

Come strut your stuff and showcase your favorite styles![/*][*]The cursor will now be visible after using Chain Sweep and Bachram Explosion.[/*][/list][h3][b]The following bug fixes have been made to the game:[/b][/h3][list][*]Fixed an issue causing Extra Equipment Slots and Jukeboxes to expire even when VIP Services are present. [/*][*]Many typo fixes this update- G13/G14/G24/G25, Glenn Bearna, Tech Duinn, Farming, and Fashion Contest were the major areas covered![/*][*]The Fashion Contest registration UI has been resized to fit the text.[/*][*]Fixed issues causing Pet Notes to display incorrectly and occasionally disappear.[/*][*]It is no longer possible to request to fly with a character using Soar.[/*][*]Under certain conditions the Shop Repurchase menu would not properly display all the re-purchasable items.[/*][*]Slightly alleviated the game slowdown when a lot of bags are open.[/*][*]When using music buff skills through higher ranks of Song, the durability and proficiency of the equipment in your right hand will no longer be affected unless the equipment is an instrument. [/*][*]Very small Milletians with very large hair/wigs were found to be possessed by a ghost, causing them to float above the ground. With Corentin's help we have banished the spectre. [/*][*]An issue where some outfit meshes may appear broken when changing equipment to the same outfit has been fixed.[/*][*]Both cymbals are now properly sized on Giants when equipped with cymbals and sheet music.[/*][*]The 'Complete Mission' and the 'Close' buttons no longer overlap when opening a G19~G25 Quest window.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where Giants would occasionally fail to hit dungeon marbles after drinking a mini potion. Mini Giants can go back to their regularly scheduled oxymoron.[/*][*]Pets will no longer relentlessly chase after opponents following a PVP match like a cat chasing after catnip.[/*][*]The Pet House UI would occasionally close itself, but this has been fixed.[/*][*]Shrimp Taming Bait and Taillteann Carp Bait will now stack properly.[/*][*]Elemental Removers dropped from monsters and purchased from NPCs will now stack properly.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where Auto Weapon Slot Conversion would not swap to proper equipment when using Party Healing.[/*][*]Gathering Clams in Scuabtuinne was not properly counting towards Hoeing training.[/*][*]Moving a bow to the bank via alt-click will now properly unequip the equipped arrow.[/*][*]Warping via the Moongate / Mana Tunnel will no longer cause outfit motion props to disappear.[/*][*]When equipped with a Control Bar with increased Control Marionette Range, an issue has been fixed where Act 1: Inciting Incident would occasionally fail to work.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where Cello-playing Milletians would fail to properly leave the homestead.[/*][*]A few Talent skills were able to be incorrectly used while riding a pet. This has been corrected.[/*][*]Fixed an issue with the portrait on the Printed Casual Wear displaying incorrectly.[/*][*]Marionettes will be able to move sooner if the target dies during the middle of Act 2: Threshold Cutter.[/*][*]The Preview option in the Dressing Room was not properly displaying when a collaboration appearance was selected.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where Milletians were unable to move upon using Divine Blast or Nova Obliteration.[/*][*]In rare circumstances the client would close upon changing channels. This has been fixed.[/*][*]Silk-Weaving Gloves were incorrectly granting their bonus while at 0 durability. They will now give no bonus in this state.[/*][*]Dorcha Snatch was training improperly when used when Hot-Air Ballooning. Little known fact, Sluagh loves floating through the sky.[/*][*]The Falias Artifact Restoration window will now display above your inventory.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where monster AI would not properly cancel an unused Life Drain.[/*][*]An issue where a previewed appearance in the dressing room was not updating under certain circumstances has been fixed.[/*][*]Specifically timed gestures/blinks/etc will no longer cause Eye VFX to stop displaying.[/*][*]Novice cards were not properly issued to new accounts with a hero card or elite hero card. This has been fixed.[/*][*]Fixed an issue causing remaining duration messages to display incorrectly when changing channels. [/*][*]An issue where the Spread Wings and Crisis Escape skills cannot be used after using a Moongate or Mana Tunnel while riding a pet after using Spread Wings has been fixed.[/*][*]A bug where pet skills are not used when summoning a Kart Rider pet has been fixed.[/*][*]The issue where pets could be summoned in Festia's Clobbermeister mini-game has been fixed.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where Act 1: Inciting Incident would improperly move when cast on a monster outside its range.[/*][*]The cat from the Academy School Uniform's outfit motion would cause characters to move awkwardly when running. This has been fixed.[/*][*]An issue where the body shape is not applied during motion when wearing the Eluned Cherry Blossom Dress (M) as a Giant character has been fixed.[/*][*]Corrected display issues with the following equipment:[/*][list][*]Blue Dragon's Chosen Robes[/*][*]Circus Performer's Outfits[/*][*]Festial Jumpsuit (M)[/*][*]Birman Marching Boots on Giants[/*][*]Guardian Boots[/*][/list][/list][h3][b]Bugs fixed during the March 28th Maintenance: [/b][/h3][list][*]Corrected a floor exploit in Fahmes Ruins.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where the Extra Equipment Slot duration was not reflected properly for some characters.[/*][*]Fixed a few Festival of Stars event related typos, and improved the dialogue of a certain raccoon.[/*][*]As grandiose as COMBAT VIP MEMBERSHIP BATTLER'S BOON / LIFE VIP MEMBERSHIP BOUNTIFUL boon are, the full names probably don't need to show on the status effect text. These have been trimmed to VIP Battler's Boon / VIP Bountiful Boon.[/*][*]Made minor adjustments to the Flight Action names to make them consistent.[/*][*]Improved the text on several Cooking Quest scrolls and objectives.[/*][*]Despite it not being visible in-game anymore, we've fixed a decade-old EU Mabinogi typo. Finally the Brioncac has been defeated![/*][*]Found a few more strings referring to "Premium Service" and replaced them with the proper name.[/*][*]Found a few Homestead items missing the "Homestead" designation on their item names.[/*][list][*]Homestead Tropical Party Pineapple[/*][*]Homestead Tropical Friends Pineapple[/*][*]Homestead Christmas Wreath[/*][*]Homestead Christmas Tree[/*][*]Homestead Rudolph[/*][*]Homestead Old Junk[/*][*]Homestead Giant Stone Statue[/*][*]Homestead Haunted House[/*][*]Homestead Red Rose Patch (Full)[/*][*]Homestead Red Rose Patch (Partial)[/*][*]Homestead Pink Rose Patch (Full)[/*][*]Homestead Pink Rose Patch (Partial)[/*][*]Homestead Rose Vine Arch (Urban)[/*][*]Homestead Rose Vine Arch (Rustic)[/*][*]Homestead Hanging Rose Valance[/*][*]Homestead Hanging Rose Blossoms[/*][*]Homestead Hanging Rose Vine[/*][*]Homestead Vine Rose Fence[/*][*]Homestead Wild Rose Bush[/*][/list][/list][h3][b]Bugs fixed during the March 21st Maintenance: [/b][/h3][list][*]Giants equipped with the new Two-handed Sword Motion Card (Type 2) and Shields were behaving strangely. The sheer magnitude of their power will no longer cause them to sink into the floor.[/*][*]The 16th Anniversary Drawstring Pouch (Doll Bags) was incorrectly targeting Birman Bags. This has been corrected so that the Doll Bag Drawstring Pouch can now be used on Doll Bags, as expected.[/*][/list][h3][b]The following are known bugs:[/b][/h3][list][*][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1150/bug_catching.png[/img][/*][*]In rare circumstances when rapidly casting Arrow Revolver, players will become unable to move or attack until receiving an attack or relogging.[/*][*]Several items containing ampersands in their name and description aren't showing the & symbol.[/*][*]Shop items with expiration times start counting down upon the player logging in or changing channels, rather than having their countdown start when the item is purchased.[/*][*]There is an issue where one-time/limited items cannot be purchased from the in-game shop, but can be on the web-shop.[/*][*]There is an issue with the in-game Guild list not populating with guilds.[/*][/list]

[h2][b]Fantasy Life Changes[/b][/h2]
[h3]Vanity Titles[/h3]
[b]Vanity Titles[/b] have been added!
[list][*]You can now set the character’s title for stats and cosmetic appeal separately![/*][*]To add a Vanity Title, open your Character Info window from your Character button in the in-game taskbar (hotkey C).[list][*]Under your Title menu, you will be able to adjust the following titles:[list][*][b]Base Title[/b][list][*]1st Title[/*][*]2nd Title[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Vanity Title[/b][list][*]1st Title[/*][*]2nd Title[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Any stat effects of the title set as the Base Title is applied to the character.[/*][*]The cosmetic effects of the title set as the Vanity Title will appear on the character, such as 2nd title effects![list][*]Vanity Titles [b]do not[/b] apply to the stats.[/*][*]Vanity title visual effects will be displayed instead of the Base title.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1079/vanity-title-option.png[/img]
[h3]Extra Equipment Slot Adjustments[/h3]
Additional additions have been made to the Extra Equipment Slot window.
[list][*]A new feature has been added to the Extra Equipment Slot to allow you to set primary and secondary equipment titles for each equipment slot.[/*][list][*]When switching equipment slots, if there is a title set for that slot, the equipment title will be switched to that title.[/*][/list][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1078/extra-equipment-slot-ui.png[/img]

notes.title: Producer’s Letter: Discussing the January 2024 Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1304/mbw-2715-220202-producers-letter-news-article-header-940x290.png[/img]

Hi Milletians,

With our January 18th update, we have released changes to Mabinogi that we recognize many Milletians have strong feelings about. In particular, we would like to address the changes to Tech Duinn missions and the weekly clear reward limits that have been integrated into these missions. As with Crom Bás or Glenn Bearna dungeons which had weekly clears from the start, Tech Duinn has now been updated to introduce similar weekly clear limits. Along with this change, the mission format has been reorganized, consolidating difficulty levels from four to two (Normal/Hard), improving the ease and intuitiveness of mission puzzles, adjusting dungeon rewards, and improving dungeon drop rates.

Many of these changes represent improvements on the existing system, but the community has expressed considerable uncertainty regarding the weekly clear limits. The team has been reading and digesting the many thoughts and feedback you have. While adding a limit to content that was previously unlimited understandably may not sit well initially, the reasons behind the change have been reviewed and considered deeply by the development team, whose thoughts we will share with you below.

As Mabinogi’s publisher, we will review and scrutinize the many facets of the game’s content, while also placing our trust in the best intentions of our developers. Our goal as a connected team aligns in our desire to do what is best not only for the longevity of the game, but for the enjoyment of our community.

From myself, and on behalf of my team at Nexon America and Nexon Korea, we will continue to put our whole hearts into Mabinogi to provide a service that we can all enjoy.

Sincerely,
[b]GM Mewlynne
Mabinogi Producer[/b]
[h3][b][u]Developer’s Comments: Behind the Change [/u][/b][/h3]
The core purpose of dungeon-related updates is to increase the value of dungeons and rewards. Most dungeons in Mabinogi have a lower chance of rewarding the most desirable items. This is by design, to encourage repeated playthroughs. The items given as dungeon rewards are typically also tradable, so the reward probability has to be determined by taking into account repeated play. Our development team believed that this was causing repeated negative experiences in dungeons.

After reviewing the data and play patterns of our Milletians, we decided that it was necessary to make improvements so that you could grow and acquire equipment. However, there were concerns that simply increasing the probability of receiving rewards would increase the supply of materials excessively, decreasing the value of items and ultimately leading to a loss of motivation to play dungeons at all. This is also the reason why the average number of runs required to obtain a desired reward set in general Mabinogi dungeons was not able to be adjusted immediately, even though it might have felt somewhat difficult for Milletians trying their hardest to grow. Our development team has thought deeply about the best choice we could make for Mabinogi’s future, and has significantly increased the probability of rewards while limiting the number of clears so that Milletians, in their quest to grow ever stronger, can enjoy a meaningful challenge in the dungeons they are focusing on.

In preparing for this update, we considered the appropriate direction based on these contents as basic premises. 
[olist][*][u][u] Tech Duinn weekly clear limits[/u][/u] 
Tech Duinn is a dungeon with the most direct rewards that Milletians can achieve as intermediate goals in their growth process. If you look at the status of Milletians playing Tech Duinn missions, they are generally receiving “Elite” passes on Feth Fiada Hard difficulty. In the case of Crom Bás, it is possible to enter without obtaining an entry pass to farm the Nightbringer weapon set, so the fact that you needed to separately obtain an Elite pass to acquire the materials for the Perseus weapon set felt like an unnatural part of the growth process. We eventually determined that to be one of the hassles, and thought of the way where you could play them without acquiring passes.

However, as acquiring passes is no longer required and the drop rates for the rewards have been increased, we have concluded that the amount of acquired items could increase too excessively, without the limitation to the entry. As maintaining items’ value is also an important part of the game, we concluded that the entry limit is necessary.

When looking at the play patterns of North American Milletians playing Tech Duinn missions, the dev team found that most Milletians who were playing the Elite missions were clearing them fewer than 10 times per week, and around 80% of Milletians were clearing them fewer than 5 times a week. When considering the now-increased probabilities of receiving many of the rewards, we felt that clearing the mission about 15 times was a reasonable level, providing a better experience in clearing without significantly affecting the value of the rewards obtained.

We have also prepared the methods for Milletians who want to clear missions more by making it possible to clear more than 15 times a week (25 times or more in total) using additional entry passes received through events and Adventurer’s Seal Shop. We are also open to the possibility of gradually easing restrictions when the demand/supply of rewards has stabilized in the future.

We are also listening carefully to your concerns about situations that impede free play. We will continue to think about which values ​​are most important from a long-term perspective and find solutions that offer enjoyable experiences. 

[/*][*][u][u]Intention of introducing the Dungeon Re:fine system[/u][/u] 

A lot of Milletians have been asking about the details of the Re:fine System and the intention behind it.

Re:fine system is the system where the probability of a certain reward’s appearance remains the same regardless of the party member’s number. In practice, it works as below.

For certain items, the number and the probability of these items appearing in one dungeon run will remain the same regardless of whether it was cleared by one person or multiple people. Once the item’s appearance is decided, who will get the item among the party will be decided by an even probability.

In other words, if the probability of an item is 1%, and an individual clears the dungeon, the item will appear by 1% for them. If the dungeon is cleared by a party of 4, whether the item will appear or not will be decided by 1%, and the item will be given to the 1 of the 4 members by even probability.

The initial purpose of the Re:fine system was to bridge the compensation gap, accounting for multi-client usage. Although this will now be addressed to some extent by blocking the use of multiple clients, we still have to take into account abnormal styles of play. In particular, the higher the expected reward of a dungeon, the more advantageous it is to clear it using multiple computers. We intended to prevent this type of play pattern from being encouraged. With the update, we applied the Re:fine system to certain dungeons while increasing the drop rates of major rewards, to prevent the situation of using multiple clients or computers being advantageous while increasing the level of rewards for playing dungeons.
[/*][/olist]
The purpose of the development explained above is focused on changes for the long-term growth of Mabinogi. However, we believe that the freedom and variety of play styles that can be experienced in Mabinogi are also important values. We will strive to develop Mabinogi through a process of gathering opinions while doing our best to provide a sufficient explanation of our intentions to all Milletians.

Thank you,
[/u][b]Mabinogi Development Team[/b]

[b]The following changes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]The following books have been updated with a revised version to be more canonically accurate.[list][*][i]The Goddess Who Turned to Stone[/i][/*][*][i]The Knight of Light Lugh, The Hero of Mag Tuireadh[/i][/*][/list][/*][*]In the Bag Order Settings menu, 'PLUS Inventory' has been renamed to 'VIP Inventory', to match the tab name. [/*][*]Renamed "Glass Trim Monocle and Earrings" to "Glass Trim Veiling Band and Earrings" to have the name better match the face accessory's visuals.[/*][*]Renamed "New Start (Ship BGM)" to "New Start (Tutorial BGM)". Visions of a blue-haired girl and a black-wooled sheep cross your mind.[/*][*]Chain Slash Grandmaster has been renamed to Grandmaster Chain Slasher, to fit with the other GM Talents. [list][*][i]We'll always remember you, Chain Slash Grandma.[/i]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/1165/this-goes-out-to-all-the-grandmas.png[/img][/*][/list][/*][*]The text when attempting to wear an invalid face accessory and headgear together has been improved to be much more clear and a bit less judgmental. 
[list][*]It was "Probably not a good idea to dress like this.", if you were curious.
[/*][/list][/*][*]When sending a message to an offline friend, it no longer will tell you that your friend is too busy to chat. They might still be busy, but that's not the reason why your message wasn’t received.
[/*][*]You can now earn Field Raid Contribution when using the following Harmonic Saint actions:
[list][*]Recover an ally with Hand of Restoration or Echoes of Salvation 
[/*][*]Resurrect an ally with Hymn of Resurrection[/*][/list][/*][*]When using Shadow Flare and Polar Vortex, 2x casting speed of wands will be applied to the Celtic Tribolt Wand and single-attribute wands.[/*][/list]
[b]The following bug fixes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]Continued Text Polish on generations and items! 
[list][*]Why the catch-all item instead of listing them all out individually, you hypothetically inquire? These are usually small things, such as adding missing periods/spaces and other similar typos. We try to include the more impactful fixes and changes individually. Thank you as always for your reports![/*][/list][/*][*]The Abominable Rabbit from Glenn Bearna was being too abominable. Previously after using Roar, the unpleasant bunny would stackingly increase its allies Defense and Protection. As this was not intended to stack, we've asked the loathsome lagomorph to take it down a notch.[/*][*]In specific situations, Dauntless Defense’s cooldown would be applied incorrectly. This has been corrected.[/*][*]The damage is now applied correctly when using Thunderblight at rank 5 or higher against a target whose Magical Defense and Magical Protection have been reduced below zero.[/*][*]The bag sizes for the following Doll Bags were incorrectly listed. The text has been updated to match the actual values. 
[list][*]Bhatair Doll Bag[/*][*]Morfydrianas Doll Bag[/*][*]Tani Doll Bag[/*][/list][/*][*]The item descriptions for the following Doll Bags displayed the incorrect Collection Categories. Only the text was incorrect, the functionality for these items have not changed. 
[list][*]Talek Doll Bag: Gold, Rare Mineralogy -> Gold, Ore, Gems[/*][*]Marleid and Piran Doll Bag: Gold, Rare Mineralogy, Weaving/Sheep Shearing, Tailoring Materials -> Gold, Ore, Gems, Weaving/Sheep Shearing, Tailoring Materials[/*][/list][/*][*]Fixed an issue where Doll Bags did not collect Equipment if set to the Cooking and Equipment Collection Categories.[/*][*]The Shadow Reaper Mask was so stealthy that Milletians couldn't even see its textures. A series of off-screen montages has given all Milletians the power to properly see the mask.[/*][*]Improved the text when cooking the best food Erinn has seen. Continue your hunt for the essence of true flavor, Master Chefs![/*][*]When undertaking the Shuriken Charge Advancement test, the supervisor no longer refers to it as the Kunai Storm test.[/*][*]Corrected a minor visual error with the Vanguard Uniform Bandage (M).[/*][*]Corrected a minor visual error with the Cheerful Bride's Gloves.[/*][*]After waiting many long years to return, the Girl on the Moon was super excited to see all you ‘Mabinogians’ again for ‘second anniversary’! She's going to catch some well deserved rest.[/*][/list]
[b]The following bugs were fixed during the course of December:[/b]
[list][*]The Check Weekly Rewards Received for Glenn Bearna no longer inaccurately lists the weekly limit as 4x per week. The text now displays the correct 3x per week.[/*][*]Undye your hair and mourn no longer- Atrata now properly grants selected PTJ rewards, rather than just giving it out all as experience points.[/*][*]Chefs rejoice! You can now search for Cooking Potions on the Auction House![/*][*]The Echostones from the Erinn-go-Round Echostone Boxes were interacting unintentionally when an Echostone Supplement was applied. We have fixed the issue causing Echostone Grades to reset- you can no longer use the Echostone Supplement item on an Echostone that has not been advanced at least one Grade.[/*][*]The notification of your Auction House listings being sold are now correctly showing once more. Yayifications![/*][*]The Detective Squirrel Doll Bag description stated that it had a set effect when summoned with another doll bag. As this isn't the case, this line has been removed.[/*][/list]
[b]The following are known bugs:[/b]
[list][*]🐛[/*][*]When using the new item Defender's Will, the stats displayed in the message incorrectly displays the stats from Aggressor's Will. This is a text issue only, the correct defensive stats are given. [/*][*]The new crafting recipes for Protective Red Upgrade Stone and Protective Blue Upgrade Stone incorrectly refer to 'Gem of Protection' as 'Gem of Protective Power'. The former is the correct name for the item, and is the item used in the craft.[/*][*]In rare circumstances when rapidly casting Arrow Revolver, players will become unable to move or attack until receiving an attack or relogging.[/*][*]Several items containing ampersands in their name and description aren't showing the & symbol.[/*][*]Shop items with expiration times start counting down upon the player logging in or changing channels, rather than having their countdown start when the item is purchased.[/*][*]There is an issue where one-time/limited items cannot be purchased from the in-game shop, but can be on the web-shop.[/*][*]There is an issue with the in-game Guild list not populating with guilds.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Upcoming Changes: Blocking Multi-Client and Improved Dungeon Drop Rates
notes.notes:
Hi Milletians,

We are announcing in advance that the security for Mabinogi will soon be improved to strengthen the detection and prevention of third-party programs and multi-client use. We recognize there may be some beneficial aspects that client modifications can offer to improve a player’s game experience, although most functionalities are against the intentions of the game and impose unfair capabilities and barriers to players who don’t modify their files. There are also risks that come with modifying the game client and data for the player and the game.

Mabinogi has been steadily improving the playability of the game, adding commonly requested features that were previously mod-only, as well as other features that have improved the stability and performance of the game. [b]While it is important for us to continue to improve the in-game experience, we believe that at this present juncture, we need to further improve the security measures within the game to prevent security vulnerabilities and create a safer Mabinogi[/b].

[h3]Blocking Multi-Client and Third-Party Programs[/h3]
Multi-client use has not been allowed in Mabinogi and it is not possible to run multiple clients through normal means. However, there are many players who have been logging in on multiple clients through unauthorized methods, bypassing the game system to play on multiple accounts at one time. In order to provide a better game experience, we are enhancing the game’s security so that it is no longer possible to bypass the restriction. In the future, if you run two or more game clients on the same device, any instances of the client beyond the first will be automatically shut down. 

Other security improvements made to the game client and account system will terminate the use of third-party programs and launchers along with it. This notice is being posted early so that you can take care to play on a clean game client before the blocking measures begin to take effect. While special mods and third-party launchers may offer small gameplay tweaks or improve the game’s performance for some, there are more risky parts of client modifications that aren’t good for the game’s overall security. This must be addressed to prevent forms of illicit or fraudulent activity, egregious activities, game exploits, hacking, and other types of abuse. There are also cases in which third-party programs can alter the game’s intention too greatly in ways that are considered exploitative and unfair, such as changes to skill cooldowns, skill usage ranges, or skill uptime. Players found abusing the game while using these types of game modifications will be subject to sanctions. 

Further information about which actions are considered violations is outlined in the [b][url=https://www.nexon.com/main/en/legal/tou]Terms of Service[/url][/b] agreement that has been agreed to when creating a Nexon account.

[h3]Addressing the [i]Caravan Joe[/i] Problem[/h3]
Multi-client use is impacting many aspects of the game. In particular, it creates an environment that feels like a gatekeeper to many players of all types. It is not a fair experience to those wanting to play and grow their character when there is such an imbalance between players who are playing multiple accounts and those who are not. The area that has experienced the most significant impact of multi-client use is the supply of gold and rewards. If we take a look at the current dungeon play experience, for example, we have individuals that play and receive one reward chest, while those using multiple clients will receive the reward chest from each of the controlled characters. Milletians who focus on playing with one client are bound to feel like they are at a disadvantage, which we are deeply sorry for.

[table][tr][td][b]"The Many Cousins of Caravan Joe"[/b]

Let's take a look at two different players, Cowenna and Caravan Joe. Both players are looking to receive a Broken Magic Essence (BME) from the Alby Advanced Hard Mode (AAHM) dungeon, and have been farming a while in hopes of getting it.

Each time Cowenna plays, she does a few runs through AAHM. Sometimes by herself, sometimes she invites her friends- Rowan, Eochaid, and Loiscneach. For a successful clear she opens a single chest and takes the loot, as do her friends. One player gets one key to open one chest, or four players get four keys to open four chests.

Each time Caravan Joe plays, he does a few runs as well. He also plays by himself, but with a twist - he invites his [i]cousins[/i], all three of them also named Caravan Joe. For a successful clear each Joe opens a single chest and takes the loot, but after this, each Joe then trades their drops to a single Joe. One player gets four keys to open four chests.

In this scenario, Caravan Joe is four times more likely than Cowenna to receive a Broken Magic Essence. Due to this imbalance, it has been difficult to move forward with Drop Rate increases without accounting for how[i] Caravan Joe and his cousins[/i], aka multi-clienting, would create further imbalances. Cowenna is still doing her AAHM runs hoping to get her BME, but feels that it's unfair that Caravan Joe is getting more drops per run. [/td][/tr][/table]
In other words, this imbalance is not a sustainable way for players to gain resources and this must be addressed to ensure that reward opportunities are available to all players in the game.

[h3]Increasing Dungeon Drop Rates and Improving the Reward Experience[/h3]
A significant change that will be made to Mabinogi will be the addition of [b]improved drop rates to dungeons and missions[/b]. This will allow players to play dungeons with more opportunities towards their reward goals. [b]A major impact of this change will be the leveling-out of imbalances that inevitably became the norm due to multi-client use, and the creation of a better experience for those hoping to receive materials and other rewards from their dungeon runs[/b]. The drop rates of rewards from major dungeons and missions will be increased significantly to the same level that Mabinogi Korea has right now. We will increase the drop rates of many rewards, with our primary focus being–but not limited to–core high-level rewards such as crafting materials and Enchant Scrolls. For some dungeons, the Dungeon Re:Fine system will be applied with the increase of drop rates. 

We will share a detailed list of the dungeons and rewards affected by this change in a later announcement. Please look forward to the improved dungeon drop rates coming soon, with detailed information regarding the changes provided in the patch notes as usual! 

Another part of the game affected by multi-client use is the in-game events. Several players have been participating in events using multiple clients to get multiple rewards. Therefore, the reality of multi-client use was factored in when the Development team determined the coin shop prices for items in event shops. Oftentimes, there is also the need to pick and choose which rewards to spend coins on versus obtaining all rewards from the shop. This aspect is where players would feel that playing on an alternate account was required in order to earn the rewards, which we want to improve. There are certain events that allow all rewards to be obtained, and the aspect of choice is an integral element of game freedom, so this will still be a factor seen in events. However, to improve the experience after the multi-client block, we will adjust the event shop’s reward prices so that you can get enough rewards by solo playing, without using multi-clients.

[h3]Further Improving your Fantasy Life[/h3]
Even with the many improvements that have been made to Mabinogi in recent years, we recognize that there are still options that many players have requested that may be missing from the game. In addition to these changes mentioned above, we will continue to actively improve the elements that burdened the experience and made multi-client use feel like a significant improvement to the game experience.
We sincerely apologize for allowing the multi-client behavior to impact the game as much as it has and hope these changes will begin to change the experience for the better. We appreciate your understanding as we enter this next chapter of Mabinogi. As this is a very important step for the future, we will do our best to ensure the long-term growth and stable service of the game, rather than focusing on the short-term visible result, such as the number of concurrent players in the game.
Thank you for your continued support, and please look forward to more details about upcoming updates to the game. We will continue to work hard so that Mabinogi can continue to grow steadily for a long time.

Milletians, we also recommend following the tips below to ensure that you are playing on a clean client:
[list][*]Please ensure that you are launching Mabinogi through the [b][url=https://www.nexon.com/main/en/download/launcher]Nexon Launcher[/url][/b] or [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/212200/Mabinogi/]Steam Launcher[/url][/b].[/*][*]Please delete any unofficial files that may be saved in the game installation folder.[/*][list][*]After removing any precarious files, [b][url=https://support-mabinogi.nexon.net/hc/en-us/articles/204741785-My-client-doesn-t-patch-correctly-when-I-run-the-Mabinogi-launcher-Do-I-have-any-other-options-]perform a Repair Installation[/url][/b] if using the Nexon Launcher, or [url=https://support-mabinogi.nexon.net/hc/en-us/articles/204741785-My-client-doesn-t-patch-correctly-when-I-run-the-Mabinogi-launcher-Do-I-have-any-other-options-][b]Verify the Integrity of the Game Files[/b][/url] if using the Steam Launcher. [/*][*]Alternatively, we recommend deleting the entire game installation folder and preparing a full reinstallation of the game to ensure that all files have been directly downloaded from the Nexon Launcher or Steam Launcher.[/*][/list][*]As the Nexon Game Security client will be improved and updated, ensure that your antivirus or firewall trusts and allows the Mabinogi client and related files to run. If you encounter any issues, please [b][url=https://support-mabinogi.nexon.net/hc/en-us]contact Player Support[/url][/b].[/*][/list]
Thank you, 

[i]- The Mabinogi Team[/i]

[b]Arcana Dark Arts Update:[/b]
[list][*]Several quality of life changes have been added to help with your fantasy life! See the full post for more information: [b][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/87846/arcana-dark-arts-update]Arcana: Dark Arts Update[/url][/b] and check out the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/micro-site/darkarts]dedicated microsite[/url]![list][*]Two new Arcanas have been added - [b]Alchemic Sharpshooter[/b] and [b]Dark Diviner[/b]. Visit the Arcana Talent Association in Tara Rath Castle to learn more![/*][*]Special Upgrades have been improved to make your upgrades feel more special![/*][*]Enchantment has been given a remake! Timers on Enchant Scrolls are now a thing of the past![/*][*]And more![/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]The following changes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]Within the Point Inventory (the shopping cart icon), we have renamed "Rearrange" to "Claim". This button has always claimed all of the selected items, which is technically a form of rearranging, but we felt it could be a lot more clear.[/*][*]Renamed "Mana Tunnel in Filia" to "Filia Mana Tunnel" to be consistent with other Mana Tunnels and Moon Gates.[/*][*]Small text improvements have been applied to Jousting and the Tara Banquet.[/*][/list]
[b]The following bug fixes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]Due to equal parts of your helpful reports and our love for polishing, we continued to improve the text in November's Beyond content. This took several forms- Mainstory text, Spirit text, Stardust quest information, and several PTJs (especially those involving the Dunbarton Library).[list][*](Also, we convinced Stewart to rename the Magazine section to Periodicals.)[/*][/list][/*][*]Corrected the text for the materials needed in the Norman Warrior Armor. Previously this indicated that you needed Common Leather Straps, when the materials used were actually Common Leather.[/*][*]Endelyon will no longer ask you to "일반 아르바이트 완전 수행 성공" for your daily Renown. Hopefully "Earn full credit for the perfect completion of any Part-Time Job" is a little more understandable![/*][*]The Growth Guide now recognizes your hard work and will award you your Growth Guide Point when you complete "Work a Part-Time Job".[/*][*]The Upgrade Stone Selection Box from the Growth Guide no longer has a unfortunate adjective suggesting that this should be a Protective Stone. The intended rewards are and always have been Red Upgrade Stone (Event) x1 or Blue Upgrade Stone (Event) x1.[/*][*]The Inquisitive Black Friday Package previously stated that it granted only one Golden Experience Fruit (1000%) and 10x Forgetful Potions. This has been corrected to the proper values: Golden Experience Fruit (1000%) x5 and 10x Special Forgetful Potions. This is only an issue with the box text, the items within have always been correct. Although the sale has ended, we feel that it was best to right this in-game as well.[/*][*]The Skill Learn method for Metal Conversion has been referencing older requirements. This has been updated to reflect the actual requirements![/*][list][*]If you're still unable to learn the skill through the above methods, we heard nearby rumors that talking to Pierrick might help...[/*][/list][/list]
[b]The following bugs were fixed during the course of November:[/b]
[list][*]Corrected an issue causing the Commerce Rankings to not update.[/*][*]Fixed issues with a few Part Time Jobs:[list][*]Glenis was ignoring Nerys' ring.[/*][*]Fraser was not giving out selected rewards for his PTJs.[/*][*]Effie and Nicca's PTJs were not showing on the Rano PTJ board.[/*][/list][/*][*]Surging Hope Gems can once again be used as expected.[/*][*]The default Dollbag collection categories for Shyllien Ecology and Rare Mineralogy were not collecting all the same materials as the add-on collection categories. Both lists are now the same.[/*][*]The Premium Collection Category Add-on Slot was not properly working for the following Dollbags:[list][*]Cethlenn and Vayne Compact Doll Bag[/*][*]Commerce Companions Compact Doll Bag[/*][*]Crom Bas Brielle and Gillach Compact Doll Bag[/*][*]Crom Bas Cast Compact Doll Bag[/*][*]Deirbhile and Piran Compact Bag[/*][*]Enya and Etain Compact Doll Bag[/*][*]Enya, Merlin, and Altam Compact Doll Bag[/*][*]Expeditionary Force Compact Doll Bag[/*][*]Folamh and Irusan Compact Doll Bag[/*][*]G22 Compact Doll Bag[/*][*]Igerna and Caoimhin Compact Doll Bag[/*][*]Linden and Sayiv Compact Doll Bag[/*][*]Marleid and Piran Compact Doll Bag[/*][*]Melwyn and Llywelyn Compact Doll Bag[/*][*]Order of the Black Moon Compact Doll Bag[/*][*]Pinkie and Katell Compact Doll Bag[/*][*]Splish-Splash Cat and Bug Catcher Pup Compact Doll Bag[/*][/list][/*][*]The Spirit Weapon Additional Contract Coupon now correctly states that it can be used three times, up to a maximum of six.[/*][/list]
[b]The following are known bugs:[/b]
[list][*]Sometimes one of the baby reindeer gets a little too excited for Part-Time Jobs and will collide with the Part-Time Job bulletin board in Dunbarton. Don't worry, he's fine and will make a full recovery (after the holidays)![/*][*]A few bags are have incorrect sizes listed in their box description. This is only a text error and does not affect the actual bag.[list][*]Bhatair Doll Bag Box - states 8x8, actual 7x10[/*][*]Morfydrianas Doll Bag Box - states 8x8, actual 7x10[/*][*]Tani Doll Bag Box - states 7x7, actual 7x10[/*][/list][/*][*]🐛[/*][*]In rare circumstances when rapidly casting Arrow Revolver, players will become unable to move or attack until receiving an attack or relogging.[/*][*]Several items containing ampersands in their name and description aren't showing the & symbol.[/*][*]Shop items with expiration times start counting down upon the player logging in or changing channels, rather than having their countdown start when the item is purchased.[/*][*]There is an issue where one-time/limited items cannot be purchased from the in-game shop, but can be on the web-shop.[/*][*]There is an issue with the in-game Guild list not populating with guilds.[/*][/list]

notes.title: BEYOND Update - Patch Notes - November 16th
notes.notes:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q3/2765/200922_patchnotes_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg[/img]

Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the BEYOND Update!

[b]The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:[/b]
[list][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/87118/master-plan-winter-infinite-growth-event]Master Plan: Winter Infinite Growth Event[/url]: Thursday, November 16th, After Maintenance - Thursday, January 18th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/87395/winter-specialist-doll-bag-box]Winter Specialist Doll Bag Box[/url]: Thursday, November 16th, After Maintenance - Thursday, January 18th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/87031/part-time-for-the-holidays-event]Part-Time for the Holidays Event[/url]: Thursday, November 16th, After Maintenance - Thursday, December 7th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/86955/resistance-box]Resistance Box[/url]: Thursday, November 2nd, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 30th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/85880/irusan-s-check-in-attendance-season-4]Irusan's Check-In Attendance Season 4[/url]: Thursday, September 7th, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 30th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/84562/glenn-bearna-dungeon-support]Glenn Bearna Dungeon Support[/url]: Thursday, July 13th, After Maintenance - Until Further Notice[url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/83337/renovation-season-4-archery-magic-and-race-specific-skill-changes][/url][/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/86893/beyond-update]BEYOND Update[/url] : Permanent[/*][/list]
[b]BEYOND Update:[/b]
[list][*]Several quality of life changes have been added. See the full post for more information: [b][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/86893/beyond-update]BEYOND Update[/url][/b]
[list][*]Part-time jobs have been improved. Read all about them with the [b][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/guide/advancedguide/system/87328/part-time-job-guide]Part-Time Job Guide[/url][/b]![/*][*]The Growth Guide has been added. Check out the [b][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/guide/advancedguide/system/87375/growth-guide-handbook]Growth Guide Handbook[/url][/b]![/*][*]Our beloved spirit, Eiry, has returned![/*][*]And more![/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]The following changes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]Certain ranks of the Fishing skill’s description have been updated.[/*][*]Tamers rejoice, it has arrived. Fixed the issue where you could not collect the 5 star taming journal of the following monsters:
[list][*]Cloaker: Peaca Intermediate Dungeon[/*][*]Grumbill: Shadow Mission ‘Defeat Fomor Commander II’[/*][*]Wight: Peaca Basic Dungeon[/*][*]Kobold: Math Advanced Dungeon[/*][*]Ghoul: Peaca Normal Dungeon[/*][/list][/*][*]To address feedback that the dungeon vouchers were out of order on the Currency menu, we have renamed them from First/Second/Third/Fourth Vouchers to 1st/2nd/3rd/4th Vouchers. Behold the list in all its organized splendor.[/*][*]Polished the standard text on the Title menu for clarity.
[list][*]This change is being made to the UI text. The titles and title display are unchanged.[/*][/list][/*][*]In order to make the Welcome Milletian Package's contents as clear as possible, we have renamed the 'Spirit Weapon Contract and Growth Box' to 'Spirit Weapon Starter Kit and Growth Box'. The contents of this are unchanged.[/*][*]In order to make the action more clear, we have retranslated the menu when using a Loot-o'-Lantern. 
[list][*]Additionally, we have added a note to all Loot-o'-Lanterns that you must be in Iria to use it.[/*][/list][/*][*]As Rua deserves the best and only the best, we have improved her dialogue during the "[Dorcha Conversion] Artifacts of Bean Rua" quest.[/*][/list]
[b]The following bug fixes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]How strange- two enchant scrolls shared similar names of Strange and Strange_. We have renamed them as follows: 
[list][*]Strange (Rank 9) Enchant has been renamed to Weird.[/*][*]Strange_ (Rank 3) Enchant has had the stray space at the end of its enchant name removed. (Strange_ > Strange)[/*][/list][/*][*]Additionally, the Water Drop (Rank A) Enchant should now be displayed as Water Drop in all areas, as opposed to Droplet.[/*][*]Corrected an issue where Elves could not move while the Eternal Resistance Two-Handed Sword Appearance Scroll was applied on an equipped weapon. Castanea asks that you forget this.[/*][*]Blue Coupons were displaying as blank items on the updated Logout screen, and shall no longer do so.[/*][*]Polished the text on a few Iria Exploration Quests. Most notably: 
[list][*]Two not-quite-as-famous deities of Erinn, Paea and Kheridwen, have been retranslated as "Phaea" and "Ceridwen".[/*][*]No longer shall two quests ask you to Defeat 10 Black Forest Mushroom Spiders, as one has been correctly renamed to Defeat 10 Blue Forest Mushroom Spiders.[/*][/list][/*][*]We accidentally'd a word on the Ace Hero Ampoule Sets. They now indicate that they are Ampoule Sets, rather than singular ampoules. Treasure Hunter is complaining, but Starlet will calm him down.[/*][*]Minor text polish on the Generations, while we were in there for Beyond.[/*][*]Removed a few more references to Inventory Plus Kit from certain Bag Coupons.[/*][*]Players reported a handful of items where the (M) and (F) descriptions were swapped. Whoops! These have been fixed.[/*][*]Fixed a rare crash issue on certain chairs.[/*][/list]
[b]Bug fixes from the October 19th and 26th Maintenances:[/b]
[list][*]Six NPC transformations from Samhain's Mysterious Transformation Medal Box were not properly registered, causing the relevant medals to display blank. The following transformations have been added, and previously blank medals are now able to be used.
[list][*]Altam the Energetic, Avelin the Wrap Artist, Caswyn the Listless, Llywelyn the Perpetually Unimpressed, Pihne the Seller of Souvenirs, and Talvish the Middle Manager[/*][/list][/*][*]Fixed an issue that prevented the use of Birman Bag Coupons while possessing specific Totem Bags.[/*][*]Giants have recently started to uniquely travel upon their Purrlings. In fear for the kitty backs, the act of Purrling Surfing has been made illegal by royal decree.[/*][*]Some players noted that the new logout/exit game feature was too big for their resolution.
[list][*]The number of items that can display has been reduced to improve this issue.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]The following are known bugs:[/b]
[list][*]The Spirit Weapon Additional Contract Coupon displays the old increase totals of '+2 for a total of 5'. This item can correctly be used three times for a total of six Spirit weapons, only the text is incorrect.[/*][*]🐛[/*][*]In rare circumstances when rapidly casting Arrow Revolver, players will become unable to move or attack until receiving an attack or relogging.[/*][*]Several items containing ampersands in their name and description aren't showing the & symbol.[/*][*]Shop items with expiration times start counting down upon the player logging in or changing channels, rather than having their countdown start when the item is purchased.[/*][*]There is an issue where one-time/limited items cannot be purchased from the ingame shop, but can be on the web-shop.[/*][*]There is an issue with the in-game Guild list not populating with guilds.[/*][/list]

notes.title: October Quality of Life Updates - Patch Notes - October 12
notes.notes:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q3/2765/200922_patchnotes_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg[/img]

Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the October Quality of Life Updates!

[b]The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:[/b]
[list][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/86167/family-weekend-fishing-event-returns]Family Weekend Fishing Event Returns![/url]: Thursday, September 21st, After Maintenance - Thursday, October 19th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/86193/bleugenne-by-bleugenne-cosmetics-box]BLEUGENNE by Bleugenne Cosmetics Box[/url]: Thursday, September 21st, After Maintenance - Thursday, October 19th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/85758/the-billionaire-s-bankroll-season-4]Billionaire's Bankroll: Season 4[/url]: Thursday, September 7th, After Maintenance - Thursday, October 26th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/86589/samhain-times-remembered-times-forgotten-event]Samhain: Times Forgotten, Times Remembered Event[/url]: Thursday, October 12th, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 2nd, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/86712/shopkeeper-s-sale-spooky-halloween-horror]Shopkeeper's Sale: Spooky Halloween Horror![/url]: October 12th, 2023, After Maintenance - November 2nd, 2023, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/86488/moonshadow-emissary-box]Moonshadow Emissary Box[/url]: Thursday, October 5th, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 2nd, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/85880/irusan-s-check-in-attendance-season-4]Irusan's Check-In Attendance Season 4[/url]: Thursday, September 7th, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 30th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/84562/glenn-bearna-dungeon-support]Glenn Bearna Dungeon Support[/url]: Thursday, July 13th, After Maintenance - Until Further Notice[url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/83337/renovation-season-4-archery-magic-and-race-specific-skill-changes][/url][/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/86550/october-quality-of-life-updates]October Quality of Life Updates[/url]: Permanent[/*][/list]
[b]October Quality of Life Updates:[/b]
[list][*]Several quality of life changes have been added with the October update. See the full post for more information: [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/86550/october-quality-of-life-updates]October Quality of Life Updates[/url]
[list][*]The Equipment Appearance Slot system has been added to the Dressing Room.[/*][*]The Currency tab has been added.
The Quest Helper System has been improved.[/*][*]And more![/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Commerce Alban Eiler Season 2:[/b]
[list][*]Seasonal Commerce Alban Eiler Season 1 will begin at 12:00 AM PDT on November 1st, 2023 and run until March 1st, 2024 12:00 AM PST.[list][*]Alban Eiler Season 1 will conclude on Friday, October 31st, 11:59 PM PDT.[/*][*]The following new outfits and sewing patterns have been added. The sewing patterns will be available for purchase from Sayiv’s shop in Season 2 for 3,000,000 Seasonal Ducats:[list][*]Refashioned Coco Sailor Mini
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/1128/refashioned-coco-sailor-mini.png[/img][/*][*]Refashioned Mini Leather Dress
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/1129/refashioned-mini-leather-dress-image.png[/img][/*][/list][/*][*]Purchase limits within Sayiv’s shop will be reset.[/*][*]The Alban Eiler Season 2 Challenger Box will be available, containing the following items:[list][*][b]*NEW*[/b] Alban Eiler Season 2 Challenger 2nd Title
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/1134/alban-eiler-season-2-challenger-2nd-title-lorge.gif[/img]
[list][*]Movement Speed +3%[/*][/list][/*][*]20 Precise Reforging Tools[/*][/list][/*][*]The Seasonal Commerce Guide will be updated with Season 2, and Alban Eiler Season 1 information will be archived.[/*][*]The stock for Bartering and Merchant Group Commerce won't reset.[/*][*]Commerce that has been completed while the season is changing will be refunded, however, please note that the purchase count won't be restored.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]The following changes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]The width of the Character Status Effects UI menu has been increased so that active effect names are no longer cut… off.[/*][*]Added a line on Starblaze Fishing Rod's description to indicate that it increases the amount of Items fished up.[/*][*]As it wasn't entirely true, we've altered the Theta cooldown message from "resets during maintenance" to "resets Thursdays at 7:00 AM Server Time". We'll want to make this change in more places in the future for clarity.[list][*]While "Server Time" isn't perfect, we find it a bit more preferable to "Earth Time"- which as it turns out, has multiple time zones.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]The following bug fixes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]Text fixes to the Generations, renaming Mini Effects to Minimize VFX, Jousting corrections, and more fixes have been included during the September patch cycle, yet after the initial September patch. See the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/85554/september-jousting-renewal-quality-of-life-updates-patch-notes-september-7]September Patch Notes[/url] for more details![/*][*]Some people heard the whispers of a Weird Cat when failing to complete their Dan Tests. No longer shall they hear its mews.[/*][*]Elsie and Shuan have been feeling ill since eating Altam's leftovers, leaving them in a state of constant screams. They have since received Party Healing, and their mouths are back to their regular size and shape.[/*][*]Corrected a visual issue when wearing Languhiris Chaser Gloves alongside Royal Knight Armor.[/*][*]A few Sewing Patterns had counterfit copies issued. Walter has since issued a recall, and the following patterns now work as expected: 
[list][*]Sewing Pattern - Elegant Gothic Suit[/*][*]Sewing Pattern - Lacard's Layered Muffler Robe[/*][*]Sewing Pattern - Classic Shoes[/*][/list][/*][*]The Advanced Search for Pet Type now appropriately uses the pet type names instead of numbers.[list][*]Where "11" would previously bring up all the Bears, now "Bear" will.[/*][/list][/*][*]Lileas was a bit distracted during the 7:00 PM PT nightly Jousting Prelims, and started the initial match's registration time five minutes later than expected. Alpin was seen giving her a lecture on responsible Honey Drink consumption practices.[list][*]Registrations for 7:00 PM PT Jousting Preliminary matches now can be accessed at 6:45 PM PT as expected.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]The following are known bugs:[/b]
[list][*]Giants have developed a unique way of riding Purrlings, causing their models to be misaligned.[/*][*]You cannot use Birman Flat Pouch coupon while possessing one of the new Horizontal Totem Bags.[b]
[/b][/*][*]You cannot use Birman Knapsack coupon while possessing one of the new Vertical Totem Bags.[/*][*][b]🐛[/b][/*][*]In rare circumstances when rapidly casting Arrow Revolver, players will become unable to move or attack until receiving an attack or relogging.
[/*][*]Several items containing ampersands in their name and description aren't showing the & symbol.
[/*][*]Shop items with expiration times start counting down upon the player logging in or changing channels, rather than having their count down start when the item is purchased.
[/*][*]There is an issue where one-time/limited item cannot be purchased from the ingame shop, but can be on the web-shop.
[/*][*]There is an issue with the in-game Guild list not populating with guilds.[/*][/list]
