notes.title: September Jousting Renewal & Quality of Life Updates - Patch Notes - September 7
notes.notes:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q3/2765/200922_patchnotes_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg[/img]

Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the September Quality of Life Updates & the September Jousting Renewal Updates!

[b]The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:[/b]
[list][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/85541/sea-angel-box]Sea Angel Box[/url]: Thursday, August 24th, After Maintenance - Thursday, September 21st, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/86020/sestia-academy-box]Sestia Academy Box[/url]: Thursday, September 7th, After Maintenance - Thursday, October 5th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/85758/the-billionaire-s-bankroll-season-4]Billionaire's Bankroll: Season 4[/url]: Thursday, September 7th, After Maintenance - Thursday, October 26th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/85880/irusan-s-check-in-attendance-season-4]Irusan's Check-In Attendance Season 4[/url]: Thursday, September 7th, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 30th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/84562/glenn-bearna-dungeon-support]Glenn Bearna Dungeon Support[/url]: Thursday, July 13th, After Maintenance - Until Further Notice[url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/83337/renovation-season-4-archery-magic-and-race-specific-skill-changes][/url][/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/85932/jousting-tournament-renewal-update]Jousting Tournament Renewal Update[/url]: Permanent[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/85915/september-quality-of-life-updates]September Quality of Life Updates[/url]: Permanent[/*][/list]
[b]September Jousting Renewal & Quality of Life Updates:[/b]
[list][*]The Jousting Tournament Renewal is here! Check in with Lileas and review the updated details here: [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/85932/jousting-tournament-renewal-update]Jousting Tournament Renewal Update[/url]
[list][*]The preliminary and tournament match times have been updated.[/*][*]Up to 64 combatants can participate in the Jousting Finals.[/*][*]Skills exclusive to Jousting have been added.[/*][*]New rewards have been added to Lileas’ shop which Jousting Points can be exchanged for.[/*][*]The ability to cheer on combatants has been added, rewarding Jousting Points when spectating.[/*][*]And more![/*][/list][/*][*]Several quality of life changes have been added with the September update. See the full post for more information: [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/85915/september-quality-of-life-updates]September Quality of Life Updates[/url]
[list][*]Several inventory improvements have been implemented, such as a fishing box, trash can function, and changes to the Inventory Search functions.[/*][*]Elves and Giants can now get married in Emain Macha![/*][*]Dan Advancement tests have been balanced so that you can achieve your Dan ranks more comfortably.[/*][*]And more![/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]The following changes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]Updated the Word Filter to allow “Swap”, “C8”, and “Lesbian”.[/*][*]You can now use Rage Impact with the following Two-Handed Clubs: [list][*]Sheep Mace [/*][*]Lovey Dovey Cotton Candy [/*][*]Merchants' Guild Abacus [/*][*]Seashell Plushie [/*][*]Beluga Whale Plushie [/*][*]Dumbo Octopus Plushie [/*][*]Black Rose Bouquet [/*][*]Black Rose Clutch [/*][*]Glass Trim Bouquet [/*][*]Sacred Glow Censer [/*][*]Sacred Glow Holy Water [/*][*]Fairy Bubble Blower [/*][*]Seraphic Cantabile Holy Censer[/*][/list][/*][*]In order to better tell them apart, we have renamed the 24-Hour cooldown “Forgetful Potion” to “Special Forgetful Potion”. The 7-Day cooldown version will remain the same. [list][*]The descriptions for both have been updated to make the effects more clear. [/*][/list][/*][*]Renamed “Sephirot Arrow” to “Sephirot Bolt”, as these can only be fired via Crossbow. [/*][*]The buff effect for Baltane Mission Crystals has been changed from "Shadow Crystal" to "Baltane Crystal", in order to make them more distinct from Shadow Crystals.[/*][*](As of the August 10th Maintenance) It has been changed so that when you use a Weapon Appearance Scroll, the color of the item will now follow the color codes of the item the Weapon Appearance Scroll was based on. Before, the color was assigned randomly.[list][*]This change applies only to the appearance scrolls obtained after the August 10th update patch.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]The following bug fixes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]The Gather Stackable Items buttons will no longer restack and highlight stacks that are already at maximum. This improves the performance of this button.[/*][*]Improved the Pet Dye UI to fit RGB values properly.[/*][*]Continued our constant pursuit of polish by fixing up typos in G3, G24, and G25.[/*][*]Joust in time, we've performed a polish pass on the Jousting-related text![/*][*]Do you hear bells? We've also improved the Marriage-related text![/*][*]Fixed the text on Zone of Renewal to correct the ability cost from Phantasmal Amalgam to Phantasmal Remnant. The actual cost is unchanged.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where Intact Shyllien (Part-Time Job only) and Energy Converter (Part-Time Job only) placed in pet inventories could not be retrieved.[/*][*]The ability Mirage Missile was not properly granting stats from ranking the skill up. For those whose Mirage Missile was already ranked up, you will receive the missing stats automatically following a Rebirth.[/*][*]Floating heads no more- Fixed an issue where NPC-style Transformations would lack a body when transforming with a full body Robe equipped in your Gear slot.[/*][*]Corrected a few graphical issues on the Rookie Barista Uniform (M).[/*][*](Fixed during the August 17th Maintenance) Commerce rejoice and wyverns beware - Fixed an issue with Poison Potions that would prevent players from crafting Poison Tip Wyvern Ballista Bolts.[/*][/list]
[b]Bug fixes from the September 14th Maintenance:[/b]
[list][*]Heavy Strike! Fixed an issue where the number of players able to join the Jousting Tournaments was incorrect. Up to 16 players may join the Preliminary matches, and up to 64 players may join the Finals.
[/*][*]Counter! The ticker times for the Preliminary matches now correctly displays the proper times.
[/*][*]Focus! The "Today's Contents" section of the Traveler's Diary now displays the proper Prelims Jousting times.
[/*][*]Unbreakable Defense! The Cheer Squad has set their alarms and will now properly show up at the updated match times.[/*][*]In an effort to improve the flavor of Mabinogi's early-game experience, we have revised the descriptions for a number of early-game weapons commonly available in NPC shops.[/*][*]Removed an out-of-date mechanic reference on some older Staves. More Stave descriptions will be updated in a later patch.
[/*][*]Polished the descriptions of the myriad Shadow Crystals to make the effect more clear.
[/*][*]Provided a little more polish for the Wedding text. Hope your love springs eternal!
[/*][*]The recipes for Arbalest and Highlander Long Bow have been updated to remove "Radiant Tough String" for the correct "Radiant String". This is a text only change, the functionality for these recipes is unchanged.[/*][*]Improved the objectives for the Carpentry Grandmaster Missions to better indicate that the [Average/Fine/Finest] Firewood must be Made, not Obtained.[/*][/list]
[b]The following are known bugs:[/b]
[list][*]When viewing the additional information in the character information UI, there is some text cut off at the bottom of the Jousting information.[/*][*]The "Today's Contents" section of the Traveler's Diary still has the incorrect time for the Sunday Jousting Finals.[/*][*]In rare circumstances when rapidly casting Arrow Revolver, players will become unable to move or attack until receiving an attack or relogging.
[/*][*]Several items containing ampersands in their name and description aren't showing the & symbol.
[/*][*]Shop items with expiration times start counting down upon the player logging in or changing channels, rather than having their count down start when the item is purchased.
[/*][*]There is an issue where one-time/limited item cannot be purchased from the ingame shop, but can be on the web-shop.
[/*][*]There is an issue with the in-game Guild list not populating with guilds.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Jousting Tournament Renewal Update
notes.notes:
[h2][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q3/2177/230904_septemberupdate_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg[/img][/h2][h2][b]Jousting Tournament Renewal Update[/b][/h2]
The Jousting Tournament has been newly improved!

Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the August Quality of Life Updates!

[b]The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:[/b]
[list][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/85163/connous-beach-vacation-event]Connous Beach Vacation Event[/url]: Thursday, August 10th, After Maintenance - Thursday, September 7th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/85181/purr-ilous-adventure-pet-box]Purr-ilous Adventure Pet Box Sale[/url]: Thursday, August 10th, After Maintenance - Thursday, September 7th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/84931/step-by-step-event]Step by Step Event[/url]: Thursday, July 27th, After Maintenance - Thursday, August 24th, 2023, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/84978/desert-mirage-box]Desert Mirage Box Sale[/url]: Thursday, July 27th, After Maintenance - Thursday, August 24th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/84562/glenn-bearna-dungeon-support]Glenn Bearna Dungeon Support[/url]: Thursday, July 13th, After Maintenance - Until Further Notice[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/83337/renovation-season-4-archery-magic-and-race-specific-skill-changes][/url][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/84136/glenn-bearna-the-midwinter-fissure-update]Glenn Bearna: The Midwinter Fissure Update[/url]: Permanent[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/85027/august-quality-of-life-updates]August Quality of Life Updates[/url]: Permanent[/*][/list]
[b]August Quality of Life Updates:[/b]
[list][*]Several quality of life changes have been added. See the full post for more information: [b][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/85027/august-quality-of-life-updates]August Quality of Life Updates[/url][/b][list][*]Several significant changes to the Auction House have been made![/*][*]Changes to several items' stack bundles has been made.[/*][*]Dungeon Guide UI changes have been made.[/*][*]And more![/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]The following changes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]The amount of Pon required to instantly completely Baltane Squire Missions has been heavily reduced.[/*][/list]
[b]The following bug fixes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]Fixed several typos on the Dungeon Guide's Additional Info sections.[/*][*]Chinese Dragon Helm (Elf) can now be listed on the Auction House. [/*][*]Corrected a few visual issues when wearing Nightbringer Vanguard on your back.[/*][/list]
[b]Bugs fixed during the July 27th maintenance:[/b]
[list][*]Continued to hunt down typos in our story- today's course: G12, G23, G24, and Glenn Bearna. Thank you as always for your reports, we will continue to polish Mabinogi to a shine![/*][*]Corrected the new description on the Ace Hero Talent Support window. We're hoping this provides an easier understanding about what the support does![/*][*]No more skipping leg day; you can now wear all shoes with the Special Seraphic Harmony Attire (M) without fear of your legs running off on you.[/*][*]Cleaned up stray punctuation in the names of a few Alban Knights Training Stones and the Ancient Nine-Tailed Fox Support Puppet.[/*][*]Fixed an issue causing the Small Draconian Cute Dresses, Shoes, and Gloves to appear less cute than intended.[/*][/list]
[b]Bugs fixed during the July 20th maintenance:[/b]
[list][*]Renamed 'Shining Crystal Shard' to 'Frostwork Crystal Shard'.[/*][*]Improved the announcement ticker text for the Emain Macha Cook-Off.[/*][*]Changed the Hero Support menu name to be Ace Hero Talent Support menu, and improved the text.[/*][*]Corrected the Tailoring List name for the Ceann Bliana Scholar's Hairpin. It was previously incorrectly Ceann Bliana Scholar's Circlet.[/*][*]Renamed 'The Sulfur Spider inside Shadow Realm' to 'Sulfur Spiders of the Shadow Realm'.[/*][*]Fixed a player reported issue where Rabbie Phantasm was dropping fewer guaranteed items than expected.[/*][/list]
[b]The following are known bugs:[/b]
[list][*]Due to the removal of bidding, there is a known issue in the Auction House UI where the Per Unit and Total amount appears abnormally in the case of a failed bid.[/*][*]In the case of bundled items in a bid listing, there is a UI issue where the 'Per Unit' amount might not exactly match the total price of the auction listing, however the retrieved total price will be correct.[/*][/list]

[b]Glenn Bearna: The Midwinter Fissure Update:[/b]
[list][*]A new dungeon, [b]Glenn Bearna[/b], and a new area, [b]Sliab Mis[/b], have been added. You can reach the area through Sidhe Sneachta.[/*][*]Scenario quests related to the new areas will be added.[/*][*]You can meet the new NPC [b]Loiscneach[/b], the mountainkeeper, during the Glenn Bearna scenario quest.[/*][*][b]Several enhancement changes have been introduced for Erg, Echostones, Arcana, and more.[/b][/*][*]See the full post for more information: [b][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/84136/glenn-bearna-the-midwinter-fissure-update]Glenn Bearna: The Midwinter Fissure Update[/url][/b]. Additional details for Glenn Bearna can also be viewed on the [b][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/micro-site/glennbearna]dedicated microsite[/url][/b].[/*][/list]
[b]Update Regarding Recent Lag[/b]

We have been working hard to fix the various lag issues that have been occurring of late. Though we reduced the heaviness of the lag a few weeks back, we wanted to improve things further. There are still a few reports we've seen that we will continue to look into, but we feel that the game is in a much better state than when this all began. 

In the future we will need to further update the affected areas which could cause some return of the lag. We will communicate this with you when the time comes, and do our best to avoid and mitigate any issues. 

We apologize for the impacted gameplay, and thank you for your patience as we determined the root causes.

- The Mabinogi Team

[b]The following changes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*][b]Upgrade Reversion Kit[/b] can now be crafted using the Handicraft skill or purchased from the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/shop/webshop/detail/cash/150742]Item Shop[/url].[/*][*]Print Casual Wear can no longer be upgraded.
[list][*]The upgrade options of already upgraded items will be kept but cannot be further upgraded.
[/*][/list][/*][*]Color has been added to the sword appearance in the animation of the Special Imperial Knight Uniform.
[/*][*]As a material item with the name "Shining Crystal Shard" already exists, the "Shining Crystal Shard" that can be obtained from Glenn Bearna will be renamed to "Frostwork Crystal Shard" in a future patch.[/*][/list]
[b]The following bug fixes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]Fixed a rare issue that loading the skill UI could cause a client crash.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where the charge count appeared abnormally when parallel-casting Elemental Knight skills.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where the remaining time for Final Strike appeared abnormally when parallel-casting while using Final Strike. [/*][*]Fixed a rare issue where you could not finish casting Meteor Strike when you are attacked while parallel-casting. [/*][*]Fixed the issue where you could defend the skills which should not be defendable by Dauntless Defense. [list][*]Combo: Pummel[/*][*]Act 6: Crisis[/*][*]Succubus Queen's Butterfly Kiss[/*][*]Merrow’s Waterspout[/*][*]Roaring skills of dragons and Neid[/*][/list][/*][*]Fixed the issue where Elemental Attunement was applied when using Thunder skill.[/*][*]Fixed missing plus marks on the announcement text when summoning (or unsummoning) a doll bag.[/*][*]Removed an incorrect mention of Royal Complete Skill EXP Potion (1 Day) being listed as part of the Snowy Scout's Warm Up Gold Shop.[/*][*]Fixed an issue causing the Fantastic Chorus Enhancement effect to not further boost the reduction to enemy stats. All other portions of the effect are working as intended.[/*][*]An issue where the Alban Eiler Season 2 Challenger box and title were granted when retrieving the previous season's rewards has been identified. Characters who obtained the Alban Eiler Season 2 Challenger box and title have had these items replaced with the correct Imbolic Season 2 Challenger Box and Imbolic Season Challenger title automatically during the July 13th maintenance.[/*][*]Found and fixed many typos through the game, this time mostly around G22, G23, Techniques/Briogh, and Arcana quests. [list][*]Thank you players for continuing to report these![/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]The following are known bugs:[/b]
[list][*]Guilds are not appearing in the Guild List.[/*][*]There is an issue where one-time/limited items cannot be purchased from the in-game shop, but can be on the web shop.[/*][*]Shop items with expiration times start counting down upon the player logging in or changing channels, rather than having their countdown start when the item is purchased.[/*][*]Several items containing ampersands in their name and description aren't showing the & symbol.
[/*][*]In rare circumstances when rapidly casting Arrow Revolver, players will become unable to move or attack until receiving an attack or relogging.
[/*][*]The Journal images for Glenn Bearna display the dungeon name as "Glenn Berna".[/*][/list]

[h2][b]Update Details[/b][/h2][list][*]A new dungeon, [b]Glenn Bearna[/b], and a new area, [b]Sliab Mis[/b], have been added. You can reach the area through Sidhe Sneachta.[/*][*]Sidhe Sneachta’s terrain has been partially changed.[/*][*]Scenario quests related to the new areas will be added.[/*][*]You can meet the new NPC [b]Loiscneach[/b], the mountainkeeper, during the Glenn Bearna scenario quest.[/*][*]Several enhancement changes have been introduced for Erg, Echostones, Arcana, and more.[/*][*]Additional details for Glenn Bearna can also be viewed on the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/micro-site/glennbearna]dedicated microsite[/url].[/*][/list]
[h2][b]Scenario Quests[/b][/h2][list][*]Cold winds from the northern lands have blown into Tir Chonaill. The Glenn Bearna prologue story will be available. [list][*]During The Scouts’ Snowy Summer Warm-Up Event, the quest [b][Content] Dark Dreams of a Winter Wind[/b] is automatically given to characters who have met one of the following condition: Completed Memory Book Volume 3, Completed Generation 1's "Advent of the Goddess", Completed Arcana Guide Quest "Lighting the Arcana's Flame"[list][*]During The Scouts’ Snowy Summer Warm-Up Event, the difficulty of battles during quests will be lowered. [/*][/list][/*][*]After The Scouts’ Snowy Summer Warm-Up Event ends, the quest [b][Content] Dark Dreams of a Winter Wind[/b] will be automatically given to characters who have at least one Arcana Talent that has at least 1 Link unlocked.   [/*][/list][/*][*]The Glenn Bearna scenario quest line begins with the guide quest, [b][Content] A Flame of Burning Cold[/b].[list][*]This quest is given when the cumulative level is 20,000 or higher, an Arcana Link is unlocked at level 1 or higher, and the prologue story quest, [b][Content] A God of the Northern Winds[/b] is completed.[list][*]You may have to change channels to receive the quest after completing the prologue story.[/*][/list][/*][*]You can proceed with the quest by talking to NPC Laoire in the Arcana Association Room in Tara Rath Royal Castle.[/*][*]Progress through the story to discover the reason behind the abnormal weather.[/*][*]During the quest, [b][Content] A Tranquil Mirror of Dawn and Dusk[/b], you will discover Sliab Mis and be able to enter Glenn Bearna.[/*][*]After completing the last quest of the scenario, you will be able to enter Sliab Mis and Glenn Bearna without quest limitations.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h2][b]Glenn Bearna Dungeon[/b][/h2]
[b]Entry Details[/b]
[list][*]Enter Glenn Bearna through the barrier in Sliab Mis, north of Sidhe Sneachta.[/*][*]Dungeon Entry Conditions:[list][*]Cumulative level 20,000 or higher [/*][*]Arcana total level 50 or higher[/*][*]Completing the final Glenn Bearna scenario quest: [Content] A Fantasia of Endless Winter[/*][/list][/*][*]A minimum of 2 to a maximum of 8 party members can enter the dungeon[list][*]Note: If you enter with an odd number, party members without pairs can have difficulty with some dungeon objectives.[/*][/list][/*][*]Glenn Bearna has two dungeon difficulty levels: [b]Normal[/b] and [b]Hard[/b]. [/*][*]There is no entry limit, but clear rewards can be obtained up to 3 times a week per character.[/*][/list]
[b]Entry Details[/b]
[list][*]In order to clear the dungeon, you must overcome the frost’s grasp within Glenn Bearna.[/*][*]Solve the paradox between the Day and Night timelines of Glenn Bearna. [/*][*]The dungeon is played in pairs with the Lifeline system.[list][*]The party will be split up into Day and Night groups, and you will be paired with someone from the other side.[/*][*]You can select which side to join and the pair will be randomly determined.[/*][/list][/*][*]You share Lifeline Health with your Lifeline Partner.[list][*]Lifeline Health gauges the shared health bar of the two paired party members depending on the dungeon difficulty.[/*][*]Lifeline Health can be reduced or restored by certain monsters or scenarios within the dungeon.[/*][*]When one gets knocked unconscious while paired in a Lifeline, the Lifeline Health will be reduced by the HP of the unconscious character. [/*][*]Resurrection is possible unless the Lifeline Health reaches 0, and the character who got knocked unconscious and used up the Lifeline Health cannot be revived.[/*][*]When Lifeline Health is reduced to 0, characters with remaining health can still play. [/*][*]If all of the party members' Lifeline Health decreases or there are no pairs left on either side, the dungeon will fail and you will not be able to proceed further.[/*][/list][/*][*]There is a 30-second cooldown when using potions in the dungeon.[/*][*]You can re-enter the Glenn Bearna Dungeon up to 3 times if disconnection occurs.[/*][*]You will move through the dungeon to clear the areas of enemies, and gather the necessary materials to survive the cold.[list][*]Party members in the Daytime are tasked with acquiring Firewood, while those in Nighttime are tasked with acquiring Ember. [list][*]These are accumulated as points and can be gathered by defeating certain enemies. Which party members have accumulated the Firewood and Ember is shown in the party details on the left of the screen.[/*][/list][/*][*]The party must work together to stop the enemies and correct the paradox affecting the areas of Glenn Bearna.[/*][*]Strategically use the braziers, lit brightly by the gathered Firewood and Embers, to collect the souls of enemies and unleash them upon your foes.[/*][*]What else may you encounter in the chill of the winter?[/*][/list][/*][*]You will encounter the following enemies and Boss monsters in Glenn Bearna:[list][*]Fianna Geimhridh[/*][*]Snuggly Sneachta[/*][*]Gwyllion[/*][*]Carnivorous Snowtrap[/*][*]Man-Eating Snowtrap[/*][*]Enkindled Wraith[/*][*]Ember Sprite[/*][*]Icicle Sprite[/*][*]Abominable Rabbit[/*][*]Abominable Rabbit of Equilibrium[/*][*]Frostwork Soul[/*][*]Folach Catt[/*][*]Gwyllgi[/*][*]Ice Golem[/*][*]Pallid Soul[/*][*]Unfinished Reverie[/*][*]Cnoc Oighir[/*][*]Cailleach[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Dungeon Rewards[/b]
[list][*]Rewards can be obtained when clearing the boss of Glenn Bearna. [/*][*]EXP and guaranteed rewards will be dropped from the Dungeon End Chest.[/*][*]Additional rewards such as gems, crafting materials and manuals, enchant scrolls, and set effect enhancement scrolls are also possible to obtain from the Dungeon End Chest. [/*][*]Clear rewards can be obtained up to 3 times a week per character.[list][*]Normal and Hard difficulty levels share the number of rewards obtained. (Resets every Saturday at 7:00 AM PT)[/*][*]You can check the weekly reward count by touching the dungeon entrance or entering the dungeon.[/*][/list][/*][/list][table][tr][th][b]Difficulty

varying amounts of Frostflame Threads.[/*][*]Exchange Frostflame Threads at the Arcana Enkindling Lectern in the Arcana Association Room for Ice-Scorched Crests, used to further upgrade your Arcana Links.[/*][*]Additional effects have been added for each new stage of [b]Elemental Knight[/b]:[list][*]Link Stage 6: Elemental Knight skill mana consumption reduced by 50%[/*][*]Link Stage 7: Close Combat and Magic talent skill cooldowns reduced by 10% (excluding race-specific skills)[/*][*]Link Stage 8: Increases Min/Max damage by 10% (maximum 50) of Magic Attack when equipped with a Close Combat talent weapon[/*][*]Link Stage 9: Blazing Assault Slash Range increased by +0.8m, Shattering Windmill Attack Radius increased by +2m, Dynavolt Smash Attack Width increased by +1m, and Dauntless Defense Attack Radius increased by +2m[/*][*]Link Stage 10: Blazing Assault Slash, Shattering Windmill, Dynavolt Smash, and Dauntless Defense cooldown reduced by 1 second[/*][/list][/*][*]Additional effects have been added for each new stage of [b]Harmonic Saint[/b]:[list][*]Link Stage 6: Casting Healing or Party Healing grants a stack of Warmth of Life, and Hand of Restoration and Echoes of Salvation gain healing +7% and 200 Wound Recovery per stack of Warmth of Life[/*][*]Link Stage 7: Voice of Vitality Recovery amount increases by +50%, Increases Piercing Resistance by +1 while the Voice of Vitality effect is applied, and Increases Protection/Magic Protection by +20 while the Voice of Vitality effect is applied[/*][*]Link Stage 8: Reduces the cooldown of Blessing of Protection by 60 seconds, and Increases the duration of Blessing of Protection by 2 seconds[/*][*]Link Stage 9: Pulse of Purification recovers 160 HP and Wounds of allies within the attack range upon inflicting damage to enemies[/*][*]Link Stage 10: Allows self-revival at your location when incapacitated (60 minute cooldown), and resurrection is possible in most cases including even in restricted dungeons, such as Rabbie Phantasm and Glenn Bearna[/*][/list][/*][*]The following Harmonic Saint skills have been adjusted: [list][*]The Voice of Vitality skill-related effects are modified to be applied to all [h2][b]Introduction of Erg Grade[/b][/h2][list][*]The Erg Grade system has been implemented into the Erg System. [/*][*][b]B-Grade[/b] and [b]A-Grade[/b] Erg Enhancement methods have been added. Existing Erg enhancements are categorized as [b]S-Grade[/b][b] Erg[/b], being the highest grade.[list][*][b]Note: Existing Erg enhanced weapons will become S-Grade Erg enhanced weapons.[/b][/*][/list][/*][*][b]Advancement Catalyst B and Advancement Catalyst A items have been added.[/b][list][*]These Catalyst items can be crafted using the Magic Craft skill with at least Rank 9 Magic Craft.[/*][*]Advancement Catalyst B:[list][*]Shyllien Crystal x2[/*][*]Fine Firewood x20[/*][*]Hay Bale x5[/*][*]Holy Water of Lymilark x20[/*][/list][/*][*]Advancement Catalyst A:[list][*]Shyllien Crystal x5[/*][*]Divine Mineral Fragment x5[/*][*]Desecrated Charm Chunk x2[/*][*]Thorny Blue Shackle x2[/*][*]Massive Turtle Shell Chip x2[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]When attempting to apply Erg to your weapon, you can select one of the three grades which are B, A, and S to start grade enhancement.[/*][*]Weapons with a lower Erg grade will have a lesser Erg effect compared to a higher grade, however the effect is easier to achieve.[list][*]The basic effect of B-grade Erg starts from level 11.[/*][*]A-grade Ergs show the basic effect from level 16 and the bonus effect from level 26.[/*][/list][/*][*]After leveling up a B Grade Erg to level 50, you can talk to Kaelic with an Advancement Catalyst B to upgrade it to A Grade. After increasing the grade, the Erg level will start again at level 30.[/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q3/1134/erg-advancement.png[/img]
[*]A-grade and B-grade Erg weapons can also be transferred using the Transference Catalyst, but cannot be transferred if the transfer target has a different Erg level.[/*][*]Erg Grade is added to the Auction House as a detailed search option.[/*][*]Additional Weapon Erg Effects have been added for the following weapon types:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q3/1207/erg-weapon-types.png[/img]
*Note: Erg effects for each level based on S grade.
[list][*][b]Erg Enhancement has been improved to add an increased chance of success after a failure when attempting to level break. [/b][list][*]When attempting to level up Erg, the success rate now increases as the number of consecutive failures increases.[/*][*][b]Example[/b]: Success Rate: 0.70% → Failed Upgrade → Success rate: 0.71 (0.70+0.01)%[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Erg can now be removed from a weapon by talking to Kaelic and selecting the Remove Erg option.[/b][list][*][b]Caution: If an Erg is removed from a weapon, the Erg cannot be recovered. [/b][/*][*]Erg cannot be removed from weapons that are sealed with a Seal Scroll.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h2][b]Additional Enhancement Changes[/b][/h2][list][*]The readability of the equipment upgrade menu has been improved.[/*][*]Upgrades made to items can now be reverted using the [b]Upgrade Reversion Kit[/b].[list][*]Normal Upgrades, Artisan Upgrades, and Gem Upgrades can be removed to return to the previous upgrade. (Special upgrades cannot be removed.)[/*][*]When reverting an upgrade, the proficiency used for the upgrade is restored up to 100.[/*][*]This item can be used on equipment that has been specially upgraded, and does not affect the special upgrade status.[/*][*]This item cannot be used on equipment that has been upgraded or in the process of being upgraded before the addition of the Upgrade Reversion Kit (before maintenance on July 13, 2023).[/*][*]Upgrade Reversion Kit can be crafted using the Handicraft skill or purchased from the Item Shop.[/*][/list][/*][*]Items that have been upgraded will now show the list of current upgrades applied in the item tooltip.[list][*]You cannot check the list of upgrades for equipment that has been upgraded or in the process of being upgraded before the addition of the Upgrade Reversion Kit (before maintenance on July 13, 2023).[/*][/list][/*][*]The number of possible Echostone advancement attempts within Sidhe Finnachaid has been increased from 3 to 5.[/*][*]The number of Echostone awakenings has been limited according to the character's cumulative level.[list][*]The AP cost per awakening attempt has not been changed.[/*][*]The limit is refreshed upon entering the dungeon again.[/*][/list][/*][/list][table][tr][th][b]Cumulative Level
[/b][/th][th]Awakening Attempts[/th][/tr][tr][td]Level 29,999 and below[/td][td]5 times[/td][/tr][tr][td]Level 30,000 ~ 39,999[/td][td]10 times[/td][/tr][tr][td]Level 40,000 ~ 49,999[/td][td]15 times[/td][/tr][tr][td]Level 50,000 and above[/td][td]unlimited[/td][/tr][/table][list][*]A separate warning notice is now displayed when fragmenting an Echostone of grade 20 or higher.[/*][*]Success Rates for Echostone Advancements have been improved.[list][*]The Advancement Success Rate when clearing Sidhe Finnachaid Advanced is:[/*][/list][/*][/list][table][tr][td]Grade 18 or lower: [b]100%[/b][/td][td]Grade 19-21: [b]90%[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td]Grade 22-24: [b]75%[/b][/td][td]Grade 25 or higher: [b]45%[/b][/td][/tr][/table][list][*]The drop rate of Runes used to upgrade the Alban Knights Emblem have increased.[/*][*]The number of Runes that can be acquired when clearing the Alban Knights Training Grounds is greatly increased.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Renovation Season 4 - Patch Notes - June 8th
notes.notes:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q3/2765/200922_patchnotes_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg[/img]

Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the Renovation Season 4 Update!

[b]The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:[/b]
[list][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/83415/sweet-dreams-box]Sweet Dreams Box[/url]: Thursday, May 25th, After Maintenance - Thursday, June 22nd, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/83692/open-ocean-box]Open Ocean Box[/url]: Thursday, June 8th, After Maintenance - Thursday, July 6th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/83560/star-fishing-event-returns]Star-Fishing Event Returns![/url]: Thursday, June 8th, After Maintenance - Thursday, July 6th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/83337/renovation-season-4-archery-magic-and-race-specific-skill-changes]Renovation Season 4 Update[/url]: Permanent[/*][/list]
[b]Renovation Season 4:[/b]
[list][*]Several skills have been modified! See the full post for more information: [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/83337/renovation-season-4-archery-magic-and-race-specific-skill-changes]Renovation Season 4: Archery, Magic, and Race-Specific Skill Changes.[/url][/*][/list]
[b]Commerce Alban Eiler Season 1:[/b]
[list][*]Seasonal Commerce Alban Eiler Season 1 will begin at 12:00 AM PDT on July 1st, 2023 and run until November 1st, 2023 12:00 AM PDT.[list][*]The following new outfits and sewing patterns have been added. The sewing patterns will be available for purchase from Sayiv’s shop in Season 1 for 3,000,000 Seasonal Ducats:[list][*]Refashioned Selina Sexy Bare Look[/*][*][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2335/refashioned-selina-sexy-bare-look.png[/img][/*][*]Refashioned Selina Lady Dress[/*][*][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2338/refashioned-selina-lady-dress.png[/img][/*][*]Refashioned Sleeveless and Bell-Bottoms[/*][*][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2336/refashioned-sleeveless-and-bell-bottoms.png[/img][/*][*]Urban Casual Look[/*][*][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2337/urban-casual-look.png[/img][/*][/list][/*][*]Purchase limits within Sayiv’s shop will be reset.[/*][*]The Alban Eiler Season 1 Challenger Box will be available, containing the following items:[list][*][b]*NEW*[/b] Alban Eiler Season 1 Challenger 2nd Title[list][*][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2332/albaneilers1-gif.gif[/img][/*][*]Movement Speed +3%[/*][/list][/*][*]20 Precise Reforging Tools[/*][/list][/*][*]The Seasonal Commerce Guide will be updated with Season 1, and Imbolic Season 3 information will be archived.[/*][/list][/*][*]Starting from the June 8th update, the required materials and quantity for each barter trading post will be partially modified.[/*][*]“Commerce Champion” titles that were acquired in the past and have already expired have been changed so that they can be equipped without any effects.[/*][/list]
[b]The following changes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]The Guardian Soul Stone item has been added back to the Adventurer's Seal shop and can be purchased for 6x Adventurer's Seals. [/*][*]The descriptive item name for “(Imbolic)” Commerce Mounts now display as “(Imbolic Style)”[/*][*]Between the May patch and June patch, the following changes and bug fixes were made:
[list][*]The Master of Potion title now properly indicates that you are the master of multiple potions.
[/*][*]Modified "Red Dragon Inside Shadow Realm" to be "Red Dragon in the Shadow Realm".
[/*][*]Fixed a typo with the stat description of the Union enchant.
[/*][*]Fixed a few text issues during the Crom Bas questline.
[/*][*]Small typo fixes to Skill Info for Commerce Mastery and Taunt.
[/*][*]Several item descriptions for certain crafting materials have been made consistent by changing one of the sentences from "Used as a material when crafting special equipment" to "Used to craft special equipment"[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]The following bug fixes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]An issue where the "Crest Forging Successful" notice appears when creating a Crest with insufficient bank funds has been fixed.[/*][*]Fixed a UI display issue when bidding at the Tara Auction.[/*][*]Fixed a punctuation typo with the Talented Artist title.[/*][*]When hovering over the Buy button in a shop without enough gold, the text will now properly indicate that you don't have enough gold in your bank.[/*][/list]
[b]The following are known bugs:[/b]
[list][*]Guilds are not appearing in the Guild List.[/*][*]A rare issue has been reported where raids do not spawn correctly on certain channels.[/*][*]There is an issue where one-time/limited items cannot be purchased from the in-game shop, but can be on the web-shop.[/*][*]Shop items with expiration times start counting down upon the player logging in or changing channels, rather than having their countdown start when the item is purchased.[/*][*]The survey notice that appears when closing Mabinogi currently displays a white screen.[/*][*]Lag issues experienced by many players are currently under investigation. [list][*]We have applied a change in the June 8th patch to alleviate the lag and further help our team identify the problem. We appreciate your patience and understanding while we work on this issue. [/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Renovation Season 4: Archery, Magic, and Race-Specific Skill Changes
notes.notes:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2291/230530_juneupdate_socials_newsarticleheader_940x290.png[/img]

[h2][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2235/archer.png[/img][/b][b] Archery
[/b][/h2]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2237/archery-compilation-resized.gif[/img][/b]

[b]Skill Changes[/b]
[list][*]For each updated skill, the skill info and description has been updated to reflect changes.[/*][/list]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2306/ranged-attack.png[/img] Ranged Attack[/b]
[list][*]The ranged attack minimum aim rate effect is added. (+20% at Dan Rank 3)[list][*]The ranged attack minimum aim rate effect can be stacked.[/*][*]There is a maximum upper limit for the ranged attack minimum aim rate which cannot be exceeded. (Max +40%)[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2240/magnum-shot.png[/img] Magnum Shot[/b]
[list][*]The damage multiplier for each skill rank has been increased.
[list][*][b]Example: [/b]Based on Dan Rank 3 of the skill: [list][*][b]Before[/b]: 560%[/*][*][b]After[/b]: 590%[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2238/crash-shot.png[/img] Crash Shot[/b]
[list][*]The fragment damage multiplier for each skill rank has been increased.[list][*][b]Example: [/b]Based on Dan Rank 3 of the skill: [list][*][b]Before[/b]: 280%[/*][*][b]After[/b]: 370%[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2241/urgent-shot.png[/img] Urgent Shot[/b]
[list][*]The Urgent Shot effect has been changed:[list][*][b]Before[/b]: Increased aiming speed for ranged attacks after Urgent Shot.[/*][*][b]After[/b]: Damage with Ranged Combat Skills +% for 10 sec. after Urgent Shot.[/*][/list][/*][*]After using Urgent Shot, damage with Ranged Combat Skills will be increased for 10 seconds. (12% at Rank 1)[/*][*]When using Urgent Shot, 10% of maximum health and stamina will be used.[/*][*]The Yellow Echostone awakening ability of “Urgent Shot Aiming Speed after Use” is replaced with “Urgent Shot Effect Duration.” (Increased by 0.1 seconds per level with a max of 2 seconds at level 20)[/*][*]The title effect of “the Master of Urgent Shot” has been changed:
[list][*][b]Before[/b]: DEX +20, Urgent Shot Aiming Speed after Use 30%, STR -20, Will -10[/*][*][b]After[/b]: DEX +20, Urgent Shot HP and Stamina Cost -2%, STR -20, Will -10[/*][/list][/*][/list]

[h2][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2236/magic.png[/img] [/b][b]Magic 

[/b][/h2]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2262/magic-compilation-resized.gif[/img][/b]

[b]Skill Changes[/b]
[list][*]For each updated skill, the skill info and description has been updated to reflect changes.[/*][/list]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2260/hail-storm.png[/img] Hail Storm[/b]
[list][*]When knocked down while casting, it has been changed so that the number of charges accumulated will be reduced by 1.[list][*]The skill is canceled when knocked down with 1 charge.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2258/blaze.png[/img] Blaze[/b]
[list][*]The target range is increased.[list][*][b]Before[/b]: Melee attack distance + 0.5 meters[/*][*][b]After[/b]: Melee attack distance + 2 meters[/*][/list][/*][*]The casting time to max charge has been reduced.[list][*][b]Before[/b]: 3 seconds[/*][*][b]After[/b]: 1.5 seconds[/*][/list][/*][*]A marker is displayed on all enemies within range while preparing the skill.[/*][*]The 2 second delay after using the skill has been removed, as well a the immunity to some negative effects that were applied during the delay.[/*][*]Improvements have been made to the mouse cursor when using the skill.[/*][*]The knockdown gauge dependence is reduced by 50% in the explosion damage formula.[list][*]Previously, 70% of the knockdown gauge could draw out all the explosion damage, but now it is possible to draw out all the explosion damage with only 35% of the knockdown gauge.[/*][/list][/*][*]Fixed an issue where damage was applied abnormally when switching weapons before applying explosive damage.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where Wind Blast damage was applied abnormally when using it after using Blaze.[/*][*]Improved skill so that it is not canceled when an enemy is selected outside the range while charging.[/*][/list]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2261/lightning-rod.png[/img] Lightning Rod[/b]
[list][*]Added a directional display effect that lets you know the attack direction while preparing the skill.[/*][*]The duration of the magic circle effect has been changed.[list][*][b]Before[/b]: 20 seconds[/*][*][b]After[/b]: Unlimited[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2264/shockwave.png[/img] Shockwave[/b]
[list][*]The delay after using the skill has been reduced.[list][*][b]Before[/b]: 1 second[/*][*][b]After[/b]: 0.3 seconds[/*][/list][/*][*]Fixed an issue where the direction the character is facing changed after using the skill.[/*][/list]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2265/spellwalk.png[/img] Spellwalk[/b]
[list][*]Improvements have been made so that skill use is maintained even when moving to a different area.[/*][/list]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2263/meteor-strike.png[/img] Meteor Strike[/b]
[list][*]Improvements have been made so that the skill slot remains visible during the flashing effect when the skill hits.[list][*]This is also applied when using the “Mini Effects” performance option setting.[/*][*]You can now turn off the flashing effect of Meteor Strike by using the "Mini Effects" performance option setting.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2259/fusion-bolt.png[/img] Fusion Bolt[/b]
[list][*]When attacking with the skill, 50% of the opponent's magic defense is applied for each bolt.
[list][*]For bolt magic combinations, a total of 2 magic defense calculations are applied, once for each bolt magic combination.[/*][/list][/*][/list]

[h2][b]Race-Specific Skills
[/b][/h2]
[b]Skill Changes[/b]
[list][*]For each updated skill, the skill info and description has been updated to reflect the changes.[/*][*]Ladeca skills (Breath of Ladeca, Vision of Ladeca, Might of Ladeca) for all three races will no longer be canceled when changing channels, logging off, or rebirthing.[/*][/list]

[h2][b]Human
[/b][/h2]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2257/human-compilation-compressed.gif[/img]

[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2254/arrow-revolver.png[/img] Arrow Revolver[/b]
[list][*]The damage multiplier for each shot is increased.[list][*][b]Example: [/b]Based on Rank 1 of the skill: [list][*][b]Before[/b]: 110% / 120% / 125% / 145% / 190%[/*][*][b]After[/b]: 170% / 180% / 185% / 205% / 250%[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The aim rate bonus that was applied only to the first hit has been removed.[/*][*]You can now perform a volley attack by pressing Ctrl + Right-Click on an enemy while preparing the skill. This will take into account the current aiming accuracy rate and damage multiplier of the current number of shots.[list][*][b]Example 1[/b]: When attacking with a volley immediately after preparing a Rank 1 skill, the first hit will attack 5 times in a row with a damaging multiplier of 170%.
[/*][*][b]Example 2[/b]: When attacking with a volley after firing 2 shots with a Rank 1 skill, the 3rd hit will attack 3 times in a row with a damage multiplier of 185%.
[/*][/list][/*][*]An issue where the skill use status was not displayed normally when cast during knockback has been fixed.[/*][/list]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2255/breath-of-ladeca.png[/img] Breath of Ladeca[/b]
[list][*]A 10% bonus damage effect has been added for close combat skills when dual swords are equipped.[list][*]Applicable skills include:[list][*]Normal Attack, Smash, Counterattack, Charge, Assault Slash, Rage Impact, Bash, Windmill, Final Hit
[/*][*]Elemental Knight skills are not directly applied, but instead indirectly applied due to increased damage of Smash/Windmill/Assault Slash.
[/*][/list][/*][*]Note: The bonus damage effect will stack with additional damage buffs for a combined calculation.[/*][/list][/*][/list]

[h2][b]Elf
[/b][/h2]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2244/elf-compilation-resized.gif[/img]

[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2247/mirage-missile.png[/img] Mirage Missile[/b]
[list][*]The effect duration of the Mirage Missile has been increased. [list][*][b]Example: [/b]Based on Rank 1 of the skill: [list][*][b]Before[/b]: 21 seconds[/*][*][b]After[/b]: 22 seconds[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Damage over time interval has been reduced from 3 seconds to 1 second.[/*][*]Damage for Mirage Shot based on the character’s Intelligence has been increased.[/*][/list]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2245/elven-magic-missile.png[/img] Elven Magic Missile[/b]
[list][*]The Elven Magic Missile can now be used while Final Shot is active.[/*][*]The way to use the skill has been changed from the existing mini-game method to selecting and using the desired attribute.[list][*]When using the skill, 3 attribute options are activated. You can select the desired option by using F1~F3 keys and the chosen option will be used.[/*][/list][/*][*]It has been changed so that you can move while casting the skill.[/*][*]The cooldown of Elven Magic Missile is reduced.[list][*][b]Before[/b]: 9 seconds[/*][*][b]After[/b]: 5 seconds[/*][/list][/*][*]Casting time of Elven Magic Missile is reduced.[/*][*]The projectile speed of Elven Magic Missile is increased.[/*][*]The Fire, Lightning, and Ice attribute damage of Elven Magic Missile is increased.[/*][*]The splash radius of Elven Magic Missile's Lightning and Ice attributes is reduced.[/*][*]The freezing effect specifications of the Ice attribute Elven Magic Missile are changed to be the same as the Ice Spear specifications.[/*][*]It is changed so that you can attack a frozen target with the Ice attribute Elven Magic Missile effect.[list][*][b]When attacking a frozen target with the Ice attribute Elven Magic Missile effect, the damage dealt is reduced by 30%.[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2246/final-shot.png[/img] Final Shot[/b]
[list][*]When Final Shot is active, it has been changed so that the character cannot be stunned or knocked down.[/*][*]The duration of Final Shot has been increased.[list][*][b]Example: [/b]Based on Rank 1 of the skill:[list][*][b]Before[/b]: 45 seconds[/*][*][b]After[/b]: 50 seconds[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]

[h2][b]Giant
[/b][/h2]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2249/giant-compilation-resized.gif[/img]

[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2248/final-strike.png[/img] Final Strike[/b]
[list][*]The stun time after attacking is reduced for each rage stage. [list][*][b]Before[/b]: 2 sec / 1.5 sec / 1 sec per level[/*][*][b]After[/b]: 1.5 sec / 1 sec / 0.75 sec per level[/*][/list][/*][*]An issue where the rage level is reset when an Elemental Knight Instill skill is activated and a skill is casted has been fixed.[/*][/list]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2251/stomp.png[/img] Stomp[/b]
[list][*]The cooldown for Stomp has been removed, and it can be used immediately.[/*][*]The stun time after use has been reduced.[list][*][b]Before[/b]: 1.5 seconds[/*][*][b]After[/b]: 1 second[/*][/list][/*][*]During the skill preparation, an indication mark has been added to identify enemies within attack range.[/*][*]Enemies that are stunned can now be hit by Stomp.[/*][/list]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2252/taunt.png[/img] Taunt[/b]
[list][*]The enemies that can be lured have been expanded.[list][*]Boss-level monsters in content such as Crom Bás, Tech Duinn Missions, Mag Mell Missions, Rabbie Phantasm Dungeons, Apostle Raids and Field Raids cannot be lured.[/*][/list][/*][*]An effect that increases Defense and Magic Defense by 20 in proportion to the number of monsters successfully provoked has been added.[list][*]Taunt timer may differ from affected enemies after recasting the skill.[/*][/list][/*][*]The “Taunt Defense and Magic Defense increase per enemy provoked” Reforging attribute and Echostone Awakening ability has been added.[list][*]Equipment with the “Enhanced Taunt'” Reforging attribute and Red Echostones with the 'Strengthening Taunt Lure' Awakening ability have been changed to the “Taunt Defense and Magic Defense increase per enemy provoked” attribute of the same level.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2253/throwing-attack.png[/img] Throwing Attack[/b]
[list][*]You can activate Redoubled Offensive (Technique) and Blast (Stardust Support Effect) when attacking an enemy with Throwing Attack.[/*][*]“Throwing Attack - Cooldown Reduction” Reforging attribute has been added.[list][*]This attribute does not appear on Echostones.[/*][/list][/*][*]Atlatl with the “Attack Speed Increase - Set Effect Value'' Reforging attribute has been changed to the “Throwing Attack - Cooldown Reduction” attribute of the same level.[/*][/list]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2250/giant-full-swing.png[/img] Giant Full Swing[/b]
[list][*]All two-handed axes and two-handed maces can now be used as exclusive weapons for Giant Full Swing.[list][*]Existing notation for items marked as Giant Full Swing exclusive weapons will be removed from the item description.[/*][/list][/*][*]The damage multiplier when using the Giant Full Swing exclusive weapon is increased.[list][*][b]Example: [/b]Based on Rank 1 of the skill: [list][*][b]Before[/b]: 400%[/*][*][b]After[/b]: 430%[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]When using a Giant Full Swing exclusive weapon, the damage multiplier bonus according to the elapsed time of the minigame is removed.[list][*]The damage multiplier bonus according to the gauge amount of the mini game is applied as before.[/*][/list][/*][*]The weapon attack effect has been changed so that it does not move along with the character.[/*][*]The “Giant Full Swing - Damage” Reforging attribute will appear instead of the “Giant Full Swing Damage” Reforging attribute.[/*][*]Two-handed maces with the “Giant Full Swing Damage” Reforging attribute have been changed to the “Giant Full Swing - Damage” attribute of the same level.[/*][/list][url=https://forums.mabinogi.nexon.net/][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q4/1120/nxa-buttons-150x35-discussonforums-nxabtn.png[/img][/url][url=https://bit.ly/MabiDiscord][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q4/1121/nxa-buttons-150x35-discussondiscord-7289dabtn.png[/img][/url]

notes.notes:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q3/2765/200922_patchnotes_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg[/img]

Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the May Update!

[list][*]Several quality of life changes have been added. See the full post for more information: [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/82434/may-quality-of-life-updates]May Quality of Life Updates[/url][list][*]Enchant improvements to make highly successful enchantments more effective while reducing the penalty of huge failure.[/*][*]The Adventurer Seal system has been renewed, and the shop has been updated with new items.[/*][*]The Mabinogi BGM song titles have been improved greatly, thanks to our localization team! [/*][*]And more![/*][/list][/*][/list]
[i]Hey all, GM Quuku here from the Quality Assurance team!

You may have noticed that we've done some Spring Cleaning as of late- we've been correcting more older bugs in each of our patches, and trying to hit newly released bugs as soon as they crop up.

If you'd cast your eyes below, you'll notice that our Known Bugs list has shrunk. We want to shift this from an incomplete backlog of our bugs into a parseable list that contains the largest, newest, and most relevant issues. We still have a (sizeable!) internal backlog that we're cruising through- these bugs haven't just gone away. Our team is dedicated to bringing you a quality play experience, and working through all bugs (new and old) in this distinguished game we play is one of our goals.

Many Milletians have been extremely kind in assisting us in squashing these issues as well, thank you so much for your support and patience. If you spot an issue, feel more than welcomed to report it to us via the official [url=https://discord.gg/mabinogi]Mabinogi Discord[/url]![/i]

[b]The following changes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]Players will now have more time during the G23 Card Flip minigame. [/*][*]Blaanid's Song "Where Memories Come Together" during Memoir Book 2 now properly plays. Yay Blaanid![/*][*]The Set Item name for Movement Speed Increase has been modified to differentiate the movement speed types.[list][*]Eweca Movement Speed Increase [list][*]Example: Items such as Fleet Feet or Shooting Star shoes. [/*][/list][/*][*]Ladeca Movement Speed Increase[list][*]Example: Items such as Abyss Dragon Armor or Imperial Knight Boots.
[/*][/list][/*][*]Eweca and Ladeca Movement Speed Increase effects can be applied to the character at the same time.
Note: At least 10 points of a set item effect must be equipped to activate the effect. Equipped items that exceed 10 points of a set item effect will not grant additional effects. Additionally, the highest value of a set effect type is applied to the character.[/*][/list][/*][*]Revised several in-game BGM song titles to accurately reflect the songs and their details.[/*][/list]
[b]The following bug fixes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]Fixed an issue where players experienced extreme instances of increasing in-game lag after maintenances.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where players experienced extreme instances of increasing login lag after maintenances.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where the G10 quest "Prophecy of Irinid" would fail to start from the Crystal Ball.[/*][*]Fixed a few minor graphic issues with the following items:[list][*]Dragon Guardian Shoes[/*][*]Special / Imperial Commander Uniforms (M)[/*][*]Special Casual Tech Chic Outfits (M)(F).[/*][/list][/*][*]The map and region name for Gairech Hills have been properly translated.[/*][*]Fixed an issue causing the Daily Messages from specific Support Puppets to not display.[/*][*]The Space Cadet pet skill text for "Cleansing Dust" will now display correctly when the pet is unsummoned.[/*][*]Corrected the Set Item descriptions for the following set bonuses: 
[list][*]Troubadour[/*][*]Demolition[/*][*]Ruination[/*][*]Perseus[/*][*]Elemental Harmony[/*][*]Forest Ranger[/*][/list][/*][*]Found a rare issue where Cliona would only sell four items, instead of the expected five, during the Tara Auction.[/*][*]Sheared a looming timer on the Cotton Candy Sheep (Aspiring to TRUE STRENGTH!) description. [list][*]A f-ewe other edits were made as well, worthy of sheeps of praise. Mutton's gonna stop us now! We're on the lamb! We can-dy this all day, we have a cot-ton of these![/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]The following are known bugs:[/b]
[list][*]If you try to change your style to an appearance already saved in a Beauty Slot, it will say it failed.[/*][*]Guilds are not appearing in the Guild List.[/*][*]During the Master Plan event, when you first open the Master Plan Inventory, it will incorrectly show as locked. Closing and reopening the inventory will fix the issue.[/*][*]A rare issue has been reported where raids do not spawn correctly on certain channels.[/*][*]There is an issue where one-time/limited item cannot be purchased from the in-game shop, but can be on the web-shop.[/*][*]Shop items with expiration times start counting down upon the player logging in or changing channels, rather than having their count down start when the item is purchased.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Mabinogi 64-bit Client Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q3/2686/200922_announcement_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg[/img]

Hello Milletians!

In an upcoming maintenance, we will be implementing our [b]64-bit Client Update[/b]. We highly recommend that you update your Mabinogi game clients, but this [b]does not require a full[/b][b] re-install of the game[/b] when upgrading to the 64-bit Client.

With the February update, Mabinogi's game client will be upgraded to 64-bit, enabling improved performance on modern systems and to help us support Mabinogi long into the future. As part of this update, [b]Mabinogi will no longer be playable on 32-bit (x86) operating systems[/b].
[h2][b]Why Upgrade to a 64-bit Game Client?[/b][/h2]
Mabinogi on 32-bit was limited in its memory usage, depending on the needs of the operating system. With the change to 64-bit, it will allow the Mabinogi client to use more memory and improve client performance in various memory-intensive situations. It has been a recurring issue that any Mabinogi client exceeding more than 4GB of memory during normal gameplay would result in memory allocation failure, ultimately resulting in client crashes. In order to avoid such problems, the transition to 64-bit client may improve overall service quality. 

While the 64-bit client will improve some client performance issues, please keep in mind that it will not resolve every issue you may have encountered previously.
[h2][b]How can I learn what Operating System I have?[/b][/h2]
If you are unsure of what sort of operating system you have running on your PC, you can find out in the "About Your PC" System Setting page:
[list][*]Use the Windows key to bring up the Start Menu, and click on the Gear icon to open up the settings.[/*][*]Under "System" menu, select "About" at the bottom of the sidebar.[/*][*]Look under "System type", which will tell you which type of operating system and processor you have.[/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1531/about-windows-64-bit-operating-system.png[/img]

It should show one of three possible options:
[list][*][b]64-bit [/b]operating system, [b]x64-based [/b]processor: No changes required, your computer is already set-up and good to go![/*][*][b]32-bit [/b]operating system, [b]x64-based [/b]processor: Your computer's operating system is still 32-bit, however your system's processor is able to support a 64-bit operating system. In order to play Mabinogi after the update, you will need to upgrade your operating system to a 64-bit version.[/*][*][b]32-bit [/b]operating system, [b]x86-based [/b]processor: Unfortunately, your computer is not able to support a 64-bit operating system, and will not be able to run Mabinogi after this update.[/*][/list][h2][b]Updated Sound Library[/b][/h2]
Finally, with the future update, Mabinogi's [b]sound library[/b] will also be updated. The sound library (MSS) used in the existing 32-bit client will be replaced with FMOD. When it came to the previous sound library, it was difficult to provide a stable environment when loading high-quality sound sources or loading sound sources of multiple instruments at once. As a result, the addition of an updated sound library will further reinforce "sound", one of the indispensable facets of Mabinogi. We will continue to strive to provide audio content that will satisfy all Milletians in the future.

Thank you for your continued support and patience!

- The Mabinogi Team

notes.title: Masterpiece Chapter 6 and 7 Update
notes.notes:
[h2][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q1/1117/230106_januaryupdate_socials_newsarticleheader_940x290.png[/img][/h2][h2][b]Update Details[/b][/h2][list][*][b]Chapter 6: The Divine Knights[/b] and [b]Chapter 7: Apocalypse[/b] generations can now be replayed.[list][*]If you have played all of[b] G19 The Divine Knights, G20 The Gate of Sanctuary, and G21 The Guardian's Path[/b], you can start the replay for the Chapter 6 Generations.[list][*]You can obtain the C6 Replay Reward Box by completing the replay.[/*][/list][/*][*]If you have played all of[b] G22 Apocalypse, G23 Tempest, G24 Ascension, and G25 Eclipse[/b], you can start the replay for the Chapter 7 Generations.[list][*]You can obtain the C7 Replay Reward Box by completing the replay.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]You can replay a completed Generation by clicking the Start Replay button belonging to that generation and chapter in the Storyline menu.[/*][*]Only one replay can be played through one Generation at a time.[/*][*]While replaying a Generation, some NPCs may not be available or it may be difficult to enter or move to certain areas. Upon completion or forfeiting of the replay, NPCs are normally visible again and you can enter certain areas.[/*][*]You cannot start a replay from the middle of a Generation.[/*][*]If you forfeit a replay or start a replay of another generation while a replay is in progress then, all replay progress of the generation will be reset.[/*][*]If the daily replay count limit has been reached for the part, the replay progress for Chapter 6 and Chapter 7 will be saved and you can start from the next part the next day.[/*][*]During replay, there is no delay in accepting quests, and it has been improved that the next quest will be received immediately.[/*][*]Replay quest has been improved to receive quests while indoors.[/*][*]Quests given between Generations Part 1 and Part 2 that are not related to the story have been excluded from Replay.[/*][*]Optional titles can be collected through repeated replays.[/*][*]Completing Chapter 6 and Chapter 7 replays will award [b][url=#c6replayrewards]C6 Replay Reward Box[/url][/b] and [url=#c7replayrewards][b]C7 Replay Reward Box:[/b][/url][list][*]Opening the box will reward a chance to receive a variety of items such as new C6/C7 Homestead Housing decorations, and unlock one BGM for the Homestead Jukebox.[list][*]The acquired BGM will be one that you have not yet unlocked.[/*][/list][/*][*]Balloons obtained from the replay reward box cannot be traded.[/*][/list][/*][*]Replay starting conditions require all chapters of a Generation to be completed.
[list][*]Example: To replay G1, you must have completed Chapter 1 by clearing all of G1, G2, and G3.[/*][*]If you are currently replaying G1, G2, or G3, the replay progress will be reset upon logging in after the update. You will receive one C1 Replay Reward Box and 3,000 gold by mail.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]The number of replay episodes that can be started per day has been changed from 5 to 7.[/b][/*][*]Improvements to existing Chapter 6: The Divine Knights and Chapter 7: Apocalypse are as follows:[list][*]When progressing through a generation in Chapter 6, optional dialogue will be presented even when talking to a character outside of the quest progression order.[/*][/list][/*][*]Completing all the Generations in Chapter 6 and Chapter 7 will permanently add NPCs in Avalon.[list][*]After the update, you will need to complete the Generations for Chapter 6 and Chapter 7 for the first time or complete a replay once.[list][*]Even if you have cleared all previous Generations for Chapter 6 and 7, you must complete a replay for any belonging to the chapter at least once to encounter the NPCs.[/*][/list][/*][*]Depending on the day of the week, the NPCs that are available will be split amongst the days; however, they won’t appear on Saturday.[/*][*]You cannot meet them during the replay though they will appear normally again when replay is completed or forfeited.[/*][*]In the case of NPCs that can be met in the sanctuary, they will appear or disappear normally only after entering the sanctuary once, even on the specified day of the week.[/*][/list][/*][*]Improvements have been made so that you can present some items to the permanent NPCs you can meet at the entrance of Tech Duinn.[/*][*]Travel Diary conversation keywords for some NPCs will be modified or added.
[list][*]Upon clearing G19, keywords for Altam or Avelin are acquired. 
[list][*]This does not apply if you have previously cleared G20 and possessed the keyword and possession history remains.[/*][/list][/*][*]Upon clearing G20, keywords for Caswyn or Pihne are acquired.[/*][*]Upon clearing G21, keywords for Talvish or Llywelyn are acquired.[/*][*]After the update, you can learn the keywords when you complete each generation first and the replay.[list][*]For those that have previously cleared all Generations, you must complete each Generation through replay at least once to obtain the keywords.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]For some NPCs, special dialogues that are only displayed during replays will be added.[/*][*]For some NPCs, reaction dialogue lines when wearing specific outfits are added.[/*][*]The description of Port Ceann in some generations will be modified to match the situation after the Great Era of Commerce update.[/*][*]Many typos and awkward expressions throughout the G19, G20, G21, G22, G23, G24, and G25 storyline have been corrected.[/*][*]A number of situations in which conversations with an NPC are impossible due to the storyline dialogue have been improved.[/*][*]Camera direction has been changed to the following missions within G19, G20, and G21.[list][*]G19: “Incidental Inevitability,” “The Wolf and the Man,” “Things with Wings,” “Shattered Trust,” and “Do or Die”[/*][*]G20: “Graveyard Night,” “Grave Keeper 1,” “Any Way the Wind Blows,” “A Knight’s Musings,” “Circle of Damnation,” and “Clashing Blades 1”[/*][*]G21: “First Communication,” “Second Communication,” “Third Communication,” “Sixth Communication,” “Colossal Enemy by the Shore,” “Ambush,” “Seventh Communication,” “Avelin’s Nightmare,” “Gravebound,” “Sanctuary Erg,” “The Keeper of the Gate,” “That Which Remains,” “Twilight, Moonlight, Starlight,” “Winds of Madness,” and “Guardians”[/*][/list][/*][*]In G20, issues have been fixed where the change in the NPC’s relationship and emotional lines were inconsistent.
[list][*]If you don’t select a speech option when offered to accompany Altam in the Budding Beginning quest, it will increase Avelin’s favorability instead of Altam.[/*][*]If you ask the reason for Pihne’s request in the quest Circle of Damnation, Caswyn’s favorability will drop instead of increasing.[/*][*]If you interrupt Pihne’s conversation in the quest Forward Progress, it will decrease Talvish’s favorability instead of Pihne’s.[/*][/list][/*][*]The balance for some of the G21 story missions has been modified.[list][*]When using the item “Prayer of Protection” in the shadow mission “Twilight, Moonlight, Starlight”, the duration of the protection effect is increased.[/*][*]In the shadow mission "Guardians”, the boss has been modified so that it does not attack while dialogue is in progress. If the boss’ HP is reduced to 80%, the boss becomes invincible until entering phase 2 of the fight.[/*][/list][/*][*]The appearance of characters in some G22 cutscenes has been changed.[/*][*]In G24, information for “Things That Go Bump in the Night“ has been changed to include more details under the Story Guide.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where Enya and Etain’s gloves were displayed incorrectly when playing G25 RP Missions or using Transformation Medals.[/*][*]The G25 Storyline start method has changed.[list][*]If you select “Start G25 Eclipse” in the Storyline Menu, the related cutscene will play and you will immediately enter the story mission.[/*][*]This has changed so that you can proceed with the first quest regardless of whether or not you have cleared the first story mission to enter.[/*][/list][/*][*]20 new BGM themes have been added to the Jukebox.[/*][/list][h2][b][b]C6/C7 Replay Reward Boxes[/b][/b][/h2][list][*]When you complete a Generation Replay for C6 and C7, you will receive a [b]C6 Replay Reward Box [/b]and [b]C7 Replay Reward Box[/b] respectively.[/*][*]Opening the box will reward one item from the following droplist, and unlock one BGM for the Homestead Jukebox.
[list][*]The acquired BGM will be one that you have not yet unlocked.[/*][*]Both C6 and C7 Replay Boxes have the possibility of dropping Mini-Gems/Mini-Gem Selection Boxes, and Balloons! [/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q1/1396/c6c7rewards.png[/img]
