When a visiting character visits the Homestead, the Today and Total Count accumulates normally.[/*][*]The available upgrades in the Item Upgrade may overlap in the UI if the window is increased.[/*][*]Homestead Anvils and Furnaces have settings to allow visitors to use them, but do not actually restrict the use of the items.[/*][*]There is a slight graphical error where part of the hose is missing when a William or Butler Partner uses the Water Hose gesture.[/*][*]Some Partner gestures that have them holding a weapon will appear as though the weapon is disconnected and floating.[/*][*]There are Partner gestures that do not activate when a Partner has something equipped in their left hand.[/*][*]There is an issue after using the Thunder skill, the character can't charge Thunder again until after the Thunder bolt hits/damages enemies.[/*][*]If you try to change your style to an appearance already saved in a Beauty Slot, it will say it failed.[/*][*]There is a minor visual issue with the Beauty Slot text if you scroll up and down after expanding the Beauty Slot.[/*][*]The outline color when clicking on an empty Beauty Slot is incorrect.[/*][*]There is text cut-off in the Buy Item UI when buying the Royal Society Appreciation Box from Melwyn.[/*][*]The inventory image for the Mace of Mercy is incorrect.[/*][*]Feeding a Pet Instructor Stick to a Level 100 Spirit weapon will cause the character to freeze.[/*][*]If you had a unicode heart on your wedding ring, the heart appears as a question mark.[/*][*]The Shaggy Perm hairstyle can be saved in a Beauty Slot.[/*][*]Cobweb Mummy enemies do not appear in the Alby Advanced Dungeon.[/*][*]Guilds are not appearing in the Guild List.[/*][*]When you first open the Master Plan Inventory, it will incorrectly show as locked. Closing and reopening the inventory will fix the issue.[/*][*]There is a minor graphical issue with the Special Shining Stage Concert Costume (M) when the character equipped with the outfit is running.[/*][*]Scathach's hands do not match her skin color.[/*][*]The Tail Chasers mini-game in Festia is currently inaccessible.[/*][*]A character's neck will become detached from their body when wearing the Mysterious Thief outfit.[/*][*]Guild stones can be placed very close to each other.[/*][*]Several menus and buttons in the Production Crafting Diary have text that is cut-off or is overlapping.[/*][*]The Journal Achievement for completing 1000 crafts incorrectly states "100" crafts.>[/*][*]A few Weaving crafting recipes are incorrectly labeled:[/*][list][*]Common Fabric: Make Fabric (Normal) -> Make Fabric (Common)[/*][*]Silk -> Cheap Silk[/*][*]Common Silk: Make Silk (Normal) -> Make Silk (Common)[/*][*]The material for crafting Ice Silk is incorrect; Cold Thread -> Frost Thread[/*][/list][*]The issue regarding Sewing Patterns and Blacksmith Manuals not having any data is still being investigated.[/*][*]Special Small Draconian Wings (3 types) and Coupon can be found in the Auction House, but these items won't be available when the other wings are released.[/*][list][*]They will be released under a different name, the Special Forgotten Draconian Wings (3 types).[/*][*]The Special Small Draconian Wings have a Dressing Room entry, while Special Forgotten Draconian Wings do not have a Dressing Room entry.[/*][/list][/list]

notes.title: Renovation Season 3: Dual Guns, Ninja, and Puppetry Talent Changes
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Gunslinger
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1715/dualguns.png[/img]
[/b][/h2]
[b]System Changes[/b]
[list][*]The stat calculation for determining damage while using Dual Guns has been changed.[list][*][b]Before:[/b][list][*]For every 6 Strength and 6 Intelligence, Minimum Damage is increased by 1.[/*][*]For every 5 Strength and 6 Intelligence, Maximum Damage is increased by 1.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]After:[/b][list][*]For every 5 Strength and 5 Intelligence, Minimum Damage is increased by 1.[/*][*]For every 4 Strength and 4 Intelligence, Maximum Damage is increased by 1.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The stun duration has been increased based on the weapon's Attack Speed and hit count.[list][*]The stun time is adjusted to 1 second or more, varying according to Attack Speed and number of hits.[/*][*]Weapons with fewer hits compared to their Attack Speed have a longer stun time.[/*][/list][/*][*]The description of certain Spirit Enhancement attributes have been changed:[list][*][b]Awakening Attack Enhancement[/b][list][*][b]Example: [/b]At Skill Level 1 - Spirit Dual Gun Awakening Damage +150% has been changed to Spirit Dual Gun Awakening Damage Multiplier +150%[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Awakening Range Enhancement[/b][list][*][b]Example: [/b]At Skill Level 1 - Spirit Dual Gun Awakening Attack Range +50cm has been changed to Spirit Dual Gun Awakening Attack Area Radius +50cm[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Skill Changes[/b]
[list][*]For each updated skill, the skill info and description has been updated to reflect changes.[/*][/list]
[u][b]Flash Launcher[/b][/u]

[u][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1706/mabinogi-renovations3-flash-launcher.gif[/img][/b][/u]
[list][*]Flash Launcher has been changed to a skill with ranged attack properties so you can attack from a distance.[/*][*]The skill casting time has been greatly reduced.[/*][*]The damage for each Rank has been increased.[list][*][b]Example: [/b]Based on Dan Rank 3 of the skill:[list][*][b]Before: [/b]950% Damage[/*][*][b]After: [/b]1300% Damage[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[u][b]Bullet Storm[/b][/u]

[u][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1705/mabinogi-renovations3-bullet-storm.gif[/img][/b][/u]
[list][*]The attack method of Bullet Storm has been changed so that it fires a set number of bullets at enemies within a certain range.[list][*]The more enemies there are within the skill casting range, the more powerful the attack. If there is only one enemy, all bullets are concentrated in one place.[/*][/list][/*][*]When the Technique Seal: Pragarah is activated, the Magic Defense and Protection of the target are reduced according to the number of Bullet Storm hits.[/*][*]The Mana Bullet consumption amount is fixed by Rank.[list][*][b]Example: [/b]Based on Rank 1 of the skill - 24 Mana Bullets[/*][/list][/*][*]The maximum number of targets per Rank has been changed:[list][*][b]Example: [/b]Based on Rank 1 of the skill - 9 maximum targets[/*][/list][/*][*]The skill's attack range has been expanded.[/*][*]Skill casting time has been reduced.[/*][*]The knockback distance of the target has been reduced.[/*][*]A basic damage multiplier per bullet has been added to each skill Rank.[list][*][b]Example: [/b]Based on Rank 1 of the skill - 50% per bullet[/*][/list][/*][*]The damage multiplier per additional target has been adjusted from 2 or more targets.[list][*][b]Example: [/b]Based on Rank 1 of the skill:[list][*][b]Before: [/b]120% damage[/*][*][b]After: [/b]60% damage[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The final damage multiplier is now determined by adding up the base damage multiplier and the damage multiplier that increases per target.
[list][*][b]Example: [/b]Based on Rank 1 of the skill:[list][*]For 3 targets: 50% + (60% *2) = 170% Damage[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The maximum damage limit has been adjusted per bullet and is applied at a fixed amount.[list][*][b]Example: [/b]Based on Rank 1 of the skill - 400% Damage[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[u][b]Grapple Shot[/b][/u]

[u][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1707/mabinogi-renovations3-grapple-shot.gif[/img][/b][/u]
[list][*]Grapple Shot has been changed so you can now use the skill by directly clicking on the ground where you want to move.[/*][*]When you arrive at the targeted location, damage is inflicted to enemies near the targeted location within a certain radius.[/*][*]The skill has been modified so that you no longer get hit for a short time while moving, similar to Chain Slash's Anchor Rush skill.[/*][*]The skill cooldown has been reduced for skill Ranks Novice to Rank 2. Rank 1 remains unchanged at 10 seconds.[list][*][b]Example: [/b]Based on Rank Novice of the skill:[list][*][b]Before: [/b]16 seconds[/*][*][b]After: [/b]13 seconds[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The damage for each Rank has been increased.[list][*][b]Example: [/b]Based on Rank 1 of the skill:[list][*][b]Before: [/b]200% damage[/*][*][b]After: [/b]400% damage[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[u][b]Bullet Slide[/b][/u]

[u][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1710/mabinogi-renovations3-bullet-slide.gif[/img][/b][/u]
[list][*]Bullet Slide has been changed so that regardless of the number of attacks, the target's defense and protection are only applied once.[/*][*]The skill's casting range has been increased to a range similar to that of a normal attack.[/*][*]Skill casting time has been greatly reduced.[/*][*]The knockback distance of the target has been reduced.[/*][*]The damage for each Rank has been increased.[list][*][b]Example: [/b]Based on Rank 1 of the skill:[list][*][b]Before: [/b]250% Damage[/*][*][b]After: [/b]1200% Damage[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Skill motion can no longer canceled with the ESC key.[/*][/list]
[u][b]Shooting Rush[/b][/u]

[u][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1709/mabinogi-renovations3-shooting-rush.gif[/img][/b][/u]
[list][*]Shooting Rush has been changed so that regardless of the number of attacks, the target's defense and protection are only applied once.[/*][*]The skill will be cast in the direction of the location selected by the cursor, regardless of the direction the character is facing when attacking.[/*][*]The enemy will be knocked back according to the direction of the skill attack.[/*][*]Skill casting time has been slightly reduced.[/*][*]The knockback distance of the target has been reduced.[/*][*]The damage for each Rank has been increased.[list][*][b]Example: [/b]Based on Dan Rank 3 of the skill:[list][*][b]Before: [/b]520% Damage[/*][*][b]After: [/b]600% Damage[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[u][b]Reload[/b][/u]
[list][*]Reload has been changed so that the skill is not canceled even if you are attacked by an enemy while casting the skill.[/*][*]The skill is only canceled if you are knocked down or die while reloading.[/*][/list]
[u][b]Way of the Gun[/b][/u]
[list][*]Bonus Damage has been added to all Ranks of Way of the Gun.[list][*][b]Example: [/b]Based on Rank 1 of the skill - 15% Damage[/*][/list][/*][*]Bonus Damage will also be provided to other Gunslinger skills while Way of the Gun is activated.[/*][/list]
[h2][b]Ninja
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1714/ninja.png[/img]
[/b][/h2]
[b]System Changes[/b]
[list][*]The damage calculation method for Ninja skills have been changed. The way of applying the target's defense and protection values has been changed to match that of other talent skills. The damage multiplier of the skill is applied first before the enemy's defense and protection reduces the damage.[/*][*]The stun duration has been increased based on the weapon's Attack Speed and hit count.[list][*]The stun time has been adjusted to 1 second or more, varying according to Attack Speed and number of hits.[/*][*]Weapons with fewer hits compared to their Attack Speed have a longer stun time.[/*][/list][/*][*]Evasion based on an enemy's Luck stats will no longer occur.[/*][*]The description of certain Spirit Enhancement attributes have been changed: 
[list][*][b]Awakening Attack Enhancement[/b]
[list][*][b]Example:[/b] At Skill Level 1 - Spirit Shuriken Awakening Damage +150% has been changed to Spirit Shuriken Awakening Damage Multiplier +150%[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Awakening Range Enhancement[/b]
[list][*][b]Example:[/b] At Skill Level 1 - Spirit Shuriken Awakening Attack Range +50cm has been changed to Spirit Shuriken Awakening Attack Range Radius +50cm[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Skill Changes[/b]
[list][*]For each updated skill, the skill info and description has been updated to reflect changes.[/*][/list]
[u][b]Explosive Kunai[/b][/u]

[u][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1708/mabinogi-renovations3-explosive-kunai.gif[/img][/b][/u]
[list][*]Skill activation time has been slightly reduced.[/*][*]The method of triggering the skill's explosive attack has been changed.[list][*]When an enemy steps on the explosive kunai, all kunai explode at the same time.[/*][*]All enemies in a 3m area around each kunai that explodes will take damage.[/*][/list][/*][*]Depending on the location, one enemy may receive damage multiple times.[/*][*]Enemies caught in the explosion are stunned for 3 seconds, and at the same time, the target's movement speed is decreased for 6 seconds.[/*][*]The damage for each Rank is increased.[list][*][b]Example: [/b]Based on Rank 1 of the skill:[list][*][b]Before: [/b]200% Damage[/*][*][b]After: [/b]300% Damage[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[u][b]Shuriken Charge[/b][/u]

[u][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1711/mabinogi-renovations3-shuriken-charge.gif[/img][/b][/u]
[list][*]Shuriken Charge has been changed so that you no longer have to charge the skill. Instead, the attack hits at full damage when the skill is used on an enemy.[/*][*]The previous animation that played when charging the skill is now played while you have the skill activated.[/*][*]You can now move your character while the skill is activated.[/*][*]You can also cancel the skill using the ESC key or by clicking on the skill balloon.[/*][*]Splash damage now always occurs when the skill is used on an enemy within 2m, and the same damage multiplier as the selected target is applied.[/*][*]The damage for the skill has been changed to be a fixed amount at each skill rank instead of requiring it to be fully charged for the full skill damage.[list][*][b]Example: [/b]Based on Dan Rank 3 of the skill - 690% Damage[/*][/list][/*][*]The "Successfully use a fully charged attack" training requirement for Rank A and higher skill ranks, has been changed to "Defeat an enemy with Shuriken Charge".[/*][/list]
[u][b]Shadow Bind[/b][/u]

[u][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1712/mabinogi-renovations3-shadow-bind.gif[/img][/b][/u]
[list][*]Shadow Bind has been changed so that binding an enemy persists while you are using the skill, keeping your character in place as you bind.[/*][*]A max binding duration has been added.[list][*][b]Example: [/b]Based on Rank 1 of the skill - 20 seconds[/*][/list][/*][*]The continuous binding can be stopped by canceling the use of the skill. It will also be stopped if you are stunned or knocked back due to an enemy's attack.[/*][*]Even if the skill use is completed or canceled, an additional binding time is applied to the target.[list][*][b]Example: [/b]Based on Rank 1 of the skill - 5.5 seconds[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[u][b]Shadow[/b][b] Cloak[/b][/u]
[list][*]A bonus damage effect has been added for Ninja skills used while Shadow Cloak is active.[list][*][b]Example: [/b]Based on Rank 1 of the skill - 10% Bonus Damage[/*][/list][/*][*]The skill duration has been increased to 10 seconds.[/*][*]The damage of the skill's Tornado attack has been increased.[list][*][b]Example: [/b]Based on Rank 1 of the skill:[list][*][b]Before: [/b]120% Damage[/*][*][b]After: [/b]300% Damage[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[u][b]Smokescreen[/b][/u]
[list][*]Smokescreen has been changed so that it now reduces the target's Magic Defense and Magic Protection. The reduction is the same as the Defense/Protection reduction.[/*][*]The smoke effect of the skill will now disappear naturally.[/*][/list]
[u][b]Kunai Storm[/b][/u]
[list][*]Damage for Kunai Storm has not been changed, however the skill description for each Rank has been changed to the damage amount rather than the damage multiplier.[list][*][b]Example: [/b]Based on Dan Rank 3 of the skill:[list][*][b]Before: [/b] +460% Damage[/*][*][b]After: [/b]560% Damage[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[u][b]Sakura Abyss[/b][/u]
[list][*]Sakura Abyss has not been changed, however the skill description for each Rank has been updated to include more information.[/*][/list][h2][b]Puppetry
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1713/puppetry.png[/img]
[/b][/h2]
 [b]System Changes[/b]
[list][*]The damage calculation method for Puppetry skills has been changed. The way of applying the target's defense and protection values has been changed to match that of other talent skills. The damage multiplier of the skill is applied first before the enemy's defense and protection reduces the damage. [/*][*]The description of certain Spirit Enhancement attributes have been changed:[list][*][b]Awakening Attack Enhancement[/b][list][*][b]Example: [/b]At Skill Level 1 - Spirit Control Bar Awakening Damage +150% has been changed to Spirit Control Bar Awakening Damage Multiplier +150%[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Awakening Range Enhancement[/b][list][*][b]Example: [/b]At Skill Level 1 - Spirit Control Bar Awakening Attack Range +50cm has been change to Spirit Control Bar Awakening Attack Area Radius +50cm[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The formula that applies the increased Marionette Damage from the Spirit Enhancement Attack effect "Spirit Training" has been changed. Damage is now increased when using a Spirit.[/*][*]The "Marionette Critical Damage" set effect has been changed.[list][*][b]Before: [/b]Increases Marionette's Critical Damage by 40%[/*][*][b]After: [/b]Increases the Marionette's Critical Damage multiplier by 80% when a Critical hit occurs.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Skill Changes[/b]
[list][*]For each updated skill, the skill info and description has been updated to reflect the changes.[/*][*]The following skills have not been changed, however the Skill Info has been slightly updated:[list][*][b]Act 1: Inciting Incident[/b][/*][*][b]Act 4: Rising Action[/b][/*][*][b]Act 6: Crisis[/b][/*][*][b]Act 7: Climactic Crash[/b][/*][*][b]Wire Pull[/b][/*][*][b]Puppet's Snare[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[u][b]Control Marionette[/b][/u]
[list][*]The Marionette will now gain 70% of the Puppeteer's Armor Pierce and Piercing Level.[/*][/list]
[u][b]Act 2: Threshold Cutter[/b][/u]
[list][*]The Combo Card damage bonus has been changed. It will now be applied to the 1st, 2nd, and 3rd consecutive hits while using the skill.[/*][*]Additional information has been added to the skill info and description.[/*][/list]
[u][b]Act 9: Invigorating Encore[/b][/u]
[list][*]While using Act 9: Invigorating Encore, the Marionette's Defense, Magic Defense, Protection, and Magic Protection is increased. Bonus damage is also applied when the Marionette attacks.[list][*][b]Example: [/b]Based on Rank 1 of the skill[list][*]Marionette Attack Bonus Damage +10%[/*][*]Defense, Magic Defense Increase: +580[/*][*]Protection, Magic Protection Increase +80[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The skill effect is maintained, even if the Marionette dies and is resurrected or if the summon is canceled and re-summoned. The skill effect will continue to be applied to the Marionette for the remaining effect duration.[/*][*]The skill's activation time has been reduced.[/*][/list]

[h2][b]Additional Content Changes[/b][/h2][list][*] Some content and NPC dialogue of the following tutorial missions have been changed to match the talent changes:[list][*]Intro Gun Training[/*][*]Intro Gun Training: Movement Skills[/*][*]Intro Gun Training: Ranged Attack Skills[/*][*]Try Talents[/*][*]Continue to Try Talents[/*][*]Learn Shuriken Charge[/*][/list][/*][*]The following NPC's Gunslinger and Ninja talent skill Ranks will be lowered and their AI has been changed:[list][*][b]Enemy NPCs[/b][list][*]Cessair's Heart in the following missions:[list][*]Heart Awakening Mission[/*][*]Fading Pulse Mission[/*][*]Into Battle Mission[/*][*]Cave of Trials Mission[/*][/list][/*][*]Llywelyn in the following mission:[list][*]Fading Pulse Mission[/*][/list][/*][*]Llywelyn's Thoughts in the following mission:[list][*]Alban Knights Training Grounds Mission[/*][/list][/*][*]Succubus Fiend in the following mission:[list][*]Rabbie Phantasm Dungeon[/*][*]Rabbie Phantasm Mirror World Dungeon[/*][/list][/*][*]Disciple, Dark Disciple, and Melci Diafol in the following dungeon:[list][*]Crom Bás Dungeon[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][b]Ally NPCs[/b]
[list][*]Treasure Hunter[/*][*]Llywelyn[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The attribute option text has been changed slightly for certain content to reflect the talent changes.[list][*]Only the name of the option has been changed. The content, appearance, and probability are unchanged.[/*][*]This affects certain descriptions for Reforging and Echostone attributes, Glyphwrighting stats, Erg stats, and the Skill Master titles related to Gunslinger, Ninja, and Puppetry.[/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Gold Renewal Update
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Gold Update[/b][/h2]
Improvements to the Gold currency system have been made!
[list][*]Gold no longer occupies inventory space. It is now stored in your main inventory as a currency amount, similar to Ducats.[/*][*]All Gold stored in your inventory in the form of Gold, Gold Pouches, and Gold Boxes has been changed to the value amount of Gold you have.[list][*][b]Immediately after the update, your Gold amount may exceed the maximum Gold storage limit.[/b] You will be unable to obtain Gold until you store the amount you have in the Bank or in a Pet's inventory.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1733/mabinogi-gold-amount-of-gold.png[/img]
[list][*]The maximum Gold limit that each character, Pet, or Partner character can store is 1,000,000 Gold (1 Million).[/*][*]A character's maximum Gold limit can be increased by an additional 1 Million Gold when the character achieves cumulative level 10,000. [list][*]This is not applicable to Pets/Partners.[/*][*]Characters who have already reached cumulative level 10,000 or higher will have their maximum Gold limit increased the first time they log in after the update.[/*][/list][/*][*]The maximum Gold limit can be increased further up to 100,000,000 Gold (100 Million).[list][*]Gold Box items have been changed to a consumption item that increased the maximum Gold limit for the character that consumes it.[/*][*]When using Lorna or Pan's Gold Box, the limit is increased by 50,000 Gold.[/*][*]When using Lorna, Pan, or Blaanid's Special Gold Box, the limit is increased by 100,000 Gold.[/*][*][b]Important Notes[/b][list][*]Pet and Partner gold limit cannot be increased.[/*][*]The Gold Box Upgrade Coupon items function as usual to upgrade a Gold Box to the Special version.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]If you obtain Gold that exceeds your character's carrying capacity, the excess amount will fall to the floor.[/*][*]If the total amount of Gold you are holding reaches the maximum limit, you can no longer pick up Gold.[/*][*]When selling items at an NPC shop, you cannot sell any items if the sale price exceeds your maximum Gold limit.[/*][*]Gold can be exchanged through the [b]Give [/b]and [b]Claim[/b] buttons in a Pet's or Partner's inventory.[list][*][b]Give [/b]can be used to store Gold in a Pet/Partner's inventory, up to 1,000,000 Gold (1 Million).[list][*]You can also pick up Gold and transfer them directly.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Claim[/b] can be used to withdraw and receive the Gold amount to your character's inventory.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1732/mabinogi-gold-give-gold.png[/img]
[list][*]Gold now stacks to 50,000 when picked up from the character's inventory or when obtained from certain content.[list][*][b]Example: [/b]Gold dropped from a Dungeon End Chest will now be dropped as a Gold stack instead of a Big Gold Pouch.[/*][/list][/*][*]Gold can be divided and picked up from a character's inventory by clicking on the Gold button in the main inventory.[list][*]50,000 Gold is the maximum amount that can be picked up.[/*][*]You can drop Gold on the ground or give them to NPCs this way.[/*][*]If you put the Gold back into your inventory, it will return your Gold value.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1731/mabinogi-gold-pick-up-gold.png[/img]
[list][*]When Trading (including Trading during Pet battles), the Gold button can be clicked to select the amount of Gold you wish to trade.[list][*]A maximum of 1,000,000 Gold (1 Million) can be traded at once through this method.[/*][*]Checks can be traded as normal and the total value of Gold being traded will be shown as the cumulative amount of Gold and Checks added to the trade.
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1730/mabinogi-gold-checks.png[/img]
[/*][*]If the trade recipient does not have enough room in their inventory to receive the Gold amount, Gold cannot be added to the trade window.[/*][*][b]Note: [/b]Gold cannot be picked up from the main inventory window while trading.[/*][/list][/*][*]If you attempt to withdraw Gold from the Bank and you have already reached the maximum Gold limit in your inventory, the Gold value will be shown as 0.[list][*]You are still able to issue a Check however.[/*][/list][/*][*]The "Gold" tag has been removed as a selection from the list of bag tags for Item Bag organization.[/*][*]The acquisition method for obtaining Gold from certain content has been changed to distribute Gold to your Gold value automatically.[list][*][b]Example: [/b]Raids, Alban Knights Training Grounds, Sidhe Finnachaid, certain quests, etc.[/*][/list][/*][*]Gold Pouches have been removed from the game.[list][*]The [b]Gold Pouch [/b]and [b]Big Gold Pouch [/b]items have been removed and you will no longer be able to obtain these items through NPC shops, quest rewards, Dungeon/Shadow Mission reward boxes, and monster drops.[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/74416/gold-pouch-removal]As previously announced[/url], this removal includes Gold Pouch items that have not been retrieved from the Auction House.[/*][*]After the update, any Gold stored in Gold Pouches that you own will be added to the Gold value for the character, Pet, or Partner who had the item.[list][*]The Gold value equal to the sales price value of the Gold Pouch (i.e. when sold to an NPC) will be added to your Gold amount automatically.[list][*]The sales price of a Gold Pouch is 880 Gold, and the sales price of the Big Gold Pouch is 4,900 Gold.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The way that the Small Gold Purse, Medium Gold Purse, and Large Gold Purse items function have been changed.[list][*][b]Before: [/b]Storage bag for Gold Pouches and Gold Boxes.[/*][*][b]After: [/b]Storage bag for items.[/*][/list][/*][*]The name of Gold Purses have been changed to Item Bag.[/*][*]The quest objective, NPC dialogue, and TIP have been changed for Blaanid's Brave Boost quest, "How to be a Prepared Milletian 1".[list][*]The quest objective that requires you to obtain an item from the General Shop has been changed from a Big Gold Pouch to a Medium Sized Bag (5x5).[/*][*]Blaanid's voice will not be available for this memoir.[/*][/list][/*][/list]

This item has also been moved to the General tab of the shop and can be purchased at the Trading Post Merchant Imp for 35,000 Ducats each.[/*][*]The [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/70689/netherlands-trade-limitations-update]Netherlands Trade Restrictions[/url] that were previously applied during the December patch have now been removed.[/*][/list]

We apologize for the inconvenience and we will continue investigating the issue.[/*][/list][/*][*]Unclaimed rewards from [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/71325/irusan-s-attendance-check-in]Irusan's Attendance Check-in[/url] event will be available in your Point Shop Inventory.[/*][*]The Blooming Roses 2nd Title will no longer appear as XML text in the title list.[/*][/list]

It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".[/*][*]Some players' hotkeys and pet menu settings reset after logging out.[/*][*]During the Kraken Rex boss fight, Kraken Rex will use an attack that will cause players to lose protection, semi-permanently, until they change channels or relog.[/*][*]There is a typo in the Finishing Materials list when crafting the Dustin Silver Knight Greaves.[/*][*]There is a known issue where some players are unable to obtain the G1 quest "Find Goro's Ring".[/*][*]There is an issue where certain G3 cutscenes will not play, but still charge gold.[/*][*]There is an issue where Homestead item information is overlapping.[/*][*]There is an issue where the Today Visitor Count does not reset to 0. When a visiting character visits the Homestead, the Today and Total Count accumulates normally.[/*][*]The available upgrades in the Item Upgrade may overlap in the UI if the window is increased.[/*][*]Homestead Anvils and Furnaces have settings to allow visitors to use them, but do not actually restrict the use of the items.[/*][*]There is a slight graphical error where part of the hose is missing when a William or Butler Partner uses the Water Hose gesture.[/*][*]Some Partner gestures that have them holding a weapon will appear as though the weapon is disconnected and floating.[/*][*]There are Partner gestures that do not activate when a Partner has something equipped in their left hand.[/*][*]There is an issue after using the Thunder skill, the character can't charge Thunder again until after the Thunder bolt hits/damages enemies.[/*][*]If you try to change your style to an appearance already saved in a Beauty Slot, it will say it failed.[/*][*]There is a minor visual issue with the Beauty Slot text if you scroll up and down after expanding the Beauty Slot.[/*][*]The outline color when clicking on an empty Beauty Slot is incorrect.[/*][*]There is text cut-off in the Buy Item UI when buying the Royal Society Appreciation Box from Melwyn.[/*][*]The inventory image for the Mace of Mercy is incorrect.[/*][*]Feeding a Pet Instructor Stick to a Level 100 Spirit weapon will cause the character to freeze.[/*][*]If you had a unicode heart on your wedding ring, the heart appears as a question mark.[/*][*]The Shaggy Perm hairstyle can be saved in a Beauty Slot.[/*][*]Cobweb Mummy enemies do not appear in the Alby Advanced Dungeon.[/*][*]Guilds are not appearing in the Guild List.[/*][*]When you first open the Master Plan Inventory, it will incorrectly show as locked. Closing and reopening the inventory will fix the issue.[/*][*]There is a minor graphical issue with the Special Shining Stage Concert Costume (M) when the character equipped with the outfit is running.[/*][*]Scathach's hands do not match her skin color.[/*][*]The Tail Chasers mini-game in Festia is currently inaccessible.[/*][*]A character's neck will become detached from their body when wearing the Mysterious Thief outfit.[/*][*]There is a chance that when logging off, you will not return to the character selection screen and will be kicked to the start menu with the error, "Server cannot be reached". This means you will need to shut down your game client and log in to the account again if you are attempting to switch characters.[/*][*]Guild stones can be placed very close to each other.

notes.title: RE:Life Update
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Production Crafting Diary[/b][/h2][list][*]The Production Crafting Diary has been added to the Collection Journal tab of the character information window.
[list][*]You can also set a hotkey shortcut for this menu in Options -> Game -> Control -> Hotkey Settings -> Crafting Diary.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1446/mabinogi-relife-production-crafting-diary.png[/img]
[list][*]You can view the production completion records for all items crafted for the following skills:[list][*][b]Tailoring[/b][/*][*][b]Weaving[/b][/*][*][b]Handicraft[/b][/*][*][b]Blacksmithing[/b][/*][*][b]Potion Making[/b][/*][*][b]Carpentry[/b][/*][*][b]Hillwen Engineering[/b][/*][*][b]Magic Craft[/b][/*][*][b]Stationery Crafting[/b][/*][*][b]Fynn Crafting[/b][/*][*][b]Refining[/b][/*][*][b]Milling[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]Any time an item is crafted, it is automatically collected in the Crafting Diary.[list][*][b]Note: [/b]Items made with Sewing Patterns and Manuals that can only be obtained from specific ways, such as part-time jobs or events/mainstreams quests, are excluded from the collection of the Crafting Diary.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1448/mabinogi-relife-production-crafting-diary-ui.png[/img]
[list][*]The Crafting Diary is divided into two sections; Collection Items and Achievements.[/*][*]When viewing an item from the [b]Collection Items[/b] tab:[list][*]You can view all craftable items that can be collected in the Crafting Diary and view the date you've first crafted an item.[list][*]You can sort by View All, Completed Items, or Uncompleted Items.[/*][/list][/*][*]You can view any related achievements that the item is associated with and your achievement progress. Clicking on a related achievement will bring up the achievement details.[list][*]Example: Crafting a Hairband fulfills the requirement for the achievement, "Novice Crafter - Tailoring".[/*][/list][/*][*]You can open the corresponding crafting menu by clicking on the hammer icon.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1444/mabinogi-relife-crafting-diary-achievements.png[/img]
[list][*]On the [b]Achievements[/b] tab, you can view items needed to complete each achievement.[list][*]If you craft all the items related to an achievement, you can obtain the [b]Completion Rewards[/b] for each achievement.[/*][*]You can only obtain the Completion Rewards once per crafting achievement.[/*][*]You only need to craft an item once for it to count towards all related achievements that require collecting the same item.[/*][*]You can obtain different item rewards when completing each achievement, such as crafting materials, Forgetful Potions, Training Potions, and more.[/*][*]The following rewards are new items that can be obtained from the Crafting Diary:[list][*][b]Crafting Quality Increase Potion Selection Box (Not tradable)
[/b][list][*]Select a potion for one of the following skills:
[list][*]Hillwen Engineering[/*][*]Magic Craft[/*][*]Blacksmithing[/*][*]Tailoring[/*][*]Carpentry[/*][/list][/*][*]When the potion is used, your skill's production quality is increased by 5 for your next crafting finishing attempt.[/*][*]The effect disappears after completing your item craft.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Echostone Advancement Assist Potion[/b]
[list][*]Increases the level up chance for your next Echostone level advancement attempt by a set amount of 10%. It is consumed once the advancement attempt has been made.[/*][*]This item can also be crafted using Potion Making.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Erg Unlock Assist Potion[/b]
[list][*]Increases the unlock chance for your next Erg level break attempt by a set amount based on the current Erg level. It is consumed once the unlock attempt has been made.[/*][*]This item can also be crafted using Potion Making.[b]
[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][table][tr][th][b]Erg Level[/b][/th][th][b]Potion Percentage Increase[/b][/th][th][b]Final Success Rate[/b][/th][/tr][tr][td]5 -> 6[/td][td]10%[/td][td]100%[/td][/tr][tr][td]10 -> 11[/td][td]10%[/td][td]70%[/td][/tr][tr][td]15 -> 16[/td][td]10%[/td][td]40%[/td][/tr][tr][td]20 -> 21[/td][td]10%[/td][td]25%[/td][/tr][tr][td]25 -> 26[/td][td]5%[/td][td]10%[/td][/tr][tr][td]30 -> 31[/td][td]4%[/td][td]6%[/td][/tr][tr][td]35 -> 36[/td][td]3%[/td][td]4%[/td][/tr][tr][td]40 -> 41[/td][td]1.30%[/td][td]2%[/td][/tr][tr][td]45 -> 46[/td][td]0.70%[/td][td]1%[/td][/tr][/table]
[b]New Journal Achievements[/b]
[list][*]New Journal achievements for crafting items and completing Crafting Diary achievements have been added.[/*][/list][table][tr][th][b]Journal Name[/b][/th][th][b]Achievement Requirement[/b][/th][th][b]Journal Score[/b][/th][/tr][tr][td]Crafting 100 Items - Complete![/td][td]

Completed 100 crafting achievements

You can search for craftable items using the search bar.[/*][*]Even if you do not have the equipment required for crafting, you can check the related UI and crafting information.
[list][*]This excludes Milling as it requires being next to a Mill.[/*][*]Crafting is possible only after wearing equipment needed and putting in required materials into the crafting menu.[/*][/list][/*][*]The "Auto Register Tools and Materials" button has been added so that all materials and crafting tool items can be automatically registered and equipped.
[list][*]You will need to manually equip corresponding skill's crafting equipment if you already have different tools equipped.[/*][/list][/*][*]Improvements have been made so that the remaining materials are returned when more material items are put in the crafting menu than the recipe's required quantity.[/*][*]In the case of the Cooking skill, if the the equipment you wear does not match the cooking recipe as a result of the selection, it will not be crafted.[/*][*]The UI text for "Automatic Production" and "Production Quantity" has been changed as follows:[list][*]Queue/Automatic Production -> Continuous Auto Craft[/*][*]Produce/Production Quantity -> Quantity[/*][/list][/*][*]When using [b]Tailoring or Blacksmithing skills,[/b] you can now toggle to show only the Sewing Patterns and Blacksmith Manuals that you have in your inventory.[/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1445/mabinogi-relife-manuals.png[/img]
[list][*]When using [b]Weaving, Handicraft, Refining, Fynn Crafting, Magic Craft, Hillwen Engineering, Carpentry, Potion Making, Stationery Crafting, and Milling skills, [/b]the following options are available in the crafting menu:[list][*]Continuous [b]Auto Craft[/b] can be toggled.[/*][*]The quantity desired can be changed depending on the amount of materials you have.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1447/mabinogi-relife-potion-crafting.png[/img]

You can purchase these in Glenis' and Glewyas' shops as well as the Flying Food Truck type pet shops.
[list][*][b]Tea Leaves[/b][/*][*][b]Napa Cabbage[/b][/*][*][b]Mint[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]Glenis offers 11 new Cooking Quests in her shop, each rewarding different ingredients:[list][*][b]Tomato Sauce[/b][/*][*][b]Gochujang[/b][/*][*][b]Meat Marinade[/b][/*][*][b]Lemon Juice[/b][/*][*][b]Vinegar[/b][/*][*][b]Wine Vinegar[/b][/*][*][b]Mint Syrup[/b][/*][*][b]Anchovies[/b][/*][*][b]Salami[/b][/*][*][b]Corn Dough[/b][/*][*][b]Mixed Vegetables[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list]

[list][*]The Weaving crafting recipes for Fabric and Silk have been changed.[/*][*]Each grade of fabric or silk previously required 5 Thin or Thick Thread to craft. It has been changed as follows:
[list][*][b]Cheap Silk[/b]

[list][*]New material pouches have been added.[/*][*]New and existing material pouches have been updated visually.[list][*]Different shapes are displayed to distinguish the types of Leather, Fabric, and Silk pouches.[/*][*]An icon for each grade is added to easily distinguish between the Cheap, Common, Fine, and Finest pouches.[/*][/list][/*][*]The following new material pouches can be purchased in Glewyas’ shop for 3 [b]Royal Court Food Delivery List 3[/b] certificates each. Each pouch can hold up to 200 items:

[list][*]The following new material pouches can be purchased from the Trading Post Merchant Imp for [b]500,000 Ducats[/b] each in the “Pouch” shop tab. Each pouch can hold up to 500 items:
[list][*][b]Sturdy Egg Pouch [/b][/*][*][b]Sturdy Potato Pouch [/b][/*][*][b]Sturdy Corn Pouch [/b][/*][*][b]Sturdy Wheat Pouch [/b][/*][*][b]Sturdy Barley Pouch [/b][/*][*][b]Sturdy Wool Collection Pouch [/b][/*][*][b]Sturdy Cobweb Pouch [/b][/*][*][b]Sturdy Thin Thread Ball Pouch [/b][/*][*][b]Sturdy Thick Thread Ball Pouch [/b][/*][*][b]Sturdy Cheap Leather Pouch [/b][/*][*][b]Sturdy Common Leather Pouch [/b][/*][*][b]Sturdy Fine Leather Pouch [/b][/*][*][b]Sturdy Finest Leather Pouch [/b][/*][*][b]Sturdy Cheap Fabric Pouch[/b][/*][*][b]Sturdy Common Fabric Pouch[/b][/*][*][b]Sturdy Fine Fabric Pouch[/b][/*][*][b]Sturdy Finest Fabric Pouch[/b][/*][*][b]Sturdy Cheap Silk Pouch[/b][/*][*][b]Sturdy Common Silk Pouch[/b][/*][*][b]Sturdy Fine Silk Pouch[/b][/*][*][b]Sturdy Finest Silk Pouch[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list]

[list][*]New Homestead gathering props have been added.[/*][*]These new props can be created on a Level 13+ Homestead using the Homestead Construction List -> Product tab using the required materials or Pon.[/*][*]These can be collected from the next day after installation.[list][*][b]Poison Herb, Mandrake, and White Herb[/b][list][*]Can be collected from 5 times per real life day.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Mag Mell Honey Pond[/b][list][*]There is no daily gathering limit.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Old Spiderweb Stump[/b][list][*]Can be collected from 20 times per real life day.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Server Merge - Patch Notes - April 14th, 2022
notes.notes:
Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the server merge of Alexina and Nao into the Erinn server!

[b]The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:[/b]
[list][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/70498/updated-extended-crom-b-s-support]Crom Bás Fever Time[/url]: Thursday, December 9th, After Maintenance - Until Further Notice[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/73187/tidal-guardian-box]Tidal Guardian Box[/url]: Thursday, March 31st, After Maintenance - Thursday, April 28th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/73320/milletian-events-server-merge-celebration]Milletian Events: Server Merge Celebration![/url]: Thursday, April 14th, After Maintenance - Multiple End Dates[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/73309/erinn-adventure-journal-special-server-merge-season]Erinn Adventure Journal: Special Server Merge Season[/url]: Thursday, April 14th, After Maintenance - Thursday, May 12th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/73321/the-billionaire-s-bankroll-season-3]The Billionaire's Bankroll: Season 3[/url]: Thursday, April 14th, After Maintenance - Thursday, June 23rd, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/73587/milletian-events-the-grand-guild-gathering]Milletian Events: The Grand Guild Gathering[/url]: Thursday, April 14th, After Maintenance - Thursday, May 12th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/73596/shopkeeper-s-sale-server-merge-fun]Shopkeeper's Sale: Server Merge Fun![/url]: Thursday, April 14th, After Maintenance - Thursday, April 28th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/73588/elemental-harmony-box]Elemental Harmony Box[/url]: Thursday, April 14th, After Maintenance - Thursday, May 12th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/73614/cash-shop-renewal-notice-and-new-sales]Cash Shop Renewal[/url]: Permanent[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/73024/together-in-erinn]Alexina/Nao Server Merge[/url]: Permanent[/*][/list]
[b]Server Merge[/b]
[list][*]The Alexina and Nao servers have been merged into the Erinn server. For full details about the merge, please read [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/73024/together-in-erinn]FAQ 1[/url] and [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/73594/together-in-erinn-updated-faq]FAQ 2[/url].[/*][*]If you are a returning player to Mabinogi, we highly recommend checking out the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/62617]Returning Milletian Guide[/url] for a quick recap on recent updates.[/*][/list]
[b]The following changes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]Guild Management and Guild Creation no longer requires Mabinogi Premium Service or VIP Service.[*]Known Issue: We are investigating the issue where some guilds cannot place a guild stone or invite new members.[/*][*]Extra Equipment Slot Tabs can now be increased to a maximum of 12 tabs, up from 8 tabs.[/*][*]Bank Limit Changes 
[list][*]The default bank limit has been increased by 50,000,000 gold for the first character created on an account. (20,000,000 -> 70,000,000 gold)[/*][*]When visiting any Bank, you can view your [b]current maximum bank limit[/b]. 
[list][*]E.g. Current: [u]Gold Amount[/u] / Max: [u]3,500,000,000[/u][/*][*]Your current bank limit is determined by the amount of characters you have on the account and can be increased in other ways: [url=https://support-mabinogi.nexon.net/hc/en-us/articles/209764243]Character Bank Limit Details[/url][/*][/list][/*][*]You will not be able to deposit any more gold to the bank once the Current maximum gold is reached for your account.[/*][*]The [b]maximum bank limit[/b] that can be reached is 3,500,000,000 gold.
[list][*]The maximum amount that can be reached by creating characters is 2,100,000,000 gold.[/*][*]You can increase your account’s bank limit by using a [b]Bank Limit Expansion Coupon[/b] to increase the capacity by up to 10 million, 50 million, or 100 million gold at a time.[/*][*]If the bank limit is increased using Expansion Coupons up to 3,500,000,000 gold, the limit cannot be further increased by other methods.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]The following bug fixes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]Fixed an issue where the Bhatair, Morfydrianas, and Tani Doll Bags had the incorrect dimensions in their descriptions.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where the recipe for the Item Illusion T46 recipe stated that it required Steel Plates.[/*][*]Fixed a grammar issue in the item attribute section of the Trader Enchant Scroll.[/*][*]Fixed a grammar issue in the Tidal Guardian Box description.[/*][/list]
[b]The following are known bugs:[/b]
[list][*]There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".[/*][*]Some players' hotkeys and pet menu settings reset after logging out.[/*][*]During the Kraken Rex boss fight, Kraken Rex will use an attack that will cause players to lose protection, semi-permanently, until they change channels or relog.[/*][*]There is a typo in the Finishing Materials list when crafting the Dustin Silver Knight Greaves.[/*][*]There is a known issue where some players are unable to obtain the G1 quest "Find Goro's Ring".[/*][*]There is an issue where certain G3 cutscenes will not play, but still charge gold.[/*][*]There is an issue where Homestead item information is overlapping.[/*][*]There is an issue where the Today Visitor Count does not reset to 0. When a visiting character visits the Homestead, the Today and Total Count accumulates normally.[/*][*]The available upgrades in the Item Upgrade may overlap in the UI if the window is increased.[/*][*]Homestead Anvils and Furnaces have settings to allow visitors to use them, but do not actually restrict the use of the items.[/*][*]There is a slight graphical error where part of the hose is missing when a William or Butler Partner uses the Water Hose gesture.[/*][*]Some Partner gestures that have them holding a weapon will appear as though the weapon is disconnected and floating.[/*][*]There are Partner gestures that do not activate when a Partner has something equipped in their left hand.[/*][*]There is an issue after using the Thunder skill, the character can't charge Thunder again until after the Thunder bolt hits/damages enemies.[/*][*]If you try to change your style to an appearance already saved in a Beauty Slot, it will say it failed.[/*][*]There is a minor visual issue with the Beauty Slot text if you scroll up and down after expanding the Beauty Slot.[/*][*]The outline color when clicking on an empty Beauty Slot is incorrect.[/*][*]There is text cut-off in the Buy Item UI when buying the Royal Society Appreciation Box from Melwyn.[/*][*]The inventory image for the Mace of Mercy is incorrect.[/*][*]Feeding a Pet Instructor Stick to a Level 100 Spirit weapon will cause the character to freeze.[/*][*]If you had a unicode heart on your wedding ring, the heart appears as a question mark.[/*][*]The Shaggy Perm hairstyle can be saved in a Beauty Slot.[/*][*]Cobweb Mummy enemies do not appear in the Alby Advanced Dungeon.[/*][*]Guilds are not appearing in the Guild List.[/*][*]When you first open the Master Plan Inventory, it will incorrectly show as locked. Closing and reopening the inventory will fix the issue.[/*][*]There is a minor graphical issue with the Special Shining Stage Concert Costume (M) when the character equipped with the outfit is running.[/*][*]Scathach's hands do not match her skin color.[/*][*]The Tail Chasers mini-game in Festia is currently inaccessible.[/*][*]The Iria Exploration Quest Board will cause a crash when clicked on.[/*][*]A character's neck will become detached from their body when wearing the Mysterious Thief outfit.[/*][/list]

notes.notes:
Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring our 14th Anniversary celebration!

[b]The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:[/b]
[list][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/70498/updated-extended-crom-b-s-support]Crom Bás Fever Time[/url]: Thursday, December 9th, After Maintenance - Until Further Notice[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/71325/irusan-s-attendance-check-in]Irusan's Attendance Check-in[/url]: Thursday, January 27th, After Maintenance - Thursday, April 14th, Before Maintenance[url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/71323/shining-stage-box]
[/url][/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/71973/woodland-teatime-basket]Woodland Teatime Basket[/url]: Thursday, February 24th, After Maintenance - Thursday, March 24th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/72033/light-and-darkness-event]Light and Darkness Event[/url]: Thursday, March 3rd, After Maintenance - Thursday, March 31st, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/72607/extravagant-wings-box]Extravagant Wings Box[/url]: Thursday, March 10th, After Maintenance - Thursday, April 7th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/72832/client-reinstallation-notice-and-hotday-event]Client Reinstallation Hotday[/url]: Thursday, March 17th, 7:00 AM PDT - Thursday, March 24th, 7:00 AM PDT[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/72864/14th-anniversary-sale]14th Anniversary Sale[/url]: Thursday, March 17th, After Maintenance - Thursday, April 14th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/72622/14th-anniversary-celebration]14th Anniversary Celebration[/url]: Thursday, March 17th, After Maintenance - Thursday, April 14th, Before Maintenance[/*][/list]
[b]14th Anniversary [/b]
[list][*]Happy 14th Anniversary, Milletians! Celebrate 14 years of Mabinogi with mini-games and tons of prizes! Check out the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/72622/14th-anniversary-celebration]event page[/url] for more in-depth details![list][*]Talk to Dero the Eventsman in Festia to start the 14th Anniversary celebration.[/*][*]Complete daily quests to receive Night Bazaar Stickers. The more daily quests you complete, the more rewards you can obtain![/*][*]How good are you at the Night Bazaar mini-games? Play 4 different types of mini-games every day![/*][*]Conquer the waves of enemies within the Cave of Trials to receive prizes and event titles celebrating your achievements! The title rewards will replace your existing Cave of Trials titles if you've been through the scenario previously.[/*][*]Use gold or Instant Prize Tickets Capsule Machine in Festia for a chance at different rewards every week.[/*][*]Exchange your Night Bazaar Stickers for special prizes at different shopkeepers![/*][*]Don't forget to log in weekly for more rewards as well as additional Night Bazaar Stickers.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Repair Cost Reduction[/b]
[list][*]The cost of repairing equipment has been lowered to 1/5th (80% per repair point) of the original price.[list][*][b]Example: [/b]If the repair cost was 260 gold per repair point before the update, it is now 52 gold per repair point after the update.[/*][/list][/*][*]If the discounted repair cost after the update is less than 1 gold, the repair cost is set to 1 gold.[list][*][b]Example: [/b]"Beginner" equipment repair cost per point is 1 gold before and after the update.[/*][/list][/*][*]The reduced repair cost applies to Gold and Ducat repair methods.[/*][*]All repair types benefit from the discount, including Falias Artifacts.[list][*]However, keep in mind that this reduction does not benefit Brionac repair as it uses AP and not gold.[/*][/list][/*][*]Cost-modifying effects such as enchantments and upgrades will still apply the cost modification, but the cost of the repair will still be lower as the base repair cost has been reduced.[/*][*]NPC repair rates have not been changed. [/*][/list]
[b]Crom Bás Dungeon Polishing[/b]
[list][*]The overall dungeon length for Crom Bás has been reduced.
[list][*]The appearance of magic circles and destinations to certain rooms and puzzles will change accordingly.[/*][/list][/*][*]The puzzle requiring you to rescue endangered citizens has been lowered from 30 waves to 16 waves.[/*][*]The location of campfires and traps has been changed.[/*][*]The number of waves of monsters and amount of monsters that appear has been adjusted.[/*][*]The maximum number of Souls that appear has been changed from 4 to 6, depending on the Crom Bás Info score.[/*][*]There has been a change made so that Melci Diafol may not appear at a low chance.[/*][*]You can now use the following skills when fighting Irusan and Glas Ghaibhleann:[list][*]Anchor Rush[/*][*]Tumble[/*][*]Wings of Eclipse[/*][/list][/*][*]Irusan's HP has been greatly reduced in the Advanced and Elite difficulties.[/*][*]Giga Glas Ghaibhleann's movement speed has been increased.[/*][*]The delay time before and after the Giga Glas Ghaibhleann's Jumping Dash skill has been reduced.[/*][*]The combat AI of Completed Glas Ghaiblheann and Giga Glas Ghaibhleann has been changed to be a little more aggressive.[/*][*]The movement speed of the Dark Shrieker that spawns during the Glas Ghaibhleann boss fight has been increased.[/*][*]When Dark Shrieker's self-destruct attack accumulates more than 5 times for Completed Glas Ghaibhleann and more than 9 times for Giga Glas Ghaibhleann, Confusion will be applied to the boss.[/*][*]The damage taken when Confusion is applied to Glas Ghaibhleann has been increased slightly.[/*][/list]
[b]The following changes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]The Weekly Reward Limit for Crom Bás has been changed from 7 times a week to [b]10 times a week.[/b][/*][*]The drop rate has been slightly increased for some enchantments that were difficult to obtain in Crom Bás.[/*][*]The drop rate of the Nightbringer Huntsman has been increased in the Crom Bás dungeon.[/*][*]Mana, Stamina, and Hunger will no longer drop below 0 if you are possessed in Crom Bás.[/*][*]The time it takes to bless an item using Holy Water of Lymilark has been changed from 4 seconds to 0.5 seconds.[/*][/list]
[b]The following bug fixes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]Fixed an issue where certain boots would clip into the the Water Spirit Outfit (F) and Special Water Spirit Outfit (F).[/*][*]An issue with enhancement from the Souls in Crom Bas that reduced the Encore skill cooldown has been fixed. When you receive the Music Enhancement blessing, the cooldown of Encore is decreased.[/*][*]The issue where Glas Ghaibhleann intermittently rises after death has been fixed.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where, when the Dark Ritual failed in Crom Bas, the increased attack power value of Glas Ghaibhleann was applied differently than intended.
[list][*][b]Before:[/b] Completed Glas Ghaibhleann increased by 3 times, Giga Glas Ghaibhleann increased by 2 times[/*][*][b]After:[/b] Completed Glas Ghaibhleann increased by 2 times, Giga Glas Ghaibhleann increased by 3 times[/*][/list][/*][*]You will now revive automatically if you die due to remaining AOE effects after clearing Crom Bas.[/*][/list]
[b]The following are known bugs:[/b]
[list][*]There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".[/*][*]Some players' hotkeys and pet menu settings reset after logging out.[/*][*]During the Kraken Rex boss fight, Kraken Rex will use an attack that will cause players to lose protection, semi-permanently, until they change channels or relog.[/*][*]There is a typo in the Finishing Materials list when crafting the Dustin Silver Knight Greaves.[/*][*]There is a known issue where some players are unable to obtain the G1 quest "Find Goro's Ring".[/*][*]There is an issue where certain G3 cutscenes will not play, but still charge gold.[/*][*]There is an issue where Homestead item information is overlapping.[/*][*]There is an issue where the Today Visitor Count does not reset to 0. When a visiting character visits the Homestead, the Today and Total Count accumulates normally.[/*][*]The available upgrades in the Item Upgrade may overlap in the UI if the window is increased.[/*][*]Homestead Anvils and Furnaces have settings to allow visitors to use them, but do not actually restrict the use of the items.[/*][*]There is a slight graphical error where part of the hose is missing when a William or Butler Partner uses the Water Hose gesture.[/*][*]Some Partner gestures that have them holding a weapon will appear as though the weapon is disconnected and floating.[/*][*]There are Partner gestures that do not activate when a Partner has something equipped in their left hand.[/*][*]There is an issue after using the Thunder skill, the character can't charge Thunder again until after the Thunder bolt hits/damages enemies.[/*][*]If you try to change your style to an appearance already saved in a Beauty Slot, it will say it failed.[/*][*]There is a minor visual issue with the Beauty Slot text if you scroll up and down after expanding the Beauty Slot.[/*][*]The outline color when clicking on an empty Beauty Slot is incorrect.[/*][*]Fine Reforging Tools can still be obtained in the Eweca Orb.[/*][*]There is text cut-off in the Buy Item UI when buying the Royal Society Appreciation Box from Melwyn.[/*][*]The inventory image for the Mace of Mercy is incorrect.[/*][*]Feeding a Pet Instructor Stick to a Level 100 Spirit weapon will cause the character to freeze.[/*][*]If you had a unicode heart on your wedding ring, the heart appears as a question mark.[/*][*]The Shaggy Perm hairstyle can be saved in a Beauty Slot.[/*][*]Cobweb Mummy enemies do not appear in the Alby Advanced Dungeon.[/*][*]Guilds are not appearing in the Guild List.[/*][*]When you first open the Master Plan Inventory, it will incorrectly show as locked. Closing and reopening the inventory will fix the issue.[/*][*]The following Doll Bags have the incorrect dimensions in the item description: [list][*]Bhatair Doll Bag[/*][*]Morfydrianas Doll Bag[/*][*]Tani Doll Bag[/*][/list][/*][*]The Item Illusion T46 recipe incorrectly states that it requires Steel Plates.[/*][*]There is a grammar issue in the item attribute section of the Trader Enchant Scroll.[/*][*]There is a minor graphical issue with the Special Shining Stage Concert Costume (M) when the character equipped with the outfit is running.[/*][*]Scathach's hands do not match her skin color.[/*][*]The Tail Chasers mini-game in Festia is currently inaccessible.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Custom Motion Update
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Custom Motion[/b][/h2]
You can now swap between custom idle motions of any outfits that have special poses!

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1445/mabinogi-custom-motion-motion-applied.gif[/img]
[list][*]The [b]View Outfits with Motion[/b] checkbox has been added to the Dressing Room -> Clothing tab[/*][*]When this checkbox is checked, only outfits with custom idle motions will be displayed in the Dressing Room.[/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1444/mabinogi-custom-motion-dressing-room.png[/img]
[list][*]To apply a motion of an outfit in the Dressing Room to your Style Tab, click on the green [b]Motion[/b] button next to the desired outfit in the Dressing Room. Once the motion is applied, the button will change to a yellow [b]Applied [/b]button.[list][*]You cannot apply the motion of outfits that you do not own, or that cannot be equipped on your current character.[/*][*]The motion of special collaboration outfits cannot be applied.[/*][/list][/*][*]Once a motion has been applied, it will change the custom idle motion of outfits worn in the Style Tab to the motion of the selected outfit.[list][*]The motion can only be swapped between outfits that have motion.[/*][*]Only one motion can be applied at a time.[/*][*]Even if you change the clothing equipped in the Style Tab, the applied motion is maintained.[/*][*]Even if there is a motion being applied in the Dressing Room, the motion will not be applied if the outfit you are wearing has no motion, or if the Style Tab has expired.[/*][*]The motion of an outfit will not change if it is equipped in the Gear Tab instead of the Style Tab.[/*][*]If you remove the outfit with the motion that is being applied from the Dressing Room, the motion is turned off.[/*][/list][/*][*]To remove an applied motion, click the [b]Applied[/b] button again, or select a different outfit using the [b]Motion [/b]button to change to a different motion.[/*][*]When an outfit with motion is worn in the Style Tab, a small icon is visible on the bottom-left corner of the Outfit slot. Click on this icon to bring up the Dressing Room with the [b]View Outfits with Motion[/b] option selected.[/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1443/mabinogi-custom-motion-inventory-icon.png[/img]

notes.title: Netherlands Trade Limitations Update
notes.notes:
Dear Dutch Milletians,

We've updated more details on the trade functionality changes that we announced in our [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/69540/notice-for-netherlands-players-part-2]Notice for Netherlands Players: Part 2[/url]. In order to comply with Netherlands regulations, the following in-game trade functions will be restricted for Dutch players:
[list][*]Give and Receive items via 1:1 Exchange trade[/*][*]Item dropping[/*][*]Buy and Sell via the Auction House[/*][*]Mailing messages with items attached[/*][*]Personal shop sales or purchases (viewing other players' shops is still possible)[list][*]Even if you have a Personal Shop Bag, you cannot open a Personal Shop.[/*][*]You can still buy the Merchant License from the Bank, but you cannot use it.[/*][/list][/*][*]Housing shop purchases (viewing items is still possible)[/*][*]Kiosk sales or purchases (viewing other players' Kiosks is still possible)[/*][*]Items given in exchange for an Enchant Entrustment[/*][*]Items acquired through pet battles[/*][*]Entering Uladh/Iria Dungeons using Item Drops, or touching the statue[list][*]If you are in a party as a party member, you can enter the dungeon with other players when they enter.[/*][*]You can enter a dungeon if you use a Unlimited Dungeon Pass.[/*][/list][/*][*]Receiving Mail Delivery part-time jobs from the Tara Bank[/*][/list]
The above limitations will be implemented during the [b]December 9th, 2021[/b] maintenance.

Thank you,

[i]- The Mabinogi Team[/i]

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/2279/beauty-slots.png[/img]
[olist][*]Access the Slot Section in the Dressing Room by clicking on the Beauty Slot icon.[/*][*]Select an appearance tab: Hair, Eye, Face, or Mouth.[/*][*]Click on [b]"Save Appearance"[/b], depending on which tab you are currently viewing, to save the current appearance of your character.[/*][*]Click on [b]"Save All Appearances"[/b] to save all currently applied appearances of the character.[list][*]If an appearance has not been saved, each appearance will be saved in an applicable empty Beauty Slot.[/*][*]Appearances that have already been saved will not change.[/*][*]If there are not enough empty Beauty Slots available, this option will not be available for use.[/*][/list][/*][*]Select an appearance in a Beauty Slot, then click [b]"Delete Appearance" [/b]to remove the selected appearance from the saved Beauty Slot.[list][*]Deleting an appearance [b]cannot be reverted.[/b][/*][*]After a saved appearance is deleted, the Beauty Slot will become empty and will be available for use.[/*][/list][/*][*]Click [b]"Beauty Slot Expansion"[/b] to increase the number of empty Beauty Slots using [b]Pon.[/b][list][*][b]60 Pon [/b]can be used to add an additional empty Beauty Slot to the [b]Hair [/b]tab.[/*][*][b]45 Pon[/b] can be used to add an additional empty Beauty Slot to the [b]Eyes, Face,[/b] and [b]Mouth [/b]tabs.[/*][/list][/*][/olist]
[b]Additional Details[/b]
[list][*]All appearances can be saved once in a Beauty Slot.[/*][*]When saving an appearance, the Hair, Eye, and Skin colors are also saved.[/*][*]You can change the character's appearance between all saved appearances at any time.[list][*]After clicking on a saved appearance, click the [b]"Change" [/b]button to apply the saved appearance to the character.[/*][*][u][b]If you change to an appearance saved in the Beauty Slot, without saving the current character's appearance, you will not be able to revert back to the unsaved appearance.[/b][/u][/*][/list][/*][*]Beauty Slots are exclusive to a character, and are not shared across your account.[list][*]Each character receives 3 free empty Beauty Slots per appearance type.[/*][*]Saved appearances are available only for the individual character that saved the appearance.[/*][*]Additional empty Beauty Slots can be expanded up to 300 for each appearance tab.[/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]Eye Blinking[/b][/h2]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/2271/access_blinking_settings.png[/img][/b]
[list][*]The [b]Eye Blinking [/b]feature has been added.[list][*]This feature can be accessed in the Dressing Room under (1) Appearance Change -> (2) Eye -> (3) Blink Settings.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/2272/blinkingsettings.png[/img]
[olist][*]Click on the [b]"Enable Blinking" [/b]checkbox to turn the blinking settings on or off.
[list][*]If checked, the blinking settings are applied to the character.[/*][*]If unchecked, the blinking settings are not applied.[/*][/list][/*][*]The [b]"Blinking Interval" [/b]can be set from a minimum of 1 second to a maximum of 60 seconds.[list][*]This determines the time between eye blinks. The character will blink randomly between the set times.[/*][*]Example: If set to a minimum of 1 second and a maximum of 10 seconds, the eyes blink randomly between 1 and 10 seconds. Immediately after blinking, the cycle is reset, and blinks randomly again.[/*][/list][/*][*]The [b]"Number of Blinks"[/b] can be modified for the blinking setting.[list][*]Blink Once[/*][*]Blink Twice (consecutive blinks)[/*][*]Randomize[list][*]If selected, your eyes will blink once or twice (consecutively) at random[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The [b]"Blinking Speed" [/b]can be adjusted.[list][*]This is the time it takes for a character to open and close their eyes.[/*][*]This time can be set from a minimum of 0.03 seconds to a maximum of 0.15 seconds.[/*][/list][/*][/olist][list][*]Once the blinking settings have been set up, click [b]Apply[/b] to save it to the character.[/*][*]To apply the default eye blinking settings, click on the [b]Default[/b] option, then click [b]Apply.[/b][/*][/list]

[h2][b]New Changes[/b][/h2][list][*]The [b]Dungeon Notebook[/b] has been added to the game.[list][*]The Dungeon Notebook can be obtained by speaking to the Researcher near Poulnabrone Rock using the "Dungeon Notebook" option.[/*][*]The Main Rewards that can be obtained from dungeon end chests and dungeon boss kill drops are now listed in the Dungeon Notebook for the following dungeons and their corresponding difficulties: [list][*]Uladh Dungeons[/*][*]Shadow Missions[/*][*]Baltane Missions[/*][*]Tech Duinn Missions[/*][/list][/*][*]You can reference the Recommended Dungeon based on your Total Skill Level in the Dungeon Notebook.[/*][*]The Dungeon Notebook can be stored in the Me tab.[list][*]If you destroy the item, talk to the Researcher again to obtain a new one.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Four new [b]Refined Armor [/b]sets, their respective Blacksmith Manuals, and Blacksmith crafting recipes have been added.[b]
[/b][/*][/list][table][tr][th][b]Type of Armor[/b][/th][th][b]Armor Set[/b][/th][/tr][tr][td]Heavy[/td][td]- Refined Dustin Silver Knight Helm
- Refined Dustin Silver Knight Armor

- Refined Dustin Silver Knight Greaves[/td][/tr][tr][td]Heavy[/td][td]- Refined Royal Knight Armor

- Refined Northern Lights Gauntlets (M)
- Refined Northern Lights Greaves (M)
- Refined Northern Lights Armor (F)
- Refined Northern Lights Gauntlets (F)
- Refined Northern Lights Greaves (F)[/td][/tr][tr][td]Light[/td][td]- Refined Majestic Knight Armor (M)
- Refined Majestic Knight Gauntlets (M)
- Refined Majestic Knight Boots (M)
- Refined Majestic Knight Armor (F)
- Refined Majestic Knight Gauntlets (F)
- Refined Majestic Knight Boots (F)[/td][/tr][/table][list][*]Two new [b]material items[/b] have been added.[list][*]Phantasmal Ingot[list][*]Can be crafted using Hillwen Engineering[/*][/list][/*][*]Polished Plate[list][*]Can be created using Handicraft[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]A [b]reward acquisition condition system[/b] has been added when playing Uladh Dungeons and Shadow Missions.
[list][*]In Uladh Dungeons and Tara and Taillteann Shadow Missions, you must meet a certain level of [b]participation time in battle[/b] to fully obtain all rewards.
[list][*]60 seconds of battle is required for Uladh Dungeons[/*][*]30 seconds of battle is required for Shadow Missions[/*][/list][/*][*]These conditions apply to individual characters within the dungeon or mission.[/*][*]These conditions apply to the following:
[list][*][b]Uladh Dungeons:[/b] Basic, Intermediate, Advanced and Hard Mode Advanced[/*][*][b]Shadow Missions:[/b] Basic, Intermediate, Advanced, Hard, and Elite[/*][/list][/*][*]Some dungeons are excluded from this reward acquisition system, such as Normal Dungeons, Siren Dungeons, Veteran Dungeons, Rabbie Phantasm Dungeon, Abyss Peaca Advanced Dungeon, Abyss Coill Advanced Dungeon, Musical Math Dungeon, Lord Missions, Sinead’s Secret Missions, and special dungeons and missions exclusively for Tutorial or Generation quests.[/*][*]A dedicated icon has been added to the top left of the screen next to the list of party members when entering Uladh Dungeons and Shadow Missions.
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/2282/checkmark_combat_icon.png[/img]
[/*][*]If you [b]meet the conditions[/b] for obtaining rewards, the icon will be highlighted with a check mark, indicating that the condition has been fulfilled and rewards can be obtained.
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/2280/grey_combat_icon.png[/img]
[/*][*]If you [b]do not meet the conditions[/b] for obtaining rewards, the following penalties will be applied:
[list][*][b]Uladh Dungeons:[/b] The dungeon itself is cleared, but the key to the reward box is not obtained after the boss is defeated.[/*][*][b]Shadow Missions:[/b] The mission itself is cleared, but the key of the reward box is not obtained and only half of the completion experience and completion gold is rewarded.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Avon Theater Mission passes of the Beginner, Intermediate, and Advanced difficulty can now be purchased from [b]Marlowe[/b] in Avon.[/*][*]Crafting recipes for the Play Pages that can be collected from Avon Paper Sheep have been added so that it is now possible to create Play Pages of a higher difficulty when using the Magic Spinning Wheel.
[list][*]5 Faded Play Page -> 1 Bronze Play Page[/*][*]5 Bronze Play Page -> 1 Silver Play Page[/*][*]5 Silver Play Page -> 1 Gold Play Page[/*][/list][/*][*]Color values ​​have been applied to Avon Theater Mission passes to make it easier to distinguish passes by difficulty.[/*][*]During a Grandmaster Mission, the durability of items equipped and used inside the mission will not decrease.
[list][*]The durability will still decrease if using certain Life skills in the mission, such as Handicraft or Cooking.[/*][/list][/*][*]The issue of walls blocking the view has been improved for the following:
[list][*]The boss room in the Lord Mission: Fragments of a Trivial Fate[/*][*]The Alby Battle Arena room in the Alban Knights Training Grounds[/*][/list][/*][*]The Abyss Peaca Advanced Dungeon Pass can now be stacked up to 10 passes.[/*][*]The newly added rewards to several dungeons have been added to the Dungeon Reward List on the Dungeon Guide.[list][*]Repeated Clear Guaranteed Rewards have not changed.[/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]Uladh Dungeon Changes[/b][/h2][list][*]There have been several changes made to Uladh Dungeons.
[list][*]These changes apply to Basic, Intermediate, Advanced and Hard Mode Advanced Uladh Dungeons.[/*][*]These changes do not apply to Normal Dungeons, Siren Dungeons, Veteran Dungeons, Rabbie Phantasm Dungeon, Abyss Peaca Advanced Dungeon, Abyss Coill Advanced Dungeon, Musical Math Dungeon, and special dungeons exclusively for Tutorial or Generation quests.[/*][/list][/*][*]The length of the entire dungeon and the number of rooms have been reduced.
[list][*][b]Basic, Intermediate, and Advanced Dungeons[/b] = 1 floor[/*][*][b]Peaca Intermediate Dungeon, Hard Mode Advanced Dungeons[/b] = 2 floors[/*][/list][/*][*]When entering dungeons from Basic to Advanced difficulty, the mini-map inside the dungeon will be displayed from the beginning.
[list][*]When entering dungeons above Advanced difficulty, including Hard Mode and Advanced Hard Mode, the mini map is hidden as before.[/*][/list][/*][*]The [b]Dungeon Key[/b] has been changed so that it no longer drops on the ground for pickup.

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/2281/key.png[/img]
[list][*]Now, if the party meets the conditions for the key to drop, the key will be acquired and displayed as a separate icon in a new special Dungeon Key menu.[/*][*]Any party member can use the Dungeon Key to open dungeon doors.[/*][*]Once the key is used, it will disappear from the menu until a new key is acquired.[/*][*]This change [b]does not[/b] apply to Uladh Dungeons that do not use a key such as Rabbie Phantasm Dungeon, Abyss Coill Advanced Dungeon, and Abyss Peaca Advanced Dungeon.[/*][/list][/*][*]You can now purchase Dungeon Passes from Basic to Advanced difficulty levels from the [b]Poulnabrone Researcher.[/b]
[list][*]The shop tabs are now separated by Basic, Intermediate, and Advanced Dungeon Passes.[/*][/list][/*][*]The shop list of [b]Tiro,[/b] who appears in some dungeons, has been changed.
[list][*]All of the items in the Potion tab have been changed.
[list][*]HP 100 Potion[/*][*]HP 100 Potion x10[/*][*]HP 300 Potion[/*][*]HP 300 Potion x10[/*][*]MP 100 Potion[/*][*]MP 100 Potion x10[/*][*]MP 300 Potion[/*][*]MP 300 Potion x10[/*][*]Stamina 100 Potion[/*][*]Stamina 100 Potion x10[/*][*]Stamina 300 Potion[/*][*]Stamina 300 Potion x10[/*][*]Comprehensive Recovery 500 Potion[/*][*]Comprehensive Recovery 500 Potion x10[/*][*]Comprehensive Recovery 1000 Potion[/*][*]Comprehensive Recovery 1000 Potion x10[/*][/list][/*][*]Some items have been added to the Consumables tab[list][*]Special Arrow Bundle (500 arrows)[/*][*]Special Arrow Bundle (1000 arrows)[/*][*]Special Bolt Bundle (500 bolts)[/*][*]Special Bolt Bundle (1000 bolts)[/*][*]Training Mana Bullet (500)[/*][*]Mana Bullet (500)[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Some iron cage-shaped dungeon doors have been improved so that they are easier to click on.[/*][*]The field of view inside the [b]Fiodh[/b] and [b]Coill[/b] Dungeons has been improved to reduce the view being blocked by bushes, trees, etc.[/*][*]The [b]Fountain of Blessing[/b] that can be found inside some dungeons has been improved.
[list][*]The size of the Fountain of Blessing has been slightly increased.[/*][*]The Fountain of Blessing will always appear in the Hard Mode Advanced difficulty.[/*][*]When clicking the Fountain of Blessing, the penalty effects have been removed, and the following fixed effects will be provided:
[list][*][b]Intermediate difficulty[/b] = Acquire 50% ~ 100% EXP. This acquisition effect is similar to the Golden Experience Fruit.[/*][*][b]Advanced difficulty[/b] = Acquire 50% ~ 200% EXP[/*][*][b]Hard Mode Advanced difficulty[/b] = Acquire 100% ~ 300% EXP or 1 ~ 3 durability of one equipped item will be repaired
[list][*]If there is no item to repair, the 100~300% EXP effect is acquired.[/*][*]The following items are not included as a repairable target:
[list][*]Brionac[/*][*]Falias Treasures[/*][*]Stardust[/*][*]Items in the Style tab[/*][*]Items in the Extra Equipment Slot[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Characters who are already level 200 will receive the Holy Water blessing effect for all equipped items instead of the EXP acquisition effect.[/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]Dungeon Rewards[/b][/h2][list][*]Several dungeon reward changes have been implemented.
[list][*]A change has been made so that the reward level of the dungeon end chest is the same regardless of the number of party members.[/*][*]The probability of obtaining each reward level of the dungeon end chest has been increased.[/*][*]The Shop Sales Bonus EXP attribute has been added to some equipment items obtained from the dungeon end chest. When sold to an NPC, the EXP bonus effect is gained by the character.[/*][*]The pool of dropped items when [b]defeating the dungeon boss[/b] has been improved.

An Unexpected Battle[/*][*]Provocation[/*][/list][/*][*]The [b]Taillteann Defensive Battle Shadow Mission[/b] has been changed as follows:[list][*]The mission is cleared by defeating all monster waves at the East, West, and South gates 9 times each.[/*][*]Each time you defeat a monster wave, a warp zone appears so that you can move to a different gate.[list][*]The location of the warp zone that appears depends on the location of the current defense line.[/*][*]The warp zone is destroyed when used once.[/*][/list][/*][*]Monsters will no longer appear at a gate if all monster waves are defeated.[/*][*]Whenever there are too many remaining monsters or an NPC ally dies, the defense line moves inward towards Taillteann Square, and if the final defense line collapses, the mission will fail.[/*][*]The mission’s Experience and Gold Rewards have been lowered.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
