notes.title: Reflections - Patch Notes - September 9th, 2021
notes.notes:
Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the Reflections Update!

[b]The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:[/b]
[list][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/68469/return-of-the-playful-puzzles-2021]Return of the Playful Puzzles 2021[/url]: Thursday, August 26th, 7:00 AM PDT - Wednesday, November 24th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/68484/bleugenne-viola-box]Bleugenne Viola Box[/url]: Thursday, August 26th, 10:00 AM PDT - Thursday, September 23rd, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/68867/wish-upon-a-star-candy]Wish Upon a Star Candy[/url]: Thursday, September 9th, After Maintenance - Thursday, October 7th, Before Maintenance[[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/68743/shopkeeper-s-sale-homestead-refreshments-and-hotdays]Shopkeeper's Sale: Homestead Refreshments and Hotdays![/url]: Thursday, September 9th, After Maintenance - Thursday, October 7th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/68794/royal-teacup-box]Royal Teacup Box[/url]: Thursday, September 9th, After Maintenance - Thursday, October 7th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/68742/family-weekend-fishing-event-2021]Family Weekend Fishing Event 2021[/url]: Friday, September 10th, 12:00 AM PDT - Sunday, October, 3rd, 11:59 PM PDT[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/68691/renovation-season-2-combat-talent-changes]Renovation Season 2: Combat Talent Changes[/url]: Permanent[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/68866/renewed-adventures-quality-of-life-updates]Renewed Adventures - Quality of Life Updates[/url]: Permanent[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/68597/refresh-your-homestead]Refresh Your Homestead - Homestead Update[/url]: Permanent[/*][/list]
[b]Reflections Update[/b]
[list][*]September is a month of reflection, and we have several updates to renew your fantasy life in Erinn. Check out each of the individual posts below to learn more about each of the updates:
[list][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/68597/refresh-your-homestead-homestead-update][b]Refresh your Homestead![/b][/url]
[list][*]The Homestead can be expanded to be even bigger than before.[/*][*]New Sales items and returning favorites are here, including Partner pets! Check out the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/68743/shopkeeper-s-sale-homestead-refreshments-and-hotdays]Shopkeeper’s Sale: Homestead Refreshments and Hotdays[/url] post for more details.[/*][*]Changes have been made to the Homestead Options menu, and you can now view your Homestead visitor count.[/*][*]You can now place your Partners on your Homestead.[/*][/list][/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/68691/renovation-season-2-combat-talent-changes][b]Renovation Season 2: Combat Talent Changes[/b][/url]
[list][*]Several new changes and improvements have been made to the Close Combat, Archery, Magic, Puppetry, and Alchemy talents.[/*][/list][/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/68866/renewed-adventures-quality-of-life-updates][b]Renewed Adventures - Quality of Life Changes[/b][/url]
[list][*]Over 40 game changes and updates are here to improve your Quality of Life in Erinn, such as no durability decrease outside of combat, visual skill cooldown timers and music buff duration, a hotkey to pick up items off of the ground, and more![b]
[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]The following change has been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]Changed the title for "a Soul Streamer" to "the Soul Streamer".[/*][/list]
[b]The following bug fixes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]Fixed an issue where the crafting materials for Energy Amplifiers were switched.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where Weapon Magic Attack was incorrectly labeled as Weapon Magic Damage while Erging.[/*][/list]
[b]The following are known bugs:[/b]
[list][*]There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".[/*][*]Some players' hotkeys and pet menu settings reset after logging out.[/*][*]During the Kraken Rex boss fight, Kraken Rex will use an attack that will cause players to lose protection, semi-permanently, until they change channels or relog.[/*][*]There is a typo in the Finishing Materials list when crafting the Dustin Silver Knight Greaves.[/*][*]There is a known issue where some players are unable to obtain the G1 quest "Find Goro's Ring".[/*][*]There is an issue where certain G3 cutscenes will not play, but still charges gold.[/*][*]There is an issue where Homestead item information is overlapping.[/*][*]There is a text issue where the quantity of Glyph Recovery Scrolls used appears abnormally in the sentence after using the Max Recovery option.[/*][*]There is an issue where the Today Visitor Count does not reset to 0. When a visiting character visits the Homestead, the Today and Total Count accumulates normally.[/*][*]The available upgrades in the Item Upgrade may overlap in the UI if the window is increased.[/*][*]Homestead Anvils and Furnaces have settings to allow visitors to use them, but do not actually restrict the use of the items.[/*][*]There is a slight graphical error where part of the hose is missing when a William or Butler Partner uses the Water Hose gesture.[/*][*]Some Partner gestures that have them holding a weapon will appear as though the weapon is disconnected and floating.[/*][*]There are Partner gestures that do not activate when a partner has something equipped in their left hand.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Refresh Your Homestead - Homestead Update
notes.notes:
[h2][b]New Homestead Expansion[/b][/h2][list][*]The size of your Homestead can now be expanded to be even bigger than before.[/*][*]Increase the size of your Homestead past the existing Stage 3 size using the following all-new items:[list][*][b]Homestead Expansion Permit Stage 4[/b][/*][*][b]Homestead Expansion Permit Stage 5[/b][/*][*][b]Homestead Expansion Permit Stage 6[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1865/mabinogi-homestead-update-hs-stages.jpg[/img]

[b]Homestead Size by Level[/b]
[table][tr][th][b]Homestead Level[/b][/th][th][b]Size[/b][/th][/tr][tr][td]Level 1[/td][td]9x9[/td][/tr][tr][td][u]Level [/u]2 - 3[/td][td]17x17[/td][/tr][tr][td][u]Level [/u]4 - 9[/td][td]25x25[/td][/tr][tr][td][u]Level [/u]10 - 13[/td][td]33x33[/td][/tr][tr][td][u]Level [/u]14 - 15[/td][td]49x49[/td][/tr][/table]
[b]Homestead Size when using a Homestead Expansion Permit[/b]
[table][tr][th][b]Stage[/b][/th][th][b]Size[/b][/th][/tr][tr][td]Stage 1[/td][td]55x55[/td][/tr][tr][td]Stage 2[/td][td]61x61[/td][/tr][tr][td]Stage 3[/td][td]67x67[/td][/tr][tr][td][b]*NEW* [/b]Stage 4[/td][td]75x75[/td][/tr][tr][td][b]*NEW* [/b]Stage 5[/td][td]83x83[/td][/tr][tr][td][b]*NEW* [/b]Stage 6[/td][td]91x91[/td][/tr][/table]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1866/mabinogi-homestead-update-homestead-items.jpg[/img]

[b]Homestead Expansion Permit Details[/b]
[list][*]Homesteads that are [b]Level 14 or higher[/b] can be expanded in size using [b]Homestead Expansion Permits[/b], up to Stage 6.[list][*]Each Expansion Permit will increase the size of the Homestead.[list][*]Stage 1 - 3: Size will be expanded by 6 tiles horizontally and vertically.[/*][*][b]*NEW* [/b]Stage 4 - 6: Size will be expanded by 8 tiles horizontally and vertically.[/*][/list][/*][*]Each Permit can only be used on a Homestead once.[/*][*]Each Permit, past Stage 1, requires the previous Stage Permit to be used on the Homestead.[list][*][b]Example:[/b] The Homestead Expansion Permit (Stage 4) cannot be used until a Homestead Expansion Permit (Stage 3) has already been used to expand the Homestead.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][b]Homestead Expansion Permits[/b] are permanently available and can be purchased in the Item Shop:[list][*]Homestead Expansion (Stage 1)[/*][*]Homestead Expansion (Stage 2)[/*][*]Homestead Expansion (Stage 3)[/*][*][b]*NEW* [/b]Homestead Expansion (Stage 4)[/*][*][b]*NEW* [/b]Homestead Expansion (Stage 5)[/*][*][b]*NEW*[/b] Homestead Expansion (Stage 6)[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[/td][/tr][/table][h2][b]New Homestead Changes[/b][/h2]
[b]Options and Permissions[/b]
[list][*]Upon entering your Homestead, two new buttons can be accessed in the Homestead Information menu in the top right. 
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1879/mabinogi-homestead-update-hs-options-1.png[/img]
[list][*][b]Options: [/b]Apply overall Homestead permissions through this menu.
[list][*]This option button replaces the need to click on the Homestead Entrance -> View Information button to open the Building information menu previously.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Minimize: [/b]This Homestead menu can now be minimized.[list][*]You can also minimize this menu when visiting other character's Homesteads.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]When you click on the [b]Options [/b]button in the Homestead menu, you can view the Homestead Options.
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1868/mabinogi-homestead-update-hs-options-2.png[/img]
[list][*][b]Entry Permissions[/b]: Set the permissions of who can enter your Homestead.[/*][*][b]Item Permissions:[/b] Apply permissions to all Homestead Props.[list][*]This has been changed from needing to set the option for each Homestead prop.[/*][*]You can still set the option for each Homestead prop individually.[list][*]However, if you set the permissions for a prop individually, the saved option in Homestead Options -> Item Permissions will be unchecked. If checked again, it will change the permissions of all props once more.[/*][/list][/*][*]When placing a new Homestead prop, the permission setting is reflected on the new item as well.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Visitor Count[/b]
[list][*]The Homestead visitor count is now displayed.[/*][*]Open the Homestead menu (Default Hotkey: U) when outside of your Homestead to view the Today and Total visitor count.
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1869/mabinogi-homestead-update-vistor-count.png[/img]
[list][*][b]Today's Count:[/b] View the total number of visitors to your Homestead for the day.[list][*]This will count once per visiting character per day, and resets at 7:00 AM PT daily.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Total Count: [/b]View the total number of visitors who have visited your Homestead.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Partner Homestead Placement[/b]

[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1870/mabinogi-homestead-update-partners-1.gif[/img][/b]
[list][*]You can now place your Partners in your Homestead.[/*][*]Upon entering your Homestead, a new [b]Partner Placement[/b] button is available underneath the Edit and Construction List Homestead buttons.
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1871/mabinogi-homestead-update-hs-buttons-partnerplacement-added.png[/img]
[/*][*]Open up the menu to view the list of available Partners that can be placed in your Homestead.

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1957/mabinogi-homestead-update-placement-menu.png[/img]
[list][*]Select [b]Static Placement[/b] from the menu to place a Partner anywhere in your Homestead.[/*][*]Select [b]Interactive Placement[/b] from the menu to place a Partner on a Homestead Prop, such as a chair.[list][*]A silhouette view will appear and it will show where the Partner can be placed on all available Homestead props.
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1872/mabinogi-homestead-update-silhouette-before.png[/img]
[/*][*]You can move a Homestead prop that has a Partner placed on it and the Partner will be moved with it.[/*][*]If you remove a Homestead prop that has a Partner is placed on it, the Partner will also be removed with the prop. The Partner can be placed again from the Partner Placement menu.[b]
[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]You are unable to select a Partner that is already placed in another Homestead within the same account.[/*][*]Partners cannot be placed inside a Homestead House.[/*][*]Partner take up a 1x1 space when placing them in your Homestead.[/*][*]Partners cannot overlap existing Homestead prop grids.[/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1873/mabinogi-homestead-update-partners-2.png[/img]

[b]Partner Homestead Options[/b]
[list][*]While outside of the Partner Placement menu, click on a placed Partner to view the following options:[list][*]Partner Gesture[/*][*]Move[/*][*]Switch Out[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1874/mabinogi-homestead-update-partner-options.png[/img]
[list][*]You can now modify the Gestures of Partners place in your Homestead.[list][*]You are unable to modify Partner Gestures when a Partner is placed on a Homestead prop.[/*][*]Crossover Partners such as Ram and Rem from the Re:ZERO crossover cannot use Partner Gestures.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[u][b]Basic Motion[/b][/u]
[list][*][b]Homestead Partner Cards[/b] can be used to add new basic motions to a Partner, like an idle stance.[list][*]Homestead Partner Cards can be obtained from the [b]Homestead Partner Basic Motion Card Box[/b] sold in the Maid and Butler Partner shops for 500,000 gold.[list][*]You can obtain 1 of [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/68889][b]85 Basic Motions[/b][/url] with an equal chance when opening the box.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Once you have a Homestead Partner Card in your character's inventory, open the Partner Gesture menu. Under the "Motions" column, click [b]Add[/b], then select a Card to give to your Partner, and then click OK.[b]
[/b][list][*]Each card is a one-time use and will only be applied to the chosen Partner.[/*][*]You can add up to 100 Basic Motions.[/*][*]You can [b]Delete[/b] the added motion, but the Motion Card will not be returned.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1875/mabinogi-homestead-update-adding-motion.gif[/img]
[list][*]If a Partner is wearing an outfit with an animation, the animation will play when the default "Basic Motion" option is selected.[/*][/list]
[u][b]Gesture Motion[/b][/u]
[list][*][b]Gesture Cards[/b] can be used to add Gestures that a Partner can use.[list][*]Existing Gesture Cards can be used.[/*][/list][/*][*]Once you have a Gesture Card in your character's inventory, open the Partner Gesture menu. Under the "Gesture" column, click [b]Add[/b], then select a card to give to the Partner, and click OK.[list][*]Each card is a one-time use and will only be applied to the chosen Partner.[/*][*]You can add up to 100 Gestures.[/*][*]You can [b]Delete[/b] the added Gesture, but the Gesture Card will not be returned.[/*][/list][/*][*]You can change the time interval (in seconds) that the Gesture will repeat.
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1876/mabinogi-homestead-update-interval.png[/img]
[/*][list][*]At 0, the Gesture will continuously repeat from beginning to end. If the set interval is shorter than the length of the Gesture, the Gesture is cut off and plays again.
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1877/mabinogi-homestead-update-2sec-repeated-gesture.gif[/img]
[/*][*]If the Gesture interval is set longer than the length of the Gesture, the Gesture will play. When it ends, the Basic Motion will play until the Gesture plays again.
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1878/mabinogi-homestead-update-15sec-gesture-then_basic-motion.gif[/img]
[/*][*]The max interval can be set is 999 seconds.[/*][/list][*]If you do not want a Gesture motion to be played, select the default "Do Not Use" option and the selected Basic Motion for the Partner will play instead.[/*][/list]
[u][b]Move[/b][/u]
[list][*]You can move the Partner around your Homestead, similar to a Homestead prop.[/*][*]You are unable to move the Partner if they are placed on a Homestead prop.[/*][/list]
[u][b]Switch[/b][b] Out[/b][/u]
[list][*]You can remove a Partner from the Homestead.[/*][*]Once a Partner is placed on the Homestead, you cannot summon it until you've removed them from the Homestead.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Renovation Season 2: Combat Talent Changes
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Magic[/b][/h2]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1836/mabinogi-talent-update-magic.png[/img][/b]

[u][b]System Changes[/b][/u]
[list][*]The magic system has been changed so that only 1 magic charge (previously 2 magic charges) is decreased if you are knocked down while charging [b]Healing[/b] or any of the following intermediate magic skills:[list][*][b]Thunder[/b][/*][*][b]Fireball[/b][/*][*][b]Ice Spear[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]The magic system has been changed so that the charge count is not removed if you are knocked down while charging [b]any type of Bolt Magic[/b].[/*][/list]
[u][b]Item Changes[/b][/u]

[b][u]Wand[/u][/b]
[list][*]You can now use all intermediate magic regardless of the type of Wand you have equipped.
[list][*]For example, Thunder, Fireball, and Ice Spear can all be cast using a Lighting Wand, Fire Wand, or Ice Wand.[/*][/list][/*][*]Each Wand receives 5% bonus damage when the intermediate magic being used matches the elemental attribute of the Wand.[list][*][b]Lightning Wand[/b] - Thunder Bonus Damage +5%[/*][*][b]Fire Wand[/b] - Fireball Bonus Damage +5%[/*][*][b]Ice Wand[/b] - Ice Spear Bonus Damage +5%[/*][*][b]Divine Tribolt Wand[/b] - Can receive Bonus Damage +5% effect from all intermediate magic[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b][u]Staff[/u][/b]
[list][*]All Staves can use intermediate magic.[list][*]You no longer need to collect elemental charges with some Staves, such as a Trinity Staff.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[u][b]Skill Changes[/b][/u]

[u][b]Fireball[/b][/u]

[u][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1833/mabinogi-talent-update-fireball.gif[/img][/b][/u]
[list][*]The damage of Fireball has been increased.[list][*]This increased damage also applies to some enemies.[/*][/list][/*][*]Fireball can now be used from 1 charge, instead of requiring 5 charges.[/*][*]The charge can still be stacked to 5, and the damage will increase with each charge up to 5.[list][*]Damage ratio per charge = 1: 2: 3: 4: 6.5[list][*]1 Charge: 1/6.5 Damage[/*][*]2 Charge: 2/6.5 Damage[/*][*]3 Charges: 3/6.5 Damage[/*][*]4 Charges: 4/6.5 Damage[/*][*]5 Charges: 6.5/6.5 Damage[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The time that Fireball will fly in the air has been shortened to 1 second.[list][*]Previously, the time was 2.5 seconds.[/*][*]This change does not apply to enemies.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[u][b]Ice Spear[/b][/u]
[list][*]The damage of Ice Spear has been increased.[list][*]This increased damage also applies to some enemies.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[u][b]Thunder[/b][/u]

[u][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1846/mabinogi-talent-update-thunder.gif[/img][/b][/u]
[list][*]The damage of Thunder has been increased.[list][*]This increased damage also applies to some enemies.[/*][/list][/*][*]The time it takes for lightning to strike has been reduced to one second, regardless of the skill Rank.[list][*]This change does not apply to enemies.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[u][b]Blaze[/b][/u]
[list][*]While charging Blaze, stun is now ignored, and no longer cancels the skill.[list][*]Being knocked down will still cancel Blaze.[/*][*]Attacks that inflict a special stun will still cancel Blaze.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[u][b]Hail Storm[/b][/u]

[u][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1835/mabinogi-talent-update-hail-storm.gif[/img][/b][/u]
[list][*]Hail Storm can now be used with Spellwalk, enabling you to walk freely while the skill is charging, or while having active Hail Storm charges.[/*][/list]
[u][b]Spellwalk[/b][/u]
[list][*]The way Stamina is consumed for Spellwalk has been changed.[list][*]Stamina no longer decreases while Spellwalk is active.[/*][*]Stamina will only decrease when moving while charging a skill, or before using a skill that has been charged.[list][*]This only applies to skills that you cannot normally move with without Spellwalk active.[/*][*]10 Stamina points are consumed per second in this state.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[u][b]Meteor Strike[/b][/u]

[u][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1844/mabinogi-talent-update-meteor-strike.gif[/img][/b][/u]
[list][*]The damage of Meteor Strike has been increased.[list][*]This increased damage also applies to some enemies.[/*][/list][/*][*]The casting time of Meteor Strike has been reduced to 2 seconds from 4 seconds.[list][*]This change does not apply to enemies.[/*][/list][/*][*]The time it takes for Meteor Strike to hit has been reduced to 2 seconds from 5 seconds.[list][*]This change does not apply to enemies.[/*][/list][/*][*]The damage reduction based on the distance furthest from the center of impact has been removed.[/*][/list]

[h2][b]Close Combat[/b][/h2]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1830/mabinogi-talent-update-close-combat.png[/img][/b]

[u][b]Skill Changes[/b][/u]

[u][b]Windmill[/b][/u]

[u][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1853/mabinogi-talent-update-windmill.gif[/img][/b][/u]
[list][*]The maximum damage per Rank has been increased.[list][*][b]Example -[/b] Based on Rank 1 of the skill:[list][*]Human/Giant: 250% -> 400%[/*][*]Elf: 200% -> 320%[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Windmill's attack range has been increased depending on the Rank of the skill.[/*][*]When you have a melee Combat talent weapon equipped and are using Windmill, enemies hit by Windmill are knocked down in place. They are no longer knocked back and scattered.[list][*]This change does not apply to enemies who use Windmill.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[u][b]Charge/Lance Charge[/b][/u]
[list][*]The position lag issue when using Charge/Lance Charge has been improved.[/*][/list]
[u][b]Assault Slash[/b][/u]
[list][*]Assault Slash's cooldown has been reduced to 7 seconds across all Ranks.[/*][*]The activation speed has been increased when using Assault Slash after Smash.[/*][/list]

[h2][b]Alchemy[/b][/h2]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1841/mabinogi-talent-update-alchemy.png[/img][/b]

[u][b]System Changes[/b][/u]

[u][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1854/mabinogi-talent-update-alchemic-damage.png[/img][/b][/u]
[list][*][b]Alchemic Damage[/b] has been added to the Character Information menu.[list][*]It now shows stats for Fire, Water, Wind, and Earth attributes based on the character's equipped titles, gear, and talent bonuses.[/*][/list][/*][*]The stats that affect Alchemy have been changed.
[list][*]Damage is increased by the average of the character's Max HP, Max MP, and Max Stamina.[/*][*]The affected skills are as follows:[list][*]Water Cannon[/*][*]Flame Burst[/*][*]Wind Blast[/*][*]Heat Buster[/*][*]Sand Burst[/*][*]Frozen Blast[/*][*]Shock[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[u][b]Skill Changes[/b][/u]

[u][b]Water Cannon[/b][/u]
[list][*]Water Cannon has been changed to apply a fixed maximum damage amount regardless of the distance from the target.[list][*]This change does not apply to enemies.[/*][*][b]Before:[/b] Base damage 1x * Damage by Distance from target (0.6x to 1.4x)[/*][*][b]After:[/b] Base damage 1x * Distance 1.4x[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[u][b]Flame Burst[/b][/u]

[u][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1834/mabinogi-talent-update-flame-burst.gif[/img][/b][/u]
[list][*]Flame Burst's duration has been increased for some Ranks of Flame Burst.[/*][*]If the new duration includes a time less than 1 second, the Flame hit will be calculated as 1 second.[list][*]In this case, the last hit of Flame Burst will deal damage proportional to the original duration.[list][*][b]Example: [/b]If the duration of Flame Burst's usage is 4.2 seconds, it will hit 5 times over 5 seconds. The last hit will be applied at 20% of the damage of 1 hit.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[u][b]Wind Blast[/b][/u]

[u][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1839/mabinogi-talent-update-wind-blast.gif[/img][/b][/u]
[list][*]Wind Blast's activation structure has been changed to be activated by clicking the ground after casting.[/*][*]When activated, enemies within a 4 meter radius around the character are pushed in one direction.[list][*]Enemies behind the character are pushed in the direction the character is facing.[/*][*]This change does not apply to enemies.[/*][/list][/*][*]The reforge option, Wind Blast Range, has been changed to Wind Blast Attack Range.[list][*]Previously, the reforge started at 1 meter, and increased the range by 0.25 meters per level.[/*][*]This has now been changed to an option that increases the attack range by 0.15 meters per level.[/*][/list][/*][*]The Stardust Support Effect for Wind Blast has been changed from Blast to Flare.[/*][/list]
[u][b]Heat Buster[/b][/u]

[u][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1837/mabinogi-talent-update-heat-buster.gif[/img][/b][/u]
[list][*]Heat Buster has been changed so that you can activate this skill when the cylinder pressure is 50% or higher.[list][*]Previously, it required 100% cylinder pressure.[/*][/list][/*][*]When activated, the damage is proportional to the pressure amount.[list][*][b]Example: [/b]When activated at 50% pressure, it is activated at 50% damage.[/*][/list][/*][*]When activated at maximum pressure, an additional 20% damage is inflicted as before.[/*][/list]
[u][b]Life Drain[/b][/u]

[u][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1858/mabinogi-talent-update-life-drain.png[/img][/b][/u]
[list][*]Life Drain can now be activated even when you have Max HP.[/*][/list]
[u][b]Summon Golem[/b][/u]
[list][*]The stats of the summoned Golem's HP, Magic Defense, and Magic Protection have been increased.[/*][*]The casting time and attack time of the summoned Golem's Smash, Defense, and Windmill skills have been reduced.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where the summoned Golem's Taunt skill did not have a cooldown.[/*][/list]

[h2][b]Puppetry[/b][/h2]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1838/mabinogi-talent-update-puppetry.png[/img][/b]

[u][b]System Changes[/b][/u]

[u][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1855/mabinogi-talent-update-marionette-info.png[/img][/b][/u]
[list][*][b]Marionette Information [/b]can now be viewed in the Character Information menu. [list][*]It outlines the stats of the summoned marionette and can only be viewed when a marionette is summoned.[/*][*]This menu can also be opened by right-clicking the summoned marionette character and clicking on "View Status".[/*][/list][/*][*]A new option has been added.[list][*]Options -> Game -> Controls -> [b]Use Marionette Camera[/b][list][*]When activated, the camera moves around the doll instead of the player.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Marionettes can now pick up items.[/*][/list]
[u][b]Skill Changes[/b][/u]

[u][b]Control Marionette[/b][/u]

[u][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1857/mabinogi-talent-update-puppetry-dismount-pet.gif[/img][/b][/u]
[list][*]The Control Marionette skill has been changed so that if the marionette summon is canceled due to mounting a pet, the marionette will be summoned automatically after dismounting the pet. [list][*]The Control Marionette skill will also be activated after dismounting the pet.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[u][b]Act 1: Inciting Incident[/b][/u]
[list][*]The base damage of Act 1: Inciting Incident has been increased.[list][*][b]Example - [/b]Based on Rank 1 of the skill:[list][*]200% -> 300% damage[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[u][b]Act 2: Threshold Cutter[/b][/u]

[u][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1843/mabinogi-talent-update-act-2.gif[/img][/b][/u]
[list][*]The base damage of Act 2: Threshold Cutter has been increased.[list][*][b]Example[/b] - Based on Rank 1 of the skill:[list][*]700% -> 960% damage[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The character and marionette motion when using the skill has been changed.[/*][*]The skill has been changed to an AoE attack skill that simultaneously attacks enemies within a 2 meter radius from the original targeted enemy.[/*][*]Attack speed has been increased.[/*][*]The Stardust Support Effect for Act 2: Threshold Cutter has been changed from Blast to Flare.[/*][/list]
[u][b]Act 4: Rising Action[/b][/u]
[list][*]The base damage of Act 4: Rising Action has been increased.[list][*][b]Example - [/b]Based on Rank 1 of the skill:[list][*]300% -> 560% damage[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[u][b]Act 6: Crisis[/b][/u]
[list][*]The invincibility duration of enemies hit by the skill has been removed.[/*][/list]
[u][b]Act 7: Climactic Crash[/b][/u]

[u][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1847/mabinogi-talent-update-act-7.gif[/img][/b][/u]
[list][*]The base damage of Act 7: Climactic Crash has been increased.[list][*][b]Example - [/b]Based on Rank 1 of the skill:[list][*]550% -> 860% damage[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]It has been changed so that the control of the marionette is not canceled after the attack is completed so long as the position of the marionette is within the control range.[/*][*]The enemy is knocked back in the same direction as the skill casting direction, increasing the probability of enemies being hit by all 3 hits.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where the marionette would not move intermittently when using the skill in front of obstacles.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where you are intermittently unable to attack enemies when using the skill in front of obstacles.[/*][/list]

[h2][b]Archery[/b][/h2]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1845/mabinogi-talent-update-archery.png[/img][/b]

[u][b]System Changes[/b][/u]

[u][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1831/mabinogi-talent-update-archery-rework.gif[/img][/b][/u]
[list][*]Archery has been changed so that regardless of the aiming rate, the Archery Talent attack will always hit an enemy.[list][*]If attacking outside of the attack range, the attack will miss.[/*][/list][/*][*]The damage is determined by the character's minimum/maximum damage in proportion to the aiming rate at the time of the attack.[list][*]When the aiming rate is 100%, the minimum/maximum damage is 100% reflected.[/*][/list][/*][*]Various effects that previously affected accuracy have been changed to now affect aiming rate.[list][*]Certain text descriptions that mention Accuracy have been changed to Aim Rate.[/*][/list][/*][*]The delay time when aiming from 99% to 100% is now removed.[/*][*]The effect that appears when the aiming rate is 100% has been changed to now appear when the aiming rate is 70%.[/*][*]A bonus to the aim rate is now applied when reaching 70% aim rate, regardless of the aiming speed.[list][*]This change only applies to player characters.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[u][b]Item Changes[/b][/u]
[list][*]The [b]Bow[/b] and [b]Crossbow Erg Bonus Effects[/b] have been changed.[list][*][b]Before: [/b]"Skill cooldown upon aim failure"
[list][*][u]Decreased time by seconds per Erg level[/u][/*][/list][/*][*][b]After: [/b]"Archery Skill Cooldown"
[list][*][u]Decreased time by seconds per Erg level[/u][/*][/list][/*][*]The Erg effect reduction value per level has been decreased[list][*][b]Example - [/b]Based on level 50 Erg:[list][*]Max 2 seconds -> 1 second[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Various arrows and bolts can now be bundled up to 500 pieces.[list][*]The number of bundles of arrows/bolts sold by weapon shop NPCs has increased.[/*][/list][/*][*]1,000 arrows can now be inserted into the Quiver.[/*][*]The [b]Piercing Forest Arrow[/b] description has been corrected to include the additional 12% maximum damage bonus.[/*][/list]
[u][b]Skill Changes[/b][/u]

[u][b]Crash Shot[/b][/u]

[u][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1859/mabinogi-talent-update-crash-shot.png[/img][/b][/u]
[list][*]Crash Shot has been changed so that the fragment attack occurs at the same time as Crash Shot hits an enemy.[list][*]This change does not apply to enemies.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[u][b]Urgent Shot[/b][/u]
[list][*]Urgent Shot has been changed so that you can use the skill regardless if the previous attack hit or missed.[/*][*]Skill cooldown has been increased.[list][*][b]Example - [/b]Based on Rank 1:
[list][*]10 seconds[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The skill training requirement has been changed.[list][*][b]Before: [/b]"Use the skill successfully immediately after missing."[/*][*][b]After:[/b] "Use Urgent Shot to defeat an enemy."[/*][/list][/*][*]The Glyph Effect for Urgent Shot has been changed.[list][*][b]Before: [/b]"Urgent Shot Available Time"[list][*][u]Increased by 0.05 seconds per level[/u][/*][/list][/*][*][b]After: [/b]"Urgent Shot Cooldown Decreased"[list][*][u]Decreased by 0.2 seconds per level[/u][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[u][b]Final Shot[/b][/u]
[list][*]When using Final Shot, you can now immediately activate the skill without casting time.[list][*]Previously, the casting time was 2 seconds.[/*][/list][/*][*]The duration of the skill has been increased.[list][*][b]Example - [/b]Based on Rank 1:[list][*]30 seconds -> 45 seconds[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Skill cooldown has been reduced.[list][*][b]Example - [/b]Based on Rank 1:[list][*]260 seconds -> 240 seconds[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The skill has been changed so that the durability of the equipped weapon does not decrease when using the skill.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Stardust Part 1 - Patch Notes - July 15th, 2021
notes.notes:
Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the first part of the Stardust Update!

[b]The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:[/b]
[list][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/67491/ocean-traveler-pet-box]Ocean Traveler Pet Box[/url]: Thursday, July 1st, After Maintenance - Thursday, July 29th, Before Maintenance[url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/66893/enchanting-peacock-box]
[/url][/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/67651/2021-summer-master-plan]2021 Summer Master Plan[/url]: Thursday, July 8th, After Maintenance - Thursday, September 2nd, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/67701/shoot-for-the-stars]Shoot for the Stars![/url]: Thursday, July 15th, After Maintenance - Thursday, August 19th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/67702/troubadour-s-box]Troubadour's Box[/url]: Thursday, July 15th, After Maintenance - Thursday, August 12th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/micro-site/stardust]Stardust Part 1[/url]: Permanent[/*][/list]
[b]Stardust Part 1 Update[/b]
[list][*]Discover the power of Stardust with [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/micro-site/stardust]Stardust: Part 1[/url]! [/*][*]After reaching [b]cumulative level 3,000[/b], help out the Royal Society of Astronomy by starting the quest [b][Guide] An Astronomical Discovery[/b] found in the "Society Sponsorship" quest tab.[/*][*]Learn more about the new Stardust System through the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/guide/advancedguide/general/67779/stardust-stardust-info-and-support-effects-guide]guide[/url]. 
[list][*]The Stardust equippable item can be obtained from the Stardust quest, [b][Guide] Stardust Cores and Regulators.[/b][/*][*]Equip the Stardust in a new special Stardust item slot in the bottom left of your main Inventory.[/*][*]Right-click the Stardust item to view [b]“Stardust Info”[/b].[/*][*]The Stardust Info menu details all things Stardust, including your Stardust Rank, Support Effects, and materials for Stardust. 
[list][*]Stardust Rank can be advanced up to Rank 10 in Part 1.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Learn more about the Royal Society of Astronomy Society Sponsorship quests through the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/guide/advancedguide/general/67713/stardust-royal-society-sponsorship-guide]guide[/url].
[list][*]Complete Society Sponsorship Quests to receive new materials necessary for ranking up your Stardust Rank and strengthening your Stardust Support Effects.[/*][/list][/*][*]The [b]Total Skill Level[/b] has been added on the Additional Info tab of the Character Info menu, and can also be found at the bottom of the Skill window.
[list][*]Total Combat Skill Level and Total Life Skill Level can be increased by ranking certain skills.[/*][*]All skills that have already been ranked will be reflected in the Total Skill Level.[/*][*]The higher the Total Combat Skill Level and Total Life Skill Level, the higher difficulty ranks of the Society Sponsored Quests will be available.[/*][/list][/*][*]Receive [b]Royal Society Sponsorship Badges[/b] to purchase items in Melwyn’s Shop.[/*][*]A new Title and Journal Achievements are available when completing Society Sponsorship Quests.[/*][*]New Intermediate Dungeons and Shadow Missions have been added, and new Enchant Scrolls can be obtained as rewards.[list][*]Intermediate Dungeon Passes can be purchased from the Researcher near the Poulnabrone Rock in Dunbarton.[/*][*]Elite Passes for the new Shadow Missions can be obtained from the mission end chests in Tara and Taillteann.[/*][/list][/*][*]The new Shadow Missions will be added as a possible Daily Mission for the [b]Today's Daily Mission[/b] daily quest.[/*][*]Completing each new Intermediate Dungeon and Shadow Mission (all difficulties) will grant a Journal Achievement.[/*][/list]

[b]Math Intermediate Enchants[/b]
[b][i]Bear Hunter[/i][/b]
- Prefix: Rank A
- Enchant enabled for weapons
- When Smash is Rank 9 or higher, Min Damage +6-9
- When Windmill is Rank 9 or higher, Max Damage +6-9
- Max HP +100
[b][i]Lucky Punch[/i][/b]
- Suffix: Rank A
- Enchant enabled for knuckles
- When Knuckle Mastery is Rank 9 or higher, Damage Balance +10%
- When Combo Mastery is Rank 9 or higher, Min Damage +10-20
- When Combo: Charging Strike is Rank 8 or higher, Max Damage +24
- Will +30

[b]Rabbie Intermediate Enchants[/b]
[b][i]Sniper's[/i][/b]
- Prefix: Rank A
- Enchant enabled for dual guns

notes.title: A Fresh Memory Update Preview
notes.notes:
Help Blaanid recover her lost memories with the revamped Memoir questline! Obtain new rewards, level up your character, and train your skills as you proceed through your journey in Erinn. Don't forget to read our [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/66448/memory-book-renewal-announcement]previous announcement[/url] to see what is being changed/removed in this update. Check out the details below.

[h2][b]Blaanid's Brave Boost[/b][/h2][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q2/1261/mabinogi-boost-up.png[/img]
With the new Blaanid's Brave Boost quests, you can level up quickly and earn AP!
[list][*]If your cumulative level is less than 5,000, completing Blaanid's Brave Boost quests grants 5x EXP.[/*][*]AP is also doubled when leveling up.[list][*]This effect is applied only with the experience obtained through Blaanid's Brave Boost quests. AP is earned at a fixed rate of 2, regardless of the use of items that affect the amount AP that can be earned.[/*][/list][/*][*]Whenever you complete a quest, you will receive a Rebirth Potion. [list][*]If you leveled up by completing a quest, reset your level by rebirthing.[/*][*]Please note that you will only receive a Rebirth Potion if you are under cumulative level 5,000.[/*][/list][/*][*]When a Rebirth Potion is used, the waiting time for rebirthing is reset, and you can rebirth immediately.[/*][*]Only characters under cumulative level 5,000 can use the Rebirth Potion given.[/*][/list]
[/url]
[h2][b]Memoir Books[/b][/h2][list][*]There are four Memoir books you will need to complete.[/*][*]Each Memoir book will show you different aspects of the game. [list][*][b]The First Memoir:[/b]
[list][*]Rebirthing[/*][*]Traveler's Guide[/*][*]Basics of Battle [/*][*]Potions[/*][*]Inventory Window[/*][*]Gold Boxes[/*][*]Titles[/*][*]Healing[/*][*]Flying Pets[/*][/list][/*][*][b]The Second Memoir: [/b]
[list][*]How to Acquire Basic Skills[/*][*]Upgrading Equipment[/*][*]Reforging Equipment[/*][*]Repairing Equipment[/*][*]Enchanting Equipment[/*][*]Uladh Dungeons[/*][*]Shadow Missions[/*][*]Baltane Missions[/*][*]Exploration Quests[/*][*]Commerce[/*][*]Food[/*][*]Buffs from Food and Music[/*][*]Festia[/*][*]Homesteads[/*][/list][/*][*][b]The Third Memoir:[/b][list][*]Music Basics[/*][*]Cleric Basics[/*][*]Life Basics[/*][*]Close Combat Basics[/*][*]Chain Blade Basics[/*][/list][/*][*][b]The Fourth Memoir:[/b][list][*]Archery Talent[/*][*]Magic Talent[/*][*]Fighter Talent[/*][*]Puppeteer Talent[/*][*]Gunslinger Talent[/*][*]Ninja Talent[/*][*]Battle Alchemy Talent[/*][*]Chain Slash Talent[/*][*]Crusader Training[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q2/1257/mabinogi-memoir-book-ui.png[/img]

[/url]
[h2][b]Improved Quests[/b][/h2][list][*]Any quests that require you to move a long distance from your current location will now allow you to teleport for free. Click on the Wing icon in the Memoir Book to teleport![/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q2/1254/mabinogi-wings-icon-memoir.png[/img]
[list][*]Easily followed explanations are now available in Blaanid's Memoir books along with improved images.[/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q2/1280/mabinogi-image-tips.png[/img]
[list][*]Blaanid will also give you various tips and guidance throughout Blaanid's Memoir questline.[/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q2/1284/mabinogi-blaanid-guide-image.png[/img]

[/url]
[h2][b]Enhanced Content[/b][/h2][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q2/1255/mabinogi-blaanid-cutscene-image.png[/img][list][*]The Memoir questline has been improved with more emotional scenarios, various cutscenes, and images.[/*][*]Korean voice over has been added for Blaanid, as well as new BGM.[list][*]You can turn off the voice over by going to Options -> Sound -> Voice Volume.[/*][/list][/*][/list]

[list][*]Fixed an issue where the Kraken Rex boss would fail to spawn in Awakened Abyssal Lord Tech Duinn Missions.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where the thread effects for Puppetry and Gunslinger skills did not appear properly.[/*][*]Fixed and issue where the Lucky Beast Doll Bag and the Far Darrig Doll Bag's +10 Luck effect did not stack with each other.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where items that changed character's skin would cause broken interactions with Transformations.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where the Little Hopper pet was unable to be used with two players.[/*][*]Fixed a minor typo in the dialogue with the quest "The Demon Lord of Pixel World - Act 3".[/*][*]Fixed an issue where the Friends List would display the message "Attempting to access Friends List".[/*][/list]

notes.title: 13th Anniversary - Patch Notes - March 18, 2021
notes.notes:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q3/2765/200922_patchnotes_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg[/img]

Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the 13th Anniversary Update!

[b]The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:[/b]
[list][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/65234/return-of-the-playful-puzzle]Return of the Playful Puzzle[/url]: Thursday, March 4th, After Maintenance - Thursday, May 27th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/65316/sweet-academy-box]Sweet Academy Box[/url]: Thursday, March 4th, After Maintenance - Thursday, April 1st, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/65744/magnificent-wings-box]Magnificent Wings Box[/url]: Thursday, March 18th, After Maintenance - Thursday, April 15th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/65683/13th-anniversary-update-preview]13th Anniversary Update[/url]: Thursday, March 18th, After Maintenance - Thursday, April 8th, Before Maintenance[/*][/list]
[b]13th Anniversary Update:[/b]
[list][*]Happy Anniversary, Milletians! Celebrate the 13th Anniversary of Mabinogi with tons of festivities and earn amazing rewards! Check out the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/65684/13th-anniversary-celebration]event page[/url] for in-depth details![list][*]Talk to Thirteen in Festia to start the 13th Anniversary celebration.[/*][*]Complete daily and weekly quests to receive 13th Anniversary Coins, 13th Anniversary Special Gift Boxes, and 13th Anniversary Instant Prize Tickets.[/*][*]How fast can you type? Compete in the Balloon Popping Mini-game and see how you stack up against other Milletians.[/*][*]Grow some mysterious balloons and hand them over to Balune the Balloon Artists for daily rewards.[/*][*]Test your strength with the Clobbermeister Mini-game![/*][*]Conquer the waves of enemies within the Cave of Trials to receive prizes and event titles celebrating your achievements! The title rewards will replace your existing Cave of Trials titles if you've been through the scenario previously.[/*][*]Use gold or 13th Anniversary Instant Prize Tickets from different events at the Capsule Machine in Festia.[/*][*]Exchange your 13th Anniversary Coins for special prizes![/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Spirit Transformation Liqueur Update:[/b]
[list][*]You can now have up to 3 Spirit Transformation Liqueurs on your Spirit Weapons.[/*][*]You no longer need to go to Berched to apply a Spirit Transformation Liqueur.[list][*]You can apply a Spirit Transformation Liqueur by simply clicking on it in your inventory.[/*][/list][/*][*]You can switch between the different Spirit Transformation Liqueurs in the Spirit Information UI.[/*][*]To remove a Spirit Transformation Liqueur, right-click on the icon in the Spirit Information UI.[list][*[b]IMPORTANT: [/b]If you remove a Spirit Transformation Liqueur from a Spirit Weapon, you will [b]NOT[/b] receive the removed Spirit Transformation Liqueur item.[b]
[/b][/*][/list][/*][*][b]Note:[/b]Some Spirit Weapons may have overlapping text in the Spirit Transformation section of the UI and the Awakening Skill Enhancement section.[/*][/list]
[b]Chain Slash Skills Fix and Compensation:[/b]
[list][*]Fixed an issue with the Spinning Slasher and Death Mark skills not giving stats when ranking from Rank 2 to Rank 1.[list][*]To receive the missing stats with the Spinning Slasher and Death Mark skills, you will need to rebirth with the age and level reset checked on after the fix is live.[/*][/list][/*][*]Users that have been affected by this issue will receive the following compensation:[list][*]Rebirth Potion x1[/*][*]Skill Reset Capsule x2[/*][*]Perfect Skill Reset Capsule x1[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]The following bug fixes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]Fixed the dungeon information for Erinn Martial Arts Competition in the Dungeon Guide UI to specify Final Round.[/*][*]Fixed the pop-up notice message to clarify that you cannot have more than one Check Folio in your inventory. [/*][*]Fixed the Autumnal Diligence Suit (M) outfit animation that had slight blinking near the bottom pockets.
[list][*]Fixed the slight cutoff of hair texture when wearing a wig with the outfit.[/*][/list][/*][*]Fixed a typo in the pop-up notice message when an unknown error occurs when adding a friend or blacklisting a player.[/*][*]Fixed the Slurp gesture animation; the animation now displays the teacup in your hand.[/*][*]Fixed a quest progression issue in the G1 quest, "Fomor Medal".[/*][*]Fixed a typo in the Taurus Balloon item description.[/*][*]Fixed a typo in the stats for "the Price is Wright" title.[/*][/list]
[b]The following are known bugs:[/b]
[list][*]The thread effects for the Puppetry and Gunslinger skills do not appear properly.[/*][*]The Large Ladle weapon will display as the same item color as the equipped item in the other hand.[/*][*]The Lucky Beast Doll Bag and Far Darrig Doll Bag's +10 Luck effects don't stack with each other.[/*][*]Using the Golden Supplement can sometimes cause a pet to receive negative EXP on the pet's EXP bar.[/*][*]There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".[/*][*]There are script errors when opening the cash shop in-game.[/*][*]There is a Friend's list issue where it displays the message "Attempting to access Friends List".[list][*]This issue does not occur for all players.[/*][/list][/*][*]The Little Hopper is unable to be used with two players.[/*][*]The Kraken Rex boss fails to spawn in Awakened Abyssal Lord Tech Duinn Missions sometimes.[list][*]This issue does not occur for all players.[/*][/list][/*][*]There is a game crash suspected to be related to the Intel Graphic Series.[list][*]This issue does not occur for all players.[/*][/list][/*][*]Some players' hotkeys and pet menu settings reset after logging out.[/*][/list]

[list][*]The Crystal Ball in the Dunbarton Library has been updated![list][*]You can now view cutscenes from Chapter 6 (G19, G20, G21) and Chapter 7 (G22, G23, G24, G25).[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]The following bug fixes and changes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]Fixed an issue where a disconnection error would ask players to reset their secondary password.[/*][*]Fixed a typo in Llywelyn's special dialogue to address Altam as Commander.[/*][*]Fixed a typo in Avelin's dialogue in "A Wavering Gaze".[/*][*]Fixed a typo in Enya's dialogue in "Another Path".[/*][*]Fixed an issue with the Cat-Shaped Mask (Face Accessory Slot Exclusive) when it is equipped with a hat, the hat either is not visible or the Cat-Shaped Mask (Face Accessory Slot Exclusive) loses textures.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where a button on Doll Bags was previously untranslated.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where the Crazy Rich Milletian Fur Scarf did not appear when worn with Macha Hair.[/*][*]Fixed a typo in Marleid's dialogue in "The Old Blood".[/*][*]Fixed a typo in Enya's dialogue in "White Wisps of Breath".[/*][*]Fixed a typo in "Slicing Through the Silence".[/*][*]Fixed an issue where you could not gift Score Scrolls to the Laighlinne partner.[/*][*]The Floral Fairy Walk 2nd Title Coupon and the Special Floral Fairy Walk 2nd Title Coupon are now tradeable.[/*][/list]
[b]The following are known bugs:[/b]
[list][*]The thread effects for the Puppetry and Gunslinger skills do not appear properly.[/*][*]The Large Ladle weapon will display as the same item color as the equipped item in the other hand.[/*][*]Slight effects issues with White-Crested Sage's Eyes, Sage's Eye, Forlorn Eyes (Teary-Eyed), Awakened Eyes (Frenzied Red), and Eyes of Madness (Explosive Blue).[/*][*]Minor graphical issues with Soldier's Combat Raincoat.[/*][*]There is a known issue where characters can no longer "queue" gathering actions.[/*][*]The Lucky Beast Doll Bag and Far Darrig Doll Bag's +10 Luck effects don't stack with each other.[/*][*]Using the Golden Supplement can sometimes cause a pet to receive negative EXP on the pet's EXP bar.[/*][*]There are minor graphical issues when holding any of the 4 lantern weapons.[/*][*]There are minor graphical issues when wearing the Autumnal Outfits:[/*][list][*]If you are a female Giant, there is a slight clipping of the hands during the special outfit animation.[/*][*]If you are a female character, there is clipping of the wrist texture when wearing the Autumnal gloves.[/*][*]If you are a female character, the Autumnal outfit will clip at the bottom when holding a Cup o' Joe.[/*][*]If you are a male Human or Elf, sitting in a chair while wearing the Autumnal outfit will cause the chair to sink lower than with other outfits.[/*][*]If you are a male character, the Autumnal outfit animation will have a slight blinking issue near the bottom pockets.[/*][*]If you are a male character, there will be a slight cutoff of the hair texture when you wear a wig with the outfit.[/*][*]If a character is equipped with an umbrella item and uses the Jump action, the character's mouth with display as a smile until you change channels or log out.[/*][/list][*]There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".[/*][*]There are script errors when opening the cash shop in-game.[/*][*]While crafting Magic Ink with the Stationery Crafting skill, the item required says "[Color] Dye". It should say "[Color] Paint".[/*][*]Some Glyph effects say "Chain: [Fighter Skill]". It should say "Combo: [Fighter Skill]".[/*][/list]

notes.notes:
Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the Dungeon Guide System update!

[h2][b]The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:[/b][/h2]
[list][*][url=http://mabinogi.nexon.net/News/All/1/00JLJ/]Playful Puzzle Returns![/url]: Thursday, September 24th, After Maintenance - Thursday, December 24th, Before Maintenance[/*]	[*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/News/Announcements/1/00JLf]Attendance Check Event[/url]: Thursday, October 22nd, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 19th, Before Maintenance[/*]	[*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/News/Announcements/1/00JLk]Steam Engineer Toolbox[/url]: Thursday, October 29th, After Maintenance - Wednesday, November 25th, Before Maintenance[/*]	[*][url=http://mabinogi.nexon.net/News/All/1/00JLt/]Dungeon Drop Rate Increase Event[/url]: Thursday, November 12th, After Maintenance - Thursday, December 17th, Before Maintenance[/*]	[*][url=http://mabinogi.nexon.net/News/All/1/00JLr/]Generation Boost Event[/url]: Thursday, November 12th, After Maintenance - Thursday, December 10th, Before Maintenance[/*]	[*][url=http://mabinogi.nexon.net/News/All/1/00JM1/]Weapon and Pet Rental[/url]: Thursday, November 12th, After Maintenance - Thursday, February 11th, Before Maintenance[/*]	[*][url=http://mabinogi.nexon.net/News/All/1/00JLq/]Dark Divination Box[/url]: Thursday, November 12th, After Maintenance - Thursday, December 10th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=http://mabinogi.nexon.net/News/All/1/00JLs/]Dungeon Guide System[/url]: Permanent[/*]	[/list]	

[h2][b]Dungeon Guide System:[/b][/h2]
[list][*]The Dungeon Guide System update is now live! Easily see which dungeons you've cleared or find new dungeons to explore with the new Dungeon Guide UI. You can also earn a ton of rewards and buy items from a brand new shop. [/*]	[list]	[*]You can check out the full details of the Dungeon Guide System update [url=http://mabinogi.nexon.net/News/All/1/00JLs/]in the guide![/url][/*]	[*]You can access the Dungeon Guide UI by clicking on the Info tab, and selecting Dungeon Guide.[/*]	[*]Each dungeon and mission listed on the Dungeon Guide UI will show information about that dungeon/mission. It will also show some of the main rewards of that dungeon/mission, as well as the guaranteed repeated dungeon clear rewards.[/*]	[*]Clearing dungeons or missions multiple times will have guaranteed rewards. You can obtain these rewards in the Dungeon Guide UI.[/*]	[*]Each dungeon or mission can only be repeated 10 times per account per real life day. The repeat timer resets at 12 AM server time.[/*]	[*]The Dungeon Guide UI will also show recommended dungeons based on your physical or magical damage output.[/*]	[*]Completing certain dungeons will yield you Support Boxes that will aid your character in getting stronger.[/*]	[*]There is a new shop that you can access via Eavan in Dunbarton.[/*]	[*]To purchase items in this shop, you will need Vouchers.[/*]	[*]Vouchers can be obtained by registering a main character at Eavan and completing dungeons/missions.[/*]	[*]You are able to change your registered character once per day after registering.[/*]	[*]There are 4 different types of Vouchers that you can obtain in different dungeons and missions.[/*]	[/list][/list]	

[h2][b]Permanent Changes:[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Dungeon Changes[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The 8-Player Dungeon event will be turned on permanently with the Dungeon Guide update.[/*][*]You are now able to enter any of the following dungeons with 8 players on any difficulty:[/*]	[list]	[*]Alby[/*]	[*]Ciar[/*]	[*]Rabbie[/*]	[*]Math[/*]	[*]Fiodh[/*]	[*]Barri[/*]	[*]Coill[/*]	[*]Rundal[/*]	[*]Peaca[/*]	[/list][/list]

[h3][b]Chapter 7: Apocalypse Changes[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The required level to start Chapter 7: Apocalypse has been reduced from level 5,000 to level 3,000.[/*][*]All enemy stats and skill ranks have been nerfed.[/*][/list]

[h3][b]G22: Apocalypse Changes[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The following changes have been made to the G22 mission, "Chance and Destiny":[/*]	[list]	[*]In the last phase of the mission, the amount of time that you need to survive the wave of enemies is now displayed on screen.[/*]	[*]The mission will not fail if the player is knocked out. You are able to revive and continue the mission.[/*]	[/list][*]The following changes have been made to the G22 mission, "Wheel of Misfortune":[/*]	[list]	[*]During the last phase of the mission, the target submerges into the water, but does not move too far.[/*]	[*]An issue where Dorcha Snatch was not counted as a hit to the target has been fixed.[/*]	[*]When using certain Chain Blades skills that cannot hit the target, a message containing instructions will appear.[/*]	[/list][*]The following change has been made to the G22 mission, "Holy Barrier":[/*]	[list]	[*]Picking an incorrect answer will no longer cause the mission to fail.[/*]	[/list][*]The following changes have been made to the G22 quests, "In Search of Clues 1-7" and "Collect Clues 1-4":[/*]	[list]	[*]The amount of glowing spots that you needs to find during "In Search of Clues 1" and "Collect Clues 1" has been reduced.[/*]	[*]The instruction text that guides you throughout "In Search of Clues 1" and "Collect Clues 1" has been improved.[/*]	[*]Directional markings have been added to lead you to the destination in the quests "In Search of Clues 2" and "Collect Clues 2".[/*]	[*]A location marker has been added to the NPC that needs to be found in the quest "In Search of Clues 3".[/*]	[*]The mission guide dialogue has been improved in the quest "In Search of Clues 3".[/*]	[*]The cooking difficulty for the quest "In Search of Clues 5" has been drastically reduced.[/*]	[/list][*]The following change has been made to the G22 quests, "Seven Eyelids", "Phantoms Among the Snow", "A Memory of Emain to the G22 quest, "The Broken Prison Gate":[/*]	[list]	[*]You are now able to proceed with the quest, even if you do not have the skill, Life Drain.[/*]	[/list][*]The following change has been made to the G22 quest, "Seeking the Last Symbols":[/*]	[list]	[*]The instruction text that appears during the quest has been improved.[/*]	[/list][*]The following change has been made to the G22 mission, "Executive Discretion":[/*]	[list]	[*]The amount of time you need to survive the wave of enemies will now be displayed on screen.[/*]	[/list][*]The following change has been made to the G22 mission, "Castling":[/*]	[list]	[*]A message to better understand the mission progress has been added.[/*]	[/list][*]The following changes have been made to the G22 mission, "A False Promise":[/*]	[list]	[*]The damaging field left by Salamanders and the damage from the Salamanders has been reduced.[/*]	[*]The duration of the summoned Fire Pillars and the damaging fields that appear have been reduced.[/*]	[*]The overall damage from the boss enemy has been reduced.[/*]	[/list][/list]

[h3][b]G23: Tempest Changes[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The following changes have been made to the G23 quest, "Winter Festival":[/*]	[list]	[*]The hints provided for the Quiz Contest will be more direct.[/*]	[*]You are now able to skip the sliding Picture Puzzle mini-game.[/*]	[/list][*]The following change has been made to the G23 quest, "Preparing for the Plague":[/*]	[list]	[*]The number of quest items needed to proceed with the made to the G23 mission, "Nightmare's Embrace":[/*]	[list]	[*]Enemy stats in the mission have been nerfed.[/*]	[*]The chance of the enemy using Thunder has been drastically decreased.[/*]	[*]You are now able to revive in the mission using Nao Stones.[/*]	[/list][*]The following change has been made to the G23 quest, "Generations":[/*]	[list]	[*]The drop chance of the quest item is now set to 100%.[/*]	[/list][*]The following change has been made to the G23 quest, "On the Brink":[/*]	[list]	[*]The warp device's recovery rate has been increased by 1.5x.[/*]	[/list][*]The following changes have been made to the G23 mission, "Who Rules the Sea":[/*]	[list]	[*]Some skill damage from enemies has been nerfed.[/*]	[*]The amount of summoned enemies that you need to defeat has been decreased.[/*]	[*]The amount of summoned enemies appearing at the same time has been decreased.[/*]	[*]The chance of an enemy using Thunder has been drastically decreased.[/*]	[/list][*]The following changes have been made to the G23 mission, "Failed Hypothesis":[/*]	[list]	[*]While possessed by the enemy, the debuff effect has been decreased.[/*]	[*]When the enemy is enraged, the attack damage [list][*]The following changes have been made to the G24 mission, "Blue and White":[/*]	[list]	[*]The mission will no longer fail if you are knocked out. [h3][b]Technique Changes[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The cooldown time of the Techniques, Iron Will, Relentless Assault, and Exploit Weakness, has been changed to 10 minutes.[/*][*]The cooldown time of the Technique, Time Shift, has been changed to 15 minutes.[/*][/list]

[h3][b]Tory Ravine Changes[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Poison Alligator, Doubcha Saturos, and Doubcha Floating Stone will no longer attack on sight.[/*][*]You will no longer be invincible when talking to a G24 NPC.[/*][/list]
	

[h3][b]The following bug fixes and changes have been made to the game:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Fixed an issue where a disconnection error would ask players to reset their secondary password.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where cash items purchased with NX Credit required you to try and claim the items twice before it moves into your inventory.[/*][*]Fixed an issue with skill training EXP potions having the same name as EXP potions. Skill training EXP potions will name have "Skill" in the name.[/*][*]Fixed an issue with Shamala's Transformation Medal item tooltip displaying the incorrect name for Caravan Joe. The name has been changed to Halloween Caravan Joe.[/*][*]Fixed an issue with promotional crossover items appearing with random color when previewing in the Dressing Room.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where multiple items were previously not listable in the Auction House.[/*][/list]
[h3]
[b]The following are known bugs:[/b][/h3]

It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".[/*][*]There is an issue where you are unable to enter the Forgotten Tomb because it will say you are already in a Shadow Mission.[/*][/list]

[*]Additionally, the following searchable keywords have been added:[/*]
[list]
[*]Human[/*]
[*]Elf[/*]
[*]Giant[/*]
[*]Male[/*]
[*]Female[/*]
[/list]
[/list]
[*]When searching for specific options in the Auction House using the "Advanced Search Filter", the search filter is maintained even when refreshing the search.[/*]
[*]When listing an item in the Auction House, it has been changed so that you can modify the price amount after highlighting any area with the mouse.[/*]
[*]Added the "Yearly" market price range option when viewing an Item's Market Price Data in the Auction House.[/*]
[*]The speed of searching for item names in the Auction House has been improved.[/*]
[*]You can now list Pet Adoption Medals with stored pets on the Auction House.[/*]
[*]The following categories have been added to the Misc section of the Auction House:[/*]
[list]
[*]Beauty Coupon[/*]
[*]Adoption Medal[/*]
[list]
[*]The following advanced search filters have been added for Adoption Medals:[/*]
[list]
[*]Price[/*]
[*]Remaining number of adoptions[/*]
[*]Pet race name[/*]
[*]Pet cumulative level[/*]
[*]Pet points[/*]
[*]Pet type[/*]
[/list]
[/list]
[/list]
[*]You can now preview the following items in the Auction House:[/*]
[list]
[*]Shamala's Transformation Medals[/*]
[*]Beauty Coupon[/*]
[*]Appearance Scrolls[/*]
[*]Homestead Props[/*]
[*]Outfit animations[/*]
[/list]
[list]
[*]Additionally, the issue of seeing abnormal animation when previewing a weapon with unique animation in the Auction House has been fixed.[/*]
[/list]
[*]The average price of Sewing Patterns, Blacksmith Manuals, and Shamala's Transformation Medal are now individually calculated according to the individual kind of Sewing Pattern, Blacksmith Manual, or Shamala's Transformation Medal item.[/*]
[list]
[*]With the above change, the average selling price of Sewing Patterns, Blacksmith Manuals, and Shamala's Transformation Medal has been reset.[/*]
[/list]
[/list]
[h2][u]Shadow Missions[/u][/h2]
[list]
[*]When receiving an Elite Shadow Mission, a menu will show a list of all Elite Pass items available for use in the inventory.[/*]
[list]
[*]Items with an expiration timer will be listed first, depending on which pass expires first.[/*]
[*]The number of passes owned won't matter.[/*]
[/list]
[*]Daily Shadow Missions now start at the same time when you first log in.[/*]
[list]
[*]The day will reset at 7:00 AM server time.[/*]
[/list]
[*]Any daily Shadow Missions from the previous day are now automatically cancelled if you did not complete them before the reset.[/*]
[*]The time requirement for when these Daily Shadow Missions can be completed has been removed.[/*]
[*]A change has been made to prevent Daily Shadow Missions from being forfeited.[/*]
[*]You cannot start the Daily Shadow Mission of that day if you have a previous quest that can be completed.[/*]
[list]
[*]You must complete the quest and log in again or change channels to start the quest of that day.[/*]
[/list]
[/list]
[h2][u]Dressing Room[/u][/h2]
[list]
[*]You can now preview items that are not collected in the Dressing Room. These items will be previewed in random colors each time you preview them.[/*]
[list]
[*]Some wings are not currently available for preview, including some dyeable wings.[/*]
[/list]
[*]There is now a feature in the Dressing Room that shows if you currently have the needed Beauty Coupon in your inventory for Hair, Eyes, Face, and Mouth styles when hovering over a style.[/*]
[/list]
[h2][u]UI Improvements[/u][/h2]
[list]
[*]Favorite 1st and 2nd Titles can be added/removed by right-clicking the title in the Title menu. Favorites are signified by a star icon.[/*]
[*]The "Keep Equipped Equipment" option is checked by default during rebirth. Additionally, any titles that were equipped before rebirthing are retained if you rebirth using this option.[/*]
[*]When attempting to enter a Homestead shortly after combat, a pop-up window will now display the amount of time you must wait before entering.[/*]
[*]The max auto-craft quantity for items created with the following Production skills have been increased to 100. Please note that special items that can only be crafted 1 at a time has not been increased.[/*]
[list]
[*]Weaving[/*]
[*]Handicraft[/*]
[*]Refining[/*]
[*]Potion Making[/*]
[*]Carpentry[/*]
[*]Hillwen Engineering[/*]
[*]Magic Crafting[/*]
[*]Fynn Crafting[/*]
[*]Milling[/*]
[*]Theatre Mission Pass Crafting[/*]
[/list]
[*]There is now a "Status List" menu to view all active status effects for the character.[/*]
[list]
[*]This menu can be opened by clicking on "Details" in the Character Info menu.[/*]
[*]The remaining duration for any status effect with a time limit can also be viewed in the Status List.[/*]
[/list]
[*]Improvements have been made to the recipe search function in the Production skill menu.[/*]
[/list]
[h2][u]Party Board[/u][/h2]
[list]
[*]The party board now displays the party's name..[/*]
[*]A party created for the Mini-game Mafia can now be registered to the Party Board.[/*]
[*]You can now sort the party list by clicking on the Party Name, Party Leader, Party Goal, Detailed Items, Restrictions, Members, or Features tab of the Party Board.[/*]
[*]The Party Board tooltip will now display if a member of the party has a title with a Party EXP increase effect.[/*]
[list]
[*]The tooltip will also display if the Grandmaster Cleric Unique Effect is activated.[/*]
[/list]
[/list]
[h2][u]Options Improvement[/u][/h2]
[list]
[*]There is now an on/off option for game sounds to play even when the game screen is not active.[/*]
[list]
[*]You can toggle this option by going to Options -> System -> Sound.[/*]
[/list]
[*]There is now a "Borderless Full Screen" mode.[/*]
[list]
[*]You can set this mode by going to Options -> System -> Screen.[/*]
[/list]
[*]The "Full Screen" button has been removed from the System menu.[/*]
[list]
[*]Pressing the Left Alt + Enter buttons in windowed mode will now switch to borderless full screen mode.[/*]
[/list]
[/list]
[h2][u]Bank[/u][/h2]
[list]
[*]The Bank inventory window will now display above your inventory when you access the Bank.[/*]
[*]Bank items can now be freely moved, similar to bags, as long as there is space available.[/*]
[/list]
[h2][u]NPC Shops[/u][/h2]
[list]
[*]You can now select the quantity of individual items in a NPC shop.[/*]
[*]There is now a "Repurchase" tab in all NPC Shops. Items sold to a NPC shop can be repurchased for the price it was sold at.[/*]
[list]
[*][u]Only up to 10 items, starting from the ones you sold recently, can be repurchased.[/u][/*]
[*]When you log out or move channels, the list of repurchasable items is reset.[/*]
[*]You cannot repurchase items that have a Shop Sales Bonus or Exploration EXP.[/*]
[*]You cannot repurchase items that are exempt from Bank fees.[/*]
[/list]
[*]Items with the enchants that give you extra gold when selling, cannot be repurchased.[/*]
[/list]
[h2][u]Traveler's Guide[/u][/h2]
[list]
[*]The Traveler's Guide search function has been improved with the following changes:[/*]
[list]
[*]You can now search without needing to add a space.[/*]
[*]You can now search by typing a single letter.[/*]
[/list]
[/list]
[h2][u]Friend's List[/u][/h2]
[list]
[*]New options have been added to the Friend's list for notifications:[/*]
[list]
[*]You can now set the use of Offline Groups for your friend's list via Friend's List -> Options.[/*]
[*]You can now toggle guild member login notifications on/off via Friend's List -> Options.[/*]
[*]You can now set an alert for unread notes when logging in via Friend's List -> Options.[/*]
[/list]
[/list]
[h2][u]Graphics[/u][/h2]
[list]
[*]Characters will no longer appear semi-transparent while in Screenshot Mode.[/*]
[*]Resolution settings are now based on the monitor in use.[/*]
[list]
[*]4K and Ultrawide (21:9) resolution is now supported.[/*]
[*]The "Widescreen support" option has been removed.[/*]
[/list]
[/list]
[h2][u]Other[/u][/h2]
[list]
[*]In-game video clips now sync with your BGM volume option.[/*]
[*]Screenshot filenames will now be saved with the year, month, day, hour, and minutes.[/*]
[list]
[*]Hours are displayed in the 24-hour format.[/*]
[/list]
[/list]

[h2]New Updates:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Happy anniversary, Milletians! Celebrate the 12th Anniversary of Mabinogi with wondrous festivities and earn fabulous rewards! Check the [url=http://mabinogi.nexon.net/News/All/1/00JIX/]event page[/url] for in-depth details!
[*] Lorna in Festia will help guide you through The Start of a New Festival!
[*] Complete the [Guide] Mysterious Magical Book to earn 12th Anniversary coins and prize tickets as well as passes to enter the returning event, the Cave of Trials.
[*] Conquer the waves of enemies within the Cave of Trials to receive prizes and event titles celebrating your achievements! The title rewards will replace your existing Cave of Trials titles if you've been through the scenario previously.
[*] Take on daily and weekly quests to prepare the town for the festival! You'll be rewarded with EXP, 12th Anniversary coins, and more!
[*] Locate the Suspicious Milletian in a Strange Land to begin the hunt for Developer's 12th Anniversary Thank-You Notes, which can be used in several different ways.
[*] Talk to the Culinary Artist in Storybook Tir Chonaill to Feed the Hungry Pinky. You'll receive coins and prize tickets as thanks!
[*] Receive 12th Anniversary Festival Gift Box every day for logging in for 36 minutes! There are additional special anniversary rewards for logging in on weekends.
[*] Use gold or 12th Anniversary Instant Prize Tickets from the different events at the Prize Ball Box in Storybook Tir Chonaill! There are super special limited prizes for some lucky Milletians!
[*] Speak to the Chief in Storybook Tir Chonaill to exchange your 12th Anniversary Coins for special prizes!
[*] The RGB tooltip feature has been added, allowing you to see the RGB (red, green, blue) values of individual item piece sections when hovering over them with your cursor.
[*] The following items will gain the ability to be dropped or destroyed:
[*] Girgashiy Slayer Title Coupon
[*] Girgashiy Eradicator Title Coupon
[*] Girgashiy Challenger Title Coupon
[/list]

[h2]The following bug fixes and changes have been made to the game:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Removed the temporary restriction on in-game character and pet creation for duplicate names blocked by the server merge
[*] Graphic issues with Solaris items from the Glimmering Wonders of Nature Box have been fixed
[*] Graphic issues with Romantic Flight have been fixed
[*] Updated the character name word filter, removing some unnecessary words
[*] Dialogue text correction for the Red Mask Phantom in G24
[*] Dialogue text correction during the quest Things that go Bump in the Night
[*] Dialogue text correction during the Shadow Mission Rebound
[*] Tooltip clarification on the item Forgetful Potion on usage limitation
[/list]

[h2]The following are known bugs:[/h2]

[list]
[*] The Death Herald Scythe Appearance Scroll makes a character appear to float.
[*] The White Pet Collar Defense incorrectly states "Defense Rate".
[*] Kaour & Logan Balloons cannot be listed in the Auction House.
[*] There is a known bug where some items do not display their RGB Code properly. We are working on a fix to be deployed in a future patch.
[*] 
[/list]

[b]Spirit Ascension[/b]:
[list][*]Check out the microsite, [url=http://mabinogi.nexon.net/micro-site/ascension/spirit]Spirit Ascension[/url], for more details![/*]  [list]  [*]Spirits can now be matched with any weapon type of your choice.[/*]  [*]More weapons are available to convert into Spirit Weapons including lances, chain blade, dual guns, and more![/*]   [*]You can now have up to 3 Spirit Weapons per character.[/*]  [*]Previously upgraded or enhanced weapons can still become Spirit Weapons.[/*]  [*]You can upgrade and repair Spirit Weapons at any Weapon Shop.[/*]  [*]There is a new Spirit Weapon menu.[/*]	  	[list]  [*]To access the new Spirit Weapon menu:[/*]	  	[list]	[*]Go to the bottom menu and select the Pet/Spirit icon.[/*]	[*]Click on the Spirit tab to access the new menu.[/*]	[*]You can also use the hotkey "/" to access the menu.[/*]	[*]You can use the menu to see information on your Spirit Weapons, enhance your Spirit Weapons, feed them, and even chat with them! [/*]        [/list]			[/list][*]You can also use the Interaction Crafter to create new Spirit Interactions.[/*][/list][/list]

notes.title: Memento Update
notes.notes:
The bards encamped by Abb Neagh Lake have stumbled across something: music, an unfamiliar sound from an unfamiliar instrument, drifting over the water, stirring their curiosity. Help them meet a strange young girl in the surreal new adventure in the land of Erinn: Memento!


[img]http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/26/00J56-00c9cee9-d5c1-4be8-862b-11a9af7b5017.jpg[/img]

[b]New Storyline: Memento[/b]

The music drifts over the lake at night. Those that have gone to look have found no one behind the enchanting bells, ringing and ringing as midnight passes by. The bard Yvona, out of curiosity, or perhaps just a desire to have her rest go undisturbed, seeks out help to find out what is behind the strange sounds in the night sky...

[img]http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/26/00J56-b843a58c-0b8c-4842-a506-beec554be663.jpg[/img]

Characters with a cumulative level of 500 or higher will be given a quest to meet with Yvona on the banks of Abb Neagh Lake, to begin the Memento storyline. 

[b]New Dungeons: Sidhe Finnachaid[/b]

The Memento Update brings us a new dungeon, Sidhe Finnachaid, sitting beneath the waters of Abb Neagh Lake. This dungeon has a special twist: Every time you enter the dungeon, your party leader will be able to select a version of the dungeon to battle in: Sorrow, Fear and Curiosity, each with a different Water Level, different foes to defeat and different rewards to claim.

[img]http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/26/00J56-8de88326-c67b-48e3-a356-1e984f2f805f.jpg[/img]

Complete the Dungeon and you'll find a special bonus at the end. Sidhe Finnachaid may seem like just an ordinary dungeon (with an extraordinary disregard for the laws of physics), but it's the only place you'll find the brand new Echostones

[b]Echostones[/b]

Echostonesare a brand new collection of power-boosting items that you'll only find in Sidhe Finnachaid. Equipped in the new Echostone section of the inventory, each stone will grant a boost to a primary stat or your Heath, Mana and SP pool, even beyond the 1500 point stat cap. But while you can Upgrade your Echostonesat the end of each Sidhe Finnachaid run, there's far more power to unlock here...

[img]http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/26/00J56-1ea1b9e4-3320-45e0-b715-8c72839182a2.jpg[/img]

At the end of Sidhe Finnachaid, you'll also be able to Awaken an Echostone by spending AP and Awakening materials collected throughout Sidhe Finnachaid. Awaken an Echostone to give it additional effects, including ones that can be found via Reforging and a special set of new abilities to grow your power even further. And if you don't like an existing Echostone's power, you can dismantle Echostones, granting Echostone Catalysts, Magic Powders and random items, including Elite Passes, gems, equipment and more.

[b]New Skill: Dance of Death[/b]

Finish the quest, "So That You Are Not a Memory", in the Memento storyline to learn the brand new Dance of Death Skill! This skill allows you to move freely while busting a move, causing damage to enemies around you. If doing Ballet with floating hearts isn't your thing, then you can switch to different moods and themes, which you can obtain in the new Sidhe Finnachaid dungeon, by clicking the Manage Button next to the skill. The harder the difficulty, then there is a higher chance for the different Moods and Themes to drop.

Dance of Death is located under the Music Talent Tab.


[b]Memento Events[/b]

[url=http://mabinogi.nexon.net/News/All/1/00J5H/][img]http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/26/00J5H-df3c846d-0dbd-4b16-8744-9cee4b687288.jpg[/img][/url]

Memento has arrived, and we're celebrating the update with a slate of bonuses and giveaways to make your experience in Sidhe Finnachaid even better! Earn double EXP this weekend, get through the storyline for a special new title, earn AP potions every day and claim special prizes for the next three weeks.

Check out the full details in the [url=http://mabinogi.nexon.net/News/All/1/00J5H/]Memento Events post[/url].

[b]Additional Changes[/b]
[list][*]Gold Rewards for the quest "Conflict! An Unexpected Battle" have been greatly reduced:
- Basic: 1,200 Gold (was 4,900 Gold)
- Int.: 1,680 Gold (was 6,860 Gold)
- Adv.: 2,400 Gold (was 9,800 Gold)
- Hard: 3,600 Gold (was 14,700 Gold)
- Elite: 4,800 Gold (was 19,600 Gold)[/list]
